notesStmt.note:
MUKTABODHA INDOLOGICAL RESEARCH INSTITUTEUse of this material (e-texts) is covered by Creative Commons license BY-NC 4.0. Catalog number : M00292 Uniform title: mantrakoṣa Author : āśāditya tripāṭhi Manuscript : NGMCP 5-470 reel number: A 169/8 Description: The Mantrakoṣa - A Treasure Chest of Mantra - is as its name suggests a collection of Mantras and matters dealing with their recitation in the context of ritual. This late work was written by a certain āśāditya tripāṭhi. He draws his material from several source like the Prapaṃcasāratantra which he sometimes names. The text comprises sixteen chapters. He announces at the beginning of each chapter (pariccheda) the subject he is going to expound. This is listed first followed by the names of the chapters. They are as follows:
1) pūjāphalakathanam ||
2) atha pūjādravyaparibhāṣā || pūjāphalakathanam
3) atha pūjopacārāḥ || puṣpādhyāyaḥ
4) atha dhūpāḥ || pūjādravyakathanam
5) atha dīkṣā || dīkṣāsaṃkṣepakathanam
6) atha guruśiṣyayogyatāparīkṣā || maṃtramelanam
7) atha bhūtaśuddhiḥ || bhūtaśuddhikathanam
8) atha mātṛkānyāsaḥ || mātṛkānyāsaḥ
9) atha sārasvatamaṃtrāḥ || sārasvatamaṃtrakathanam
10) atha śrīmaṃtrāḥ || ādityamaṃtrakathanam
11) atha gaṇapati maṃtrāḥ || gaṇapatimaṃtrakathana.
12) atha śaivamaṃtrāḥ || nṛsiṃhamaṃtrakathanam
13) paṃcāyatanamaṃtrakathanānaṃtaraṃ nānāmaṃtrā ucyante ||
tatrādau gāyatrīvidhānaṃ likhyate || nānāmaṃtrakathanam
14) athāgneyāstraṃ likhāmaḥ | astrādimaṃtrakathanam
15) atha yaṃtre vaktavye pūrvaṃ homīyadravyaparibhāṣā likhyate || yantrakathanam
16) atha devapūjādau upayuktā mudrā likhyante | Notes: Revision 0: December 17, 2013 Publication country : India

text.body:
<1a>
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
praṇamya sūryaṃ vighneśaṃ śivaṃ durgāṃ hariṃ kramāt | prakaṭīkṛtya sanmaṃtrān vakṣye sāṃgānsugopitān ||
āgameṣu mayā jñātāḥ prayogāgurvanugrahāt | pūjā mātraṃ tathāppatralikhyategraṃtha gauravāt ||
viṃśatsaṃkhyā paricchede maṃtrakoṣena dūṣitāḥ | ye maṃtrāstetralikhyaṃte pūjādi phalapūrvakāḥ ||
prathame tu paricchede pūjāphala manukramāt | liṃgapūjā viśeṣaśca devādhāra vivecanaṃ ||
śalagrāmaphalaṃ caiva tatparīkṣādikaṃ tathā | dvitīyetvarcanadravyaṃ paribhāṣā vidhikramaḥ ||
vastrādi rūpakathanasadhikārinirūpaṇaṃ | pātralakṣaṇaṃ marghyaṃ ca snānapātrādikaṃ tathā ||
pūjādravyavihīne ca pūjane'niṣṭabhāgitā | viśeṣapātradānena viśeṣaphalabhāgitā ||
ghṛtādi snānajaṃ puṇyaṃ sūryādīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ | pūjopakaraṇaṃ ceti likhyate tatsamāsataḥ ||
tṛtīye'nulepanaṃ proktaṃ grāhyāgrāhyaṃ ca puṣpakaṃ | sūryādīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sāmānyakusumāni ca ||
caturthe dhūpadīpādi vastrālaṃkaraṇādikaṃ | paṃcame maṃtradīkṣā ca ṣaṣṭhe tu guruśiṣyayoḥ ||
<1b>
parīkṣāmelanaṃ caiva maṃtrāṇām ṛjumārgataḥ | saptame bhūtaśuddhiśca vyāsataśca samāsataḥ ||
aṣṭame mātṛkānyāsaḥ keśavādi prabhedataḥ | navame sarasvatī maṃtrādaśameśrīranukramaḥ ||
ekādaśeravermaṃtrādvādaśe vaidyarājikāḥ | trayodaśe ca śaivāḥ syurdaurgāścāpi caturdaśe ||
vaiṣṇavāḥ paṃcadaśake nārasiṃhāstu ṣoḍaśe | nānāmaṃtrāḥ saptadaśe'ṣṭādaśettānikānicit ||
ekonaviṃśeyaṃtrāṇiviṃśe mudrākṣamālikā | evaṃ kramānukathane namo honveṣaṇeṃ bhavet ||
na koṣāt sugamopāyomaṃtrārṇava vilaṃghane | na maṃtrāt sugamo pāyo bhavārṇava vilaṃghane ||
vinyayajñaṃ vinātīrthaṃ vinādānaṃ vinātapaḥ | svargādidevaṃ pūjāyāṃ japadhyānāṃvu puṣpataḥ ||
anekāyāsavittaiśca svargaḥ sādhyo mahājanaiḥ | sa eva sādhyate lokairmaṃtramātreṇa pūjanāt ||
tasmāt kaliyuge ghore dhanavidyāṃ vivarjitāḥ | narāḥ kurutaṃ devānāmarcanaṃ śraddhayānvitāḥ ||
evaṃ puṣpādināpi devapūjāṃ kartumasamartha | śvettadā maṃtrajapenaiva sādhayati svargādikaṃ ||
tathā coktaṃ manunā |
<2a>
japyenaiva tu saṃsiddhodbrāhmaṇo nātra saṃśayaḥ | kuryādanānnavā kuryānmaitro brāhmaṇa ucyate ||
brāhmaṇa utyupalakṣaṇaṃ | kiṃtu yatra yasyādhikārastattanmaṃtraṃ japet | tasya tenaiva saṃsiddhiriti uktaṃ ca bharate |
āyuṣyaṃdhanaṃ putrāṁśca paśūn vidyāṃ mahadyaśaḥ | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṁśca labhate vai japannaraḥ ||
japecedālasyaṃ bhavati tadā dhyāne naiva devatā varaṃ dadāti | tathā ca dhyānena munayaḥ sarve parāṃsiddhimavāpnuyuriti | tacca dhyānaṃ dvividhaṃ saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ ceti | nirguṇaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ kāryaṃ saguṇamāgamokta maṃtrapūtaṃ gṛhasthaiḥ kāryaṃ | te'tra maṃtrālikhyaṃte | vanyapuṣpapūjādi mātreṇa kathaṃ svargādi siddhiritpāṃśaṃkāyāṃ pramāṇavacanāni likhyaṃte | prathamataḥ prayojanamanuddiśya namaṃdopi pravartate iti nyāyāt | tathā ca matsyapurāṇe |
yastu saṃpūjayennityaṃ devatāṃ niyateṃdriyaḥ | bhaktibhāva samāyuktaḥ sopi gacchetya saṃgatiṃ ||
kālikāpurāṇe |
śivaṃ bhāskaramagniṃ ca keśavaṃ kauśikīmapi | manasā'narcayan yāti devalokā dadhogatiṃ ||
<2b>
manasā śraddhayā anarcayan |
atha vā manasāpyanarcayan ityāvaśyakapūjoktiratiṣṭa sravaṇāt | kauśikīdurgā | atra pāṭha krameṇa pūjākramo navoddhavyaḥ | yataḥ pūrvaṃ sūryapūjāśeṣeṇa devapūjeti śiṣṭācāro dṛśyate ||
bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
yaḥ pradadyādgavāṃ lakṣaṃ dogdhrīṇāṃ vedapārage | ekāhamarcayedbhānuṃ tasya puṇyaṃ tatodhikaṃ ||
sāmānyatopi devārcane gopradānaphalaṃ bhavati vādhikaṃ |
tathā ca yājñavalkyaḥ |
śrāṃtasaṃvāhanaṃreṇi paricaryā surārcanaṃ | viprapādodakecchiṣṭamārjanaṃ gopradānavat ||
harināthanivaṃdhādau kvacidevaṃ pāṭhaḥ |
yaḥ pradadyādgavāṃ lakṣaṃ yegdhrīṇāṃ vedapārage | ekāhamarcayedbhānuṃ śivaṃ vāpyatha keśavaṃ ||
bhaveccaiva naraśreṣṭha tasya puṇyaṃ tatodhikaṃ | aśvamedha sahasrāṇi vājapeya śatāni ca ||
sūryasyārcārcanasyaite kalānāṃrhati ṣoḍaśīṃ |
arcā pratimā |
tathā sadāyajaṃti yajñena dānaṃ dadati te sadā | sadā te vāyubhakṣāścayercayaṃti divākarā tathā ||
ye'rcayaṃti mahātmānaṃ vighnarājaṃ sadānarāḥ | teṣāṃ sarvasamṛddhiśca sarvasiddhiśca jāyate ||
surārcāṃ lakṣaṇairhīnāṃ yastu pūjayate naraḥ |
<3a>
tasyānnaṃ nābhinaṃdaṃti tasmāttāṃ parivarjayet ||
ityaniṣṭāṃ śravaṇātsalakṣaṇā pūjayet | lakṣaṇaṃ tu graṃthagauravabhayānnalikhitaṃ ||
skaṃdapurāṇe |
aśvamedha sahasrāṇi rājasūya śatāni ca | maheśārcanaṃ puṇyasyakalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīṃ ||
yāvannābhyeti maraṇaṃ yāvannābhyeti tejasa | yāvanneṃdriyavaikalyaṃtāvadevārcayeśvaraṃ ||
bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
yena rānārcayaṃtīha śivaṃ tribhuvaneśvaraṃ | na te svargasya mokṣasya rājyasyāpi na bhājanaṃ ||
varaṃ prāṇaparityāgaḥ śiraso vāpi kartanaṃ | natva saṃpūjya bhūṃjīta bhagavaṃtaṃ trilocanaṃ ||
sphuṭaṃ nirvahate yasya yāvajjīvaṃ śivārcanaṃ | manuṣya carmaṇānaddhaḥ sa rudro nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
ākāśaṃ liṃgamityāhuḥ pṛthivī tasyapīṭhikā | ālayaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ layanālliṃga mucyate ||
arcāyāṃ pūjayedyomāṃ viṣṇurbhavati pūjitaḥ | arcitā mūrtayaḥ sarvāyomeliṃgaṃ samarcayet ||
liṃgapurāṇe |
liṃgepi pūjite sarvamarcitaṃ syāccarācaraṃ | tasmāttadarcanaṃ kāryaṃ liṃgasya sumahātmabhiḥ ||
anekajanmasāhasraṃ bhrāmyamānastu yoniṣu | kathaṃ māpnoti vai muktiṃ śivaliṃgārcanaṃ vinā ||
<3b>
sarveṃdriya prasaktopi yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ | sopi yāti śivaṃ deviliṃgaṃ yorcayatīhame ||
arcāyāṃ arcayedyomāṃ pūrṇamaṣṭaśataṃ naraḥ | ekaṃ ca divasaṃ liṃge samametanna saṃśayaḥ ||
bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
yaḥ kṛtvā pārthivaṃ liṃgaṃ pūjayecchubhavedikaṃ | ihaiva dhanavān śrīmānaṃ te rudrastu jāyate ||
śubhavedikaṃ śobhanavedikāyuktaṃ |
brahmapurāṇe |
haro maheśvaraścaiva śūlapāṇiḥ pinākadhṛk | paśupatiḥ śivaśceti kṣamasveti visarjanaṃ ||
mṛdāharaṇa saṃghaṭṭa pratiṣṭhāhvānameva ca | snapanaṃ pūjanaṃ caiva kṣamasveti visarjanaṃ ||
oṃ harāya namaḥ mṛdamāharāmi || <1> || oṃ maheśvarāya namaḥ mṛdaṃ saṃghaṭṭayāmi || <2> || oṃ śūlapāṇaye namaḥ mṛdaṃ pratiṣṭayāmi || <3> || oṃ pinākadhṛgenamaḥ mṛdiśivamāvāhayāmi || <4> || oṃ paśupataye namaḥ pādyādikaṃ snapanaṃ kuryāt || <5> || oṃ śivāya namaḥ | iti pūjayet || <6> || iti pūjākramaḥ || uktaṃ cāgame | pārthivaṃ siddhidamiti |
trisaṃdhyaṃ pūjayelliṃgaṃ kṛtvā viṃvena pārthivaṃ | daśaikādaśikaṃ yāvat tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
anenaiva svadehena rudraḥ saṃjāyate kṣitau | pāpahā sarvamartyānāṃ darśanāt sparśanādapi ||
tathā apyāmalakamātraṃ tu liṃgaṃ kṛtvābhi pūjya ca |
<4a>
hiraṇmayaṃ ratnamayaṃ śivaloke mahīyate ||
mṛdbhasmagosakṛtpiṃḍatāmrakāṃsyamayaṃ ca vā | kṛtvā liṃgaṃ sakṛtpūjyavaset kalpāyutaṃdivi ||
devīpurāṇe |
vārkṣyaṃ vittapradaṃ liṃgaṃ sphāṭikaṃ sarvakāmadaṃ | tathā narmadāgirijaṃ śreṣṭhamanyadvāpi hi liṃgavat ||
kṛtvā pūjayavipreṃdraprākṣyase cepsitaṃ phalaṃ | vārkṣyaṃ śubhavṛkṣasaṃbhavaṃ | anyadvā śailāṃtarajamapi liṃgavat | tatra sarvatra liṃgaṃ karkaśamapi kṣudramapi sthūlaṃ cipiṭakākāraṃ piṃḍikā viṣamavarṇaṃ | vyaṃgaṃ vyaṃgapiṃḍakaṃ | mānonmānahīnaṃ | mānonmānahīnapiṃḍikācana pūjyaṃ | vāṇaliṃgaṃ ca kapilaṃ niṣiddhaṃ | pakvajaṃvūphalābhaṃ na niṣiddhaṃ | sānaṃ yathā liṃgamastakavistāro liṃgocchrāya samobhavet | dviguṇaḥ pariṇāhaḥ syāttadvatpiṃḍī vyavasthitā | piṃḍikāyā uparibhāgo'dhobhāgaścoccatvaṃ ca liṃgātpraṇālikā ca samā eva |
brahmapurāṇe |
varṇakaiḥ sitaraktaiśca apyaṃgulyāpiyo likhet | likhitvā pūjayedyastu bhavetsopi gaṇeśvaraḥ ||
pāṃśunākrīḍamānopi liṃgaṃ kuryāttuyonaraḥ | puṇyāt sa labhate rājya sa sapattnaṃ sakaṃṭakaṃ ||
atha devī pūjāphalaṃ |
bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
<4b>
agnihotrādikaṃ karmavedā yajñāḥ sa dakṣiṇāḥ | caṃḍikārcārcanasyaitelakṣāṃśenāpino samāḥ ||
tathānyaḥ sadā pūjayeddurgāṃ praṇamedvāpi bhārata |
sa yogī sa munirdhīmān tasya muktiḥ karesthitā | tathā sa dātā sa muniryaṣṭā sa tapasvī sa tīrthagaḥ ||
yaḥ sadā pūjayeddurgāṃ puṣpagaṃdhānulepanaiḥ ityādi ||
atha viṣṇupūjāphalaṃ || uktaṃ ca viṣṇupurāṇe |
bhaumānmanorathānsvargaṃ svargivaṃdyaṃ tathā spadaṃ | prāpnotyārādhite viṣṇau manasā padyadicchati ityārādhanaphalaṃ ||
na tu pūjāmātrasya | aihikān putrādīn | svargivaṃdyaṃ idratvarūpaṃ | yadyapi viṣṇupūjāphalamaihikaṃ na dṛśyate tathāpyānuṣaṃgikaṃ jñeyaṃ |
narasiṃhapurāṇe |
arcanaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi devadevasya cakriṇaḥ | yatkṛtvā munayaḥ sarve parāṃ siddhimitogataḥ ||
narasiṃhapūjāyāṃ ca |
yastu pūjayate nityaṃ narasiṃhaṃ surottamaṃ | sasvargamokṣabhāgī syānnātra kāryāvicāraṇā ||
tasmādekamanā bhūtvā yāvajjīvaṃ pratijñayā | arcanānnarasiṃhasya saṃprāpnotyabhivāṃchitaṃ ||
narasiṃhapurāṇe |
narake pacyamānasya yamena paribhāṣitaṃ | kiṃtvayānārcito devaḥ keśavaḥ kleśanāśanaḥ ||
alābhe proktadravyāṇāmudakenāpinārcitaḥ |
yogayājñavalkyopi |
viṣṇurbrahmā ca rudraśca viṣṇurdevodivākaraḥ |
tasmāt pūjyatamaṃnānyamahaṃmanye janārdanāt ityādi vacanādviṣṇu pūjā nityā avaśyaṃ kartavyā bhavati raktaṃ ca viṣṇu smṛtyāṃ nityasnānavidhyaṃtaraṃ |
<5a>
atha su snātaḥ su prakṣālitapāṇipādaḥ svācāṃto devārcāyāṃ sthale vā bhagavaṃtamanādinidhanaṃ vāsudevaṃ pūjayediti tadaṃte vaiśvadevaṃ vidhirevokta iti ||
sūryapūjānaṃtaraṃ narasiṃhapurāṇamapi | jalāddevaṃ namaskṛtya tato gṛhapatiḥ punaḥ ||
vidhinā brahmasūktasya tato viṣṇuṃ samarcayet | vaiśvadevaṃ tataḥ kuryādvalikarma yathāvidhi ||
ityādi vacanaparyālocana yā viṣṇu pūjānaṃtaraṃ vaiśvadevikamiti viṣṇupūjānityā ||
atha devādhārāḥ | aśvagnau hṛdaye sūryesthaṃḍile pratimāsu ca | ṣaṭveteṣu hareḥ samyagarcanaṃ sūribhismṛtamiti ṣaṭsthānāni śreṣṭhāni | anyatrāpi śālagrāmādau pūjāphalamāhātmyamuktaṃ | tathā ca bhagavānāha |
hṛdikaścitpaṭekaścillekhye kaścittumānavaḥ | pūjayedya divācakre mamatejoṃśa saṃbhave ||
narasiṃhapurāṇe |
agnau kriyāvatāṃ devodividevomanīṣiṇāṃ | pratimāsvalyavuddhīnāṃ yogināṃ hṛdaye hariḥ ||
haviṣāgnaujaleṃ puṣpairjñānena hṛdaye hariṃ | arcaṃti sūrayonityaṃ dhyānena ravimaṃḍale ||
tathā coktaṃ |
dhyeyaḥ sadā savitṛmaṃḍalamadhyaṃ vartīnārāyaṇaḥ sarasijāsanasanniviṣṭaḥ | keyūravānūṃ kanakakuṃḍalavān kirīṭīhārīhiraṇmayavayurdhṛtaśaṃkhacakraḥ ||
<5b>
jalādhārādi pūjā yadyapi hareruktā tathāpyanyeṣāmapi sā vijñeyā | tathā ca śātātapaḥ |
bhūmāvapsu tathāgnau ca divisūrye ca devatāḥ | nityamannehiraṇye vā brāhmaṇeṣu ca goṣu ca ||
apsudevā manuṣyāṇāṃ dividevāmanīṣiṇāṃ | kāṣṭhaloṣṭheṣu mūrkhāṇāṃ mumukṣorātmani devatā iti | dividevāḥ saṃtīti śeṣaḥ | eteṣvādhāreṣu devatāḥ pūjyāḥ | śivasya tu jalapūjāniṣiddhā || viṣṇoḥ śālagrāmapūjāphalamadhikaṃ | brahmapurāṇottarakhaṃḍebhyaḥ pūjayeddhariṃ cakre śālagrāmasamudbhave |
aśvamedha sahasreṇa teneṣṭaṃ prativāsaraṃ sadā kāṣṭhesthito vahnirmathanāṃte prakāśate ||
yathā tathā harirvyāpī śālagrāme prapūjayet iti |
prāṇapratiṣṭhādi saṃskāraḥ śālagrāmasya nāsti tasya tatra nityatvāt |
na tathā ramate lakṣmyāṃ na tathā svepure hariḥ | śālagrāma śilācakre yathā saṃcarate sadā ||
agnihotraṃ kṛtaṃtena dattāṃ pṛthvī sa sāgarāṃ | yenārcito hariścakre śālagrāma śilodbhave ||
yaḥ punaḥ pūjayedbhaktyā śālagrāmaṃ śilāśataṃ | uṣitvā saharerloke cakravartīhaṃ jāyate ||
kāmakrodhaiḥ pralobhaiśca vyāpto yotra narādhamaḥ | sopi yāti harerlokaṃ śālagrāma śilārcanāt ||
yaḥ pūjayati goviṃdaṃ śālagrāme sadā naraḥ | āhūtasaṃplavaṃ yāvanna sa pracyavatedivaḥ ||
atha śālagrāma parīkṣā ||
brahmapurāṇa varāhapurāṇayoḥ |
dvāradeśe same cakre dṛśyetenāṃtarīyake | vāsudevaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ śuklāṃbhaścāti śobhanaḥ ||
dvecakrehyeka saṃlagne pūrvabhāge tu puṣkaraḥ |
<6a>
saṃkarṣaṇaḥ sa vijñeyo raktābhaścāti śobhanaḥ || <2> ||
pradyumnaḥ sūkṣmacakra raktapīta dīptistathaiva ca | sukhiraṃ chidravahulaṃ dīrghakāyasthayet bhavet || <3> ||
aniruddhastu nīlābhovartulaścāti śobhanaḥ | rekhātraya samāyukto devaḥ padmena lāṃchitaḥ || <4> ||
śyāmo nārāyaṇo devo nāti usvastathonnataḥ | śilādīrghasamopeto dakṣiṇe sukhiraṃ pṛthu || <5> ||
parameṣṭhī lohitābhaścakraṃ dhatte tathāṃvujaṃ | viṃvākṛtiṃ tathā pṛṣṭhe sukhiraṃ cāti puṣkalaṃ || <6> ||
kapilo narasiṃhastha pṛthu vaktreṇa śobhitaḥ | brahmacaryādhikāreṇa nānyathā pūjanaṃ bhavet || <7> ||
kṛṣṇavarṇastathā viṣṇusthūlacakreṇa śobhitaḥ | gadākṛtistathā rekhā lakṣate pṛṣṭhadeśataḥ || <8> ||
vārāhaḥ śaktiliṃgastu dvecakre viṣame sthite | iṃdranīlanibhaḥ sthūlastrirekhālāṃchitaḥ punaḥ || <9> ||
kūrmonnatastathā pṛṣṭhe vartulāvartaṃ pūritaḥ | haritaṃ varṇamādhatte kaustubhena sa cihnitaḥ || <10> ||
hayagrīvaḥ sa vijñeyo rekhā cakre samīpagāṃ | vahuviṃdu samāyuktaḥ pṛṣṭhato nīlarūpagaḥ || <11> ||
vaikuṃṭho maṇiratnābhaścakramekaṃ tahtāṃvujaṃ | dvāroparidadhadrekhāyūpākārāḥ suśobhanāḥ || <12> ||
matsyarūpaḥ sa devoyaṃ dīrgharekhā vibhūṣitaḥ | viṃdudvaya samāyuktaḥ kārśyavarṇaḥ suśobhanaḥ || <13> ||
trivikramastathā devaḥ śyāmamūrtirmahādyutiḥ | vāmapārśvegadācakre rekhācāṃsya tu dakṣiṇe || <14> ||
vartulaśkati hrasvaśca vāmanaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
<6b>
atasī puṣpasaṃkāśo viṃdunoparilāṃchitaḥ || <15> ||
sudarśanastathā devaḥ śyāmavarṇomahādyutiḥ | vāmapārśve gadācakre rekhācāsya tu dakṣiṇe || <16> ||
śrīdharaśca saṃvijñeyaścihnittovanamālayā | kadaṃvakusumākāro rekhā paṃcaka saṃyutaḥ || <17> ||
nānāvarṇastvanaṃtaḥ syānnāgabhogopacihnitaḥ | anaṃtamūrtisaṃkīrṇaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ || <18> ||
vidikṣudikṣu sarvāsu yasyorddhaṃ dṛśyate mukhaṃ | puruṣottamaḥ sa vijñeyo bhuktimukti phalapradaḥ || <19> ||
dṛśyate śikhare śṛṃgaṃ śālagrāma samudbhave | tasya yogeśvaronāmabrahmahatyāṃ vyayohati || <20> ||
dāmodarastathā madhye sthūlacakra pratiṣṭhitaḥ | dūrvābhoddāra saṃkīrṇaḥ pītarekhā samanvitaḥ || <21> ||
snigdhā siddhikarī proktā kṛśāṃkīrtikarī punaḥ | pāṃḍurāpāpadahanīpītā putraphalapradā ||
nīlāyāṃ dṛśyate lakṣmī raktāroga pradāyinī | rūkṣātūdve gadānityaṃ vaktrā dāridryadāyikā ||
kapilāharate pāpaṃ brahmacaryeṇa pūjitā | śālagrāmaśilāyāṃ tu nityaṃ sannihito hariḥ ||
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvatīrtha jalādhikaṃ | viṣamā cirakālena sādhakāya phalapradā ||
asamāstyājyā sarvatra viparīta phalapradā | śālagrāmodbhavo devoyodevodvārakodbhavaḥ ||
<7a>
ubhayoḥ saṃgamo yatra muktistatra na saṃśayaḥ | śālagrāmaśilā yatra tatra vārāṇasī sadā ||
dvārakodbhava saṃyuktā sarvatīrthamayī sadā | dvārakāśilāttu śuklavarṇā eva pūjyānānyavarṇā ||
tathā coktaṃ |
putrapautradhanādīni sukhaṃ mokṣaṃ tathāśriyaṃ | dadāti śuklavarṇā tu nāmataḥ pūjayet sadā ||
chidrā vaktrādi doṣadūṣitā dāridryadātyājyāsyāt | uktaṃ ca trikoṇāviṣamā caiva chidrā bhagnā tathaiva ca ||
arddhacaṃdrā kṛtistyājyā pūjāhīnā bhavaṃtitāḥ | vyāttamukhī cordhvamukhī viṣamāvakra cakrikā ||
ghoramūrtiranarcyāsyādgaṃbhīrāsaṃpuṭā tathā | atha dvārakāśālagrāmayoścakra parīkṣā ||
sudarśanaścaika cakro dvābhyāṃ nārāyaṇaḥ śriyā | tribhiścācyuta evāsauvaturbhistu janārdanaḥ ||
paṃcabhirvāsu devosauṣaḍbhiḥ pradyumna ucyate | saptabhirvalanadrastu cāṣṭabhiḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||
navavyūhothanavabhirdaśabhirdaśajanmakaḥ | ekādaśabhiraniruddho mādhavo dvādaśātmakaḥ ||
ataḥ paramanaṃtastu bhuktimukti phalapradaḥ ||
pratimūrtibhinnaṃbhinnaṃ phalaṃ | vahumūrti pūjane vahuphalaṃ | dvādaśaśilāpūjanamavaśyaṃ kāryāṃ |
<7b>
dṛṣṭaṃ praṇamitaṃ yena snāpitaṃ pūjitaṃ stutaṃ | yajñakoṭi samaṃ puṇyaṃgadhāṃkoṭi phalapradaṃ ||
yāyasyeṣṭā tu vai mūrtiḥ sattāṃ yatnena pūjayet | pūjite phalamāpnoti ihaloke paratraceti bhaviṣyapurāṇe ||
divāmūrtiṣu sarvāsu rātrau vahniṣu pūjayet | prāk paścimodagāsyastu prātaḥ sāyaṃ niśāsu ca ||
yathā saṃkhyaṃ maṃtraḥ tena prātaḥ pāṅmukhaḥ sāyaṃ paścimābhimukhaḥ rātrāvudaṅmukha ityarthaḥ | kiṃ ca sūryādīnāṃ dhyānasaukarya pūjāphalādhikyābhyāṃ pratimāpūjāpraśastā | śivasya tu liṃgapūjāyāṃ prāśastyaṃ ||
matsyapurāṇe |
sauvarṇī rājatī tāmrī mṛnmayī ca tathā bhavet | rītikā dhātuyuktā vā tāmrakāṃsyamayī tathā ||
śuddhadārumayī vāpi devatārcā praśasyate | aṃguṣṭaparvādārabhyavitastiryāva deva hi ||
gṛheṣu pratimākāryānādhikāśasyate budhaiḥ |
arcā pratimā || devī pratimādhikāre devīpurāṇe |
ekāṃgulaṃ samārabhya yāvacca dvādaśāṃgulaṃ | gṛheṣvarcā samākhyātā prāsādecādhikā śubhā ||
tathā na gṛhe sa jaṭāśubhā | tathā śailajā na gṛhe pūjyā | śailajā pāṣāṇajā | caturbhujā gṛhekāryā | aṣṭabhujā pratimādevī gṛhekāryā | krūrāghorā ca na gṛhekāryā | tathā ca bhayaphaladā bhavati | iti paṃcāyatana pūjāphala kathanaṃ ||
<8a>
matsyapurāṇe |
ārogyaṃ bhāskarādiccheddhanamiccheddhutāsanāt | jñānaṃ tu śaṃkarādicchenmokṣamicchejunārdanāt ||
ityādi vākyeṣu sūryādīnāṃ śīghraphaladātṛtvaṃ uktaṃ na tu phalāṃtara nivṛttiriti ||
brahmaṇopi pūjāmahāphaladā | tathā ca narasiṃhapurāṇe |
yastu pūjayate bhaktyā viriṃciṃ kamalāsanaṃ | sanākarājyamokṣāṇāṃ kṣipraṃ bhavati bhājanaṃ ||
varaṃ deha parityāgovaraṃ narakasaṃbhavaḥ | na caivā pūjyabhuṃjīta devaṃ vai padmasaṃbhavaṃ ||
[iti śrīmadāśādityatripāṭhisaṃgṛhīte maṃtrakoṣe pūjāphalakathanaṃnāma prathamaḥ paricchedaḥ] || atha pūjādravyaparibhāṣā ||
tatra viṣṇuḥ | na naktaṃ gṛhītodaṃkena devapūjāṃ kuryāditi viśeṣaḥ | vaudhāyanaḥ | paridhṛtamadhirūḍhagaṃdhaṃ sphāṭitaṃ prāvaraṇamapracalitaṃ | manuṣya saṃyuta devatrāna saṃghuṣṭhāt paridhānaśayanāsana tayā yanmanuṣyopabhuktaṃ yatkareṇanānu mṛjyā prakṣālitaṃ taddevatāyaina yujyādityarthaḥ | yasya devasya yādṛśaṃ vā saḥ kathitaṃ tādṛśaṃ tasmai dadyāt | śuklaṃ vā sarvasya viṣṇuḥ | na vāso nīlaraktaṃ āraktaṃ sūryapriyaṃ | anyopyupacāraḥ ||
<8b>
naṃdipurāṇe |
alaṃkāraṃ ca yodadyādviprāyātha surāya ca ||
sa gacchedvāruṇaṃ lokaṃ nānābharaṇabhūṣaṇaṃ | jātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ kālena bhavet dvīpapatirnṛpaḥ ||
tathā |
yajñopavītadānena surebhyo brāhmaṇaya vā | bhavedvipraścaturvedaḥ śuddhadhī nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
yastu pūjayate devān brāhmaṇo dravyalobhataḥ | mṛtvā bharataśārdūla sa yāti narakaṃ dhruvaṃ ||
devālayeṣu sarveṣu agnikāryeṣu sarvataḥ | yaḥ kuryāt dravyalobhena so'dhogatimavāpnuyāt ||
devapūjādikamiti śeṣaḥ | devīpurāṇe |
mātṛmaṃḍalavettā ca brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyopya vā | prati vā ropya vā vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā taṃtravidyadi ||
pūjāvidhau bhavecchreṣṭhona paśurnakuśīlavaḥ | nānaiṣṭhikodāṃbhiko vā pūjakaḥ procyate śubhaḥ ||
paśuratra pūjāśāstrānabhijñaḥ | kuśīlavaścāraṇaḥ | devīpurāṇe |
śuciḥ suvastradhṛk prājño maunī dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ | gatakāmobhavedvaṃdyorāgamātsaryavarjitaḥ ||
ātmānaṃ pūjayitvā tu sugaṃdhisita vā sasā | sumuhūrte yajeddevānsvakīyāsanasaṃsthitān ||
āvāhanaṃ cārghapādyaṃ hemapātreṇa dāpayet ||
atha sāmānyorghyaḥ |
raktavilvākṣataiḥ puṣpairdadhi dūrvākuśaistilaiḥ | sāmānyaḥ sarvadevānāmarghoyaṃ parikalpitaḥ ||
<9a>
abhāvāddadhi dūrvādermāna saṃparikalpayet | sumuhūrte puṇyakāle pūrvāhnādau | arghapādyādītyādiśaṣṭaḥ snānādi paṃcopacāraparaḥ | atra yathopayogaṃ pātrasthāpanaṃ | raktamiti rakta caṃdanādi gaṃdhadravyaṃ | raktaṃ kuṃkumamiti lakṣmīdharaḥ | liṃge raktaṃnecchaṃti kecana | svasvadharmāvirodhena devapūjākāryā | tathā ca |
svasvadharmaṃ parityajya catvāro brāhmaṇādayaḥ | pūjāmeva prakurvaṃti natāṃ gṛhṇaṃti devatāḥ ||
bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
arthaṃvinaivamaṃtreṇa puṇyarāśiḥ prakīrtitaḥ | syādayaṃ maṃtrayuktaścetpuṇyaṃ śataguṇottaraṃ ||
devatānāmnāpi pūjāphaladāsyāditi ||
brahmapurāṇe |
devānāṃ pratimā yatra ghṛtābhyaṃgakṣamā bhavet | palāni tasyai deyāni śraddhayā paṃcaviṃśatiḥ ||
aṣṭottaraśatapalaṃ snānedeyaṃ ca sarvadā | dvesahasre palānāṃ ca mahāsnānena saṃkhyayā ||
dātavyaṃ yena sarvāsu dikṣu niryāti tadvṛttaṃ | brahmāṃgalagnaṃ viprebhyo vaiṣṇavaṃ ca pradīyate ||
rudrāṃgalagnamagnau ca dahet sarvaṃ ca takṣaṇāt | anyebhyastvatha devebhyo yattaddīneṣu nikṣipet ||
viprebhyastvatha taddeyaṃ mātṛbhyo yanniveditaṃ |
naivedyādikamimiśeṣaḥ ||
devīpurāṇe |
pātrāṇāmādaraḥ kāryaḥ pātrāṇyevottamāni tu | valioma kriyārthaṃ hi vināpātraṃ na sidhyati ||
<9b>
tasmādyajñāṃgamityāhuḥ pātraṃ cāgryaṃ mahāmune | yasya yaccāyudhaṃ proktaṃ tasya tallāṃchanaṃ bhavet ||
ṣaṭtriṃśadaṃgulaṃ pātramuttamaṃ parikīrtitaṃ | madhyamaṃ tu tribhāgonaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ dvādaśāṃgulaṃ ||
vasvaṃgula vihīnaṃ ca na pātraṃ dhārayet kvacit | nānāvicitra rūpāṇi puṃḍarīkākṛtīni ca ||
śaṃkhaṃ nīlotpalābhāni pātrāṇi parikalpayet | vināpātreṇayaḥ kuryāt pratiṣṭhāṃ yājñikī kriyāṃ ||
viphalā jāyate sarvāvāhanādidhanāpahā ||
valihīne tu durbhikṣaṃ gaṃdhahīnetva bhāgyatā | dhūpahīne tathodvego vastrahīne dhanakṣayaḥ ||
ratnahīne priyedbhāryāvipatāke anāyakaṃ | chatrahīne hataṃ chatramavitāne nārakī bhavet ||
vedyahīne tu nāśaḥ syādātmano nagarasya vā | dīpahīne tu daurbhāgyaṃ prāpnuyāt kārakaḥ sadā ||
dakṣiṇāhīne ca tatsarvaṃ vyarthaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ | maṃtravidyā vihīne tu saṃpūrṇamapi naśyati ||
pātramaṃtra samāyuktaṃ sarvadoṣāyahaṃ bhavet | asaṃpattau tu tatsarvaṃ manasā pūjādau deyaṃ ||
tathā hemapātreṇa sarvāṇi īhitānilabhenmune | arghaṃ datvā tu raupyeṇa āyūrājyaṃ suttān labhet ||
tāmrapātreṇa saubhāgyaṃ dharmaṃ mṛnmaya saṃbhavaiḥ ||
evaṃ dārupātramṛṇmayapātrapadmapātrapalāśapātratāmrapātrasuvarṇapātra(-) raupyapātrāṇyarghasnānanaivedyavalidhūpādikāryeṣūttarottarataḥ praśastāni sarveṣāṃ bhagnapātraṃ niṣiddhaṃ |
<10a>
tāmra suvarṇaraupyaśaṃkhaśuktibhagnamapi grāhyaṃ ||
brahmovāna ||
śaṃkhasthite na toyena yaḥ snāpayati keśavaṃ | kapilāyāḥ sahasrasyaphalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
śaṃkhe tīrthodakaṃ kṛtvā yaḥ snāpayati keśavaṃ | viṃdumātreṇa dvādaśyāṃ kulānāṃ tārayecchataṃ ||
kapilāṃ kṣīramādāya śaṃkhe kṛtvā janārdanaṃ | yajñāyuta sahasrasyasnāpayitā phalaṃ labhet ||
śaṃkhalagnaṃ tu yattoyaṃ bhrāmitaṃ keśavopari | vaṃdate śirasānityaṃ gaṃgāsnānena tasya kiṃ ||
śaṃkhapātrārghadānaṃ śivavarjaṃ sarveṣāṃ kāryaṃ | viṣṇoradhikaṃ |
arghaṃ kṛtvā tu śaṃkhena yaḥ karoti pradakṣiṇaṃ | pradakṣiṇī kṛtātena saptadvīpā sa sāgarā ||
pradakṣiṇa saṃkhyā yathā |
ekaṃ caṃḍodivau saptatrīṇi dadyādgaṇeśvare | catvāri keśavo dadyācchivasyārddha pradakṣiṇaṃ ||
atha devamālyāpanayanādi ||
devamālyāpanayanaṃ devāṇarasamūhanaṃ | snāpanaṃ sarvadevānāṃ gopradānaphalaṃ smṛtaṃ ||
atha sūryasya |
tatra bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
paśyan pariharan jaṃtūnmārjanyā mṛdusūkṣmayā | śanaiḥ saṃmārjanaṃ kṛtvā cāṃdrāyaṇaphalaṃ labhet ||
yāvaṃtyaḥ pāṃśukaṇikāmajyaṃte bhāskarālaye | dinānidivitāvaṃtitiṣṭhatyastamalonaraḥ ||
yāvannī rājanaṃ kuryādarcāṇi vidhivadraveḥ | tāvadyuga sahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate ||
<10b>
nīrājanamārātrikoparibhrāmaṇaṃ ||
varṣakoṭi sahasreṇa yadrajaḥ samupārjitaṃ | ghṛtasnānena tatsarvaṃ dahatyagnirivedhanaṃ ||
saptabhyāṃ tu ghṛtasnānaṃ kṛtvā sūrye sa kṛnnaraḥ | kulānyuddhṛtya saptaiva sūryaloke mahīyate ||
evaṃ śuklāṣṭamyāmapi yathā |
saptamyāmatha vāṣṭamyāṃ gavyena payasāraveḥ | snāpanaṃ tu nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ mahāpātakanāśanaṃ ||
snāpyaṃ dadhnā sa kṛdbhānuṃ viṣṇuloke mahīyate | pitṝnuddiśyayo bhānuṃ snāpayecchītavāriṇā ||
tṛptānsvargaṃ nayatpāṃśupitaro narakādapi | bhānuṃ śītāṃvunāsnāpyadhārollapayasā tathā ||
snāpya paṃcāmṛte naiva magniloke mahīyate | etat snānatrayaṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā ca bhāskaraṃ ||
aśvamedha sahasrasyaphalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ | rasena snāpanaṃ kṛtvā aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ||
tathā |
yathā na laṃghayet kaścit snapanaṃ bhāskarasya tu | tathā kuryāt prayatnena laṃghitaṃ hyaśubhāvahaṃ ||
tāmisraṃ narakaṃ kartā laṃghayedyaḥ sa rauravaṃ |
athārghaṃ ||
caṃdanodaka misraistu datvārghaṃ kusumairaveḥ | sa putrapautralakṣmīkaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate ||
<11a>
yo'ṣṭāṃgamardyamāpūryabhāno mūrdhni nivedayet | daśavarṣa sahasrāṇi saramedarkamaṃḍale ||
āpaḥ kṣīraṃ kuśāgrāṇi ghṛtaṃ dadhi tathā madhu | raktāni karavīrāṇi tathā raktaṃ ca caṃdanaṃ ||
aṣṭāṃgamardya eṣo vai brahmaṇā parikalpitaḥ | dāraveṇārghapātreṇa datvārghaṃ yatphalaṃ labhet ||
tasmācchataṃguṇaṃ proktaṃ mṛtyātreṇa narādhipa | tāmrapātra pradānena puṇyaṃ daśaguṇaṃ tataḥ ||
palāśapadmapatrābhyāṃ tāmrapātra samaṃ bhavet | raupyapātre tu vijñeyaṃ lakṣārddhaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
suvarṇapātravinyastaṃ sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ raveḥ | evaṃ snānetha naivedye validhūpādiṣu kramāt ||
pātrāṃtara viśeṣeṇa tatphalaṃ tūttarottaraṃ |
yathā suvarṇādi pātreṇārgha dānaphalaṃ tathā snānādiṣṭvapi draṣṭavyaṃ ||
raupyapātra pradānena yatpuṇyaṃ vedapārage | tasmācchataguṇaṃ proktaṃ sūryamṛtpātradānataḥ ||
tulyameva phalaṃ proktaṃ margheṇāḍhya daridrayoḥ | vibhavesati yo mohānna kuryādvidhivistaraṃ ||
na tatphalamavāpnoti salobhākrāṃtamānasaḥ | evaṃ śivepi phalaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ ||
viśeṣastu śivasya bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
<11b>
sakṛdgavyena payasāyoliṃgaṃ snapayennaraḥ | rājate na viprānena svargaloke mahīyate ||
kalpakoṭi sahasreṇa yatpāpaṃ samupārjitaṃ | ghṛtābhyaṃgena liṃgasya dahetpāpaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ ghṛtasnānaṃ kṛtvā liṃge sakṛnnaraḥ | kulaikaviṃśamuttrarbhya śivaloke mahīyate ||
madhunā snāpayedyastu pitṛloke mahīyate | su sugaṃdhena tailena snāpanaṃ yaḥ karoti me ||
atirātraphalaṃ tasmai sa saubhāgyaṃ dadāmyahaṃ | snānakāle trisaṃdhye vā yaḥ kuryādgītavāditaṃ ||
nṛtyaṃ vā mukhavādyaṃ vā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu | yāvat padāni kurutegeya nṛtyādi vāditaṃ ||
tāvadyuga sahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate | yadyapi śivapūjane nṛtyādi phalamuktaṃ tathānyeṣāmapi pūjane tattalloka prāptirdraṣṭavyeti ||
atha viṣṇoḥ | narasiṃhapurāṇe |
datvārcana mathārghaṃ ca pādyamācamanīyakaṃ | devadevasya vidhinā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
snāpayet payasā bhaktyā narasiṃhaṃ tu yo nṛpa | sarvapāpa vinirmukto viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
snāpya dadhnā sakṛdviṣṇuṃ nirmalaḥ priyadarśanaḥ |
<12a>
viṣṇulokamavāpnoti sevyamānaḥ sudottamaiḥ ||
yaḥ karoti harerarcā snapanaṃ madhunānaraḥ | agniloke samoditvā punarviṣṇupure vaset ||
ghṛtena snapanaṃ yastu sarvaloke viśeṣataḥ | divyaṃ vimānamāsthāya viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
yavagodhūmajaiścūrṇairudvarntyoṣṇena vāriṇā | prakṣālya devadeveśaṃ sa triṇāṃlokamāpnuyāt ||
atha durgāyāḥ ||
kapilā paṃcagavyena dadhikṣīraghṛtena ca | snānaṃ śataguṇaṃ proktamitarebhyo narādhipaṃ ||
varṣakoṭiṃ sahasraistu yatpāpaṃ samupārjitaṃ | tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yātitoyeṣu lavaṇaṃ yathā ||
itarebhyaḥ itaraṃ paṃcagavyebhyaḥ ||
tathā ghṛtābhyaṃgena devyāstu śubhena vidhivannṛpa | sarvapāpa viśuddhātmā durgāloke mahīyate ||
kṣīreṇa snāpayedyastu śraddhābhaktiṃ samanvitaḥ | caṃdrikāṃ vidhivadvīra caṃdraloke mahīyate ||
snāpayedyastu vidhivaddadhnā durgāṃ mahīyate | rājate na vimānena durgāloke mahīyate ||
caṃḍikāṃ snāpayedyastu naraścekṣu rasena vai | gairikena vimānena viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
navamyāṃ śuklapakṣe tu vidhivaccaṃḍikāṃ ||
<12b>
ghṛtena snāpayedyastu tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu | daśapūrvāndaśaparānātmānaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||
bhavārṇavāt samuddhṛtya durgāloke mahīyate |
[iti śrīmaṃtrakoṣe pūjāphalakathanaṃnāmadvitīyaḥparicchedaḥ || atha pūjopacārāḥ] ||
tathā ca prapaṃcasāre |
āsanasvāgate sārdhapādye sā ca manīyake | madhuparkā ca masnānavasanābharaṇāni ca ||
sugaṃdhasumanodhūpadīpanaivedyacaṃdanāt | prayojayedarcanāyāmupacārāṁstu ṣoḍaśa ||
arghapādyā ca manamadhuparkā ca manānyapi | gaṃdhādayo nivedyāṃtā upacārādaśa kramāt ||
gaṃdhādayo nivedyāṃtā pūjāpaṃcopacārikā | saparyā trividhā proktā tāsyamekāṃ samāśrayet ||
atha gaṃdhāḥ | teṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ | atha bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
caṃdanā gurukarpūrakuṃkumaiśca sa padmakaiḥ | aluliptojanairbhaktyā dadāti paramepsitaṃ ||
padmakaiḥ padmakāṣṭhaiḥ | etat sarveṣāṃ | atha sūryasya |
yaḥ samāṃ labhate sūryaṃ caṃdanā gurukuṃkumaiḥ | karpūra vyatimisraiśca tathā kastūrikānvitaiḥ ||
samamekṛśaṃtaṃ varṣaṃ vihṛtyatridivālaye | punaḥ saṃjāyate bhūmau rājarājo na saṃśayaḥ ||
saṃvījya tālavṛṃtena śubhagaṃdhairvilepitaṃ | daśavarṣa sahasrāṇi vīramitrapurevaset ||
<13a>
evaṃ śivepi draṣṭavyaṃ ||
atha viṣṇoḥ |
narasiṃhapurāṇe |
kuṃkumāguru śrīkhaṃḍacaṃdanairacyutā kṛtiṃ | ālipyaṃ bhaktyā rājeṃdra kalpakoṭi vaseddivi ||
atha durgāyāḥ || bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
caṃdanāgurukarpūraiyastu durgāṃ pralepayet | samamekaṃśataṃ divyaṃ śakraloke mahīyate ||
gaṃdhānu lepanaṃ kṛtvā jyotiṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet | caṃdanena vilipyāryāmagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet ||
vilipyaṃ kṛṣṇāguruṇā vājapeya phalaṃ labhet | kuṃkumena vilipyāryāṃgo sahasraphalaṃ labhet ||
dadyāddevāya ca maraṃ maṇidaṃḍa vibhūṣitaṃ | hemarūpyādi daṃḍaṃ vā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
cāmaravyagrahastāgra divyastrīparivāritaḥ | mahābhogairvimānasthaściraṃ devapurevaset ||
iti sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ samaṃphalaṃ ||
atha puṣpāṇi ||
bhaviṣyapurāṇe ||
puṣpairaraṇyasaṃbhūtaiḥ patrairvāgiri saṃbhavaiḥ | aparyuṣitaniḥ kṣidraiḥ prokṣitairjaṃtu varitaiḥ ||
ātmarāmodbhavairvāpirbhaktyā saṃpūjayetsurān | kṛmikīṭāvapannāniśīrṇaparyuṣitāni ca ||
svayaṃ patita puṣpāṇityajedupahatāni ca | mukulairnārcayeddevamapakvaṃ na nivedayet ||
<13b>
phalaṃ vakṣamividdhaṃ ca prayatnāttadvivarjayet |
puṣpairaniṣiddhairavihitairapi | mukulaṃ kalikā ||
alābhena tu puṣpāṇāṃ patrāṇyapi nivedayet | patrāṇāmapyaṃ bhāve tu phalānyapi nivedayet ||
phalānāmapya bhāvena tṛṇagulmauṣadhīrapi | oṃ ṣadhīnāmalābhe tu bhaktyā bhavati pūjitaḥ ||
pratyekaṃ muktaṃ puṣpena daśasauvarṇikaṃ phalaṃ | srajobhirnṛpaṃśārdūla tadeva dviguṇaṃ bhavet ||
samitpuṣpakuśādīni brāhmaṇaḥ svayamāharet | śūdrānītaiḥ krayaḥkrītaiḥ karmakurvan patatyadhaḥ |
iti svayaṃmātṛ ca matiphaladaṃ |
aśaktau krītamapi śūdrānītamapi prokṣitaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | mahājana gṛhītatvāt ||
lakṣādi puṣpadānenyāyārjitadhanakrītamapi puṣpaṃdeyame vā tathā ca viṣṇuṃ dharmottare |
dharmārjitadhanakrītairyaḥ kuryāt keśavārcanaṃ | uddhariṣpatyasaṃdehaṃ saptapūrvāṁsūyā parān ||
tathāpi samitpuṣpakuśādīni prokṣaṇāṃta śuddhyaṃtīti manyaṃte ||
devo paridhṛtaṃ yacca vāmahaste ca yāddṛtaṃ | adhovastraṃ dhṛtaṃ yaccajale'ṃtaḥ kṣālitaṃ yat ||
devatāstanna gṛhṇaṃti puṣpaṃ nirmālyatāṃgataṃ | iti haribhaktigraṃthelikhitaṃ ||
<14a>
nityapūjārthamadattopādānamapi puṣpasya kāryaṃ | devatārthaṃ ca kusumamasteyaṃmanuravravīt iti vacanāt || hārītaḥ |
snānaṃ kṛtvā tu ye kecitpuṣpaṃ cinvaṃti vai dvijāḥ | devatāstannagṛhṇaṃti bhasmī bhavati dāruvat ||
svārthe deva pūjāma kṛtvā na gṛhṇīyāt | parārthe tu gṛhṇīyādapi | nityapūjānaṃtaraṃ ca divasāṃtara pūjārthaṃ grāhyaṃ ||
bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
nirgaṃdhīnyugragaṃdhīni kusumāni vivarjayet | gaṃdhahīnaṃmapigrāhyaṃ pavitraṃ yatkuśādikaṃ ||
praharaṃ tiṣṭhatejāṃtīkaravīra maharniśaṃ | tadupari nirmālyatāṃ yā tītyarthaḥ ||
tulasyāṃ vilvapatreṣu jalajeṣu ca sarvaśaḥ | naparyuṣitadoṣosti mālākāragṛheṣu ca ||
mudgarāṇi kadaṃvāni rātraudeyā nibhānave | kanakāni kadaṃvāni rātrau deyāni śaṃkare ||
divāśeṣāṇi puṣpāṇi divārātrau ca mallikā |
mudgarāṇi mugarāvelīti prasiddhā | deyāni grāhyāṇītyarthaḥ |
kiṃca vihitapuṣpamālāsu ca grathitaṃ niṣiddhā puṣpapatramapi na doṣāvahaṃ ||
parotyādita puṣpadānā svayamutyādita puṣpadāne cādhikaṃ phalaṃ | sāmānyavihitaṃ puṣpadānāccaviśeṣapuṣpadāne'dhikaphalatvaṃ ||
<14b>
vihita puṣpapatrābhāve ca vihita niṣiddhadānaṃ na doṣāvahaṃ || viśeṣavihita puṣpālābhe niṣiddhavihitaṃ na grāhyaṃ || iti grāhyāgrāhyasāmānyaṃvidhiḥ |
atha sūryādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ sāmānya puṣpāṇi | jātī śamīkuśāḥ kubjaṃ mallikā karavīrakaṃ ||
nāgapunnārākāśokaraktai nīlotpalāni ca | vaṃcakaṃṣakula caiva padmaṃ vilvaṃ pavitrakaṃ ||
etāni sarvadevānāṃ vihitāni samāniha | kubjakaṃku āṭi iti prasiddhaṃ mallikā velī iti prasiddhā ||
nāgaḥ nāgakesara iti | punnāgapunnāga iti prasiddhaṃ | atha sarveṣāṃ vihita niṣiddhāni | pāṭalā ca śamīpatraṃ durgāyāstu hitāhitaṃ |
kuṃdaṃ palāśakusumaṃ dūrvā ca śivapūjane | kumudaṃ kuṃkumadreṇiṃ tagaraṃ sūryapūjane ||
acchovakaḥ karṇikāraḥ kiṃkirāto harestathāṃ | kiṃkirātaḥ pītāmrāttakaḥ |
tilakaṃ mālatī vāṇastulasībhṛṃgarājakaṃ | jamulaṃ śivadurgārthaṃ niṣiddhavihitaṃ bhavet ||
tilakaṃ tilakā iti khyātaṃ |
mālatī goduma iti khyātā | kākamācī vā | jātyāḥ pṛthadupādānāt | vāṇaḥ kṛṣṇageṃṭhīti loke prasiddhā |
<15a>
āmrātaka prabhedoloke prasiddha ityanye | vāṇaḥ kaṭasarayā |
jayaḥkāśaḥ śvetapadmaṃ śvetamaṃdārakaṃ tathā | durgāyāścaiva viṣṇośca niṣiddha vihitaṃ bhavet ||
jayaḥ jayaṃtī iti khyātaṃ ||
agastirati muktā ca tirīṭaṃ ca hare harau | apāsārgasyapatraṃ hi sūryadurgāhitāhitaṃ ||
atimuktakosādhavīlatā | trīṭaṃ lodhrapuṣpaṃ ||
dhattūraḥ śiṃśayā maṃdāraścā parājitā | sūryaviṣṇorna hi hitaṃ damanaṃ śivasūryayoḥ ||
śiṃśayāti urā iti || damanaṃ śivasya caitra śuklacaturdaśyāṃ vihitaṃ anyatra niṣiddhaṃ || atha niṣiddhāni ||
bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
kṛṣṇalonmattakaṃ kāṃcī tathā ca girimallikā | na kaṃṭakārī puṣpaṃ ca tathānyadgaṃdhavarjitaṃ ||
na cāmrātakajaiḥ puṣpairarcanī yo divākaraḥ | āmrātakajairiti pāṭhe kuṭajairiti tadā vyākhyeyaṃ ||
kṛṣṇalākaraṃjī ghoṃghacī iti prasiddhā | kāṃcī vā vāhī | girikarṇikā aparājitā | kaṃṭakījavarehaṭābhāve upādeyaṃ kecittu na niṣiddhamevāhuḥ | tathā yeṣāṃ na ca niṣedhosti gaṃdhavarṇānvitāni ca |
tāni puṣpāṇi deyā nibhānave lokabhānave | etāni sarvāṇi vihitā bhāve tu pādeyāni ||
<15b>
devamullaṃ sa yedyastu tatkṣaṇāt puṣpalobhataḥ | puṣpāṇi ca sugaṃdhīni pūjakonettarāṇi ca ||
brahmahatyā madyaṃ vāpyeha pacyate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ ||
truṭimātraṃ tu yo dadyādāgneyakṛtapaṃjakaṃ | bhāskarasyottamāṃge tu tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
iṃdrasyārddhāsane tiṣṭhedyāvadiṃdrāścaturdaśa | evaṃ vittānusāreṇa phalaṃ jñeyaṃ samāsataḥ ||
anyeṣvapi jñeyamidaṃ phalaṃ || atha śivasya niṣiddhaṃ ||
tatra bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
ketakī cāti muktaśca kuṃdīyūthīmadaṃtikā | śirīṣasarja vaṃdhūka kusumāni vivarjayet ||
madaṃtikāmadayaṃtī gauḍe iti prasiddhā | yūthyanukāra puṣpa ityanye | sarjaḥśālaḥ | iṃdra taruḥ siṃdhuvāraḥ | kuṃdapuṣpaṃ varṣapūjāyāṃ māghevihitaṃ anyadā niṣiddhaṃ || tathā nirgaṃdhīnyugragaṃdhīni kusumāni vivarjayet | gaṃdhahīnamapi grāhyaṃ pavitraṃ yatkuṃśādikaṃ ||
atha durgāyāḥ | viśeṣaniṣedhonāstyeva | tatpunaruktaṃ | devīnāmarkamaṃdārau sūryasya tagaraṃ tathā | śive ca varjayet kuṃdamunmattaṃ ca harau tatheti | itaradevīnāṃ niṣiddhau na tu durgā mūrtyāḥ | karavīrārka puṣpaiśca śiṃśayaiścāparājitaiḥ iti ||
<16a>
lakṣmyāḥ droṇapuṣpamapi sāhasryāṃ niṣiddhāṃ ||
viṣṇorapi puṣpaviśeṣaniṣedhonāsti ||
uktaṃ ca viṣṇunānogragaṃdhīni puṣpāṇi nāgaṃdhinakaṃṭahvijaṃ | kaṃṭakijamapi śuklaṃ sugaṃdhaṃmapi yattaddadyāt | na raktaṃ dadyāt raktamapi kuṃkumajaṃ jalajaṃ ca dadyāt | atra jalajakuṃkumapāṭalā trisaṃdhyā karavīra pāribhadra śamīpalāśāśokakuśavarjalohitaṃ puṣpaṃ niṣiddhaṃ ||
viṣṇudharme |
kauṭajaṃ śālmalī puṣpaṃ śairīṣaṃ ca janārdane | niveditaṃ bhayaṃ rogaṃ prayacchati na saṃśayaḥ ||
krakarasya ca puṣpāṇi tathā dhattūrakasya ca | kṛṣṇaṃ ca kuṭajaṃ cārkaṃ naiva deyaṃ janārdane ||
krakaraṃ karīrakaṃ || viṣṇurahasye|
na bhuktaiḥ pūjayedviṣṇuṃ kusumairnamahīgataiḥ | na jīrṇairdalamuktairnanacai vāśuvikāśitaiḥ ||
āśuvikāśitairvalātkāravikāṃśitaiḥ |
narasiṃhapurāṇe |
tejaḥ jayeśaṃtanuṃ pratināradavākyaṃ |
ata ūrdhvaṃ nirmālyaṃ nānarcaya mahīpate | narasiṃhasya devasya tathānyeṣāṃ mahīpate ||
iti niṣiddha puṣpāṇi ||
atha vihitapuṣpapatrāṇyucyaṃte ||
tatra sūryasya |
bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
<16b>
mālatī mallikā caiva dūrvākāśoti muktakāḥ | pāṭalā karavīrāṇi jayājayaṃtireva ca ||
caṃpakorottakaḥ kuṃdovāṇāvarvara mallikā | aśokaḥ kubjakolodhrastathaiva vāṭarūṣakaḥ ||
śatapatrāṇi cānyāni vakāhvaṃka viśeṣakaḥ | agasti kiṃśukautadvatpūjārthaṃ bhāskarasya tu ||
mallikā velīti prasiddhā | pāṭalā pāḍarīti prasiddhā | atimuktako mādhavīlatāṃ | kubjako kūā | rotakoroharī | vāṇaḥ kṛṣṇageṃṭhīti prasiddhā | varvaramallikā vavarīti prasiddhā | āṭasūṣakovāsakaḥ | vṛkāhvova kula iti prasiddhaḥ || atha patrāṇi |
vilvapatraṃ śamīpatraṃ bhṛṃgarājasya patrakaṃ | tamālapatraṃ ca hareḥ sadaiva tapana priyaṃ ||
tulasīkālatulasī tathā raktaṃ ca caṃdanaṃ | ketakī patrakusumaṃ sadyastuṣṭikaraṃ raveḥ ||
aha sūryasya puṣpaviśeṣe phalaviśeṣā |
bhaviṣyapurāṇe ||
daśadatvā suvarṇasya niṣkāṇāṃ labhate phalaṃ | karavīre tathaikasminnarkopari nivedite ||
bhaktvā pūjayate cārkamarka puṣpaiḥ samāhitaḥ | tejasāsorkasaṃkāśo arkaloke mahīyate ||
japāṃ ca karavīraṃ ca vilvapatraṃ ca padmakaṃ | vakapuṣpaṃ darbhapuṣpaṃ śamīpuṣpaṃ tathotpalaṃ ||
<17a>
raktotpala sahasreṇa nīlotpala śatena ca | raktairvā karavīraiśca yastu saṃpūjayedraviṃ ||
kalpakoṭi sahasrāṇi kalpakoṭi śatāni ca | vasedarkapure śrīmānarkatulya parākramaḥ ||
śamīpuṣpaṃ vṛhatyāśca kusumaṃ tulyameva ca | karavīra samājñeyā jātī vakulapāṭalāḥ ||
śvetamaṃdāra kusumaṃsitapadmaṃ ca tatsamaṃ | nāgacaṃpakapunnāga mudgarāśca samāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
vṛhatī kaṃṭakārikā | nāgonāgakesaraḥ | mudgaraḥ vicakilaḥ vahupatra mallikā |
atha śivasya vihitapuṣpāṇi |
bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
tapaḥ śīlaguṇopeta pātre vedasya pārage | datvā suvarṇasya śataṃ tatphalaṃ kusumasya ca ||
karavīrovakaścaiva arka unmatta eva ca | pāṭalā vṛhatī caiva tathā ca girikarṇikā ||
tathā kāsasya puṣpāṇimaṃdāraṃ cāparājitā | śamīpuṣpāṇi cānyāni kubjakaḥ śikhinī tathā ||
apāmārgastathā padmaṃ samīpuṣpaṃ sa coṣaṇaṃ | caṃpakośīratagaraṃ tathā vai nāgakesaraṃ ||
puṃnāgaṃ kiṃkirātaśca droṇapuṣpaṃ tathā śubhaṃ | śiṃśayorduvaraścaiva jayāmallī tathaiva ca ||
<17b>
puṣpāṇi yajñavṛkṣasya tathā vilvaṃ priyaṃ śubhe | kusumasya ca puṣpāṇi tathā vai kaṃkatasya ca ||
nīlaṃ ca kumudaṃ caiva tathā raktotpalāni ca | surabhīṇi ca sarvāṇi sthalajānyaṃvujāni ca ||
gṛhṇāmi śirasā deviyome bhaktyāni vedayet | śikhinī curiā | vai kaṃkato vyāghrapadīṭaṃṭārīti prasiddhā ||
atha śivasya puṣpe viśeṣaphalāni ||
tatra bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
tapaḥ śīlaguṇopete pāte vedasya pārage | datvā suvarṇasya palaṃ tatphalaṃ kusumasya ca ||
arkapuṣpe tathaikasmin śivāya vinivedite | daśadatvā suvarṇasya tatphalaṃ samavāpnuyāt ||
arkaṃ ca karavīraṃ ca vilvaṃ droṇasya puṣpakaṃ | apāmārgaṃ kauśapuṣpaṃ śamīpuṣpaṃ tathaiva ca ||
ekaṃ dhattūrakaṃ caiva nīlaṃ cotpalameva ca | pūrṇapūrṇa sahasrebhyodhikaṃ syāduttarottaraṃ ||
nīlotpala sahasrasyayo mālāṃ saṃprayacchati | śivāya vidhivadbhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
kalpakoṭi sahasrāṇi kalpakoṭi śatāni ca | vasecchivapure śrīmān śivatulya parākramaḥ ||
śeṣāṇāṃ puṣpajātīnāṃ yatphala parikīrtitaṃ |
<18a>
sa tatphalānusāreṇa śivaloke mahīyate ||
karavīra samājñeyājātīvakulapāṭalāḥ | śvetamaṃdāra kusumaṃ karavīraṃ ca tatsamaṃ ||
nāgacaṃpaka puṃnāgadhattūrakasamāḥ smṛtāḥ | vilvapatrairakhaṃḍaiśca sa kṛlliṃgaṃ prapūjayet ||
sarvapāpa vinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate | dhattūrakaiścayoliṃgaṃ sakṛt pūjayate naraḥ ||
sa golakṣaphalaṃ prāpya śivaloke mahīyate | vṛhatī kusumairbhaktyāyoliṃgaṃ sakṛdarcayet ||
gavāmayutadānasya phalaṃ prāpya śivaṃ vrajet ||
atha durgāyāvihita puṣpāṇi ||
devīpurāṇe || brahmovāca ||
śṛṇu śakra pravakṣyāmi puṣpā dhyāyaṃ samāsataḥ | ṛtukālodbhavaiḥ puṣpairmallikājāti kubjakaiḥ ||
sitaraktaistathā puṣpaiḥ padmaiśca pāṃḍuraistathā | kiṃśukaistagaraiścaiva kiṃkirātaiḥ sa caṃpakaiḥ ||
vakulaiścaivamaṃdāraiḥ kuṃdapuṣpaistirīṭakaiḥ | karavīrārka puṣpaiśca śiṃśayaiścāparājitaiḥ ||
śitaraktaistathā pītaiḥ kṛṣṇaiścaiva caturvidhaiḥ | dhattūrakātimuktaiśca vaṃdhukāgasti saṃbhavaiḥ ||
damanaiḥ siṃduvāraiśca surabhirmaruvakaistathā | latābhirbrahmavṛkṣasya dūrvākāṃḍaiḥ sukomalaiḥ ||
<18b>
maṃjarīmiḥ kuśānāṃ ca vilvapatraiḥ suśobhanaiḥ | raktānvitaistathā puṣpairjalajaiḥ sthalasaṃbhavaiḥ ||
patraiḥ puṣpairyathālābhaṃ sarvauṣadhimayaiḥ śubhaiḥ | dhānyānāṃ sarvapatraiśca puṣpaiścaiva prapūjayet ||
atha tasyā eva mukhya phalāni || tatra bhaviṣyapurāṇe ||
agnihotra pare vipre vedavedāṃgapārage | suvarṇānāṃ suvarṇānāṃ śate datte tu yatphalaṃ ||
tatphalaṃ labhate rājan pūjayitvā tu caṃḍikāṃ | mālayā vilvapatrāṇāṃ na vamyāṃ guggulena ca ||
mālā vaddhena saṃpūjya durgādevīṃ narādhipa | vilvavṛkṣasya patrāṇāṃ rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet ||
karavīrasrajobhiśca pūjayedyastu caṃḍikāṃ | sogniṣṭoma phalaṃ prāpya durgāloke mahīyate ||
pūjayitvā tato bhaktvā caṃḍikāṃ padmamālayā | jyotiṣṭoma phalaṃ prāpya durgāloke mahīyate ||
vakapuṣpaisrajobhistu pūjayedyastuṃ caṃḍikāṃ | vājapeyasya yajñasya phalaṃ viṃdati mānavaḥ ||
droṇapuṣpaiḥ srajobhistu pūjayedyastu caṃḍikāṃ | rājasūyaphalaṃ prāpya śakraloke mahīyate ||
kuśapuṣpaiḥ srajobhiśca pūjayedyastu caṃḍikāṃ | sogniṣṭomaphalaṃprāpya pitṛloke mahīyate ||
śamīpuṣpasrajobhistu āryāṃ saṃpūjya śraddhayā |
<19a>
gosahasraphalaṃprāpya viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
nīlotpalasrajobhistu pūjayedyastu caṃḍikāṃ | vājapeyaphalaṃ prāpya rudraloke mahīyate ||
sarveṣānevadvevānāṃ pravalaṃ nīlamutpalaṃ | nīlotpala sahasreṇa yastu mālāṃ prayacchati ||
durgāyai vidhivadvīratasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu | varṣakoṭi sahasrāṇi varṣakoṭi śatāni ca ||
rudrasyānucaro bhūtvā śivaloke mahīyate | sugaṃdha puṣpairyo bhaktyā pūjayedyastu caṃḍikāṃ ||
mālatyā mallikā vāpi sośvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ||
atha viṣṇorvihitāni | narasiṃhapurāṇe ||
mallikā mālatī jñānīketakāśokacaṃpakaiḥ | munnāganāgavakulaiḥ padmakairutpalādibhiḥ ||
etairanyaistu kusumaiḥ praśastaṃ pūjanaṃ hareḥ | arcayedyaḥ suvarṇasya pratyekaṃ phalamāpnuyāt ||
vāmanapurāṇe |
jātīśatāhvā sumanāḥ kuṃdaṃcārupuṭastathā | vāṇaṃ ca caṃpakāśoka karavīraṃ ca yūthikā ||
pāribhadraṃ pāṭalā ca vakulaṃ giriśālinī | tilakaṃ jāsuvanajaṃpītakaṃ tagaraṃ tvapi ||
etāni hi praśastāni kusumānyacyutārcane | surabhīni tathānyāni varjayitvā tu ketakīṃ ||
<19b>
ghattūrakaṃ ketakī ca narasiṃhamūrtau vihitāni kusumāni ||
anyatreti niṣiddhāni iti kecana | śatāhvāsauṃphu iti prasiddhā | śatāvarītyeke | sumanāḥ suvarṇajātī | cārupuṭaḥ vicakila ityeke | pāribhadraḥ phala hada | jāsuvanajñaṃ japā kusumaṃ | pītakaṃ piyarī | śaṃśayā kuṣmāṃḍamapyāgame vihitaṃ | śaṃśapāti urā iti || vaṃdhūkairharibhaktiḥ syāditi haribhaktau likhitaṃ || jayaṃtī patramapi tatraiva niṣiddhaṃ || atha patrāṇi narasiṃhapurāṇe |
apāmārgasya prathamaṃ bhṛṃgarājamataḥ paraṃ | tasmāccakhādiraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śamīpatraṃ tataḥ paraṃ ||
dūrvāpatraṃ tataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ tatopi kuśapatrakaṃ | tasmāddamanakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tato vilvasya patrakaṃ ||
vilvapatrādapi harestu lasīpatramuttamaṃ | eṣāṃ caiva yathā laṅghaiḥ patrairyaścārcayeddhariṃ ||
sarvapāpa vinirmukto viṣṇuloke mahīyate | skaṃdapurāṇe |
tulasī patramekaṃ tu suvarṇapalasaṃmitaṃ | tulyaṃ bhavati rājeṃdradattaṃ keśvamūrdhani ||
na viprasadṛśaṃ pātraṃ na dānaṃ surabhīsamaṃ | na ca gaṃgāsamaṃtīrthaṃ na patraṃ tulasīsamaṃ ||
tulasīpatra lakṣeṇa kārtikeyorcayeddhariṃ | patre patre muniśreṣṭhamauktikaṃ labhate phalaṃ ||
atha viṣṇoreva puṣpaphalāni ||
<20a>
narasiṃhapurāṇe |
tapaḥśīlaguṇoyete pātre vedasya pārage | daśadatvā suvarṇāni yatphalaṃ samavāpnuyāt ||
tatphalaṃ labhate martyo hareḥ kusumadānataḥ | droṇapuṣpe tathaikasmin mādhavāya nivedite ||
daśadatvā suvarṇāni tatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ | evaṃ puṣpaviśeṣeṇa phalaṃ tadadhikaṃ nṛpa ||
evaṃ puṣpottaraṃ yena yathā syāt tannivodhame | droṇapuṣpaṃ khādiraṃ ca śamīvilvaṃvakaṃ tathā ||
naṃdyāvartaṃ karavīraṃ tathā śvetaṃ ca kiṃśukaṃ | śukapuṣpaṃ tamālaṃ ca caṃpakāśoka ketakī ||
trisaṃdhyaṃ mālatī puṣpaṃ trisaṃdhyaśvetayā tathā | kuṃdaṃ ca śatapuṣpaṃ ca mallikājāti puṣpakaṃ ||
pūrvapūrva sahasrebhyo'dhikaṃ syāduttarottaraṃ | sarvāsāṃ puṣpajātīnāṃjātī puṣpamihottamaṃ ||
jātī puṣpasahasreṇa yacchenmālāṃ suśobhanāṃ | viṣṇave vidhivadbhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
kalpakoṭi sahasrāṇi kalpakoṭi śatāni ca | vasedviṣṇupure śrīmān viṣṇutulya parākramaḥ ||
aparādha sahasrāṇi aparādha śatāni ca | patreṇaikena deveśaḥ kṣamate helayārcitaḥ ||
padmenaikena deveśamarcayan kamalāpatiṃ | varṣāyuta sahasrāṇi pāpasya kurute kṣayaṃ ||
ketakī patreṇaikena pūjito garuḍadhvajaḥ |
<20b>
samāḥ sahasraṃ surātī jāyate surasādanaḥ ||
suvarṇaketakī puṣpaṃ yo dadāti janārdane | koṭi janmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ harate garuḍadhvajaḥ ||
viṣṇu dharmottare |
bhṛṃgarājasya vilvasyavakapuṣpasya vai dvijāḥ | yaccāpi vījapūrāṇāṃ patrāṇi vinivedayet ||
eteṣāmapyekasya patradānaṃ mahāpātakanāśanaṃ | yeṣāṃśaṃsaṃti puṣpāṇi praśastāḥ putramālinaḥ ||
pallavānyapi tasyāḥ syuḥ patrāsyarcā vidhau hareḥ |
evaṃ vihita puṣpavṛkṣapatrapallavairbhakṣavanaspati pallavaiḥ sarve devāścārcyāḥ ||
nākṣatairarcayedviṣṇuṃ na śivaṃ śaṃkhavāriṇeti | yavā viṣṇoḥ praśastāḥ syuḥ | śaṃkhavāri śivavyatiriktamanyeṣāmiti || iti puṣpoddeśa saṃketaḥ || iti vihita puṣpapatrābhāve'nyadapi puṣpaphalaṃ niṣiddhavarjamupādeyaṃ || yattuḥ puṣpairaraṇya saṃbhūtaiḥ patrairvā girisaṃbhavaiḥ | iti tad vihitairaniṣiddha puṣpairapi pūjākāryā | atra vā śaṣṭya samuccayārtho na vikalpārthaḥ | vahupuṣpapatraṃ samuccayastu tattatphalārtho na viruddhaḥ ||
[iti śrīmadāśādityatripāṭhīsaṃgṛhīte maṃtrakoṣe puṣpādhyāyo nāma tṛtīyaḥ paricchedaḥ] || <21a>
atha dhūpāḥ || tatra sūryasya | bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
gaṃdhāścāpi śuṃbhāye tu dhūpāśca vijayādayaḥ | divākarasya dharmajñairnivedyāḥ sarvadā punaḥ ||
saghṛtaṃ gugguluṃ dagdhvā rājan kuḍurukaṃ tathā | caturveda gṛhejanma prāpnoti satataṃ sukhaṃ ||
devadāruṃ nameruṃ ca śrīvāsaṃ kuṃduruṃ tathā | śrīphalaṃ rājyasaṃmiśraṃ dagdhvā śriyamavāpnuyāt ||
namerurgugguluḥ | tathā pradhānataruviśeṣa iti kaścit | śrīvāsaḥ śaralodbhava iti prasiddhaḥ | kuṃduruḥ sallakīrasaḥ ||
dhūpena labhate svargaṃ tu ruṣkena sugaṃdhinā | karpūrāgurudhūpena rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet ||
tu ruṣkena sihlakena || atha śivasya || bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
kṛṣṇāguruṃ sa karpūraṃ dhūpaṃ dadyānmaheśvare | nairaṃtaryeṇamāsārdhaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
kalpakoṭi sahasrāṇi kalpakoṭi śatāni ca | śukle śivapure śrīmāṁstasyāṃte sa mahīpatiḥ ||
atha durgāyāḥ |
bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
kṛṣṇāguruṃ sa karpūraṃ caṃdanaṃ sihlake tathā | bhagavatyai naro dhūpamidaṃ dadyānnarādhipa ||
ihakāmānavāpnoti durgāloke mahīyate | guggulaṃ saghṛtaṃ dadyāddurgāyai bharatarṣabha ||
<21b>
māsārdhaṃ vidhivadbhaktyā gosahasraphalaṃ labhet | sarveṣāmevadhūpānāṃ durgāyā gugguluḥ priyaḥ ||
ghṛtayukto viśeṣeṇa satataṃ prītivardhanaḥ |
atha viṣṇoḥ || tatra viṣṇuḥ || na dhūpārthe prāṇijātaṃ || vāmanapurāṇe |
ruhikākṣaṃkaṇaṃ dārusihlakaṃ sā gurusitāṃ | śaṃkhaṃ jātīphalaṃ śrīśedhūpānisyuḥ priyāṇi vaiḥ |
ruhikākṣaṃ jaṭāmāṃsī | kuṇaṃ gugguluḥ | dārurdevadāruḥ | śitā karpūraḥ | śarkareti kaścit | śaṃkhaṃ nakhī | śrīśe viṣṇau | tathā
mahiṣākhyaṃ gugguluṃ yaṣṭvātha yuktaṃ saśarkaraṃ | dhūpaṃ dadāti rājeṃdra narasiṃhā ca bhaktimān ||
sa dhūpitaḥ sarvadikṣu sarvapāpa vivarjitaḥ | apsaro gaṇayuktena vimānena virājate ||
vāyulokaṃ samāsādya viṣṇuloke mahīyate |
atha dīkṣāḥ || tatra sūryasya | bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
ghṛtena dīpaṃ prajvālya tilatailena vā punaḥ | prayāti sūryalokaṃ sa dīpakoṭi śatairvṛtaḥ ||
sarvalokamaye vīravīraloke mahīyate |
atha śivasya | bhaviṣyapurāṇe ||
ghṛtadīpapradānena śivāyaśatayojanaṃ | vimānaṃ labhate divyaṃ sūryakoṭi samaprabhaṃ ||
<22a>
śivasya tailadīpapradānaṃ niṣiddhaṃ ||
atha durgāyāḥ ||
bhaviṣyapurāṇe ||
ghṛtena vātha tailena dīpaṃ yojvālayennaraḥ | sośvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya durgāloke mahīyate ||
tailadīpa pradānena yaḥ pūjayati caṃḍikāṃ | vājapeyaphalaṃ prāpya kiṃ naraiḥ sahamodate ||
atha viṣṇoḥ ||
na ghṛtatilatailaṃ vinā kiṃcana dīpārthe ||
narasiṃhapurāṇe ||
ghṛtena vātha tailena dīpaṃ yojvālayennaraḥ | viṣṇave vidhivadbhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
vihāyapāpaṃ sakalaṃ sahasrāditya saṃprabhaḥ | sośvamedhaphalaṃprāpya viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
atha dīpadānānaṃcaraṃ bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
tāṁśca datvā na hiṃseta na ca tailavivarjitān | kurvīta dīpahartā tu mūṣiko'dhaḥ prajāyate ||
sāmānyato yamaḥ ||
devatā puṣpadānena jāyate śrīsamanvitaḥ | ūrdhvāṃgatimavāpnoti yaśca dhūpapradonaraḥ ||
lokaprakāśakobhāti cakṣuṣmānivadīpadaḥ ||
atha naivedyāni | tatra sūryasya | bhaviṣyapurāṇe ||
śālitaṃḍulaprasthasya kuryādannaṃ susaṃskṛtaṃ | sūryāya carukaṃ datvā saptamyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||
<22b>
prasthaḥ ṣoḍaśapalāni ||
saṃyāvakṛśarāpūpapāyasaṃyāvakaṃ tathā | dadhyodanaṃ rasālaṃ ca modakāṃ pūḍikāṃgulān ||
yāvaṃtastaṃḍulāstasminnaivedye parisaṃkhyayā | tāvadvarṣa sahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate ||
rasālā śiṣariṇī ||
uḍakhaṃḍa ghṛtānāṃ ca bhakṣāṇāṃ ca nivedane | ghṛtāpūpahataiḥ siktaiḥ puṇyaṃ daśaguṇottaraṃ ||
yathā yathā hi ṣastūni svādūni surabhīṇi ca | bhakṣānnapānamāṃsāni tatphalāni tathā tathā ||
arkaparṇa puṭaṃpūrṇaṃ madhuparkasamanvitaṃ | yonivedayate'rkāya so'śvamedha phalaṃ labhet ||
bhāskarasyāgrato datvā darpaṇaṃ nirmalaṃ śubhaṃ | paryaṃta śobhinaṃ kṛtvā śvetamālyaiḥ sa caṃdanaiḥ ||
kalpāyuṃta sahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate | anyasyāṃ darśadānena tatsamānaṃ phalaṃ bhavet ||
atha śivasya ||
bhaviṣyapurāṇe ||
śālitaṃḍulaprasthaṃ tu kuryādannaṃ susaṃskṛtaṃ | śivāyataccaruṃ dadyāccaturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
yāvaṃtastaṃḍulāstasminnaivedyeparisaṃkhyayā | tāvadvarṣa sahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate ||
<23a>
guḍakhaṃḍa ghṛtānāṃ ca bhakṣāṇāṃ ca nivedane | mātuluṃgaphalādīti supakvāni nivedayet ||
atha durgāyāḥ ||
bhaviṣyapurāṇe ||
guḍakhaṃḍādyasaṃmiśramannaṃ dadyānnarādhigraṃ | vaiṣṇavasyaphalaṃprāpya sūryaloke mahīyate ||
guḍakhaṃḍaghṛtānāṃ ca tathā śarkarayā nṛpa | ghṛtena paripakvānāṃ pradānād brahmaṇaḥ padaṃ ||
śālyodanaṃ rasālāṃ ca pānaṃ vadarajaṃ tathā | yaḥ prayacchati durgāyai sa gacchati śivālayaṃ ||
durgāmuddiśyapānīyaṃ ketakī śaśi vā sitaṃ | yaḥ prayacchati rājeṃdra sa gaṇādhipatirbhavet ||
śaśīkarpūraḥ |
āmraṃ ca nālikeraṃ ca kharjūraṃ vījapūrakaṃ | yaḥ prayacchati durgāyai sa gacchet paramaṃ padaṃ ||
atha viṣṇoḥ ||
tatra viṣṇuḥ ||
nā bhakṣyaṃ naivedyārthe bhakṣetha jāmahiṣīkṣīraṃ gavyaṃ ca dadhipayoghṛtaṃ ||
praśastaṃ nāvikaṃ sa chāgaṃ |
māhiṣaṃ cāvikaṃ chāgamayajñīya mudāhṛtaṃ | paṃcanakha varāhamatsyamāṃsāni ca ||
varāhapurāṇe ||
sarvaṃ vīhimayaṃ grāhyaṃ śubhaṃ sarvaṃ rasānvitaṃ | maṃtreṇamepradiyetana kaścidapi saṃspṛśet ||
<23b>
iṃgudī phalavilvāni vadarāmalakāni ca | kharjūrīpanasāṁścaiva punnāgaphalameva ca ||
tāṃvūlīnāṃ kiśalayaṃ svargalokamavāpnuyāt | saubhāgyamuttamaṃ loke tathā rūpamanuttamaṃ ||
kiśalayadatveti śeṣaḥ |
evamādīni vahūni phalamūlaśākādīni naivedyārthe kathitāni |
tāni graṃthagauravānnalikhitāni | śivavarjaṃ sarveṣāṃ māṃsaṃ deyaṃ | pādodakaṃ ca peyaṃ | muktaṃ viṣṇudharmottare |
sadyaḥ phalapradaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpavināśanaṃ | sarvamaṃgalamaṃgalyaṃ sarvaduḥkhavināśanaṃ ||
duḥsvapnanāśanaṃ puṇyaṃ viṣṇupādodakaṃ śubhaṃ | pādodakaṃ viṣṇu naivedyamudareyasya tiṣṭhati ||
nāśriyaṃ labhate pāpaṃ svayameva vinaśyati | tathā śālagrāmaśilātoyaṃ yaḥ pivedviṃdunāṃ samaṃ ||
mātustanyaṃ punarnaivesapivenmuktibhānnaraḥ | tīrthakoṭi sahasraistu prāśitaiḥ kiṃ prayojanaṃ ||
tokaṃ yadi pivettoyaṃ śālagrāma śilodbhavaṃ |
iti paṃcopacāraḥ ||
ṣoḍaśopacārastu ||
āvāhana svāgatāsanapādyāghā ca manīyasnānavastra yajñopavīta gaṃdhapuṣpadhūpadīpanaivedyāṃjali pradakṣiṇa visarjanāni ||
atha sūryasyadeyāni |
<24a>
tatra bhaviṣyapurāṇe ||
vāsobhiḥ pūjayedbhānuṃ yānyevātmapriyāṇi ca | tathānyaiśca śubhairdravyairarcayedaṃ śubhānaṃ ||
vāsāṃsi suvicitrāṇi sāravaṃti mṛdūni ca | sāravaṃti ravaudadyādvikeśāni navāni tu ||
yāvadvastrasya taṃtūnāṃ parimāṇaṃ pracakṣyate | tāvadvarṣa sahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate ||
trivṛt śubhraṃ supītaṃ vā paṭṭasūtrādinirmitaṃ | dadhvopavītaṃ sūryāyabhadheḥ dvedāṃgapāraṣṭāḥ ||
śvetaṃ mahādhvajaṃ divyaṃ kṛtvā vā saptaraṃgitaṃ | kiṃkinījālanirghoṣaṃ māyūracchatra bhūṣitaṃ ||
yastvarkāyaṃ naro dadyācchraddhayāparaṃ yānvitaḥ | manvaṃtaraśataṃ divyaṃ modate dividevavat ||
maṇidaṃḍamayaṃ chatraṃ dadyādvākāṃcanādyakaṃ | modate sūryalokeṣu vimānavaramāsthitaḥ ||
yaḥ śṛṃkhalā samāyuktāṃ mahāghaṃṭāṃ mahāsvanāṃ | kāṃsyalohamayīṃ vāpi vadhnīyācca surālaye ||
sonutasyānugaḥ śrīmān vradhnasyātīva vallabhaḥ | bherīmṛdaṃgapaṭaṃhaḍamaruṃ murajādikaṃ ||
vaṃśya kāṃsyādivāditraṃyo vradhnāya nivedayet | yugāyutasamaṃ divyaṃ vradhnaloke mahīyate ||
sūryayajñopakaraṇaṃ datvālyaṃ yadi vā vahu |
<24b>
bhāvavittānusāreṇa sūryaloke mahīyate ||
bhāskarāya tanābhyāsesūryakṣetraṃ samaṃ tataḥ | dehināṃ tvatra paṃcatvaṃ sūryasāyujyakārakaṃ ||
manujaiḥ sthāpite sūryekṣetra mānamidaṃ smṛtaṃ | krośārdhakalpayedrājannardhārdhamatha vāpi vā ||
tasmādāvasathān kuryāt sūryakṣetra samanvitān | mānorāyatanābhyāse yattoyaṃ purataḥ sthitaṃ ||
sūryagaṃ yeti sā proktā tatra snāto divaṃ vrajet | yaḥ kuryāddīrghikāṃ vāpī taḍāgaṃbhāskarālaye ||
satāṃrayetkulaśataṃ sūryaloke mahīyate | gau vāpi mahiṣīrvāpi gajānakhāśca bhājanāt ||
yaḥ prayacchati sūryāya tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu | akṣayaṃ sarvakāmāya aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ||
yaḥ sūryāya jalopetāṃ sarvasasya prarohiṇīṃ | mahīmahīpatirdadyāttasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
bhuvaḥ pāṃśūniyāvaṃti bhūtalebhāṃti sattamaṃ | tāvadyugusahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate ||
yasvā rāmaṃ raveḥ kuryādrāmravilvādi śobhitaṃ | jātī jaṃvīra nāraṃga karavīraiḥ sakubjakaiḥ ||
yāvadvi patra kusumaṃ vīrudhāni phalāni ca | tāvadvarṣa sahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate ||
evaṃ vahavaḥ puṇyahetavo nirdiṣṭaḥ |
te graṃthagauravānnalikhitā sūryasyetyupalakṣaṇaṃ |
<25a>
śivadurgāviṣṇūnāmapyevaṃ sarvaṃ tattalloka prāptayeṃ voddhavyaṃ ||
evaṃ pratyeka kathane graṃthagauravaṃ bhavediti saṃkṣepataḥ pūjā dravyavidhānaṃ | etāni pūjā dravyāṇi sarvāṇi mūlamaṃtreṇa pūtāni devebhyo deyāni | maṃtrāstu traivarṇikānāṃ vaidikā eva mukhyāḥ avarāṇāṃ āgamādyupayuktā maṃtrāḥ | tadabhāve tu traivarṇikānāmapi strī śūdrāṇāṃ ca paṃcarātroktā evaṃ mukhyā na vaidikāḥ | teṣāṃ tadanadhikārāt | ato brāhmaṇe kṣatraviśāmapyāgamyektā maṃtrā aviruddhā vedāviruddhāścet | uktaṃ ca vārāhapurāṇe | alābhe vedamaṃtrāṇāṃ paṃcarātrodito vidhiriti || kiṃ ca āgamokta maṃtrāḥ savīryā uktāḥ | tathā ca prapaṃce |
kṛte śrutyuktamārgātretāyāṃ stutibhāvataḥ | dvāparesyāt purāṇoktāḥ kalāvāgamasaṃbhavāḥ ||
aśūdrāḥ śūdrakalpā hi brāhmaṇāḥ kalisaṃbhavāḥ | teṣāmāgamamārgesyātsiddhirnaśrautavartmanā ||
yadi kaścit dvijaśreṣṭhaḥ kṛtācāro jiteṃdriyaḥ | tasya sāvitryādi maṃtrāḥ phalaṃtyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||
te punargurormukhāddīkṣāpuraḥsaraṃ gṛhītāḥ phalāya kalpaṃ te nānyatheti ||
<25b>
tathā ca adīkṣitasya aniṣṭa śravaṇāt |
adīkṣitasya vāmo rukṛtaṃ sarvamanarthakaṃ | paśuyonimavāpnoti dīkṣāhīnonaraḥ sadā ||
yadṛcchayā kṛtaṃ maṃtraṃ channaṃ nyāyaphalena vā | yatrekṣite vā gārthā ca yajuyettadanarthakaṃ ||
kiṃ ca samyak siddhaika maṃtrasya nāsādhyamiha kiṃcana | vahumaṃtravataḥ puṃsaḥ kākathā vyāsa eva saḥ ||
tasmādekopi maṃtro dīkṣayā grāhyaḥ sādhyate gururmukhāt ityata ete maṃtrā atravivicyocyaṃte | na punargurormukhāt dīkṣāpuraḥsarāgṛhītāḥ phalāyakalpaṃte nānyatheti ||
yataḥ |
snehādvālobhato vāyonugrahīṣpakṣā dīkṣayā | asmin gurau sa śiṣyai tu devatāśāya āpatet ||
iti devatāśāya bhayāddīkṣā pūrvaka eva maṃtrodeya iti sā dīkṣā saṃkṣepataḥ prasūyate ||
[iti śrīmaṃtrakoṣe pūjādravyakathanaṃnāma caturthaḥ paricchedaḥ] || atha dīkṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi maṃtriṇāṃ hitakāmyayā | yayāvināna labhyeta sarvaṃ maṃtraphalaṃ yataḥ ||
jñānaṃ divyaṃ tato dadyāt kuryāt pāpakṣayaṃ yataḥ | tasmāddīkṣeti sā proktā deśikaistaṃtravedibhiḥ ||
caturvidhā dīkṣā yadyapi tathāpi deśakālādi saukaryāt saṃkṣepataḥ kriyāvato dīkṣāvidhirucyate ||
<26a>
tatrādau guruśiṣyaparīkṣā ||
avadātānvayaḥ śuddhaḥśodhitācāra tatparaḥ | āśramī krodharahitaḥ sarvaśāstrārtha tatvavit ||
saguṇārcāsu kṛtadhīḥ kṛtajñaḥ śiṣyavatsalaḥ | vigrahānu grahedakṣo mahāmaṃtraparāyaṇaḥ ||
ahāyohapramāṇajñaḥ śuddhāmnāyaḥ kṛpālayaḥ | ityādi lakṣaṇairyukto guruḥ syādgarimānidhiḥ ||
śiṣyaḥ śuddhānvayaḥ śrīmān vinītaḥ priyadarśanaḥ | satyavāk puṇyanirato'dabhradhīrdaṃbhavarjitaḥ ||
yuvāviniyatā śeṣakaraṇaḥ karuṇālayaḥ | ityādi lakṣaṇairyuktaḥ śiṣyo dīkṣādhikārabhāk ||
atha śuddhasamaye dīkṣāmāsāḥ ||
caitredīkṣā sa duḥkhāsyādvaiśākhe sarvasiddhidā | jyeṣṭhe mṛtyupradāsāsyādāṣāḍhe vaṃdhunāśinī ||
śrāvaṇe vṛddhidā nṝṇāṃ na bhasyedduḥkhadāmatā | āśvine sarvasiddhyaisyāt kārtike jñānavṛddhidā ||
śubhakṛnmārgaśīrṣe ca pauṣe jñānavināśinī | māghe medhā vṛddhidāsyātphālgune vijayapradā ||
kṛṣṇapakṣāt śuklapakṣaḥ praśastaḥ | riktā kuhūvarjitāstithayaḥ ||
<26b>
uttarā trayarohiṇī citrānurādhāmṛgaśirorevatī puṣpāśvinīhastānakṣatrāṇi | maṃgalavarjaṃ vārāḥ || sthirāṇi lagnāni vṛṣasiṃhavṛścikakuṃbhākhyāni ||
atha prayogaḥ ||
tatra prathamataḥ svasti ṛddhipuṇyāhaṃ vācanaṃ kṛtvā ācāryaṃ vṛṇuyāt | yathā śaktyalaṃkārādisahita tripaṭimācāryāya datvā adyetyādi tvatto'mukamaṃtraṃ grahituṃ tadaṃgabhūtahomādikarmakartumamukagotramamukaśamīṇa mamukavedādhiyinamebhiścaṃdana patrākṣata tāṃvūlālaṃkāra vāsobhirgurutve natvā mahaṃ vṛṇe vṛtosmīti prativaṃcanaṃ | (*)(?) tato gururmadayāṃtargatvāṃ arghapātra catuṣṭayaṃ kṛtvā siddhārthākṣata kuśāgra tilapuṣpajalaṃ phalāni nikṣipyārghaṃ gṛhītvā saṃsārārṇavamagrānāṃ paśūnāṃ pāśamuktaye | tvameva śaraṇaṃ vaṃde sadātvaṃ bhaktivatsala | devadevānujānī hi prākṛtaiḥ pāśavaṃdhavaiḥ | pāśitānmocayiṣyāmitvat prasādāt paśūnimān ityarghaṃ datvā anaṃtāsanāya namaḥ | vimalāsanāya namaḥ <2> yogāsanāya namaḥ <3> padmāsanāya namaḥ <4> ityetairmaṃtrairabhimaṃtritān kuśān datvā āsanaṃ saṃpūjyaṃ tatra pūrvābhimukha upaviśyaguṃgurubhyo namaḥ | gaṃgaṇapataye namaḥ
<27a>
iti vāmadakṣiṇabhāgerguruṃ gaṇapatiṃ ca pūjayitvā || dakṣiṇabhāge pūjādravyāṇi vāmabhāge naivedyādi sthāpayitvā uccairghṛtena karpūragarbhiṇībhirvartikābhidīyān prajvālya | anaṃtaraṃ paṃcavarṇikābhiḥ sarvato bhadrādi maṃḍalānāmekatamaṃ maṃḍalaṃ viracayya mūlamaṃtreṇa prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā bhūtaśuddhiṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ mātṛkānyā sa ca kṛtvā dātavya maṃtrasya ca ṣaḍaṃganyāsākṣaranyāsān vidhāya svadehe mūlādhārādārabhya ādhāraśaktyādimeruparyaṃtaṃ hṛdayaṃ yāvat pūjayet | tadupari aṃsadvayorudvaya pīṭhakoṇarūpeṣu dharmādīn | mukhapārśvanābhipārarśvapīṭhagātreṣu adharmādīn pūjayet | hṛtkamale satvādi paratatvāṃtaṃ ciṃtayedevaṃ pīṭhādi pūjāṃtaṃ mānasairupacāraistatra saṃpūjya svahṛdaye devaṃ saṃkalpa | tato'grataḥ śaravasthāpanamārabhet || tatrāgneḥ | oṃ vahnimaṃḍalāya daśadharmakalātmane namaḥ ityarghabhūmiṃ pūjayitvā | oṃ sūryamaṃḍalāya
<27b>
dvādaśārtha kalātmane namaḥ iti tatra sthāpitā dhārapātraṃ pūjayitvā tadupari astrāya phaḍiti maṃtreṇa śaṃkhaṃ prakṣālya vinyasya mūlamaṃtreṇa jalaṃ prakṣipya oṃ somamaṃḍalāya ṣoḍaśāmṛta kalātmane namaḥ iti jalaṃ saṃpūjya | svāheti caṃdanaṃ vaṣaḍiti maṃtreṇākṣatān humiti maṃtreṇāvaguṃṭhyaḥ astrāya phaḍimaṃtreṇa saṃrakṣya tatra gaṃge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvati | narmade siṃdhukāverijalesminsaṃnidhiṃ kuru iti tatra tīrthamāvāhyagāminī mudrāṃ dhenumudrāṃ ca pradarśya svamudrayā saṃrakṣya hastābhyāṃ śaṃkhamācchādayan daśavāraṃ mūlamaṃtraṃ japitvā tajjalaṃ dakṣiṇabhāgasthita prokṣaṇī pātre prakṣipya tenātmānaṃ yāgabhūmiṃ ca prasicya | tataḥ svadehakalpitāṃ dhārapīṭhe maṃtrāṃtaṃ saṃpūjya tatra hṛtkamale devamāvāhya puṣpāṃjali paṃcakena svamūrdhne hṛnmūlādhārapāda sarvāṃgeṣu paṃcasupūjayet naivedyaṃ vinā || tataḥ śaṃkhedevamāvāhayet | tato gaṃdhāṣṭakaṃ tatra prakṣipet || tadyathā |
caṃdanā gurukarpūracaurakuṃkumarocanāḥ | jaṭāmāṃsī kapiyutā śaktergaṃdhāṣṭakaṃ viduḥ ||
caurakacūru | kapiḥsī ||
<28a>
caṃdanāguru hrīverakuṣṭhakuṃkumasevyakāḥ | jaṭāmāṃsīmuramiti viṣṇorgaṃdhāṣṭakaṃmataṃ ||
hrīveraṃ karpūrajalaṃ | sevyakaṃ tu sīraḥ | muraṃ iti ||
caṃdanā gurukarpūratamalajalakuṃkumaṃ | kusītakuṣṭasaṃyuktaṃ śaivaṃ gaṃdhāṣṭakaṃ ||
iti devatānurūpaṃ gaṃdhāṣṭakaṃ śaṃkhe viloḍya sarvāḥ kalāstatrāvāhya pūjayet ||
oṃ aṃ amṛtāyai namaḥ <1> oṃ āṃ mānadāyai <2> oṃ iṃ pūṣāyai <3> oṃ īṃ tuṣṭyai <4> oṃ uṃ yuṣṭayai <5> oṃ ūṃ ratyai <6> oṃ ṛṃ dhṛtyai <7> oṃ ṝṃ śaṃkhinyai <8> oṃ ḷṃ caṃḍikāyai <9> oṃ ḹṃ kāṃtyai <10> oṃ eṃ jyotsnāyai <11> oṃ aiṃ śriyai <12> oṃ oṃ mrītyai <13> oṃ ūṃ aṃgadāyai <14> oṃ aṃ pūrṇāyai <15> oṃ aḥ pūrṇā mṛtāyai namaḥ <16> ityabhyarcya prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kuryāt | amṛtādi somakalānāṃ prāṇā ihaprāṇāḥ amṛtādīnāṃ jīva iha sthitaḥ amṛtādīnāṃ sarveṃdriyāṇi amṛtādīnāṃ vāṅmanaścakṣuḥ śrotra jihvāghrāṇa prāṇā ihaivāgatyasukhaṃciraṃ tiṣṭhaṃtu svāhā || punastapanādyādvādaśakalā āvāhayāmītyāvāhyaṃkaṃbhaṃtapinyai namaḥ <1> khaṃ vaṃ tāpinyai <2> gaṃ phaṃ dhūmrāyai <3> ghaṃ yaṃ marītryai <4> ṅaṃ maṃ jvālinyai <5> caṃ dhaṃ rucyai <6> chaṃ daṃ suṣumṇāyai <7> jaṃ thaṃ bhogadāyai <8> jhaṃ taṃ viśvāyai <9> ñaṃ ṇaṃ rodhinyai <10> ṭaṃ ḍhaṃ dhāriṇyai <11> ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ kṣamāyai iti pūjayet ||
<28b>
tathaiva prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kuryāt | tapanādyātityakalānāṃ prāṇā ihaprāṇāḥ ityādi || punardhūmrārcirityādyā agnerdaśakalā āvāhayāmītyāvāhvayaṃ dhūmrārviṣenamaḥ <1> raṃ uṣmāyai <2> laṃ jvalinyai <3> vaṃ jvālinyai <4> śaṃ visphuliṃgyai <5> ṣaṃ suśriyai <6> saṃ svarūpāyai <7> haṃ kapilāyai <8> laṃ havyavāhanāyai <9> kṣaṃ kavyavāhanāyai namaḥ <10> iti pūjayet | agnikalānāṃ prāṇā ihaprāṇā ityādi || tataḥ praṇavakalāḥ | akārakalātmaka brahmaṇaḥ sṛṣṭyādi daśakalā āvāhayāmītyāvāhya puṣpākṣataiḥ pūjayet || kaṃsṛṣṭyai namaḥ <1> khaṃ ṛddhyai <2> gaṃ smṛtyai <3> ghaṃ medhāyai <4> ṅaṃ kāṃtyai <5> caṃ lakṣmyai <6> chaṃ dūtyai <7> jaṃ sthirāyai <8> jhaṃ sthityai <9> ñaṃ siddhyai namaḥ <10> iti saṃpūjya | sṛṣṭyādīnāṃ prāṇā ihaprāṇā ityādi | haṃsaḥ śuciṣadvasuraṃtarikṣasaddhotāvediṣadatithirduronasaḥ | nṛṣadvarasadṛttasadvyomasadabjāgojā ṛtajā adrijāritaṃ vṛhaditi r.camāvāhya pūjayet || tata ukārātmaka viṣṇorjarādi daśakalā āvāhayāmītyāvāhya | ṭaṃ janāyai namaḥ <1> ṭhaṃ pālinyai <2> ḍaṃ śāṃtyai <3> ḍhaṃ aiśvaryai <4> ṇaṃ ratyai <5> taṃ vāmikāyai <6>
<29a>
thaṃ varadāyai <7> daṃ hlādinyai <8> dhaṃ (**)(?) naṃ dīrghāyai namaḥ <10> iti pūjayet | jarādīnāṃ prāṇā ihaprāṇā ityādi || tataḥ | atadviṣṇustavate vīryeṇa mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucarogiriṣṭhāḥ | yasyo ruṣutriṣu vikramasoṣvadhikṣiyaṃti bhuvanāni viśvāḥ iti ṛcamāvāhya pūjayet || tato makārātmakaṃ rudrasya tīkṣhrādi daśakalā āvāhayāmītyāvāhya | paṃtīkṣktāyai namaḥ <1> phaṃ rodryai <2> vaṃ tayāyai <3> bhaṃ nidrāyai <4> maṃ taṃdrāyai <5> yaṃ kṣudhāyai <6> raṃ krodhinyai <7> laṃ kriyāyai <8> vaṃ utkāryai <9> śaṃ mṛtyurūpāyai namaḥ <10> iti tīkṣṇādīnāṃ daśakalānāṃ prāṇā iha prāṇā ityādi || tataḥ tryaṃvakaṃ yajāmahe sugaṃdhiṃ puṣṭivardhanaṃ | urvārukamiva vaṃdhanānmṛtyormukṣīyamāmṛt ityāvāhya pūjayet || tataḥ pītādivatasraḥ kalā āvāhayāmītyāvāhyaṣaṃpītāyai namaḥ <1> saṃkhyetāyai <2> haṃ aruṇāyai <3> kṣaṃ asitāyai namaḥ <4> iti pūjayet | pītādīnāṃ prāṇā ityādi tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargodevasyadhīmahi | dhiyoyonaḥ pracodayāt ityāvāhya pūjayet || tato nivṛtyādi ṣoḍaśakalā āvāhayāmītyāvāhya aṃ nivṛtyai namaḥ <1> āṃ pratiṣṭhāyai <2> iṃ vidyāye <3> īṃ śāṃtyai <4> uṃ iṃdhikāyai <5>
<29b>
ūṃ dīpikāyai <6> ṛṃ recikāyai <7> ṝṃ mocikāyai <8> ḷṃ sūkṣmāyai <9> ḹṃ sūkṣmāmṛtāyai <10> eṃ jñānāyai <11> aiṃ jñānāmṛtāyai <12> uṃ āpyāyinyai <13> ūṃ vyāpinyai <14> aṃ vyomarūpāyai <15> aḥ naṃtāyai namaḥ <16> iti pūjayet | nivṛtyādīnāṃ ṣoḍaśakalānāṃ prāṇā iha prāṇā ityādi | anaṃtaraṃ viṣṇuryoni kalpayatu tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi pīṅasatu āsiṃcatu prajāpatirddhātā garbhaṃ dadhātute iti ṛcamāvāhya pūjayet || iti śaṃkhe kalāpūjāṃ vidhāyaḥ sarvato bhadrādimaṃḍalamadhyasthakamalaṃ karṇikāyāṃ puṣpākṣatairabhyarcyaḥ tadupariśālidhānyāni tadupariśāli taṃḍulān tadupari kuśān tadupari kuśakūrcaṃ datvā tatrādhāra śaktyādi sahitaṃ pīṭhaṃ pūjayitvāṃ tadupari haimaṃ vā rājataṃ vā tāmramayaṃ vā kalaśaṃ tadabhāve avraṇaṃ śobhanākāraṃ śyāmikādi doṣarahitaṃ sarvatastriguṇī kṛtasūtrairveṣṭitaṃ caṃdanā gurukarpūradhūpitaṃ astreṇa prakṣālitāṃtaraṃ praṇavaṃ japan kalaśaṃ sthāpya kalaśamadhye paṃcaratnaṃ saṃkṣipya kṣaṃ laṃ haṃ saṃ ṣaṃ śaṃ vaṃ laṃ raṃ yaṃ maṃ bhaṃ vaṃ phaṃ paṃ naṃ dhaṃ daṃ thaṃ taṃ ṇaṃ ḍhaṃ ḍaṃ ṭhaṃ ṭaṃ ñaṃ jhaṃ jaṃ chaṃ caṃ ṅaṃ ghaṃ gaṃ khaṃ kaṃ aṃḥ aṃ
<30a>
ūṃ uṃ aiṃ eṃ ḹṃ ḷṃ ṝṃ ṛṃ ūṃ uṃ īṃ iṃ āṃ aṃ evaṃ vilomamātṛkāṃ japan mūlamaṃtraṃ ca puṣpakarpūrādi vā sitaiḥ puṇyajalairdevatā vadhyā saṃpūrya śaṃkhasthaṃ kiṃcijjalaṃ aṣṭatriṃśatkalāḥ paṃcāśatkalāḥ paṃcarcomūlamaṃtraśceti caturna bhavati devatātmākaṃ triśo gṛhītvā kalaśe nikṣipet || tato'śvacchayana sa cūtakomalapallavairiṃdravallīvaddhaiḥ suradrumadhiyākalaśamukhaṃpidhāya tatra caṣakaṃ kāṃsyamayaṃ phalātmakaṃ sthāpayet || tataḥ kuṃbhaṃ nirmalakṣaumayugmena veṣṭayet | iṃdravallī idāruṇa iti prasiddhaḥ | kṣaumābhāve vastradvayenāpi veṣṭayitvā mūlamaṃtreṇa kalaśe devatā mūrtiṃ dhyātvā āvāhanādikāḥ ṣaṇmudrāḥ pradarśayet | tataḥ pūrvokta vidhinā tatra devaṃ ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya yathā śaktideyamaṃtraṃ japitvā samarpyopacārān datvā chatra cāmarādikaṃ tāṃvūlaṃ dadyāt | iti pūjāṃ vidhādhāgniṃ svagṛhya vidhinā saṃsthāpya tatra mukhyadevatāyāḥ pīṭhadevatādi krameṇa tatra tattannāmabhiḥ svāhāṃte ekaikāmāhutimājyena hutvā yasyā śaktimūlamaṃtreṇa devatāṃ homaṃ vidhāya svāṃgādyā
<30b>
varaṇānāṃ tattannāmabhirekaikāmāhutiṃ datvā punaḥ pūrṇāhutyaṃtaṃ homaṃ parisamāpayet || tataḥ śiṣyo gurave vā sasī suvarṇāṃgulīyakaṃ dadyāt || anaṃtaraṃ guruḥ śiṣyamagni samīpamānīya netramaṃtreṇa netravāsasā śiṣyanetrevadhnīyāt || tatovaddha netrameva śiṣyaṃ kare gṛhītvā kalaśasamīpaṃ nītvoyaveśayet | tattanau mātṛkāvarṇān vinyasya tasyāṃjali puṣpaiḥ pūrayitvā yathāvidhi kalaśadevatā prītayekṣepayenmūlamaṃtramuccaran || tato netravaṃdhaṃ vyayohya śiṣyatanauḥ kṣakārādyakāraparyaṃtaṃ vilomamātṛkāṃ saṃhārakrameṇa saṃhṛtya paścādakārādi krameṇa sṛṣṭi utpādya devyamaṃtrākṣaranyāsaṃvinyasya paṃcopacāraiḥ kuṃbhasthāmiṣṭadevatāṃ pūjayet || tatonyasminmaṃḍale śiṣyamupaveśya sarvavādya brāhmaṇāśīrvādaiḥ sahakuṃbhamuddhṛtya tanmukhasthaṃ suradrumairmātṛkāṃ manasā japan mūlasādhitaistoyaiḥ śiṣyaśirobhiṣiṃcet | abhiṣekānaṃtaraṃ kuṃbhamukhasya sa phala caṣakena śiṣyaṃ nīrājya vimale vā sasīparidhāpya svasamīpa upaveśayet || tata ācāṃtasya pūrvābhimukhopaviṣṭasya
<31a>
gururuttarābhimukhaḥ śanaiḥ śanairdakṣiṇakarṇemaṃtraṃ niḥśrāvayet || brāhmaṇāyāṃvu pūrvaṃ dadyāt | anyebhyaḥ kathanamātraṃ labdhvā'ṣṭa kṛtvaḥ śiṣyo japet | gurumaṃtra devatā śiṣyānāmaikyaṃ saṃbhavitavyamubhābhyāmiti | tato guroḥ pādadvayaṃ gṛhītvā śirasi nidhāya śarīramarthaṃ prāṇaṃ ca sarvaṃ gurave nivedayet | gururapitraṇaṃtaṃ śiṣyaṃ vadet | uttiṣṭavatsa saumyosi samyagācāravān bhaveti | śiṣyaḥ prasannamanā gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt || uktaṃ ca gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt samagrāṃ prītamānasaḥ | brāhmaṇāṁ starpayet paścādbhakṣyabhojyaiḥ sa dakṣiṇaiḥ || prapaṃcasārepi | natvā punarattanubhṛte paramātmane svaṃ dravyārddhameva gurave caturaṃśakaṃ vā | datvā daśāṃśamatha vāpi ca vittasādhyaṃ hitvārpayennijatanuṃ tadadhī na cetāḥ || uktaṃ ca taṃtrarāje ācāryādanabhi prāptaḥ prāptaścādatta dakṣiṇaḥ | satataṃ japyamānopi maṃtraḥ siddhiṃ na gacchati || maṃtremaṃtragurāvapi maṃtrī maṃtrasya devatāyāṃ ca | triṣu vihita satatabhaktiḥ pretyehanijepsitaṃ labhate ||
[iti śrīmadāśādityatripāṭhīsaṃgrahīte maṃtrakoṣe dīkṣāsaṃkṣepakathanaṃ nāma paṃcamaḥ paricchedaḥ] || <31b>
atha guruśiṣyayogyatāparīkṣā ||
mātṛtaḥ pitṛtaḥ śuddho vipraḥ śuddhānvayaḥ kramāt | maṃtrāṇāṃ śuddhamārgāṇāṃ puraścaraṇavān guruḥ ||
ekāṣṭena bhavedyogyo brāhmaṇo dvyaṣṭavānnṛpaḥ | vaiśyo varṣaistribhiḥ śūdraścaturbhirvarṣato guroḥ ||
susuśrūṣuḥ parigrāhyo dīkṣāyāga vratādiṣu ||
atha maṃtramelanaṃ ||
yataḥ | nāsti maṃtra samaṃmitraṃ nāsti maṃtrasamoripuriti | ato vahudhā śodhayet | uktaṃ vāgame |
guptopadeśānmaṃtropi manunāttrāyate'thavā | japataḥ saṃsṛti bhayādvahudhātaṃ viśodhayet ||
siddhasādhyādibhedena svakulānyakulena vā | vālaprauḍha jaradbhedaistathā strīpuṃnapuṃsakaiḥ ||
rāśinakṣatrabhedena suptavuddhādibhistathā | ṛṇena ca dhanenātha bhāgaśaścopalakṣitaḥ ||
tathā hi ṣoḍaśa koṣṭhāni kṛtvā |
iṃdrā <1> gni <3> rudra <11> nava <9> netra <3> yugena <12> dikṣu <10> ṛtva <6> ṣṭa <8> ṣosiddhasādhyagrasu siddhaḥ | ariḥ | punaḥ siddharisthasiddhasyadhyaḥ | siddha susiddhaḥ | siddha ariḥ sādhyasiddhaḥ | sādhyaṃ sādhyaḥ | sādhya susiddhaḥ | sādhya ariḥ | susiddhasiddhaḥ | susiddhasādhyaḥ | susiddhasusiddhaḥ | susiddha ariḥ |
<32a>
uśa <16> caturdaśa <14> bhūtaṃ keṣu <5> pātola <7> paṃcadaśa <15> vahni himāṃśu <13> koṣṭhe varṇānnyasellipibhavān kramaśastudhīmān || akathaha <1> u ṅa pa <2> ḷ jha ma <6> ū ḍa va <5> iti prādakṣiṇyena koṇa catuṣkena likhet || ākhadala <2> ṛ ca pha <4> ḹ ña ya <8> oṃ ṭa śa <7> iti dakṣiṇa catuṣke || i ga dha kṣa <21> ṛ ccha va <12> e ṭa ra <16> aṃ ṇa ṣa <15> iti paścima catuṣke || ī gha na <1> ṛ ja bha <10> ai ṭha la <14> aḥ ta sa <1> iti taduttara catuṣke || evaṃ tasmin koṣṭhe sādhaka nāmādyākṣaraṃ bhavati prādakṣiṇyena tamārabhya siddhasādhya susiddhāri krameṇa gaṇayet || atha phalaṃ |
siddhaḥ sidhyati kālena sādhyasu japa homataḥ | susiddhastu grahādevaripurmūlānnikṛṃtati ||
iti catuṣke catuṣke kramaḥ |
atha cedekasmiṁścatuṣke maṃtrādyākṣaraṃ tadāyaṃ kramaḥ | sādhakādyākṣarasya catuṣkakoṣṭhamārabhya maṃtrākṣara catuṣkaparyaṃtaṃ siddhādigaṇanākāryā tato yasmiṁścatuṣkakoṣṭhe sādhakādyākṣara maṃtrākṣarasthita catuṣkasya tameva koṣṭhamārabhya punaḥ siddhādi gaṇanākāryā tade tatphalaṃ | siddhasiddho yathoktena dviguṇāt siddhasādhaka || siddhasusiddho'rddhvajapātsiddhārirhati vāṃdhavān |
<32b>
sādhyasiddhastrighnajapātsādhyasādhyo nirarthakaḥ | tatsusiddhodvipnajapātsādhyārirhaṃti gotrajān | susiddhasiddho'rdhvajapāt susiddhasādhyoguṇādhitān | tatsusiddhograhādevatadarirjñātihā bhavet |
arisiddhaḥ sutaṃhanyādarisādhyastu kanyakaṃ | tatsusiddhastu patnīghno aryariḥ sādhakāyahaḥ ||
nṛsiṃhārkavarāhāṇāṃ prāsāda praṇavasya ca | sa piṃḍākṣaramaṃtrāṇāṃ siddhādīnnaiva śodhayet ||
svapnalabdhe striyādatte mālāmaṃtre tathaiva ca | vaidikeṣu ca sarveṣu siddhārīnnaiva śodhayet ||
siddhasusiddhau grāhyau sādhyaṃ śatruṃ ca varjayenmatimān | ādāvaṃte śatruryasya bhavettaṃtyajenmaṃtraṃ ||
atha svakulānya kulabhedaḥ ||
u ṛ rva ga ja ṅa da va laḥ pārthivāḥ | ṛ ṝ a gha jha ḍha dha bhavaśāḥ vāruṇāḥ | i ī ai kha cha ṭha tha pha rakṣāḥ āgneyāḥ |
a ā e ka ca ṭa ta payaṣāḥ māruttāḥ | ḷ ḹ aṃ aḥ ṅa ña ṇa nama sahāḥ nābhasāḥ ||
pārthive vāruṇaṃ mitraṃ āgne yasyāpi mārutaṃ | pārthivāpyākṣarāṇāṃ ca śatrutve mārutaṃ sthitaṃ ||
āgneyasyāṃbhasaṃ śatruraṃbhasaṃstaijasaṃ tathā | eteṣāmeva sarveṣāmavirodhitu nābhasaṃ ||
<33a>
paraspara viruddhānāṃ na kuryānmelanaṃ vudhaḥ | sādhakasyākṣaraṃ pūrvaṃ maṃtrasyāpi tadakṣaraṃ ||
yadyeka bhūtadaivatyaṃ jānīyāt svakulaṃ hi tat ||
atha vālādibhedaḥ ||
ekākṣarādimārabhya yāvanmaṃtrāḥ ṣaḍakṣarāḥ | vālāste bhairaveṇoktā maṃtrāviṃśativarṇakāḥ ||
prauḍhājñeyā statonyeyete maṃtrāḥsthaṃ virāmatāḥ ||
atha stryādibhedaḥ ||
strīrūpāye'gnijāyāṃtā maṃtrādye tu namo'ṃtagāḥ | napuṃsakāste vijñeyāḥ pumāṃso huṃphaḍaṃtagāḥ ||
eteṣāṃ nāmānurūpaṃ phalaṃ ||
atha rāśimelanaṃ ||
a ā i ī bhavenneṣe u ū ṛ tritayaṃ vṛṣe | ṝ ḷ ḹ mithunāyāṃ ca e ai dvau karkaṭe tathā ||
u ū dvau siṃharāśau jñeyāstau kramataḥ surāḥ | aṃ aḥ śa ṣa sahālakṣaṃ kanyāyāmaṣṭakaṃ bhavet ||
tulāyāṃ tu kavargaḥ syādvṛścike ca cavargakaḥ | dhanuṣyapiṭavargaḥ syānmakare ca ta vargakaḥ ||
kuṃbheṃyavargomīnecaṃ yaralāvaḥ prakīrtitāḥ | sādhakanāmādyākṣaraṃ rāśiparyaṃtaṃ gaṇanākramaḥ ||
ekapaṃcaka navavādhavāḥ smṛtā dvau ca ṣaṭvadaśamāstu sevakāḥ | trīṇi saptavabhajāstu poṣakā dvādaśāṣṭaṃ caturastu ghātakāḥ ||
vaṃdhusevaka poṣakaṃ ghātakā iti trirāvṛttyā gaṇayet ||
<33b>
yo vaṃdhurbhavati sa rakṣakaḥ kṛtī sarvārthānapivitanoti sevakoyaḥ | puṣṭiḥ śrīrvibhavayaśāṃsi poṣakoyaḥ prāṇārthān vinihaṃti ghātakoyaḥ ||
atha nakṣatramelana gaṇamelane ||
a āśvinī daivagaṇaḥ iyamomānuṣogaṇaḥ | ī uktaṃ kṛttikārakṣaḥ ṛ ṝ ḷ ḹ brahmamānuṣaḥ ||
e mṛgo devagaṇa ai ārdrā mānuṣastathā | uṃ apunarvasū daivaḥ kaḥ puṣpo devatāgaṇaḥ ||
khagauśleṣāgaṇo rakṣo gha ṅa maghārākṣasogaṇaḥ | ca pūrvā mānuṣagaṇaḥ chajottaramanuṣyajau ||
jha ña hasto devagaṇaḥ ṭa ṭha citrātha rākṣasaḥ | ḍa svātī devagaṇo ḍhaṇviśāṃṣātha rākṣasaḥ ||
tathadā anurādhādyaurdhajyeṣṭhā rākṣaso gaṇaḥ | na pa pha mūlarakṣopiva pūrvāṣāḍha mānuṣaḥ ||
bhottarā mānuṣagaṇomo viṣṇurdevataḥ smṛtaḥ | yaraudhaniṣṭhā rakṣopi lavāruṇastu rākṣasaḥ ||
vaśau pūrvāmānuṣastuṣa sahā uttarānṛjaḥ | aṃ akṣo revatī daivogaṇayet sādhakākṣarāt ||
<34a>
janmasaṃpadvipakleśaḥ pratpariṃsādhakovadhaḥ | maitraṃ paramamaitraṃ ca janmādīṁśca punaḥ punaḥ ||
iti navanavagaṇayitvānāmānuguṇaṃ phalaṃ ||
tato gaṇanakṣatrāṇi |
anurādhāśvinī puṣpapunarvasukarāmṛgaḥ | svātī śravaṇarevatyo navadevagaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
ārdrābharaṇiṃ rohiṇyaḥ pūrvottara trayaṃ tathā | etāmartyaṃgaṇāstārāḥ śeṣārakṣogaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
tatrāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ |
devamānuṣayordevagaṇayośca mānuṣagaṇayośca maitrī na deva manuṣyagaṇayorākṣasagaṇeneti | parasya raviruddhānāṃ na kuryānmelanaṃ vudha ityuktatvāt || atha rākṣasagaṇayośca || atha ṛṇadhanaśodhanaṃ || iṃdra <14> rkṣa <21> netra <2> havi <12> paṃcadaśa <15> rtu <6> ve dai <4> rvahnyā <3> yudhā <5> ṣṭa <8> navabhi <9> rguṇitāṁśca sādhyān | di <10> gbhūṃ <1> giri <8> śruti <4> gajā <8> gni <3> munī <7> ṣu <5> vedaiḥ <2> ṣa <6> dvahnibhi <3> ścaguṇitānatha sādhakārṇān
<34b>
nyāsā tu lādakaṭhavān gajamattu śeṣaṃ jñātvo bhayoradhikaśeṣayutaṃ ṛṇaṃ syāt || asyāyamarthaḥ | maṃtrasya vyaṃjanāni svarāṁśca pṛthak kuryāt | sādhakanāmnaśca svarān vyaṃjanāni ca pṛthak kṛtvā sthāpayet | tato akaṭhavādyātmakaṃ ca varga catuṣṭayaṃ mātṛkāyāḥ kuryāt | a iṃ uṃ ṛṃ ḷ e e u ū | aṃ aḥ ityekaḥ | ka kha ga gha ṅa ca cha ja jha ña ṭa iti dvitīyaḥ | ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa ta tha da dha na pa pha iti tṛtīyaḥ | va bha ma ya ra la va śa ṣa sa ha iti caturthaḥ | evaṃ vargacatuṣṭa yasyāpi ekaikamakṣaraṃ gṛhītvā gṛhītvā akṣaraṃ catuṣṭayenaikaikovargo bhavati | akaṭhava ityekaḥ | i kha ḍa ta iti dvitīyaḥ | evaṃ krameṇa ekādaśa vargāḥ saṃpadyaṃte | eteṣāmekādaśa vargāṇāmebhirekādaśabhiraṃkairyathā kramekaikākṣaraṃ guṇayet | tadyathā | yadi maṃtre vargākṣarāṇi pataṃti tadā yathā saṃkhyaṃ iṃdrādibhirguṇayet | yadi sādhakanāmni pataṃti tadādigādibhiraṃkairyathā saṃkhyaṃ guṇayet | tayordvayorapyaṣṭabhiraṣṭabhirapi pātite aṃkādhika śeṣe ṛṇaṃ syāt | adhika varṇavān ṛṇī unavarṇavānuttamarṇaḥ | atatsādhakasyottamarṇatvamapekṣitaṃ ||
<35a>
atha suptaprabuddhaprakāraḥ || yataḥ | prayacchaṃti phalaṃ sarve prabuddhāmāṃtriṇāṃ sadā | tadyathā | svarāḥ ṣoḍaśa saumyāḥ | vyaṃjanānikādīnimāṃtāni saurāṇi || yakārādīnyāgneyāṇi | svareṣu a i u e ū aṃ hrasvāḥ | ā ī ṛ ai a aḥ dīrghāḥ | ṛ ṝ ḷ ḹ napuṃsakāḥ | yatadākrāṃtāstu maṃtrāḥ | yadā dakṣiṇamārge vāyurvahati tadā hrasva pradhānā maṃtrāḥ prabuddhā bhavaṃti | yadā vāmamārge vāyurvahatiṃ tadā dīrghapradhānā āgneyaśaurapradhānāśca saumyapradhānāśca napuṃsakānyubhayoḥ prabuddhā bhavaṃtīti || śāradāyāṃ | rephapraṇavāṃtya hakāra vahulā dakṣiṇe prāṇe āgneyāḥ prabuddhāḥ | saumyāḥ sakāra vakāra vahulā vāme vahati prabuddhāḥ | ubhayatra sarvepi anyatra suptāḥ | ubhayasvarena puṃsakapradhānā iti || etena dānakāle japakāle ca maṃtrāḥ phaladā bhavaṃti || atha yecchinnādayo maṃtrāste graṃthagauravānnalikhitāḥ | prayojanābhāvāt | te maṃtrā atra na saṃtyeva || ityādi maṃtramelana prakārāye uktāste sarvepi maṃtrena milaṃti | kiṃtu vahuguṇā alpadoṣā maṃtrādeyāḥ | yasyatvanena prakāretāddurvodhastasya sugamaṃ upabhyo likhyate ||
<35b>
nāmādyākṣaraṃ yanmaṃtrasyāpi tadakṣaraṃ cettadāsamilati | tathā coktaṃ |
sādhakasyākṣaraṃ yacca maṃtrasyāpi tadakṣara | yadyekabhūtadevatyaṃ jānīyāt svakulaṃ hi tat ||
atorāśi nakṣatra koṣṭhamelana prakāreṇā likhanamidaṃ ||
akārādi nāmnaḥ a ā ka ga ha kha da lā maṃtrāmilaṃti | kakārādi nāmnaṃ a ā kha yadgādyā maṃtrāmilaṃti ||
thādi nāmnaḥ ha ha jha ma kha da ga dha cha dyā milaṃti | hakārādi nāmnaḥ a ā ka kha dha kṣā dyā milaṃti ||
ukārādi nāmnaḥ e u ca pha ṛ ṣādyā milaṃti ||
ṣakārādi nāmnaḥ ca pha dhā dyā e vā rukārādi nāmnaḥ ya ra e dha chādyā milaṃti |
makārādi nāmnaḥ ka pa kha e ṭa ra i gādyā milaṃti | akārādi nāmnaḥ u ū ja ṭha śa tu pa ṇa khādyāmilaṃti ||
ukārādi nāmnaḥ u va i ga dha chādyāḥ | vādināmnaḥ ḍa u ḍa ka ṣādyāḥ ||
ākārādi nāmnaḥ kha da la gha lā ghā maṃtrā milaṃti | khakārādi nāmnaḥ ādaya i ga gha ḍā dyā maṃtrāmilaṃti ||
<36a>
dakārādi nāmnaḥ kharelādyā maṃtrāmilaṃti | cakārādi nāmnaḥ ṛṭaśajādyā maṃtrāmilaṃti ||
akārādi nāmnaḥ ca pha śa ja bha na śādyā maṃtrāmilaṃti | phakārādi nāmnaḥ ca ai ādyāmilaṃti | yakārādi nāmnaḥ ā ai ṭha la ī nā dyāḥ | ḍādināmnaḥ oṃ śa u pha ṇa ṣa na śa bhādyāḥ | śādināmnaḥ ṛ pha ṣa kṣa ta sa ja bhādyāḥ | īkārādi nāmnaḥ ga dha cha ṭa gha na ṭha a dyāḥ | gādināmnaḥ kṣa ī gha ṭha e akādyāḥ | dhādināmnaḥ ga kṣa e gha na ka tha hādyāḥ | chādināmnaḥ e ra ka hā dyāḥ | ṛkārādi nāmnaḥ cha ta aṃ u aḥ va bhajādyāḥ | chādināmnaḥ ca ja ta sa uḍādyāḥ | vādināmnaḥ cha ṇa ja bha pa nu pādyāḥ | ṭādināmnaḥ ṭha i nama a kaśca hādyāḥ | rādināmnaḥ e ca ai ca la i na jha ṇa akatha hādyāḥ | ṇakārādi nāmnaḥ ṣa na sa bha tu da upādyāḥ | īkārādināmnaḥ gha na la a ka tha ha ma ā dādyāḥ | ghādināmnaḥ la a ka ha ma ā khā dyāḥ | nādināmnaḥ la bha jā dyāḥ | jādināmnaḥ ta i sa ṛ ca jhā dyāḥ | bhādināmnaḥ pa va ca phā dyāḥ | ḍādināmnaḥ la gha na ma a ka tha ha ā dā dyāḥ | tādināmnaḥ sa va śa cā dyāḥ | sādināmnaḥ ta va śa cā dyāḥ ||
<36b>
anye prakārāyadi na milaṃti tathāpye tatkoṣṭarāśi nakṣatramelanamavaśyamapekṣaṇīyaṃ | yataḥ | svatārarāśi koṣṭhānāmanukūlān bhajenmanū nityuktatvāt | sādhyamaṃtrā api siddhasusiddhayogena viruddhāḥ samīcī tatvena jñeyāḥ ||
janenaṃ jīvanaṃ paścāttāḍanaṃ vodhanaṃ tathā | athābhiṣeko vimalī karaṇāpyāyane punaḥ ||
tarpaṇaṃ dīpanaṃ guptirdaśaitāmaṃtra saṃskriyāḥ ||
mātṛkāto maṃtroddhāro jananaṃ <1> praṇavāṃtarita maṃtraikaikākṣara japojīvanaṃ <2> maṃtravarṇāllikhitvā pratyakṣaraṃ vāyuvījena caṃdanāṃbhasā tāḍanaṃ tāḍanaṃ <3> likhitamaṃtrākṣarāṇi pratyakṣaraṃ karavīra puṣpaiḥ maṃtrākṣara saṃkhyākairvahnivījena hananaṃ vodhanaṃ <4> maṃtrākṣara saṃkhyayāśvaccha pallavairabhiṣecanaṃ abhiṣekaḥ <5> oṃ hrauṃ ityanena dahanaṃ vimalīkaraṇaṃ <6> anenaiva kuśodaka prokṣaṇaṃ āpyāyanaṃ <7> vāriṇā mūlamaṃtreṇa tarpaṇaṃ tarpaṇaṃ <8> oṃ hrīṁ śrīṁ vījapuraḥ sarajayodīpanaṃ <9> maṃtrāprakāśanaṃ gopanaṃ <10> iti daśasaṃskārasaṃskṛtā duṣṭā api maṃtrāḥ | kiṃ ca sānusvārairakārādibhiḥ savisargaiḥ
<37a>
pratilomaiḥ kakārādibhiśca pratyekaṃ mātṛkāvarṇaiḥ puṭī kṛto meruḥ | eṣākṣamālājapoya yuktā || anayā maṃtrajapaḥ siddhiśīghraphaladaḥ kakāphaladā bhavaṃti ||
iti śrīmadāśādityatripāṭhīsaṃgṛhīte maṃtrakoṣe maṃtramelanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭhaḥ parichedaḥ || atha bhūtaśuddhiḥ ||
mṛdāsane saṃvaddha padmāsane upaviśya apakrāmaṃ tu bhūtāni piśācāḥ pretaguhyakāḥ || ye cātra nivasaṃtyetā devatā bhuvisaṃsthitāḥ | apasarpaṃtute bhūtāyebhūtābhuvisaṃsthitāḥ | ye bhūtā vighnakartā rasvenaśyaṃ tu śivājñayā | iti krūradṛṣṭyāttānu vighnakartṝn niḥkārayet || pṛthvītvayā dhṛtā lokā devitvaṃ viṣṇunādhṛtā | tvaṃ ca dhārayamāṃ devi pavitraṃ kuru cāsanaṃ iti bhuvaṃ prārthayitvāḥ aghorāstrāya phaṭ iti tālatrayaṃ digvaṃdhanaṃ kṛtvā śāraṃgāya saśarāyasanārācāya śrīsudarśanāyāstrāya phaṭ iti choṭikaṃ yā īśānakoṇe astraṃ visṛjet | agniprākāratiṣṭhatiṣṭha iti tarjanyā agniprākāratrayaṃ kuryāt || śarīrasyāṃtaryāmī ṛṣiḥ prakṛtaṃ puruṣaṃ caṃdaḥ satyo devatā dharmārtha kāmamokṣārthe viniyogaḥ | āsana maṃtrasya meru
<37b>
pṛṣṭha ṛṣiḥ sutalaṃ chaṃdaḥ śrīkūrmodevatā meruparvatāgre āsanārthe viniyogaḥ || anaṃtāsanāya namaḥ <1> vimalāsanāya <2> yogāsanāya <3> padmāsanāya namaḥ <4> ityetairmaṃtrairabhimaṃtritān kuśānsvāsane dadyāt || oṃ pṛthivyādi mahābhūtānyātmani saṃhṛtyātmanā sahaparavyomnyudvāsayāmīti saṃkalpya pṛthivyādi sthānāni ciṃtayet ||
pādādi jānuparyaṃtaṃ pṛthivīsthānamucyate | ājānoḥ pāyuparyaṃtamayāṃ sthānaṃ prakīrtitaṃ ||
āpāyorhṛdayāṃtaṃ yadvahnisthānaṃ prakīrtitaṃ | āhṛnmadhyādbhruvormadhyaṃ yāvadvāyostuvarṇitaṃ ||
ābhrūmadhyādi mūrdhnāṃtamākāśamihacocyate | tatra pṛthivīsthāne pādeṃdriyagamanakriyā ||
gaṃtavyaṃ gaṃdhaghrāṇa pṛthivīpādasaṃbhava brahmanivṛtti samānavāyūnsaṃsmṛtya mūlādhārasthayā āpādatalamastakavyāptayā kuṃḍalinyāgrasyamānānsaṃsmṛtyaṃ oṃ hrīṃ brahmaṇe pṛthivyaṃdipataye nivṛtti kalātmane huṃphaṭ svāhā ityamuṃ maṃtramuccārya kuṇḍalinī dvārā ātmanyupa saṃharet || <1> || punarayāṃ sthāne hastādānādātavya rasarasanājalaviṣṇu pratiṣṭho dānansmṛtvā
<38a>
oṃ viṣṇave jalādhipataye pratiṣṭhā kalātmane huṃ phaṭ svāhā ityamuṃ maṃtramuccāryatānsarvān kuṇḍalinī dvārā ātmanyupasaṃharet || <2> || punaragnisthānepāyu visargavisarjanīya rūpa cakṣustejo rudravidyāvyānānsaṃsmṛtya oṃ hrūṁ rudrāya tejodhipataye vidyākalātmane huṃ phaṭ svāhā ityamuṃmaṃtramuccārya kuṇḍalinīdvārā ātmanyupasaṃharet || <3> || punarvāyusthāne upasthānaṃ tadviṣayasya saṃspraṣṭavya vāgīśvaraśāṃtyapānātsaṃsmṛtya oṃ hyeṁ īśānāya vāyvadhipataye śāṃtikalātmane huṃ phaṭ svāhā ityamuṃ maṃtramuccārya kuṇḍalinī dvārātānsarvān paramātmanyupasaṃharet || <4> || punarākāśasthāne vāgvadanavaktavyaśaṣṭaśrotākāśa sadāśiva śāṃtyatīta prāṇānsaṃsmṛtya oṃ hauṁ sadāśivāyākādhipataye śāṃtyatīta kalātmane huṃphaṭ svāhā ityamuṃ maṃtramuccāryatānsarvān kuṇḍalinīdvārā paramātmanyupasaṃharet || <5> || tāṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ lalāṭāgragāṃguṣṭha mātranādaśaktau nādaṃ viṃduṃ śaktauḥ tāṃcamūlaśaktau praṇavena saṃhṛtyatāṃ ca nirguṇe paramātmanyupa saṃharet || hṛṁ huṁ phaṭ ityanena ityupasaṃhṛtya svaśarīrasya śoṣaṇādikaṃ kuryāt | iḍayā vāyu mākṛṣya nābheradhoyaṃvījaṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ mahāvārciṣaṃ ciṃtayan kuṃbhakedvātriṃśadvārān japan
<38b>
