tena vāma kukṣistha madhomukha maṃguṣṭhamātramupapātakoṣa kalpitoyāṃgaṃ pāpapuruṣaśarīraṃ śoṣayet | taṃ vāyuṃ piṃgalayā recayet || <1> || punariḍayāvāyumākṛṣya mūlādhāre saṃyojya tatra ramiti vījaṃ piṃgalavarṇaṃ saṃciṃtya tena svaśarīraṃ pāpapuruṣaṃ dahan kuṃbhake catuḥ ṣaṣṭhivārān ramiti vījaṃ japan pāpapuruṣaṃ bhasmapiṃgale yāvahiḥ kuryāt || <2> || punariḍayā vāyumākṛṣya brahmaraṃdhre prāpajya tatra sahasradalakamale ca nityamṛtavījaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ saṃciṃtya tanniḥ sṛtayā amṛtadhārayā svaśarīraṃ saṃsican cetuḥ ṣaṣṭhivāraṃ kuṃbhakelamiti vījaṃ japet || <3> || punaridrayā vāyumākṛṣya mūlādhāre saṃyojya tatraṃlamiti pṛthivī vījaṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ saṃciṃtyatena svaśarīrabhasmaṃ pi (*)(?) kurvan catuḥ ṣaṣṭivāraṃ kuṃbhakelamiti vījaṃ japet || <4> || punaridrayā vāyumākṛṣya mūlādhāre hrīṃ bhuvaneśvarīvījaṃ saṃciṃtya (**)(?) śiraścaraṇādyavayavān kurvan kuṃbhake catuḥ ṣaṣṭivārān japet || <5> || evaṃ sthūlaṃ niḥpādya sūkṣmaśarīraṃ kuryāt | praṇavaṃ trayamuccārya ātmanaḥ sakāśānmūlaśaktiṃ nādaśaktiṃ viṃduśaktiṃ sṛṣṭvā hrīṃ nama ityanena || oṃ hauṃ sadāśivāyākāśādhipataye śāṃtyatīta kalātmane namaḥ ityanena maṃtreṇa viṃdurūpātmanaḥ prāṇaśāṃtyatīta
<39a>
sadāśivākāśaṃ śrotraśaṣṭavāgvadana vaktavyanutpādya ākāśasthāne sthāpayet || <1> || oṃ hyeṃ īśvarāya vāgadhipataye śāṃti kalātmane namaḥ ityayānaśāṃtīśvara vāyusparśaneṃdriyaspraṣṭavyopasthānaṃ tadviṣayān vāyusthāne sthāpayet || <2> || oṃ hrūṃ rudrāya tejodhipataye vidyā kalātmane namaḥ iti vyānavidyārudrāgni cakṣuḥ rūpavāyuvisargatadviṣayān agnisthāne sthāpayet || <3>|| oṃ hrīṃ viṣṇave jalādhipataye pratiṣṭhā kalātmane namaḥ iti udāna pratiṣṭhā viṣṇujalarasanārasahastādānādyān sṛṣṭvā apāṃsthāne sthāpayet || <4> || oṃ hrīṃ brahmaṇe pṛthivyadhipataye nivṛtti kalātmane namaḥ iti samāna nivṛtti brahmapṛthivī gaṃdhapādaṃ gamanagaṃtavyān sṛṣṭyā pṛthivī sthāne sthāpayet || <5> || evaṃ sūkṣmaśarīraṃ niṣpādya viṃdunāda mūlaśaktīnāṃ svaśarīre vyāptiṃ praṇavena kṛtvāḥ amṛtodaka saṃpūrṇaiḥ kalaśairhemanirmitaiḥ | dignārīṇāṃ karadhṛtairātmānamabhiṣiṃcāmi ityātmānamabhiṣiṃcya praṇavena hṛdiparamātmānamāvāhayet || tataḥ prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kuryāt | tadyathā || prāṇapratiṣṭhā maṃtrasya brahmaviṣṇurudrāḥ ṛṣayaḥ ṛgyajuḥ sāmātharvāṇi chaṃdāṃti prāṇodevatā prāṇapratiṣṭhārthe viniyogaḥ |
<39b>
oṃ āṃ hrīṃ krauṃ ya ra la va śa ṣa sa hoṃ saṃ haṃ saḥ mama prāṇā iha prāṇā mamajīva iha sthitaḥ | mama sarveṃdriyāṇi vāṅmanaścakṣuḥ śrotrajihvā ghrāṇaprāṇā ihaivāgatyasukhaṃciraṃtiṣṭhaṃtu svāhā haṃsaḥsaṃ | iti pratiṣṭhā maṃtreṇa tattatsthāne prāṇajīveṃdriyāṇi pratiṣṭhāpayet || tato vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa mātṛkānyāsaṃvidhāya śuddho bhavati japapūjādi yogyo bhavati || evaṃ vistaraṃ kartuśca samarthastadā saṃkṣepatopi bhūtaśuddhiḥ kāryā | tadyathā | digvaṃdhanādikaṃ kṛtvā praṇavena prāṇā ātmamanasā paramātmani saṃhṛtya pāpapuruṣeṇa sahasvaśarīraṃ yamiti vījaṃ dvātriṃśadvāraṃ japan śoṣayet || <1> || ramiti vījaṃ catuḥ ṣaṣṭhivāraṃ kuṃbhake japan śarīraṃ bhasmī kuryāt || <2> || punariḍayā vāyumākṛṣya kuṃbhakevamiti vījaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭhivāraṃ japan svaśarīrabhasmasiṃcet || <3> || tanniḥ sṛtāmṛtadhārayā tathaiva kuṃbhakelamiti vījaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭhivāraṃ japan śarīrabhasmapiṃḍī kuryāt || <4> || punastathaiva kuṃbhake hrīṃ bhuvaneśvarī vījaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭhivārān japan karaśiraścaraṇādyavayavān kṛtvā
<40a>
prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ pūrvavat kuryāt || iti trimaṃḍala bhūtaśuddhiḥ || atha paṃcamaṃḍala bhūtaśuddhi prākāro likhyate || hrāṃ nivṛtti kalāyai namaḥ <1> hrīṃ pratiṣṭhā kalāyai <2> hrūṃ vidyākalāyai <3> hyaiṃ śāṃtikalāyai <4> hauṃ śāṃtyatīta kalāyai namaḥ <5> ityebhirmaṃtraiḥ prāṇāyāma krameṇa pādayornābheraṃdhastāddhṛdaye kaṃṭhe śirasi ca paṃcamaṃḍalāni śodhayet || atha teṣāṃ svarūpāṇi || pṛthivī maṃḍalaṃ catuḥkoṇaṃ pītavarṇaṃ vajrāṣṭa lāṃchitaṃ laṃvījasahitaṃ brahmadevatātmakaṃ <1> āpyamaṃḍalaṃ padmadvayāṃtargatadhanurākāraṃ śvetavarṇaṃ vaṃvījātmakaṃ viṣṇudaivataṃ <2> agnimaṃḍalaṃ trikoṇaṃ svastikopetaṃ tadaṃtasyaraṃ vījātmakaṃ rudradevatātmakaṃ <3> vāyumaṃḍalaṃ ṣaḍviṃdulāṃchitaṃ aṃtasyayaṃ vījaṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ īśvaradevatātmakaṃ <4> ākāśamaṃḍalaṃ vṛttaṃ hakārāṃ tasthaṃ nīlavarṇaṃ sadāśivadevatākaṃ ciṃtayan <5> paṃcabhirmaṃtraiḥ paṃceṃdriya kṛtān doṣān śodhayet || ityeṣā paṃcamaṃḍala bhūtaśuddhiḥ || [iti śrīmadāśādityatripāṭhīsaṃgṛhītemaṃtrakoṣe bhūtaśuddhikathanaṃnāma saptamaḥ paricchedaḥ] || atha mātṛkānyāsaḥ ||
śuddhaścāpi sa viṃdukastvatha kalāyuccheśavādyastathā śrīkaṃṭhādiyutaśca śaktikamalāmāraistathaikaikaśaḥ | nyāsāstedaśa ca pṛthagni gaditāḥ
<40b>
syurbrahmaṃ yāgāṃtikāḥ sarvesādhakasiddhisādhanaparāḥ saṃkalpaklpadrumāḥ || ato'nyepi vācyāḥ || mātṛkāmaṃtrasya brahmā ṛṣirdaivīgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ varṇātmikā sarasvatī devatā sakalamaṃtrāṃgatve viniyogaḥ | oṃ aṃ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ṅaṃ āṃ jñānātmane hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> iṃ caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ ñaṃ īṃ śaktyai śirase svāhā <2> uṃ ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ oṃ valāyai śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> eṃ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ aiṃ aiśvaryāya kavacāya huṃ <4> ūṃ paṃ phaṃ vaṃ bhaṃ maṃ oṃ tejasenetra trayāya vauṣaṭ <5> aṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ laṃ kṣaḥ aḥ vīryāyāstrāya phaṭ <6> iti ṣaḍaṃganyāsaṃ kṛtvā dhyānaṃ kuryāt || paṃcāśadvarṇabhedairvihitavadanadoḥ pādayukakukṣivakṣo dehāṃ bhāsvat kapardākalita śaśikalāmiṃdukuṃdāvadātāṃ | akṣasrakakuṃbhaciṃtā likhitavarakarātrīkṣaṇāṃ padmasaṃsthāṃ svacchākalpāmatucchastanajaghanabharāṃ bhāratīṃtāṃ namāmi || dakṣiṇordha haste akṣasrak vāmorddha haste kuṃbhaḥ vāmādhaḥ ityādyukārādikṣakārāṃtanyāsakramaḥ | nyāsasthānāni | kānanavṛṃtadvyakṣiśrutito gaṃḍoṣṭhadaṃtamūrdhāsye | doḥyatsaṃdhyagreṣu ca pārśvadvayapṛṣṭhanābhi jaṭhareṣu | hṛddormūlāparagalakakṣeṣu hṛdādi pāṇipādayuge | jaṭharādiṣṭhaṃgeṣṭhā pāpakasaṃjñāṃ nyasedathākṣarān kramaśaḥ || athāṃtarmātṛkānyāsaḥ |
dvyaṣṭa patrāṃvuje kaṃṭhesvarān ṣoḍaśa vinyaset | dvādaśacchada hṛtpadmekādīn dvādaśa vinyaset ||
<41a>
daśapatrāṃvuje nāmauḍakārādīn daśanyaset | ṣaṭpatra madhyeliṃgasthe vakārādīnnyasecca ṣaṭ ||
ādhāre caturovarṇān vādīnnyaseccaturdale | hakṣau bhrūmadhyage padme lipinyāsoyamīritaḥ ||
etayorekataraṃ kuryāt ||
atha pūjā ||
mūlamaṃtreṇa prāṇāyāmaṃ kṛtvāḥ ardhasthāpanavidhinā arghapātraṃ sthāpayitvā pātrāṃtare oṃ ādhāraśaktyai namaḥ <1> mūlaprakṛtyai <2> maṃḍukāya <3> kālāgni rudrāya <4> kūrmāya <5> anaṃtāya <6> mahāvarāhāya <7> bhūmyai <8> mahāmerave <9> kalpavṛkṣāya <10> suvarṇamaṃḍapāya <11> ratnasiṃhāsanāya <12> nama ityuparyuparipūjayet || tadupari caturasraṃ pīṭhaṃ parikalpya āgneyādi koṇamārabhya dharmāya <1> jñānāya <2> vairāgyāya <3> aiśvaryāya namaḥ <4> iti pīṭhakoṇeṣu pūjayet | oṃ adharmāya namaḥ <1> ajñānāya <2> avairāgyāya <3> anaiśvaryāya namaḥ <4> iti pīṭhagātreṣu || taṃ tamase namaḥ <1> raṃ rajase <2> saṃ satvāya <3> māṃ māyāyai <4> viṃ vidyāyai <5> āṃ ātmane <6> paṃ paramātmane <7> jñāṃ jñānātmane <8> vaṃ vahnimaṃḍalātmane <9> nama ityuparyuparipūjayet | tadupari aṣṭadalaṃ kamalaṃ parikalpya tatkarṇikāyāṃ hmau iti vījaṃ likhitvā aṃ āṃ ityādidvaṃdvaṃkeśareṣu likhet | ka ca ṭa ta pa ya śa iti vargasaptakaṃ lakṣaṃ ityekaḥ | evaṃ vargāṣṭakaṃ padmapatrāṣṭakeṣu likhet || tadvahirvahnimaṃḍalaṃ vilikhya tatkoṇeṣu ṭhakāraṃ dikṣu vakāraṃ vilikhet | padmakarṇikāyāṃ devīṃ pūrvoktāṃ sarasvatīṃ āvāhya pādyādibhirupacāraiḥ pūjayet |
<41b>
agnīśāsuravāyuṣu purataḥ pṛṣṭhataścāṃgāni pūjayet | aṃgadevatā pūjā sarvatra namoṃtā śikhādiṣṭapi | aṃ āṃ nama iti kesarasthāneṣu pūjayitvā patreṣu likhitāṣṭa vargān pūjayet | oṃ medhāyai namaḥ <1> prajñāyai <2> prabhāyai <3> vidyāyai <4> dhiye <5> dhṛtyai <6> smṛtyai <7> budhyai namaḥ <8> iti prāgādi patreṣu pūjayet || vidyaiśvaryai namaḥ iti kamalakarṇikāyāṃpurataḥ | brāhmyai <1> māheśvaryai <2> kaumāryai <3> vaiṣṇavyai <4> vārāhyai <5> māheṃdryai <6> cāmuṃḍāyai <7> mahālakṣmyai namaḥ iti svadikṣu pūjayet || iṃdrāya namaḥ <1> agnaye <2> yamāya <3> nirṛtaye <4> varuṇāya <5> vāyave <6> kuverāya <7> īśānāya nama iti svadikṣu pūjayet || tato yathā śakti japitvā devīṃ visarjayet | lakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | nyāsaścalakṣaṃ | madhuratrayasaṃyuktaiḥ śuddhaistilairdaśāṃśo homaḥ || trimāsamaṃbhaḥ parijaptame tayā piveddinādāvapividyayāsudhīḥ | anenamūkopikavitvagarvitaḥ parāṃ ca siddhiṃ labhate'rkamāsataḥ || vinyāsairathasajapairhutārcanādyairdhyānaiśca prabhajati bhāratīyaḥ | saśrīmān punaracireṇa kāvyakartāvyāsādīñjayatijarāyamṛtyurogaiḥ ||
somasūryāgni rūpāḥ syurvarṇa lohatrayaṃ tathā | raupyamiṃduḥ smṛto hemasūryastāmraṃhutāśanaḥ ||
lohabhāgāḥ samuddiṣṭā svarādyakṣarasaṃkhyayā | tairlohaiḥ kārayenmudrāmasaṃkalita saṃgatāṃ ||
sāgraṃ sahasraṃ saṃjapyatā spṛṣṭvā juhuyāttataḥ | tasyāṃ saṃpātayenmaṃtrī sarpiṣā pūrvasaṃkhyayā ||
<42a>
nikṣipya kuṃbhetāṃ mudrāmābhiṣekokta vartmanāṃ | āvāhya pūjayeddevīmupacāraiḥ samāhitaḥ ||
abhiṣicya vinītāya dadyāttāṃ mudrikāṃ guruḥ | iyaṃ rakṣā kṣudraroga viṣajvara vināśinī ||
vyāghracoramṛgādibhyo rakṣāṃ kuryādviśeṣataḥ | yuddhe vijayamāpnoti dhārayanānujeśvaraḥ ||
svarādyakṣarasaṃkhyeti ṣoḍaśa paṃcaviṃśati daśasaṃkhyayetyarthaḥ | tathā ca prapaṃcasāre | vargasvarayādyaṃśāḥ krameṇa kaladhautarajatatāmrāsyuḥ | iti racitaṃ rucakamidaṃ sādhakārthadāyi satataṃ syāt || nyāsa kramastu śuddha prathamaḥ || visargānvitaḥ sṛṣṭinyāsaḥ | ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvoktaṃ | ṣaḍaṃgāni visargāṃtāni | dhyānaṃ || siṃdūrakāṃtimamitābharaṇaṃ trinetraṃ vidyākṣasūtramṛgayotavarān dadhānaṃ | pārśvasthitāṃ bhagavatīṃmapikāṃcanābhāṃ dhyāyetkarābjadhṛtapustakavarṇamālāṃ || ūrdhva vāmadakṣiṇakarayoḥ pustakākṣamāle |
tadadhaḥ mṛgaśāvakavaraudadhānaṃ devaṃ | pustakaṃ vāme dakṣiṇe'kṣamālāṃ dadhānāṃ devī ||
pūjādikaṃ ca pūrvavat || nyāsa kramastu | aḥ namaḥ | āḥ namaḥ | iḥ namaḥ ityādi || visargaviṃdvaṃtaḥ sthitinyāsaḥ | sarvaṃ pūrvavat | nyāsa kramastu | aṃḥ namaḥ | āṃḥ namaḥ | iṃḥ namaḥ | ityādi ||| pratilomato viṃduyuktaḥ saṃhāranyāsaḥ | ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvavat | dhyānaṃ | akṣasrajaṃ hariṇayotamudagravaṃkaṃ vidyākarai ravirataṃdadhatīṃ trinetrāṃ | ardheṃdu maulimaruṇāmaraviṃda vāsāṃ varṇeśvarīṃ praṇamatastanabhāranamrāṃ || nyāsārcanādikaṃ pūrvat |
<42b>
dakṣiṇādhaḥ karamārabhyākṣasragādīni | nyāsakramastu | kṣaṃ namaḥ | laṃ namaḥ | ityādi || atha sārasvatārthaṃ vāgvījādyaḥ | ṛṣyāṛṣyādikaṃ mātṛvat | nyāsaṃ kramastu | aṃ aiṃ namaḥ | āṃ aiṃ namaḥ ityādi || atha vighnopaśāṃtyarthe gāṇapatyanyāsaḥ || gaṇaka ṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ gaṇapati svarūpiṇī sarasvatī devatā vighnopaśāṃtaye viniyogaḥ | gāṃgīmityādi ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | dhyānaṃ | vījāpūragadekṣukārmukaṃrujā ca krābjapāśāṃkuśa vrīhyagrasvaviṣāṇa ratnakalaśaprodyatkarāṃbhoruhaḥ | devaṃ pustaka pūrṇakuṃbhavilasanmudrākṣamālādharā viśvotpattivināśasaṃsthitikarī dhyeyā ca devī parā || dakṣiṇopari karamārabhya vījapūrādīni dadhāno devaḥ | adho vāmakaramārabhya pustakādīni dadhānā devī | oṃ aṃ gaṃ namaḥ | oṃ āṃ gaṃ namaḥ | ityādi nyāsakramaḥ | evaṃ gaṇapatyārādhane nyaset || atha aiśvaryārthe śaktivījādyaḥ || śaktirṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ viśvajananī sarasvatī devatā sarvaiśvaryārthenamaseviniyogaḥ || hrāṃ hrīṃ ityādi ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | dhyānaṃ | udyatkoṭi divākara pratibhaṭātuṃgorūpīnastanī vaddhārdheṃdu kirīṭahāra rasanā maṃjīra saṃśobhitā | vibhrāṇākarapaṃkajairjapapaṭīṃ pāśāṃkuśau pustakaṃ diśyādvojagadīśvarī trinayanā padmeni ṣaṇāśriyaṃ || dakṣiṇādhaḥ karamārabhya japapaṭī prabhṛti dhyeyaṃ || aṃ hrīṃ namaḥ | āṃ hrīṃ namaḥ | ityādi nyāsakramaḥ || pūjādi pūrvavat | durgārādhane yujyate || atha śrī
<43a>
prāptaye śrīvījādinyāsaḥ | bhṛguṛṣirgāyatrīchaṃdaḥ śrīsvarūpiṇī mātṛkā devatā śrīvṛddhyarthe mātṛkānyāse viniyogaḥ | oṃ aṃ śrī namaḥ | oṃ āṃ śrī namaḥ | ityādi | dhyānaṃ | vidyuddāma samaprabhāṃ himagiri prakhyaiścaturdhirgajaiḥ śuṃḍādaṃḍa samuddṛtā mṛtarasairāsicya mānāmimāṃ | vibhrāṇāṃ karapaṃkajairjapapaṭīṃ padmadvayaṃ pustakaṃ bhāṃsvadratva samujvalāṃ kuṃcanatāṃ dhyāyejjagatsvāminīṃ | dakṣiṇādhaḥ karamārabhya japapaṭī prabhṛti catvāri dhyeyāni | evaṃ lakṣmyāṃrādhane nyaset || atha vaśyārthe kāmavījādiḥ | saṃmohana ṛṣiḥ paṃktiḥ chaṃdaḥ kāmajananī sarasvatī devatāvaśyārthe mātṛkānyāse viniyogaḥ | klāṃ klīṃ ityādi ṣaḍaṃgaṃ dhyānāṃ | vālārkakoṭhirucirāṃ sphaṭikākṣamālāṃkodaṃḍabhikṣujanitāṃ smaravāṇāpaṃcan | vidyāṃ ca hastakamalairdadhanīṃ trinetrāṃ dhyāyet samastajananīṃ navacaṃdracūḍāṃ || dakṣiṇa vā meva karayo rakṣamālā pustake | tadupari paṃcavāṇa dhanuṣī pūjādikaṃ ca pūrvavat | aṃ klīṃ namaḥ | āṃ klīṃ namaḥ | ityādi nyāsaḥ | eṣavaśyārthe || atha aiśvarya lakṣmī vaśyārthe nyāsaḥ || brahmā ṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ triśaktirūpiṇī saṃmohinī sarasvatī devatā aiśvaryārthe nyāse viniyogaḥ | hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṁ ityādi kramotkramābhyāṃ tribhirvījaiḥ ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | dhyāyeyaṃ makṣavalayekṣu śarāśapāśān padmadvayāṃkuśaśarānnavapustakaṃ ca | āvibhraṃtī nijakarairaruṇāṃkucārtāṃ saṃmohanīṃ triṇayanāṃ taruṇeṃdu cūḍāṃ |
<43b>
uparitana vāmakaradvaye padmadvayaṃ | tadadhaḥ pāśāṃkuśau | tadadhaḥ śaradhanuṣī | tadadho'kṣamālā pustake | pūjādikaṃ pūrvavat | oṃ aṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ namaḥ | āṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ namaḥ | ityādinyāsa kramaḥ || atha śrīkaṃṭhādinyāsaḥ śivapūjāyāṃ praśastaḥ | dakṣimūrti ṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ ardhanārīśvaro devatā sakalapuruṣārthasiddhi pūrvakaṃ śrīkaṃṭhādinyāse viniyogaḥ | hlāṃ hlīṃ ityādi ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | dhyānaṃ ca | vaṃdhūka kāṃcananibhaṃ rucirākṣamālāṃ pāśāṃkuśau ca varadaṃ nijavāhudaṃḍaiḥ | vibhrāṇamiṃduśakalābharaṇaṃ triṇetramardhāṃ vikeśamaṃ niśaṃva purāśrayāmi | dakṣiṇādhaḥ karamārabhyākṣamālādīni | oṃ aṃ śrīkaṃṭhāya pūrṇodaryai namaḥ <1> āṃ anaṃteśāya virajāyai <2> iṃ sūkṣmāya śālmalyai <3> īṃ trimūrtaye lolākṣyai <4> oṃ amareśvarāya vartulākṣyai <5> oṃ accīśāya dīrghaghoṇāyai <6> ṛṃbhārabhūtaye sudīrghamukhyai <7> ṝṃ atithīśāya gomukhyai <8> ḷṃ sthārāvīśāyadīrghajihvāyai <9> ḹṃ harāya kuṃḍodaryai <8> eṃ jhaṃṭīśāya urdhvakeśinyai <11> aiṃ bhautikeśāya vikṛtamukhyai <12> oṃ sadyojātāya jvālāmukhyai <13> oṃ anugraheśāya ulkāmukhyai <14> aṃ akrūreśāya śrīmukhyai <15> kaṃ krodhīśāya mahākālyai <17> khaṃcaṃḍīśāya sarasvatyai <18> gaṃ paṃcāṃtāya sarvasiddhyai <19> ghaṃ śivottamāya gauryai <20> ṅaṃ ekarudreśāya trailokyavidyāyai <21> caṃ kūrmeśāya maṃtraśaktyai <22> chaṃ ekanetrāya ātmaśaktyai <23> jaṃ caturānaneśāyamamārtre <24> jhaṃ ajeśāyalavoharyai <25>
<44a>
ñaṃ sarveśāyadrāviṇyai <26> ṭaṃ someśāyanāgaryai <27> ṭhaṃ lāṃgalīśāya khacaryai <28> ḍaṃ dārukeśāya maṃjaryai <29> ḍhaṃ ardhanārīśvarāyarūpiṇyai <30> ṇaṃ umākāṃteśāyavīriṇyai <31> taṃ āvyāniśāya koṭaryai <32> thaṃ daṃḍīśāya pūtanāyai <33> daṃ atrīśāya bhadrayoginyai <34> dhaṃ mīneśāya śaṃkhinyai <35> naṃ meṣeśāyagarjinyai <36> paṃ lohiteśāya kālarātryai <37> phaṃ śikhīśāya kurdinyai <38> vaṃ chagaleśāyakapardinyai <39> bhaṃ dvilaṃ īśāyavajrāyai <40> maṃ mahākālāya jāyāyai <41> yaṃ tvagātmane kapālīśāya sumukheśvaryai <42> raṃ asṛgātmanebhujaṃgeśāyarevatyai <43> laṃ māṃsātmane pinākīśāya mādhavyai <44> vaṃ meda ātmane khaḍgīśāyavāruṇyai <45> śaṃ asthyātmane vakreśāya vāyavyai <46> ṣaṃ majjātmane śveteśāya rakṣyoṁ vadhāriṇyai <47> saṃśukrātmane bhṛgvīśāya sahajāyai <48> haṃ lakulīśāya mahālakṣmyai <49> laṃ śiveśāya vyāpinyai <49> kṣaṃ saṃvartakeśāya māyāyai <50> namaḥ iti pūrvoktasthāneṣu nyāsakramaḥ | arcanādikaṃ mātṛkāvat || atha śrīkṛṣṇapūjāyāṃ keśavāṃdinyāsaḥ | kāmavījādiḥ | prajāpati ṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdolakṣmī nārāyaṇo devatā caturvidha puruṣārtha siddhyarthe nyāse viniyogaḥ | klāṃ klīṃ mityādi ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | dhyānaṃ | hastairvibhratsarasijagadāśaṃkhacakrāṇi vidyāṃ padmādarśaukanakakalaśaṃmeghavidyudvilāśaṃ | vāmottuṃgastanamaviralā kalpamāśleṣalomādekī bhūtaṃ vapuravatuvaḥ puṃḍarīkākṣa lakṣmyoḥ ||
<44b>
dakṣiṇādhaḥ karamārabhyaḥ sarasijādīni | lakṣmībhāge vāmādhaḥ karamāranyavidyādīni ||
klīṃ aṃ keśavāya kīrtyai namaḥ | klīṃ āṃ nārāyaṇāyaṃ kāṃtyai | iṃ mādhavāya tuṣṭyai | īṃ goviṃdāya puṣṭyai | uṃ viṣṇavedhṛtyai | ūṃ madhusūdanāyakāṃtyai | oṃ trivikramāya kriyāyai | oṃ vāmanāyadayāyai | ḷṃ śrīdharāyamedhāyai | ḹṃ hṛṣīkeśāya harṣāyai | eṃ padmanābhāya śraddhāyai | aiṃ dāmodarāya lajjāyai | oṃ vāsudevāyalakṣmyai | oṃ saṃkarṣaṇāya sarasvatyai | aṃ pradyumnāya prītyai | aḥ aniruddhāyaratyai || kaṃcakriṇe jayāyai | khaṃ khadine durgāyai | gaṃ śārṅgiṇe prabhāyai | ghaṃ khaḍgine satyāyai | ṅaṃ śaṃkhine caṃḍāyai | caṃ halinevāṇyai | chaṃ muśaline vilāsinyai | jaṃ śūlike vijayāyai | jhaṃ pāśine virajāyai | ñaṃ aṃkuśine viśvāyai | ṭaṃ mukuṃdāya viśadāyai | ṭhaṃ naṃdajāya sunaṃdāyai | oṃ naṃdine smṛtyai | ḍhaṃ nārāyaṇāya ṛddhyai | ṇaṃ narakaṃjite samṛddhyai | taṃ haraye śuddhyai | thaṃ kṛṣṇāya bhuktyai | daṃ satyāya śuddhyai | dhaṃ sātvanāyamatyai | naṃ śauriṇe kṣamāyai | paṃ śūrāyaramāyai | phaṃ janārdanāya umāyai | vaṃ bhūdharāya kledinyai | bhaṃ viśvamūrtaye klinnāyai | maṃ vaikuṃṭhāya vasudhāyai | yaṃ puruṣottamāya vasudhāyai | raṃ valineparāyai | laṃ valānujāyaparāyai | vaṃ valāyapārāyaṇāyai | śaṃ vṛṣaghnāya saṃdhyāyai | ṣaṃ vṛṣāya prajñāyai | saṃ hasāya prabhāyai |
<45a>
haṃ varāhāṃya niśāyai | laṃ vimalāya amoghāyai | kṣaṃ nṛsiṃhāya vidyutāyai namaḥ iti pūrvoktasthāneṣu nyaset | pūjādi pūrvavat || atha praṇavakalā nyāsaḥ || prajāpati ṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ kalātmikāṃ sarasvatī devatā mokṣārthenyase viniyogaḥ | aṃ ūṃ āṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ | iṃ uṃ īṃ śirase svāhā | uṃ ūṃ oṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | ityādi ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | dhyānaṃ | hastaiḥ padmaṃ rathāṃgaṃ guṇamatha hariṇaṃ pustakaṃ varṇamālāṃṭaṃkaṃ śubhraṃ kapālaṃ dalamaṃmṛtalasaddhemakuṃbhaṃ vahaṃtī | muktāṃ vidyutyayo sphaṭika navajapāvaṃdhuraiḥ paṃcavaktraistryakṣairvakṣojanamrāṃ sakalaśaśinibhāṃ | śāradāṃtāṃ namāmi | vā mādho hastamārabhyaṃ padmādīni | iti dhyātvā sakalāṃ mātṛkāṃ nyaset || tadyathā | oṃ aṃ nivṛtyai | āṃ pratiṣṭhāyai | iṃ vidyāyai | īṃ śāṃtyai | uṃ iṃdhikāyai | ūṃ dīpikāyai | ṛ recikāyai | ṝ mocikāyai | ḷṃ sūkṣmāyai | ḹṃ sūkṣmāmṛtāyai | eṃ jñānāyai | aiṃ jñānāmṛtāyai | oṃ āpyāyinyai | oṃ vyāpinyai | aṃ vyomarūpāyai | aḥ anaṃtāyai | kaṃ sṛṣṭyai | khaṃ ṛddhyai | gaṃ smṛtyai | ghaṃ medhāyai | ṅaṃ kāṃtyai | caṃ lakṣmyai | chaṃ dūtyai | jaṃ sthirāyai | jhaṃ sthityai | jñaṃ siddhyai | ṭaṃ jarāyai | ṭhaṃ mālinyai | ḍaṃ śāṃtyai | ḍhaṃ aiśvaryai | ṇaṃ ratyai | taṃ kāminyai | thaṃ varadāyai | daṃ hlādinyai | dhaṃ prītyai | naṃ dīrghāyai | paṃ tīkṣṇāyai | phaṃ raudrāyai | vaṃ bhayāyai | bhaṃ nidrāyai | maṃ taṃdryai | yaṃ kṣudhāyai | raṃ krodhinyai | laṃ kriyāyai | vaṃ utkāryai | śaṃ mṛtyave | ṣaṃ prītāyai | saṃ śvetāyai | haṃ aruṇāyai | laṃ amitāyai | kṣaṃ anaṃtāyai namaḥ ityukta sthāneṣu nyāsaḥ ||
<45b>
pūjādi pūrvavat ||
atha prapaṃcayāgaṃnyāsaḥ | brahmā ṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ yaṃ tejorūpiṇī sarasvatī devatā samastavastusiddhayenyāse viniyogaḥ | svāhā hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> sohaṃ śirase svāhā <2> haṃsaḥ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> hrīṃ kavacāya hūṃ <4> oṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ <5> harihara astrāya phaṭ <6> iti ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | dhyānaṃ | tārādi paṃcamanubhiḥ paricīyamānaṃ mānairagaṇyamaniśaṃ jagadekamūlaṃ | saṃvitsamastagamanasvaramacyutaṃ tattejaḥ paraṃ bhajatasāṃdūsudhāṃvurāśiṃ || oṃ hrīṃ aṃ āṃ iṃ īṃ uṃ ūṃ ṛṃ ṝṃ ḷṃ ḹṃ eṃ aiṃ oṃ auṃ aṃ aḥ haṃsaḥ sohaṃ svāhā vadane <1> oṃ hrīṃ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ṅaṃ haṃsaḥ sohaṃ svāhā dakṣiṇavāhau <2> oṃ hrīṃ caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ ñaṃ haṃsaḥ sohaṃ svāhā vāmavāhau <3> oṃ hrīṃ ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ haṃsaḥ sohaṃ svāhā dakṣiṇapāde <4> oṃ hrīṃ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ haṃ saḥ sohaṃ svāhā vāmapāde <5> oṃ hrīṃ paṃ phaṃ vaṃ bhaṃ maṃ haṃsaḥ sohaṃ svāhā śīrṣe <6> oṃ hrīṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ laṃ kṣaṃ haṃsaḥ sohaṃ svāhā vakṣasi <7> iti nyāsaṃ kṛtvā oṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ sohaṃ svāhā iti paramātmā'ṣṭākṣaramaṃtromātṛkāsaṃvaṃdhaṃ vināpi mumukṣubhirjapyaḥ | nyāsastu | oṃ hrīṃ aṃ haṃ saḥ sohaṃ svāhā | oṃ hrīṃ āṃ haṃsaḥ sohaṃ svāhā | ityādi pūrvasthāneṣu nyāsaḥ | evaṃ nyāse divyatanurbhavati || atha grahanyāsaḥ || aṃ āṃ iṃ īṃ uṃ ūṃ ṛṃ ṝṃ ḷṃ ḹṃ eṃ aiṃ oṃ auṃ aṃ aḥ ādityāya namaḥ vadane <1> kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ṅaṃ aṃgārakāya namaḥ dakṣiṇavāhau <2> caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ ñaṃ śukrāya namaḥ vāmavāhau <3>
<46a>
ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ vudhāya namaḥ dakṣiṇapāde <4> taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ vṛhaspataye namaḥ vāmapāde <5> paṃ phaṃ vaṃ bhaṃ maṃ śanaiścarāya namaḥ jaṭhare <6> yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ kṣaṃ somāya namaḥ vakṣasi <7> || atha mahāsaṃpadarthaṃ śaktikamalāpūrakonyāsaḥ | aṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ namaḥ | āṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ namaḥ | ityādinyāsaḥ | kānanavṛttetyādiṣu prabhedāt || atha sakalaṃ siddhayenyāsaḥ || aṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ drāṃ klīṃ hlūṃsaḥ ityādi || evaṃ sa viṃdukanyāsaḥ kalānyāsaḥ || grahanyāsaḥ prapaṃcayāganyāsaśca sarvataṃtreṣu praśastaḥ || anyānapi mātṛkānyāsān jñānīmaḥ | tān graṃthagauravabhayāścalikhāmaḥ || iti śrīmadāsādityatripāṭhīsaṃgṛhīte maṃtrakoṣe mātṛkānyāsaṃ paricchedo'ṣṭamaḥ samāptaḥ atha sārasvatamaṃtrāḥ ||
tatra bhūtalipiḥ | a i u ū ḷ e ai ū a ha ya ra va la <3> iṃ ka kha ga <4> ña ca cha ja jha <5> ṇa ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṭa <6> na ta tha dha da <7> ma pa pha na va <8> śa ṣa sa <9> evaṃ navavargāḥ || ebhya ekaikaṃ bhakṣaramuddhṛtya vyomādi paṃcavargāḥ kāryāḥ | tadyathā | a e ha ṅa ña ṇa namaśāḥ iti vyomavargaḥ <1> ī ai ya ka va da ta paṃ ṣāḥ iti vāyuvargaṃ <2> uṃ ūṃ ra kha cha ṭha tha pha ṇaḥ ityagni vargaḥ <3> oṃ auṃ va gha ru ḍha dha ma | iti jalavargaḥ <4> ḷ kha ga ja ḍa da vā dharāvargaḥ <5> evaṃ dvicatvāriṃśa dakṣarātmako bhūtalipimaṃtraḥ || asya dakṣiṇāmūrti ṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ varṇeśvarī devatā vidyārthe viniyogaḥ | hādi ṣaḍvargaiḥ ṣaḍaṃgāni | dhyānaṃ |
<46b>
aṃkonmukta śaśāṃkakoṭisadṛśīmāpīna tuṃgastanī caṃdrārddhāṃkita mastakāṃ madhumadādālolanetratrayāṃ | vibhrāṇāmapiśaṃvaraṃ japapatīṃ vidyāṃ kapālaṃkarairādyāṃ yauvanapardhinaṃ | lipitanuṃ vāgīśvarī mā'sraye dakṣiṇādhaḥ karamaṃrabhya varādīni | iti dhyātvā pūrvokta pīṭhe devī māvāhya pūjayet || atha daśākṣarī vāgvādinī maṃtraḥ | vadavadavāgvādini svāhā || asya kāśyapa ṛṣirvirāṭ chaṃdaḥ | vāgvādinī devatā vidyārthye viniyogaḥ | vaṃ vījeliṃge svāhā | śaktipādayonyaset | vākakīlakaṃ | aṃ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ āṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ ityādi mātṛkokta ṣaḍaṃganyāsaṃ kṛtvā maṃtrākṣarāṇi nyaset | vaṃ śirasi daṃ dakṣiṇa śrotre <2> vaṃ vāma śrotre <3> dakṣiṇa netre <4> vāṃ vāmanetre <5> vāṃ dakṣiṇanāsāpuṭe <6> diṃ vāmanāsāpuṭe <7> niṃ vadane <8> svaṃ ṣaṣṭhye īṃ hāṃ yude || dhyānaṃ | amalakamala saṃsthā lekhanī pustakodyatkarayugalasarajī kuṃdamaṃdāramaṃdāragauṇa ghṛta śaśadharakhaṃḍollāsikoṭīra cūḍā bhavatu bhavabhayānāṃ bhaginī bhāratīvaḥ | dakṣiṇa karetvakhatrī | vāme pustakaṃ | iti dhyātvā | mātṛkokta pīṭha padme medhāyai namaḥ | prajñāyai <2> prabhāyai <3> vidyāyai <4> dhiye <5> dhṛte <6> smṛtyai <7> vidyeśvaryai <8> nama iti prāgādi patreṣu madhye ca pīṭhaśaktīḥ pūjayitvā tatkarṇikāyāṃ sarvaśakti kamalāsanāyai namaḥ iti pīṭhamūlayitvā devī māvāhya pūjayet | mūlamaṃtra muccārya idaṃ pādyaṃ eṣordyaḥ idamācamanīyaṃ
<47a>
punarācamanīyaṃ vastrācamanīyaṃ puṣpāṃjalitrayākṣatakuśānnivedayet || tato'ṃgāvaraṇaṃ | agnīśāsuravāyuṣu purataḥ pṛṣṭhataśca ṣaḍaṃgāni pūjayet | tataḥ kamaladaleṣu prāgādi krameṇa yogāyai namaḥ <1> satyāyai <2> | vimalāyai <3> | jñānāyai <4> | smṛtyai <5>| buddhyai <6> | medhāyai <7> | prajñāyai <8> nama iti pūjayet | brāhmyai <1> māheśvaryai <2> kaumāryai <3> vaiṣṇavyai <4> vārāhyai <5> māheṃdryai <6> cāmuṃḍāyai <7> mahālakṣmyai namaḥ <8> iti pūjayet | iṃdrāya devādhipataye sāyudhāya sa vāhanāya namaḥ <1> agnaye tejodhipataye <2> yamāya pretādhipataye <3> nirṛtaye rakṣodhipataye <4> varuṇādhipataye <5> vāyave prāṇādhipataye <6> kuverāya yakṣādhipataye <7> īśānāya vāhvadhipataye <8> nirṛtivaruṇayormadhye anaṃtāya nāgādhipataye <9> īśāneṃdrayormadhye brahmaṇe lokādhipataye <10> sāyudhāya sa vāhanāya namaḥ iti svadikṣu pūjayet || iti pūjayitvā yathāśakti japitvā anena japena vāgvādinīmeprīyatāmiti japaṃ nivedya natvāstutvā saṃhāramudrayā visarjayet || daśalakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | kṣīrāktaiḥ śvetakamalairdaśāṃśohomaḥ | trimadhurāktaistilairvāhomaḥ ||
pītvā tanmaṃtritaṃ toyaṃ sahasraṃ pratyahaṃ japet | mahākavirbhavenmaṃtrīvatsareṇa na saṃśyaḥ ||
rājavṛkṣa samudbhūtaiḥ prasūnairmadhurāplutaiḥ | tatsamidbhiśca juhuyāt kavitvamatulaṃ labhet ||
atha ṣoḍaśākṣarī vāgvādinī | aiṃ namo bhagavati vadavadavāgdevi svāhā | ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvoktaṃ |
<47b>
aiṃ vījaṃ svāhā śaktiḥ vākkīlakaṃ vāksiddhaye viniyogaḥ | aiṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> namaḥ śirase svāhā <2> bhagavati śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> vadavada kavacāya huṃ <4> vāgdevi netratrayāya vauṣaṭ <5> svāhā astrāya phaṭ <6> | dhyānaṃ | śubhrāṃ svacchavileyamālyavasanāṃśītāṃ śukhaṃḍo jvalāṃ vyākhyāmakṣaguṇaṃ sudhāḍhyakalaśaṃ padmaṃ ca hastāṃvujaiḥ | vibhrāṇāṃ kamalāsanāṃ kucanatāṃ vāgdevatāṃ susmitāṃ vaṃde vāgvibhavapradāṃ triṇayanāṃ saubhāgyasaṃpatkarīṃ || dakṣiṇādhaḥ karamārabhya vyākhyādi catuṣṭayaṃ vibhrāṇāṃ | pūjādikaṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ || atha haṃsavāgīśvarī parijātta sarasvatī maṃtraḥ || oṃ hrīṃ aiṃ hrīṃ oṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ | haṃsavāgīśvarī maṃtrasya śakti ṛṣirdaivī gāyatrī chaṃdaḥ sarasvatī devatā vāksiddhaye viniyogaḥ | hraiṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ ityādi ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | aiṃ nama ityādinā vā brahmaraṃdhra bhrūmadhyanetraśrotranāsāraṃdhra dvayaṃ jihvāliṃgagudeṣu maṃtrākṣarāṇi vinyaset | tato dhyānaṃ | vāṇīṃ pūrṇaniśākaro jvalamukhīṃ karpūrakuṃdaprabhāṃ caṃdrārdhāṃkitamastakāṃnijaṃkaraiḥ saṃvibhratīmādarāt | vīṇāmakṣaguṇaṃ sudhāḍhyakalaśaṃ vidyāṃ catuṃgastanīṃ divyairābharaṇairvibhūṣita tanuṃ haṃsādhirūḍhāṃbhaje | dakṣiṇādhākare vīṇāṃ vāmādhaḥkare vidyāṃ | uparitanakarābhyāṃ akṣamālāmamṛtakuṃbhaṃ ca dadhatīṃ dhyāyet | tato mānasīṃ pūjāṃ vidhāya vāhyapūjāṃ medhādi sahitāṃ mātṛkokta pīṭhedevīmāvāhya pūjayet |
<48a>
aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇāṃ devyādakṣa vāmapārśvayoḥ saṃskṛtāyai namaḥ | prākṛtāyai namaḥ || tato daleṣu prajñāyai medhāyai śrutyai śaktyai smṛtyai vāgīśvaryai sumatyai svastyai namaḥ iti pūjayet | teṣveva brāhmyādi śaktīḥ pūjayet | lokapālāṁśca dikṣu | dvādaśalakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | śvetakamalairdaśāṃśohomaḥ || atha vākyati maṃtraḥ || aiṃ vācaspate amṛtepluvaḥ pluḥ | asya ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvoktaṃ | aiṃ vācaspate amṛte pluvaḥ pluḥ | etaiḥ paṃcāṃgaṃ netrahīnaṃ || dhyānaṃ | āsīnākamale karairjapavaṭīṃ padmadvayaṃ pustakaṃ vibhrāṇā taruṇeṃdu vaddhamukuṭā mukteṃdu kuṃdaprabhā | bhālonmīlitalocanā kucabharāklāṃtā bhavadbhūtaye bhūyādvākyati devatā munigaṇairāsevyamānāniśaṃ || uparitana vāmadakṣiṇa karayoḥ kamaladvayaṃ | adhaḥ karayorjapamālikā pustakaṃ ca | iti dhyātvā pūrvoktapīṭhe devīmāvāhya pūjayet | ekādaśalakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | ghṛtena daśāṃśo homaḥ |
anayā vidyayā japtaṃ brāhmīpatraṃ ca bhakṣayet | na vismarati medhāvī śrutvā vedāgamān punaḥ ||
brāhmīrasesvakalkādye kapilājye paṃcejapan | piveddinādau tannityaṃ sarvaśāstrārthavidbhavet ||
atha tryakṣaraḥ sārasvataḥ | vāṁ rūṁ svoṁ | asya ṛṣyādikaṃ nāsti | dviruktaistribhirvījaiḥ ṣaḍaṃgāni | dhyānaṃ |
<48b>
muktā hārāvadātāṃ śirasi śaśikalālaṃkṛtāṃ vāhubhiḥ svairvyākhyā mudrākṣamālāṃ maṇimayakalaśaṃ pustakaṃ codvahaṃtī | āpīnottuṃga vakṣoruhabharavinamanmadhyadeśāmadhīśāṃ vācāmīdrecirāya tribhuvana vinatāṃ puṃḍarīke niṣaṇāṃ || dakṣiṇakarayorvyākhyākṣamāle | vāmayoḥ kalaśapustake | iti dhyātvā mātṛkāpūjāvidhinā pūjayet | lakṣatrayaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | āḍyasiktena pāyasena daśāṃśo homaḥ |
japan vījatrayaṃ maṃtrī sabhāyāṃjaya māpnuyāt | sitāṃ vacāṃ vā brāhmīṃ vā japtāṃ cādeddināgame ||
medhāṃ kāmāna vāpnoti sādhako nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
atha saptakoṭīśvarī maṃtraḥ | kaḥ saḥ caṃḍikeśaḥkaḥ | brahmā ṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ saptakoṭīśvarī devatākaṃvījaṃ saḥ śaktiḥ caṃkīlakaṃ vidyā siddhaye viniyogaḥ | sāṃsīṃ ityādi ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | pūjādikaṃ tripurāvat || atha vāgvādinī mālāmaṃtraḥ oṃ na triṃśadakṣarātmakaḥ | oṃ vadavadavāgvādini hrīṃ klīṃ klinnekledini mahākṣobhaṃ kuru | sauḥ mokṣaṃ kuruṣṭha oṃ | ṛṣyādikaṃ vāgīśvarīvat || atha tripurabhairavī maṃtraḥ | hraiṃ hklīṃ hrauṃ | śaktirṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ tripurabhairavī devatā vidyādi siddhaye viniyogaḥ | ādyaṃ vījaṃ aṃtyāśaktiḥ rephaḥ kīlakaṃ | hraiṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> hraiṃ śirase svāhā <2> hraiṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> hraiṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ <4> hraiṃ kavacāya huṃ <5>hraiṃ astrāya phaṭ <6>
<49a>
hrāṃ hrīṃ ityādi śāradāyāṃ ṣaḍaṃgaṃ || aiṃdrāṃ drāvaṇavāṇāya namaḥ <1> aiṃdrīṃ mohanavāṇāya namaḥ <2> aiṃ klīṃ saṃdīpanavāṇāya namaḥ <3> aiṃ klūṃ saṃtāpanavāṇāya namaḥ <4> aiṃ saḥ vaśīkaraṇavāṇāya namaḥ <5> ityādhāranābhi hṛdayānana mūrdhvasu nyaset | aiṃ mohanakāmāya namaḥ <1> aiṃ klīṃ kaṃdarpakāmāya <2> aiṃ klīṃ klūṃ makaradhvajakāmāya <3> aiṃ strīṃ manmathakāmāyateṣvevaṃ | ityādi vahavonyāsāgraṃtha gauravānnalikhitāḥ | dhyānaṃ | udyadbhānu sahasrakāṃti maruṇakṣaumāṃ śiromālikāṃ raktāliptapayodhaṃ rājayavaṃṭī vidyāmabhītiṃvaraṃ | hastābjairdadhatīṃ trinetra vilasadvaktrāraviṃdaśriyaṃ devīṃ vaddha himāṃśu ratnamukuṭāṃ vaṃde samaṃdasmitāṃ | uparitana dakṣiṇavāmaṃ hastayorjapavaṭī pustake | dakṣiṇavāmādhastanayoḥ abhayavarau | iti dhyātvā mānasikapūjānaṃtaraṃ ādhārādi śaktipīṭhe dvādaśadalāṃtara navayoni cakraṃ likhitvā padmapatreṣu vāmāyai jyeṣṭhāyai <2> raudryai <3> aṃvikāyai <4> icchāyai <5> jñānāyai <6> satkṛtāyai <7> kubjikāyai <8> pradvyai <9> viṣaghnyai <10> dūtyai <11> bhūtaye <12> sarvānaṃdāyai nama iti pūjayet || śāradāyāṃ tvaṣṭadalapadmaṃ | tatraitāḥ śaktayaḥ | icchājñānākriyākāminī kāmadāyinī ratiḥ ratipriyānaṃdā pūjyā manonmanīṃ madhye || tato navayoni madhye aiṃ parāyai <1> aparāyai <2> parāparāyai <3> hasoḥ sadāśiva mahāpreta padmāsanāya nama ityāsanaṃ saṃpūjya tatra devī māvāhya pūjayet |
<49b>
tato'ṃgapūjā | tato madhyayotarvahiḥ ṣaṭkoṇasyāṃtaḥ purvādi pradhānadikṣu caturovāṇān saṃpūjya paṃcamaṃ devyagrabhāge pūjayet | drāṃ śoṣaṇavāṇāya namaḥ <1> drīṃ mohanavāṇāya namaḥ <2> klīṃ saṃdīpanavāṇāya namaḥ <3> klūṃ saṃtāpanavāṇāya namaḥ <4> saḥ unmādanavāṇāya namaḥ <5> iti pūjayet || madhyaṃ yonyavaṃ śiṣṭayoniṣu prāgādi krameṇa subhagāyai <1> bhagāyai <2> bhagasarpiṇyai <3> bhagamālinyai <4> anaṃgāyai <5> anaṃgakusumāyai <6> anaṃgamekhalāyai <7> anaṃgamadanāyai namaḥ <8> iti pūjayet || tadvahirbrāhmyādayaḥ || tadvahirbhairavān | asitāṃga bhairavāya <1> rurubhairavāya <2> caṃḍabhairavāya <3> krodhabhairavāya <4> unmādabhairavāya <5> kapālibhairavāya <6> bhīṣaṇabhairavāya <7> saṃhārabhairavāya <8> nama iti dalāgreṣu pūjayet || lokapālāṁśca svadikṣu | tato yathāśakti japaṃ nivedya visarjayediti | dvādaśalakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | madhuratrayāktaiḥ palāśakusumairdvādaśa sahasraṃ homaḥ | karavīra kusumaiśca daśāṃśohomaḥ || vāksiddhiṃ labhate maṃtrī palāśakusumairhutāt ||
karpūrakapicorāṇi samabhāgāni kalpayet | caturbhāgaṃ jaṭāmāṃsī tāvatī rocanāmatā ||
kuṃkumaṃ saptabhāgaṃsyādigbhāgaṃ caṃdanaṃ mataṃ | agururnavabhāgaḥ syāditi bhāgakrameṇa tu ||
himādbhiḥ kanyayāpiṣṭame tatsarvaṃ susodhitaṃ |
<50a>
ādāyatilakaṃ mālekuryādbhūmipatīnnarān ||
vanitāmadagarvādyā madonmattānmataṃgajān | siṃhavyāghrān mahāsarpān bhūtavetāla rākṣasān ||
darśanādevavaśayettilakaṃ kārayannaraḥ || athāsyā maṃtraprabhedāḥ || īṃ ityekomaṃtraḥ <1> aiṃ rāṃ ityeko maṃtraḥ aiṃ rīkṣaṃ ityeko maṃtraḥ <3> aiṃ klīṃ sauṃ ityekaḥ <4> aiṃ hrīṃ hauṃ ityekaṃ <5> saiṃ klīṃ sauṃ ityekaḥ <6> śaiṃ khlīṃ śrauṃ ityekaḥ <7> hraiṃ hrīṃ hrauṃ ityekaḥ <8> klīṃ aiṃ sauṃ <9> klīṃ sauṃ aiṃ <10> śraiṃ śrauṃ śrīṃ <11> sakala hrīṃ saiṃ haiṃ saṃ <12> hrāṃ sakala hrīṃ <13> śrauṃ śraiṃ śrauṃ <14> sahaklīṃ śraiṃ śrūṃ sklrīṃ hrauṃ sahaklauṃ <15> sahaiṃ sahauṃ <16> hklīṃ sahaklīṃ <17> sahauṃ sahaklīṃ <18> śraiṃ sahaiṃ sahaklīṃ <19> sahaiṃ sahauṃ sahaiṃ <20> sahaklīṃ sahrauṃ sahaiṃ <21> sahrauṃ sahaklīṃ sahaiṃ <22> sahaiṃ aiṃ īṃ jauṃ <23> hasaiṃ hasaklīṃ hasauḥ | iṃ jauṃ aiṃ <25> jauṃ īṃ aiṃ <26> ebhyo'nye maṃtrabhedāḥ saṃtite graṃtha gauravānnalikhitāḥ eteṣāṃ ṛṣyādi pūjāṃtaṃ tripurāvat || atha vālatripurā | aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ | asya dakṣiṇāmūrti ṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ vālatripurādevatā aiṃ vījaṃ klīṃ śaktiḥ vidyārthe viniyogaḥ aiṃ madhyamayoḥ <1> klīṃ anāmikayoḥ <2> sauḥ kaniṣṭhikayoḥ <3> aiṃ aṃguṣṭhayoḥ <4> | klīṃ tarjanyoḥ <5> sauḥ karapuṭayoḥ <6> aiṃ ādhāre <7> klīṃ hṛdaye <8> sauḥ brahmaraṃdhre <9>
<50b>
aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ dehavyāpakatvena nyaset || aṃ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ṅaṃ āṃ sauḥ hrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> iṃ caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ ñaṃ īṃ sauḥ hrīṃ śiraḥ <2> uṃ ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ ūṃ sauḥ hrūṃ śikhā <3> eṃ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ aiṃ sauḥ hraiṃ kavacaṃ <4> oṃ paṃ phaṃ vaṃ bhaṃ maṃ aṃ sauḥ hrauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ <5> aṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ laṃ kṣaḥ aḥ sauḥ astrāya phaṭ <6> iti ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | dhyānaṃ | muktāśeṣara kuṃḍalāṃgadamaṇigraiveyahārormikāṃ vidyotadvalayādikaṃ kaṇakaṭī sūtrāṃ sphurannūpurāṃ | māṇikye | daravaṃdhukaṃcukavarāmiṃdoḥkalāṃ vibhraṃtī pāśaṃsāṃkuśa pustakākṣavalayaṃ dacchorddhavāṭkāditaḥ | pūrṇeṃdu pratimaprasannavadanāṃ netratrayodbhāsitāmiṃdu kṣīravalakṣagātravilasanmālyānulepāṃvarāṃ | mūlādhāra samudgatāṃ bhagavatīṃ hṛtpaṃkaje ciṃtayan dakṣānnāsapuṭādvirecya kusumeṣṭhā vāhayenmaṃḍale | iti dhyātvā mānasopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya vāhyapūjāmārabhet oṃ guṃ aiṃ śivādi gurubhyo namaḥ | oṃ aiṃ gaṃgaṇapataye namaḥ iti savyāpasavye saṃpūjya tāmrādipātre ādhārādi sahite pūrvoktapīṭhe aṣṭadalamadhyastha navayonimaṃḍale pūrvādikoṇa krameṇa aiṃ jayāyai namaḥ <1> aiṃ vijayāyai <2> aiṃ ajitāyai <3>
<51a>
aiṃ aparājitāyai <4> aiṃ nityāyai <5> aiṃ vilāsinyai <6> aiṃ dogdhryai <7> aiṃ aghorāyai <8> nama iti pūjayet || aiṃ maṃgalāyai namaḥ iti madhye pūjayet | tatra pūrvoktāṃ devīmāvāhya pūjayet pādyādibhirupacāraiḥ | tato'ṃgāvaraṇaṃ | uparistha trikoṇa vāmadakṣiṇāgra trikoṇeṣu | aiṃ ratyai namaḥ <1> klīṃ prītyai <2> sauḥ manoramāyai <3> nama iti pūjayet || agnīśāsuravāyuṣupurataḥ pṛṣṭhataścāṃgāni pūjayet | drāṃ drāvaṇavāṇāya namaḥ <1> drīṃ mohanavāṇāya namaḥ <2> iti devyādakṣiṇataḥ pūjayet | klīṃ saṃtāpanavāṇāya namaḥ iti pṛṣṭhataḥ pūjayet | klūṃ saṃdīpanavāṇāya namaḥ iti vāmataḥ | saḥ vaśīkaraṇavāṇāya namaḥ iti devyagrataḥ | tato brāhmyādayaḥ pūjyāḥ | tato lokapālāḥ pūjyāḥ | japaṃ nivedya visarjayet | anyadbhairavīvat | klīṃ tripurādevi vidmahe kāmeśvari dhīmahi | tannaḥ klinne pracodayāditi tripurā gāyatrī sānnidhyakāriṇī ||
susitairgaṃdhakusumaiḥ pūjāsārasvate vidhau | dūrvāvījāṃkuraṃ puṇyaṃ rājavṛkṣa samudbhavaṃ ||
ityetāni praśastāni siṃdhuvārāṃkurāṇi vai | japansarasvatīṃ nityametāni parivarjayet ||
āmrātaṃ gṛṃjanaṃviṃvaṃkaraṃjalasunaṃ tathā |
<51b>
tailaṃ palāḍuṃ piṇpākaṃ sāṃguṣṭhamapi bhojane ||
sarvaṃ paryuṣitaṃ tyājyaṃ sadāsārasvatārthinā | nācarenniśitāṃvūlaṃ striyaṃ gaccheddivāna ca ||
na saṃdhyayoḥ svayejātunā śuciḥ kiṃciduccaret | pradoṣeṣu bhavenmaunī digvastrāṃ na vilokayet ||
na puṣpitāṃ striyaṃ gacchennaniṃdedvāmalocanāṃ | na mṛṣāvacanaṃ vrūyānnā kramet pustakaṃ sudhīḥ ||
akṣarādvyāni patrāṇinopekṣetana laṃghayet | ityādi sārasvatārthinātyājyaṃ ||
[iti śrīmadāśādityatripāṭhīsaṃgṛhīte maṃtrakoṣe sārasvatamaṃtrakathanaṃ nāma navamaḥ paricchedaḥ] || atha śrīmaṃtrāḥ ||
tatraikākṣaraḥ | śrīṃ | śrīmaṃtrasya bhṛgurṛṣiḥ trivṛdanuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ śrīrdevatāśaṃvījaṃ īṃ śaktiḥraṃkīlakaṃ mahāsaṃpatprāptaye viniyogaḥ | śrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> śrīṃ śirase svāhā <2> śrūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> śraiṃ kavacāya huṃ <4> śrauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ <5> śrallastrāya phaṭ <6> || āgamokta nyāsā ucyaṃte | mahāśriye <1> mahāvidyutprabhe svāhā <2> gaurī mahāvale vaṃdhavaṃdha svāhā <3> dhṛti svāhā <4> huṃ mahākāye padmahaste huṃ phaṭ <5> iti paṃcāṃgāni || tato dhyānaṃ | bhūyādbhūyodvipadmā'bhayavarakarā taptakārtasvarābhāśubhrā ābhebhayugmadvayakaraṃ dhṛtakuṃbhāṃdbhirāsicyamānā | ratnaughāvaddamaulirvimalataradukūlārtavāle parāḍhyā padmākṣī padmanābho rasikṛta vasatiḥ padmagāśrīḥ śriyevaḥ ||
<52a>
uparitana dakṣiṇavāmakarābhyāṃ padmadvayaṃ tadadhaḥ abhayavarau | iti dhyātvā mānasikapūjāṃte vāhyapūjāṃ kuryāt | ādhārādi pīṭhaṃ pūjayet | aṃ ādhāraśaktyai namaḥ <1> mūlaprakṛtyai <2> maṃḍūkāya <3> kūrmāya <4> anaṃtāya <5> mahāvarāhāya <6> bhūmyai <7> kṣīrodārṇavāya <8> śvetadvīpāya <9> ratnamaṃḍapāya <10> ratnasiṃhāsanāya <11> nama ityuparyupari pūjayitvā tadupari caturasraṃ pīṭhaṃ parikalpya dharmāya <1> jñānāya <2> vairāgyāya <3> aiśvaryāya <4> nama iti pīṭhakoṇeṣu pūjayet | adharmāya <1> ajñānāya <2> avairāgyāya <3> anaiśvaryāya <4> nama iti pīṭhagātreṣu | taṃ tamase namaḥ paraṃ rajase <2> saṃ satvāya <3> māṃ māyāyai <4> viṃ vidyāyai <5> vahnimaṃḍalāya <6> sūryamaṃḍalāya <7> somamaṃḍalāya nama iti pīṭhamadhye uparyuparipṛṣṭhayitvā tadupari śvetakamalaṃ parikalpya vibhūtyai namaḥ <1> unnatyai <2> kāṃtyai <3> hṛtyai <4> kīrtyai <5> sannatyai <6> puṣṭyai <7> utkṛṣṭyai <8> daleṣu | madhyen (*)(?)yai namaḥ iti pūjayet || karṇikāyāṃ devīmāvāhya pādyādibhirupacāraiḥ pūjayet | agnīśāsuravāyuṣupurataḥ pṛṣṭhataṃścāṃgāni pūjayet | vāsudevāya <1> saṃkarṣaṇāya <2> pradyumnāya <3> aniruddhāya <4> nama iti pūrvādi pradhānadikṣu | damakāya <1> śalalāya <2> śulgulakāya <3> kuruṃṭakāya <4> nama iti koṇapatreṣu pūjayet || śaṃkhanidhaye namaḥ iti dakṣiṇapārśve |
<52b>
padmanidhaye namaḥ iti vā vāmārdhe || valākyai <1> vimalāyai <2> kamalāyai <3> vanamanikāyai <4> vibhīṣikāyai <5> mālikāyai <6> śāṃkaryai vasumālikāyai <8> nama ityaṣṭa (**)(?) pūjayet || yathāśakti japitvā nivedya visarjayet | dvātriṃśallakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | madhuratrayāktaiḥ kamalairvilvasamidbhirvādaśa (***)(?) homaḥ || icchaṃyo bhavate maṃtrī vidhinā sādhakottamaḥ | dhanadhānyasamṛddhaḥ syāt | śriyamāpnotyanaṃditāṃ | vakṣaḥ pramāṇe sali(***)(?) maṃtramimaṃ japet | trilakṣaṃ saṃyato maṃtrī devīṃ dhyātvārkamaṃḍale | saṃbhavet svalpakālenaramāyā vasatiḥ sthirā || (**)(?) kamalavāsinī maṃtraḥ || namaḥ kamalavāsinyai svāhā | asya dakṣa ṛṣirvirāṭchaṃdaḥ kamalavāsinī devatānaṃvījaṃ svāhā (***)(?) kīlakaṃ saṃpadarthe viniyogaḥ | oṃ devyai namaḥ hṛdaye <1> oṃ padminyai namaḥ śiraḥ <2> | oṃ viṣṇupatnyai namaḥ śikhā <3> oṃ varadāyai namaḥ (*****##?) padmasthā padmanetrakamalayugavarābhīti yugdo (****)(?) dehocchābhiḥ prabhābhistribhuvanamakhilaṃ bhāsurābhāsayaṃtī || muktāhārāṃbhirāmonnatakucakalasāratnamaṃjīraka (****)(?) myaṃdagadājrādhṛtamaṇimukuṭāśreyase (*)rbha(?) vedvaḥ || uparitana vāmadakṣiṇayoḥ kamale tadadho varāmaye |
<53a>
śrīmaṃtroktapīṭhe devīmāvāhya pūjayet | tato'ṃpūjāṃte pūrvādi patreṣuvalākādyāḥ pūjayet | lokapālāṃśca svadikṣu | daśalakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | trimadhurayuktaiḥ kamalairdaśāṃśohomaḥ || atha mahālakṣmī hṛdayamaṃtraḥ saptaviṃśatyakṣaromālātmakaḥ | oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ kamale kamalālaye prasīda prasīda śrīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ mahālakṣmi namaḥ || mahālakṣmyai nama iti śāradāyāṃ || kutrāpi śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ ityādi vījatrayaṃ | kutrāpi oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ ityādi vījadvayaṃ | asya dakṣaṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ lakṣmīrdevatālakṣmīprāptaye viniyogaḥ oṃ śrīṃ vījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ praṇavaḥ kīlakaṃ | tataḥ paṃcāṃgaṃ | oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ kamale śrīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ kamalālaye śrīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ śirase svāhā <2> oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ prasīda śrīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ prasīda śrīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ kavacāya huṃ <4> oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ mahālakṣmi namaḥ śrīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ astrāya phaṭ <5> dhyānaṃ | hastodyadva supātra paṃkajayugādarśā sphurannūpurāgraiveyāṃgadahārakaṃkaṇa mahāmauli sphuratkuṇḍalā | padmasthā paricārikā parikarāśuklāṃgarāgāṃśukādevī divyagaṇānatābhavadadyapradhvaṃsinī syādramā || uparihastadvaye padmadvayaṃ adhodakṣe dhanapātraṃ vāme ādarśaṃ | evaṃ dhyātvā mānasika pūjāṃvidhāya ādhārādibhūtyaṃte śrīpīṭhedevīmādya pūjayet |
<53b>
aṃgapūjāṃvidhāya | oṃ śrīdharāya namaḥ <1> hṛṣīkeśāya <2> vaikuṃṭhāya <3> viśvarūpāya <4> iti dikpatreṣu pūjayet | vāsudevāya <1> saṃkarṣaṇāya <2> pradyumnāya <3> aniruddhāya <4> nama iti koṇapatreṣu pūjayet | bhāratyai namaḥ <1> pārvatyai <2> cāṃdryai <3> śacyai <4> iti dikpatreṣu pūjayet | damakāya <1> salalāya <2> gulgulave <3> kuṃḍakāya <4> nama iti koṇapatreṣu || anurāgāya <1> abhisaṃvādāya <2> vijayāya <3> vallabhāya <4> madāya <5> valāya <6> tejase nama <8> iti pūrvādi patreṣu | lokapālāṁśca svadikṣu iti pūjā japaśca | lakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | madhuratrayāktairvilvaphalairayutaṃ homaḥ || atha hṛnmaṃtraḥ | aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ sauḥ jagatprasūtyai namaḥ | brahmāṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ mahālakṣmīrdevatālakṣmīprāptaye viniyogaḥ | aiṃ hṛdayaṃ <1> hrīṃ śiraḥ <2> śrīṃ śikhā <3> klīṃ kavacāṃ <4> sauḥ astraṃ <5> samastena vyāpakaṃ | mūrdhādi vakṣo liṃgādyo paṃcavījāni vinyaset | dhyānāṃ | vālārkadyutimiṃdukhaṃḍa vilasatkoṭīrahārajvalāṃ ratnākalpavibhūṣitāṃ kucanatāṃśāleḥ karairmaṃjarīṃ | padmau kaustubha ratnamapyavirataṃ saṃvibhraṃtī susmitāṃ phullāṃbhoja vilocana trayayutāṃ dhyāyet parāṃdevatāṃ | uparitana hastadvaye padmadvayaṃ | vāmādhaḥ śāśinavallī dakṣiṇādhaḥ kaustubhamaṇiṃ |
<54a>
iti dhyātvā vibhūtyādisahita ādhārādi pīṭhe parijātā ghoraratnasiṃhāsanasthāmāhuya pūjayet || tato'ṃgāvaraṇaṃ | dakṣiṇapārśve gaṇapataye namaḥ | vāmapārśve puṣpadhanvane namaḥ iti pūjayet | umāyai <1> śriyai <2> sarasvatyai <3> durgāyai <4> dhariṇyai <5> gāyatryai <6> devyai <7> uṣāyai <8> nama iti pūrvādi patreṣu pūjayet | pādādhaḥ | gaṃgāyai yamunāyai nama iti pūjayet | pārśvadvaye śaṃkhanidhaye padmanidhaye nama iti pūjayet | paścime chatrahastāya varuṇāya namaḥ | paritaḥ śeṣāya namaḥ iti dvādaśaṃ lagnāni pūjayet | tadvahiḥ sūryāya nama iti dvavagrahān pūjayet | aṣṭadikṣu airāvatāya <1> puṃḍarīkāya <2> vāmanāya <3> kumudāya <4> aṃjanāya <5> puṣpadaṃtāya <6> sārvabhaumāya <7> supratīkāya <8> nama iti pūjayet | tadvahiriṃdrādīn | tadvahistadastrāṇi iti pūjā || dvādaśalakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | ghṛtaiḥ padmairvilvaiḥ pratyekamayutaṃ homaḥ || kaṃṭhamātrodakesthitvā dhyātvā devīṃ divākare | ardhavāhurdaśa śatamaṣṭottaraśataṃ japet | ārogyaṃ labhate sadyo dhanamāpnoti niścitaṃ | śālibhirjuhuyānnityamaṣṭottarasahasrakaṃ acirādeva mahatī lakṣmīḥ saṃjāyate dhruvaṃ || atha caturvargamaṃtraḥ | caturakṣaraḥ | aiṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ | asya maṃtrasya bhṛguṛṣiḥ tṛvṛdanuṣṭup
<54b>
chaṃdaḥ śrīrdevī vījaṃ īśaktiḥnaṃ kīlakaṃ mahāsaṃpat prāptaye viniyogaḥ | śrāṃ hṛdayaṃ <1> śrīṃ śiraḥ <2> śrūṃ śikhā <3> śraiṃ kavacaṃ <4> śrauṃ netratrayaṃ <5> śraḥ astraṃ <6> || dhyānaṃ | māṇikya pratimaprabhāṃ himanibhaistuṃgaiścatubhirgajairhastāṃgrāhitaratnakuṃbhalalilairāsicya(##-) kāṃtākāṃkṣita pārijātalaṃtikāṃvaṃde sarojāsalā | dakṣiṇa vāmādhaḥ karayorvarābhaye upariṃ paṃkajadvayaṃ | iti dhyātvā pūrvoktapīṭhe devīmāvāhya pūjayet | āvarādikaṃ pūrvoktaṃ | dvādaśalakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | aruṇakamalairayutaṃ homaḥ || atha maṃtrāṃtaraṃ || oṃ śuddhavyasase namo mahāśriyai namaḥ | ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvavat | oṃ hṛdayāya (**)(?) śuddhavāsase śirase svāhā <2> namaḥ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> mahāśriyai kavacāya huṃ <4> namaḥ astrāya phaṭ <5> dhyānapūjādikaṃ pūrvokta trilakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | kamalairdaśāṃsohomaḥ || atha maṃtrāṃtaraṃ || pautaumautabhayeśriye śrīrnamaḥ | asya jamadagni ṛṣi stri(*)(?)p chaṃdaḥ śrīrdevatālakṣmī prāptaye viniyogaḥ | pautaumautabhaye namaḥ hṛdayaṃ <1> pautaumautabhaye svāhā śiraḥ <2> pautaumautabhave(**)(?) | śikhā <3> pautaumautabhaye namaḥ kavacaṃ <4> śrīrnamaḥ astraṃ <5> | dhyāna pūjādikaṃ pūrvoktaṃ | saptarātraṃ nityaṃ dvādaśa sahasraṃ (***)(?) | tataḥ siddho bhavati | devīṃ suvarṇa kamalakarāṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ dhyātvā aṣṭasahasraṃ japet |
<55a>
abhīṣṭārthaṃ labhate | aṣṭottaraśatajaptena tilakāṃjana puṣpavastrādikaṃ dhārayet śrīmatāṃ sograṇī bhavet || māsatrayaṃ tathā japyādgrāmo viprasya siddhyati || atha kṣepita pradomaṃtraḥ || padmaṃprabhe padmasuṃdari dharmarṣe svāhā | asya ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvoktaṃ | padmaprabhe hṛdayaṃ <1> padmasuṃdariśiraḥ <2> dharmarṣeśikhā <3> svāhā kavacaṃ <4> sarveṇāstraṃ <5> japapūjādhyānādikaṃ pūrvoktaṃ || vidyāṃ smarejjapadgatādibhirarthasiddhāṃ kruddhasya patyurnayanāgravartinīṃ | prasīdatīyaṃ ca karoti sāsmaidadyāccasākalpalateva kāmān || maṃtrāṃtaraṃ | namo brahmatanaye | ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvoktaṃ | namo brahmatanaye hṛdayāya namaḥ ityādi | dhyāna pūjādikaṃ pūrvavat || atha tripuṭā | śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ | hrīṃ vījaṃ śrīṃśaktiḥ klīṃ kīlakaṃ iṣṭārthe viniyogaḥ | mūlamaṃtreṇa prāṇāyāmaṃ trayaṃ kṛtvā | śrīṃ hṛdayaṃ <1> hrīṃ śiraḥ <2> klīṃ śikhā <3> śrīṃ kavacaṃ <4> hrīṃ netra trayaṃ <5> klīṃ astraṃ <6> | dhyānaṃ | navakanakabhāsurorvīviracita maṇikuṭṭime sa kalpatarau | ratnavaravaddhasiṃhāsana nihitasaroruha samāsīnāṃ || āvaddha ratnamukuṭāṃ maṇikuṃḍalodyatkeyūrakormirasanādvayanūpurāḍhyāṃ | dhyāyet dhṛtābja yugapāśānkuśeṃducāpānsa puṣpaviśikhānnava hemavarṇān |
<55b>
cāmaramukurasamudgakatāṃvūlakaraṃ | upavāhinībhiścadūrtībhiḥ samabhivṛtāṃ paśyaṃtīṃ sādhakaṃ prasannadṛśā | dakṣiṇavāmo parikarayoḥ kamaladvayaṃ tadadhaḥ pāśāṃkuśau | tadadhaḥ kare iṣṭa cāpa puṣpavāṇau dhyeyau | evaṃ dhyātvā ādhārādi vibhūtyaṃtaṃ pīṭhaṃ pūjayitvā tatrastha kamalakarṇikāyāṃ devīmāvāhya pādyādibhirupacāraiḥ pūjayet | aṃgaiḥ aṃgāvaraṇaṃ || tataḥ lakṣmyai namaḥ <1> haraye <2> gaurye <3> śivāya <4> ratyai <5> kāmāya namaḥ <6> iti vaṭkoṇeṣu pūjayet | śaṃkhanidhaye namaḥ | padmanidhaye namaḥ iti pārśvadvaye aṣṭadaleṣu brāhmyādīn | lokapālāṁśca svadikṣu pūjayet | dvādaśalakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | vilvasamidbhirājavṛkṣa samidbhirvā trimadhurāktābhirdvādaśāṃśohomaḥ || śriyo maṃtraṃ japan maṃtrī śrīsūktānyapi saṃjapet | bhūyasī śriyamākāṃkṣan satyavādī bhavet tadā | pratyagā sā mukhośnīyatsmita pūrvapriyaṃ vadet | bhūṣayedgaṃdhapuṣpādyairātmānaṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ | śayīta śubhaśayyāyāṃ taruṇyā sahanānyathā | nagnonāvataredaṃdhastailābhyakto na bhakṣayet |
<56a>
haridrāṃ na mukheliṃpenna svapeda śuciḥ kvacit | na vṛthā vilikhedbhūmiṃ na vilvaṃ droṇamaṃvujaṃ ||
dhārayenmūrdhni naivādyālloṇaṃ tailaṃ ca kevalaṃ | malinona bhavejjātu kutsitānnaṃ na bhakṣayet ||
droṇapaṃkajavilvani padbhyāṃ jātu na laṃghayet | sahādevīrmidravallīṃ śrīdevīṃ viṣṇuvallabhāṃ ||
kanyāṃ jaṃvūpravālaṃ ca dhārayenmūrdhni sarvadā | ityācāra paronityaṃ viṣṇubhakto dṛḍhavrataḥ ||
śriyamāpnoti mahatīṃ devānāmapi durlabhāṃ ||
atha śrīsūktāni | hiraṇyavarṇāṃ hariṇīṃ suvarṇarajatasrajāṃ | iṃdrāṃ hiraṇmayīṃ lakṣmīṃ jātavedo mamāvahā || <1> ||
tāṃma āvahajātavedo lakṣmī manapāyinīṃ | yasyāṃ hiraṇyaṃ videyaṃgāmaśvaṃ puruṣānahaṃ || <2> ||
aśvapūrvāṃ rathamadhyāṃ hastināda pramodinī | śriyaṃ devīmupahvaro śrīrmādevījuṣatāṃ || <3> ||
kāṃso smitāṃ hiraṇyaprakāramārdrāṃ jvalaṃtī tṛptāṃ tarpayaṃtī | padmesthitāṃ padmavarṇāṃ tāgnihopāhvayeśriyaṃ || <4> ||
caṃdrāṃ prabhāsāṃ yaśasājvalaṃtīṃ śriyaṃ loke devapuṣṭāmudārāṃ | tāṃ padmayoniṃśaraṇaṃ prapadye alakṣmīrmenaśyatāṃ tvāṃ vṛṇomi || <5> ||
<56b>
ādityavarṇe tapaso'dhijāto vanaspatistavavṛkṣotha vilvaḥ | tasya phalāni tapasānudaṃtumāyāṃtarāyāśca vāhyā alakṣmīḥ || <6> ||
upaitumāṃdevasakhaḥ kīrtiśca prāṇinā saha | prādurbhūto smirāṣṭresmin kīrtiṃ vṛddhiṃ dadātu me || <7> ||
kṣut pipāṃsāmalājyeṣṭhā alakṣmīrnāśayāmyahaṃ | abhūtima samṛddhiṃ ca sarvānnirnudamegṛhān || <8> ||
gaṃdhadvārāṃdurādharṣāṃ nityapuṣṭāṃkarīṣiṇīṃ | īśvarīṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tāmihopahvayeśriyaṃ || <9> ||
manasaḥ kāmamākūtiṃ vācaḥ satyamaśīmahi | paśūnāṃ rūpamannaṃ mamapiśrīḥ śayatāṃyaśaḥ || <10> ||
kardamena prajābhūtāmapi saṃbhavakardamaḥ | śriyaṃ vā samaye gṛhe mātaraṃ ratnamālinī || <11> ||
āpaḥ sṛjaṃ tu snigdhāni viklītavasame gṛhe | jivadevīṃ mātaraṃ śriyaṃ vāsayamekule || <12> ||
ārdrāṃ puṣkariṇīṃ puṣṭiṃ piṃgalāṃ hemamālinīṃ | caṃdrāṃ hiraṇmayīṃ lakṣmīṃ jātavedo mamāvahaṃ || <13> ||
tāṃma āvahajātavedo lakṣmī manayagāminīṃ | yasyāṃ hiraṇyaṃ prabhūtaṃ gāvodāsyo ruciṃ deyaṃ puruṣāna hūmiti || <14> ||
yaḥ śuciḥ prayato bhūtvā juhuyādājyamanvahaṃ | śriyaḥ paṃcadaśarcaṃ tu śrīkāmaḥ satataṃ japet ||
padmānane padma turū padmākṣīṃ padmasaṃbhave | taṃme bhajasi padmakṣipena saukhyaṃ labhāmyahaṃ ||
aśvadāyigodāyidhanadāyi mahādhane | dhanaṃ maṃjuṣatāṃ devi sarvakāmāṁśca dattavaiḥ ||
<57a>
putrapautradhanaṃdhānyaṃ hastyaśva ca gaverathaṃ | prajānāṃbhavasīmātā āguṣmaṃtaṃ karotu me ||
dhanamagnirdhanaṃ vāyurdhanaṃ sūryodhanaṃ vasu | dhanamiṃdraṃ vṛhaspatirvaruṇaṃ dhanumutsṛje ||
vainateyaṃ somaṃ pivamāṃsaṃ piva tu vṛtrahā | somaṃ dhanaṃ syasominomihaṃ dadātu sominaḥ ||
na krodho na ca mātsaryo na lobho nā śubhāmatiḥ | bhavaṃti kṛta puṇyānāṃ bhaktānāṃ śrīsūktaṃ japet ||
śrīvarcasvamāyuṣyamārogyamāvidātyavamānaṃ paśuṃ putralābhaṃ śatasaṃvatsaraṃ dirghamāyuḥ ||
hiraṇyavarṇā ityasyā ṛcaḥ śrī ṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ śrīragnirdevatā | tāṃma āvahetyādi caturdaśarcāmānaṃdakardamaviktīta śrīputrā ṛṣayaḥ || tāṃma āvahāśva pūrvāmiti ṛk dvayasyānuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ | kāṃsosmītyasyāḥ prastārapaṃktiśchaṃdaḥ sarvāsāṃsyagnirdevate ādyāvījaṃ aṃtyāśaktiḥ mahālakṣmī prāptaye | va niyogaḥ || mūrdhākṣikarṇaghrāṇamukhagrīvā vāhudvayahṛdayanābhiliṃgagudorujānujaṃghāvaraṇeṣu paṃcadaśarcaḥ krameṇa nyasyet | praṇavena trivāraṃ karau pramṛjya | hiraṇmayī caṃdrārajatasrā suvarṇasrajā hiraṇyaḥ aṃguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāṃtaṃ praṇavādi caturthyaṃtaṃ namoṃtā vinyasya | hṛdayādiṣu tā eva vinyaset | tataḥ parameśvarīṃ ciṃtayet ||
<57b>
dhyānaṃ aruṇakamala saṃsthātadrajaḥ puṃjavarṇākara kamaladhṛteṣṭābhīti yugmāṃvujā ca | maṇimukuṭa vicitrā laṃkṛtākalpavrajairbhavatu bhuvanamātā saṃtataṃ śrīḥ śriyevaḥ | uparikarayoḥ kamale tadadho varābhaye | iti dhyātvā śrīmaṃtrokta pīṭhe śriyamāvāhya pūjayet | hiraṇyavarṇāmityanayā āvāhanaṃ <1> tāṃma āvahetyanayā āsanaṃ parikalpya <2> aśvapūrvāmityanayā arghaṃ <3> kāṃsosmītyanayāpādyaṃ <4> caṃdrāmityanayā ācamanīyaṃ <5> ādityavarṇetyanayā madhuparkaṃ <6> upaitumāmityanayā abhiṣekaṃ <7> kṣutpipāsāmityanayā vastraṃ <8> gaṃdhradvārāmityanayābhūṣaṇāni <9> manasaḥ kāmamityanayā anulepanaṃ <10> kardameṇetyanayā puṣpāṇi parikalpayet <11> tataḥ parivārānarcayet | tato daleṣu | padmāyai namaḥ <1> padmavarṇāyai namaḥ <2> padmasthāyai <3> ārdāyai <4> tarpayaṃtyai <5> tṛptāyai <6> jvalinyai <7> svarṇaprakārayai <8> nama iti pūjayet || lokapālāṁśca svadikṣu | tadvahistadastrāṇi | tataḥ saparivārāyai bhagavatyai namaḥ || āpaḥ sṛjaṃtviti anayādhūpaṃ <12> ārdāṃ puṣkariṇī nityanayādīpaṃ <13> ārdāmityanayānaivedyaṃ <14> tato devyaimaṃgalārātrikaṃ vidhāya | vahnau sa ghṛtenānnenaikaikāmāhutiṃ datvā devyai ācamanīyaṃ vidhāyastutvā | tāṃma āvahetyanayā svahṛdaye devī tu dvāsayet |
<58a>
iti pūjā || śuklāṃ pratipadyamārabhya yāvadekādaśī tāvat dvādaśa sāhasraṃ brahmacarya paro maunī śuklavastrālaṃkāravān japet | dvādaśyāṃ trimadhurāktaiḥ padmairvilvavṛkṣasamidbhiḥ pāyasena ghṛtena triḥtriḥśatamekaikenāhutiṃ juhuyāt | dvādaśa viprān bhojayet | maṃtraḥ siddho bhavati || tadyathā |
pariṣiṃce triśonityaṃ sūktaistaiḥ snānakarmaṇi | ādityābhimukhojapyāvagavacca tarpayet ||
prayogeṣu catvāriṃśacchukravāreṣu | aṃtyāmṛcamaṣṭottaraśataṃ japitvā navanītāktāni kamalāni tāṃvat saṃkhyayaiva juhuyāt | kāṃsosmītyanayā evaṃ ṣaṇmāsātmahāsaṃ pattirbhavati || pratyahaṃ tarpaṇāṃte etairapi tarpayet | oṃ śriyai tarpayāmi <1> lakṣmyai <2> varadāyai <3> viṣṇupatyai <4> vasudāyai <5> hiraṇyarūpāyai <6> suvarṇamālinyai <7> rajatasrajāyai <8> suvarṇagṛhāyai <9> suvarṇaprākārāyai <10> padmavāsinyai <11> padmahastāyai <12> padmapriyāyai <13> muktālaṃkārāyai <14> sūryāyai <15> caṃdrāyai <16> vilvapriyāyai <17> īśvarāyai <18> bhuktyai <19> pramuktyai <20> vibhūtyai <21> ṛddhyai <22> samṛddhyai <23> tuṣṭyai <24> puṣṭyai <25> dhanadāyai <26> dhaneśvaryai <27> śraddhāyai <28> bhoginyai <29> bhogadāyai <30> dhātryaiśa vidhātryai nama iti sūktavidhiḥ || [iti śrīmadāśādityatripāṭhīsaṃgṛhītemaṃtrakoṣelakṣmīmaṃtrakathanaṃnāma daśamaḥ paricchedaḥ] ||
<58b>
atha ādityamaṃtrāḥ || tatra nityapūjā kramāt sadyādau snātvā vimale vāsasī paridhāya saṃdhyādi vidhiranaṃtaraṃ pūjāmaṃḍapasamīpamāgatya kṛtapādaśaucācamana atitīkṣṇa mahākāyakalpāṃta dahano yamabhairavāya namastubhyamanujñāṃ dātumarhasi | gaṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ | kṣaṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ iti dakṣiṇa pārśvato vā (***)(?) to natvā dvāraśriyai namaḥ iti | dvāradehalyai namaḥ iti dehalyāṃ | tato'strāya phaḍityastra muccaran vāmāṃga saṃkocena vāmapādamagri (***)(?) pāṃtaḥ praviśansansarṣapān vikiran vighnakarān krūradṛṣṭyāniḥ sārayet | apakrāṃtastute bhūtāye bhūtā bhuvi saṃsthitāḥ | ye (****)(?) kartārastenaśyaṃ tu śivājñayā | oṃ astrāya phaṭ āsanāya nama ityāsanaṃ saṃpūjyate | tatropaviśya dakṣiṇataḥ pūjā dravyāṇi vāma (**)(?) vedyādyupacārāṁśca parikalpya mūlamaṃtraiṇaṃ prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā pūrvokta prakāreṇa bhūtaśuddhi prāṇapratiṣṭhā mātṛkānyāsān (**)(?) pūjāmārabhet || tatra tu paṃcāyatana pūjā | tatra sakṛdeva kuryāt | na tu pratipūjāmiti sādhāraṇavidhiḥ || atha sauraścatura (***)(?) hrīṃ haṃsaḥ | mūlamaṃtreṇa prāṇāyāma trayaṃ kṛtvā | asya maṃtrasya brahmā ṛṣirgāyatrīchaṃdaḥ savitā devatāhaṃ vījaṃ saḥśaktiḥ praṇavaḥ kīlakaṃ | oṃ vījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiriti kaścit | ārogyādyamīṣṭhārtha siddhyarthe viniyogaḥ | oṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ <1>
<59a>
hrīṃ śirase svāhā <2> oṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> oṃ hrīṃ kavacāya huṃ <4> oṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ <5> oṃ hrīṃ astrāya phaṭ <6> iti ṣaḍaṃgaṃ vidhāya dhyānaṃ kuryāt || bhāsvadratnaughamaulisphuradamṛtarucoraṃ jayan cāruṃ teṣāṃ sadyaḥ saṃtaptakārtasvarakamalajapābhāsurābhiḥ prabhābhiḥ | viśvākāśāvakāśāṃjvalayadaśiśiraṃdhartṛpāśāṃkuśeṣṭābhītīnāṃ bhaṃgituṃgastanamavatu jaganmāturārkaṃvayurvaḥ | dakṣiṇaṃ vāmordhakarayoḥ pāśāṃkuśau | tadadhaḥ karayorvarābhaye dhyeye | iti dhyātvā naivedyaṃ vināmānasairupacārairabhyarcya vāhyapūjāmārabhet | gaṃgurubhyo namaḥ | gaṃgaṇapataye namaḥ iti pārśvadvaye smṛtvā | tatogre'rghapātra sthāpanaṃ bhūmau trikoṇaṃ kṛtvā vahnirmaṃḍalāya daśadharmakalātmane nama iti saṃpūja <1> | tatra sādhāraṃ śaṃkhādipātraṃ saṃsthāpya sūryamaṃḍalāya dvādaśakalātmane namaḥ iti pātraṃ saṃpūjya <2> | tatramūlamaṃtreṇa jalaṃ prakṣipya somamaṃḍalāya ṣoḍaśāmṛta kalātmane namaḥ iti jalaṃ pūjayitvā <3> | tatra puṣpacaṃdanādi prakṣipyāmṛtīkṛtya dhenumudrāṃ pradarśya hastābhyāmācchādya mūlamaṃtraṃ vā rāṣṭrakaṃ japet | gurubhyo namaḥ | paramagurubhyo namaḥ | parāpara gurubhyo namaḥ iti vāmapārśve | gaṃgaṇapataye namaḥ iti dakṣiṇapārśve pūjayet || atha pīṭhapūjā || devapātre ādhāraśaktyai namaḥ <1> mūlaprakṛtyai <2> maṃḍukāya <3> kūrmāya <4> kālāgni rudrāya <5>
<59b>
anaṃtāya <6> varāhāya <7> bhūmyai <8> nālāya <9> kamalāya <1> namaḥ ityuparyupari saṃpūjya tadupari caturasraṃ pīṭhaṃ parikalpa | agnyādi koṇeṣu prabhūtāyai <1> vimalāyai <2> sārasāyai <3> samārādhyāyai <4> nama iti pūjayet | paramasukhāyai nama iti madhye || teṣveva koṇeṣu | dharmāya <1> jñānāya <2> vairāgyāya <3> aiśvaryāya <4> nama iti pūjayet | pradhāna pūrvādi dikṣu adharmāya <1> ajñānāya <2> avairāgyāya <3> anaiśvaryāya <4> namaḥ iti pūjayet || taṃ tamase namaḥ <1> raṃ rajase namaḥ <2> saṃ satvāya <3> māṃ māyāyai <4> viṃ vidyāyai <5> ātmane <6> amṭarātmane <7> paramātmane <8> jñānātmane <9> vahnimaṃḍalāya <10> sūryamaṃḍalāya <11> somamaṃḍalāya namaḥ <12> ityuparyupari pūjayitvāṃ taduparyaṣṭadalaṃ kamalaṃ parikalpya pūrvādi patreṣurāṃ dīptāyai <1> rīṃ sūkṣmāyai <2> rūṃ jayāyai <3> reṃ bhadrāyai <4> raiṃ vibhūtyai <5> rauṃ vimalāyai <6> riṃ amṛtāyai <7> raṃ vidyutāyai namaḥ iti pūjayet | raḥ sarvatomukhyai namaḥ iti madhye || brahmaviṣṇu śivātmakāyasaurāya yogapīṭhātmane nama iti pīṭhaṃ pūjayitvā tatra devamāvāhya āvāhana sthāpanasvārāta saṃnirodhāvaguṃṭhana saṃvyāyanamudrāḥ pradarśya mūlamaṃtreṇa sarvaṃ | tato devadehe ṣaḍaṃgāni vinyasya pādyā camanīyārdhā camanīya madhuparkācamanīya snānācamanīya vastragaṃdhapuṣpākṣatārātrika dhūpadīpanaivedyāni mūlamaṃtreṇa dadyāt | tato'gnīśāsuravāyuṣu puraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ taścāṃgāni pūjayet | hṛllekhāyai <1> gaganāyai <2> raktāyai <3> karālikāyai <4> mahokṣuṣmāyai <5> namaḥ ṛrdhe <5> pūrvādidikṣu somāya <1> aṃgārakātra <2>
<60a>
vudhāya <3> śanaiścarāya <4> ṛ vṛhaspataye <5> rāhave <6> śukrāya <7> ketave <8> nama iti pūjayet || lokapālāṁśca svadikṣu | iti pūjayitvā prasannārghaṃ dadyāt | tadyathā | pratiloma maṃtraṃ japan arghapātre jalaṃ prakṣipya kuśakusumadūrvākṣata caṃdanatilasarṣapayavān prakṣipet | puṣpāṃjaliṃ devāya samarpya arghapātraṃ hastābhyāmuddhṛtya aṣṭottaraśataṃ mūlamaṃtraṃ japitvā jānubhyā mavanīṃ gatvā prastakāṃtaṃ pātraṃ nītvā arghaṃ dadyāt || tato yathāśakti maṃtraṃ japitvā nivedya ca hṛdyupasaṃharet | iti saṃpūjya nirmālyaṃ tejaścaṃḍāyadīyatāṃ | lakṣa catuṣṭayaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | kiṃśukakusumaiḥ sarojairvādaśāṃśohomaḥ || śāradaṃ tilakoktānyargha dravyāṇi tu |
kuṃkumaṃ rocanāṃnājī raktacaṃdana vaiṇavān | karavīra japāśālikuṃśaśyāmākataṃḍulān ||
niḥkṣipya salile tasminnaikyaṃ saṃkalpabhānunā | arghadānamimaṃyuṃgāmāyurārogya vṛddhidam ||
dhanadhānya paśukṣetra putramitra kalatradaṃ | tejovīryayaśaḥ kīrtirvidyāvibhavabhāgyadaṃ ||
ityādityavāraṃ prativādeyaḥ ||
atha prayojana tilakaḥ || hrīṃ hrīṃ saḥ | asya brahmā ṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ sūryodevatā hrāṃ vījaṃ saḥ śaktiḥ hrīṃ kīlakaṃ iṣṭārthe viniyogaḥ || hrāṃ guhyamārabhya caraṇaparyaṃtaṃ nyaset <1> hrīṃ kaṃṭhamārabhya guhyaparyaṃtaṃ <2> saḥ mūrdhānamārabhya kaṃṭhāṃtaṃ nyaset <3> || hrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ <1>
<60b>
hrīṃ śiraḥ <2> hrūṃ śikhā <3> hraiṃ kavacaṃ <4> hrauṃ netratrayaṃ <5> hraḥ astraṃ <6> dhyānaṃ | aruṇasaroruha saṃsṛdṛgaruṇoruṇa kamalayugaladharaḥ | karakāletā bhayavaradodyuti viṃvo'mitabhūṣaṇastvinovatuvaḥ | uparitanakaradvaye kamale | tadadho bhayavarau iti dhyātvā sauramaṃtrokta pīṭhedevamāvāhya pūrvokta vidhinā pūjayet | aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ <1> somādibhirgrahaiḥ ketuparyaṃtaṃ dvitīyaṃ <2> somāya <1> vudhāya <2> vṛhaspataye <3> śukrāya namaḥ iti prāgādiṣu | aṃgārakāya <1> maṃdāya <2> rāhave <3> ketave namaḥ <4> iti koṇeṣu pūjayet || japaṃ nivedyodvāsayet | arghadravyāṇi pūrvoktāni | alābhe yathā lābhameṣāṃ | dvādaśalakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | tāvatsahasraṃ saghṛtenānnenahomaḥ || atha mārtaṃḍa vījaṃ || hyauṃ || ṛṣyādikaṃ nāsti | hrāṃ hrī mityādi ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | dhrāṃ dhrī mityādinā vā | dhyānaṃ | hemāṃbhoja pravālapratimanijaruciṃcāruṣaṭvāṃga padmau cakraṃ śaktiṃ sapāśaṃ śṛṇimatirucirāmakṣamālāṃ kapālaṃ | hastāṃbhojairdadhānaṃ trinayana vilasaddhe bhavaktrābhirāmaṃ mārtaṃḍa vallabhādyaṃ maṇimayamukuṭaṃhāradīptaṃbhajāmaḥ || dakṣiṇavāmahastābhyāṃ khaṭvāṃgapadmau | tadadhaścakraśaktī | tadadhaḥ pāśāṃkuśau tadadho'kṣamālākapāle dadhānaṃ | evaṃ dhyātvā saurepīṭhedevamāvāhya pūjayet | aṃgagrahalokapālairāvaraṇaṃ | lakṣatrayaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ |
<61a>
kamalairdaśāṃśe homaḥ ||
puṭitaṃ viṃvavījena sarvakāmaphalapradaṃ |
dhrimiti viṃvavījaṃ |
imaṃ maṃtraṃ japanmartyaḥ kīrtiṃ putrān valaṃ dyutiṃ | vāksiddhimatulāṃ lakṣmīṃ saubhāgyamapi sādhayet ||
atha ghṛṇimaṃtraḥ || oṃ ghṛṇi sūrya ādityaṃ | asya devabhāga ṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ sūryodevatāghaṃvījaṃ riṃśaktiḥ iṣṭārthe viniyogaḥ || satyatejojvalajvālāmaṇi huṃ phaṭ svāhā hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> oṃ brahmatejojvalajvālāmaṇi huṃ phaṭ svāhā śiraḥ <2> viṣṇutejojvalajvālāmaṇi huṃ phaṭ svāhā śikhā <3> oṃ rudratejojvalajvālāmaṇi huṃ phaṭ svāhā kavacaṃ <4> oṃ agnitejojvalajvālāmaṇi huṃ phaṭ svāhā netraṃ <5> sarvatejojvalajvālāmaṇi huṃ phaṭ svāhā astraṃ <6> aṃ ādityāya namaḥ śirasi <1> iṃ ravaye mukhe <2> oṃ mānave hṛdaye <3> ṛṃ bhāskarāya guhye <4> ḷṃ sūryāya caraṇadvaye <5> iti nyaset || oṃ śirasi <1> ghṛmukhe <2> ṇigale <3> sūhṛdaye <4> rya udare <5> ānābhau <6> di guhye <7> tyaḥ padadvaye <8> nyaset || dhyānaṃ | aruṇoruṇapaṃkajeniṣaṇaḥ kamalebhītivaraukarairdadhānaḥ | svarucāhimamaṃḍalastrinetro ravirākalpaśatākulo'vatādvaḥ || uparikaradvaye kamale | tadadho dakṣiṇavāmakaradvaye varābhaye | iti dhyātvā saure pīṭhe devamāvāhya pūjayet | aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ | oṃ ādityāya <1> ravaye <2> bhānave <3> bhāskarāya <4> nama iti dikṣu || uṣāyai <1> prajñāyai <2>
<61b>
prabhāyai <3> saṃdhyāyai <4> nama iti vidikṣu || tato brāhmyāṃdayaḥ || lakṣmīsannidhau aruṇāya nama iti pūjayet | tatogni mahān | tato lokapālān | sūryapariṣaḍbhyo namaḥ iti vidikṣu japaṃ nivedya visarjayet || aṣṭalakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | madhuratrayāktābhiḥ kṣīravṛkṣasamidbhirhutvā ravihomaḥ || aṣṭasahasraṃ śāradāyāṃ | tanmaṃtra maṃtritāṃbhobhiḥ saptadhāṃjali secanaṃ | dāridryapāpadhiḥkāranāśanaṃ śaṃkaraṃ paraṃ || sthaṃdilāṣṭadale kuṃbhatīrthodakādisupūritaṃ | saparivāraṃ devamabhyarcya sthaṃḍilegniṃ samādhāya kapilākṣīracaruṃ nirvāpyasājyaṃ juhuyāt sahasraṃ pratisaptamyāmupoṣitaḥ | snānāyābhimaṃtritaṃ puṇyajalebhiṣekayet punarnatvā saṃpūjyabhartā saṃbhogamācaret || atha maṃtrāṃtaraṃ | oṃ kholkāya svāha | khaṃ khaṃ kholkāya svāhā ityekaḥ prakāraḥ || asya maṃtrasya sūkṣmakaṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ sūryodevatā | iṣṭārthe | sūkṣmakāya svāhā hṛdayaṃ <1> sūkṣmaṃ tajase svāhā śiraḥ <2> sūkṣmakāya svāhā śikhā <3> sūkṣmavastrāya svāhā kavacaṃ <4> sūkṣmakāya huṃ phaṭ astraṃ <5> dhyānādikaṃ pūrvavat | saptaturagāya vidmahe sahasrakiraṇāyadhīmahi | tannoraviḥ pracodayāt | anayāṃ gāyatryāṃ vyomamudrāṃ pradarśayet || lakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ vilvapalāśāśvacchoḍuṃvara samidbhirdadhimadhughṛtāktābhiḥ pratyekamaṣṭottara sahasraṃ homaḥ |
<62a>
tato maṃtrasiddhirbhavati | arghaṃ pūrvavat sarvapāpakṣayo bhavati || atha ṛgvede || udyaṃteti ṛk ādityamaṃtraḥ || asya praskaṇva ṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ sūryodevatā | pūjādikaṃ pūrvavat || taittirīyakeyosāvādityaratyādi paṃcabhānavaḥ prasiddhāḥ | pūrvavat pūjādikaṃ kṛtvā japitvā visarjayet sarvasiddhirbhavati || atho'japāhaṃsamaṃtraḥ || haṃsaḥ | asya brahmāṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ paramātmā devatā iṣṭārthe viniyogaḥ | hlāṃ hlīṃ hlūṃ hlaiṃ hlauṃ hlaḥ ityādi ṣaḍaṃgaṃ || hsrāṃ hsrīṃ ityādi vā || dhyānaṃ | udyadbhānu sphuritaṃ taṃḍidākāramarddhāṃvikeśaṃpāśābhītī varadaparaśūsaṃdadhānaṃ karābjaiḥ | divyākalpairnavamaṇimayaiḥ śobhitaṃ viśvamūlaṃ sauryāgne tat traipuravapurava tu vaścaṃdracūḍaṃ trinetraṃ || dakṣiṇavāmo parikarayoḥ pāśaparaśū | adhovarābhaye | iti dhyātvā saurepīṭhe devamāvāhya pūjayet || aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ | ṛtātmane <1> viśvātmane <2> paramātmane <3> narātmane <4> namaḥ iti dikṣu | ṛtajāyai <1> abjujāyai <2> gojāyai <3> adrijāyai <4> namaḥ iti koṇeṣu || lokapālāṃśca svadikṣu | tadāyudhāni | dvādaśalakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | ājyānvitena pāyasena daśāṃśohomaḥ |
aṣṭottaraśataṃ maṃtraṃ japet toyaṃ sudhāmayaṃ |
<62b>
smṛtvā tenābhiṣiṃcedyaḥ sabhavedvigatāmayaḥ ||
āyurārogya vibhavānīpsitāllamate naraḥ | anenaiva vidhānena viṣārtonirviṣo bhavet ||
[iti śrīmadāśādityatripāṭhīsaṃgṛhīte maṃtrakoṣe ādityamaṃtrakathanaṃ nāmekādaśaḥ paricchedaḥ] || atha gaṇapati maṃtrāḥ ||
tatraikākṣaraḥ || gaṃ || asya gaṇapati ṛṣistriṣṭup chaṃdaḥ gaṇapatirdevatā gaṇamaṃvījaśaktī sarvavighnoyaśāṃtipūrvakalakṣmīprāptaye viniyogaḥ | aṃgamaṃtreṇa karanyāsaṃ kuryāditi sarvatra | gāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> gīṃ śirase svāhā <2> gūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> gaiṃ kavacāya huṃ <4> gauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ <5> gaḥ astrāya phaṭ <6> tato dhyānaṃ | raktoraktāṃgarāgāṃśukakusumayutastuṃdilaścaṃdramaulernetrairyukta stribhirvāmanakaracaraṇo vījapūrārtanāsaḥ || hastāgrāktapta pāśāṃkuśaradavaradonāgavaktro hi bhūṣodevaḥ padmāsanovo bhavatu natasuro bhūtaye vighnarājaḥ || dakṣiṇordhādhaḥ karayoḥ pāśavarau | vāmordhādhaḥ karadvaye'ṃkuśaradau | iti dhyātvā manasīṃ pūjāṃ vidhāya ādhārādi mātṛkāpīṭhe |
<63a>
tīvrāyai <1> jvālinyai <2> naṃdāyai <3> bhogadāyai <4> kāmarūpiṇyai <5> ugrāyai <6> tejovatyai <7> satyāyai <8> nama iti pūrvādi kamalapatreṣu pūjayet | vighnanāśinyai namaḥ iti madhye | sarvaśaktikamalāsanāyanamaḥ iti pīṭhaṃ pūjayitvā tatkarṇikāyāṃ devamāvāhya pādyādibhirupacāraiḥ pūjayet | gaṇādhipāyanamaḥ <1> gaṇeśāya <2> gaṇanāyakāya <3> gaṇakrīḍāya <4> namaḥ iti ca tasṛṣu dikṣu pūjayet | tato'ṃgāvaraṇaṃ || vakratuṃḍāya <1> ekadaṃtāya <2> mahodarāya <3> gajānanāya <4> laṃvodarāya <5> vikaṭāya <6> vighnarājāya <7> dhūmravarṇāya <8> nama iti daleṣu || teṣveva brāhmyādayaḥ | lokapālāṁśca svadikṣu | tadastrāṇi ca | aṣṭottaraśataṃ japitvā visarjayet | lakṣa catuṣṭayaṃ puraścaraṃ | aṣṭa ityairdaśāṃśohomaḥ ||
modakaiḥ pṛthukairlājaiḥ saktubhiḥ sekṣuparvabhiḥ | nālikeraistilaiḥ śuddhaiḥ supakvaiḥ kadalīphalaiḥ ||
aṣṭadravyāṇi vighnasya kathitāni manīṣibhiḥ | siddhamaṃtraḥ prakurvīta prayogān kalpanoditān ||
tarpayecchalilaiḥ śuddhairdinaśo gaṇanāyakaṃ | catuścatvāriṃśadādyaṃ catuḥśatamataṃdritaḥ ||
āpnuyānmaṃḍalādarvāgabhīṣṭamadhikaṃ naraḥ |
<63b>
nālikaraiḥ kṛto homaścaturthyāṃ śrīprado bhavet ||
śuklapakṣa pratipadamārabhyadinasaḥ sudhīḥ | caturthyaṃtaṃ ca pṛthuka saktulājatilaiḥ kramāt ||
catuḥśataṃ prajuhuyādvaśyāḥ syuḥ sarvajaṃtavaḥ | satilaistaṃḍulairhomo mahālakṣmīprado bhavet ||
lājaistrimadhuropetairhomokanyāṃ prayacchati ||
gagaṃ | gauge | eteṣāmayameva pūjākramaḥ || glauṃ | ityaparo maṃtraḥ | asya ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvavat | gaṃ vījaṃ aṃ śaktiḥ laṃ kīlakaṃ | glāṃglīmityādi ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | dhyānādikaṃ pūrvavat || goṃ ityamaraḥ | dhyānādikaṃ pūrvavat || atha kṣipraprasādanamaṃtraḥ | gaṃ kṣipraprasādanāya namaḥ | asya gaṇapati ṛṣirvirāṭ chaṃdaḥ gaṇapatirdevatāgaṃ namaḥ vījaśaktī | iṣṭārthe | gaṃ gīṃ gūṃ gaiṃ gauṃ gaḥ ṣaḍaṃgāni | dhyānaṃ | dhṛtapāśāṃkuśa kalpalatikāsvatradṛṣavīrapūrakaṃ yutaḥ | śaśiśakalakalitamaulistrinetroruṇagaṃḍaśca gajavadanaḥ | bhāsurabhūṣaṇadīptau vṛhadudaraḥ padmaviṣṭarolalitaḥ | dhyeyo anayanadoḥ padasarasīruhaḥ saṃpade sadā manujaiḥ | uparitana dakṣiṇa vāmakarayoḥ pāśāṃkuśau | tadadhaḥ kalpalatadaṃtau dhyeyau | śuṃḍādaṃḍe vījapūraṃ ca iti dhyātvā mānasīṃ pūjāṃvidhāya vāhyapūjāṃ kuryāt | tīvrādi śaktisahite gaṇeśapīṭhe devamāvāhya pādyādibhirupacāraiḥ pūjayet |
<64a>
vighnāya <1> vighnanāyakāya <2> śūāya <3> vīrāya <4> varadāya <5> i bhavaktrāya <6> ekaradāya <7> laṃvodarāya <8> nama iti pūrvādi dikṣu pūjayet | tato brāhmyādīn | lokapālāṁśca | naivedyaṃ datvā japitvā visarjayet | lakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | trimadhurāktaistilairaṣṭra dravyairvāyutaṃ homaḥ || ājyānnairjuhuyānnityamannavān vatsarād bhavet | pāyasānnena mahatīṃ śriyamāpnoti mānavaḥ || atha heraṃvamaṃtraścaturakṣaraḥ || oṃ gūṃ namaḥ | asya ṛṣyādikaṃ nāsti | heraṃvodevatā | gāṃgīmityādi ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | dhyānaṃ | muktākāṃcana nīlakaṃdaghusṛṇacchāyai strinetrānvitairnāgārayairhati vāhanaṃ śaśidharaṃ heravamarkaprabhaṃ | dṛptaṃ dānamabhītimodakakaraṃṭaṃkaṃ śirobjātmikāṃ mālāṃ mudgaramaṃkuśaṃ triśiṣikaṃdorbhirdadhānaṃbhaje || adho dakṣiṇa vāmakarayorvarābhaye | tadupari laḍḍukadaṃtau | tadupari paraśukapāle | tadupari kamalasrakamudgarau | tadupari aṃkuśa triśūle | tīvrādi yukte hemapīṭhe gaṇapatimāvāhya pūjayet | uktādi varṇakathana mūrdhapūrvādivaktra paṃcakasya pīṭhamaṃtraḥ | oṃ huṃ huṃ mahāsiṃhāya
<64b>
gāṅgeravāsanāya namaḥ ityāsanaṃ saṃpūjya devamāvāhya pādyādibhirupacāraiḥ pūjayecca || aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ | vighnādi vināyakairdvitīyaṃ | brāhmyādibhistṛtīyālokapālaiścaturthaṃ | lakṣatrayaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | kamalairvātilaiḥ sājyairdaśāṃśohomaḥ || atha gaṇapati maṃtraścaturakṣaraḥ || oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ | asya śukraṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ gaṇapatirdevatāgrīṃvījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ iṣṭārthe | grāṃ hṛdayaṃ <1> grīṃ śiraḥ <2> grūṃ śikhā <3> graiṃ kavacaṃ <4> grauṃ netraṃ <5> graḥ astraṃ <6> | dhyānaṃ | hemābhaṃ hemavastraṃ vṛhaḍudaratanuṃ cāruvāhuṃ trinetraṃ dorbhiḥ pāśākṣasūtre nijaradanaśṛṇīmodakaṃ puṣkareṇa vibhrāṇaṃ hemabhūṣaṃ taruṇataraṇisaṃkāśaśaktyāsametaṃ vighnāṃtaṃ vighnamaṃtastribhuvananamitaṃ ciṃtayettaṃ gaṇeśaṃ || uparitanadakṣiṇaṃ vāmakarayoḥ pāśāṃkuśau | tadadhaḥ karayorakṣamālāradau vibhrāṇaṃ | śuṃḍādaṃḍenamodakaṃ | iti dhyātvā | pūrvoktapīṭhe devamāvāhya pūjayet | ādau aṃgāvaraṇaṃ | vakratuṃḍāya <1> ekadaṃṣṭrāya <2> mahodarāya <3> gajānanāya <4> laṃvodarāya <5> vikaṭāya <6> vighnarājāya <7> dhūmravarṇāya <8> nama iti daleṣu ||
<65a>
teṣveva brāhmyādayaḥ | lokapālāśca | aṣṭottaraśataṃ japitvā visarjayet | lakṣatrayaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | tilairdaśāṃśohomaḥ ||
ājyānnairjuhuyānnityamannavān vatsarādbhavet | pāyasānnena mahatīṃ śriyamāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
atha śaktigaṇapati maṃtro dvādaśākṣaraḥ | hrīṃ gaṃ hrīṃ mahāgaṇapataye svāhā | asya gaṇakaṛṣistrivṛdanuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ śaktigaṇapatirdevatāgaṃsvāhāṃvīja śaktī iṣṭārthe hrāṃ gāṃ hṛdayaṃ <1> hrīṃ gīṃ śiraḥ <2> hrūṃ guṃ śikhā <3> hraiṃ gaiṃ kavacaṃ <4> hrauṃ grauṃ netraṃ <5> hraḥ graḥ astraṃ <6> dhyānaṃ muktāgairaṃ bhavajalamukhaṃ caṃdracūḍaṃ trinetraṃ hastaiḥ svīyairdadhatamaraviṃdāṃkuśauratnakuṃbhau | aṃkasthāyāḥ sarasijarucastavūjālaṃvipāṇairdevyāyonau vinihitakaraṃ ratnamauliṃbhajāmaḥ || uparitana dakṣiṇa vāmakarayoḥ kamalāṃkuśau | ratnakuṃbhau śuṃḍādaṃḍastadyonipidhāne | dakṣiṇādhaḥ karamārabhya vā kamalādi catuṣṭayaṃ | evaṃ vā sudhāṃbho nidhimadhyasthaṃ raktarājīvasannibhaṃ |
koṭivālārkasaṃkāśaṃ pāśamaṃkuśamaikṣavaṃ | dhārayaṃtaṃ ca caṣakaṃ pivaṃtaṃ cekṣujaṃ rasaṃ ||
śuṃḍā daṃḍena caṣakaṃ vāmāṃkasthita yānvitaṃ śaktyā kamaladhāriṇyā dhyātvā vighneśamarcayet ||
<65b>
uparitana karayordakṣiṇavāmayoḥ pāśāṃkuśau | tadadho guḍasekṣu rasa caṣako caṣakāṃtekṣurasaṃ śuṃḍādaṃḍenapivaṃtaṃ dhyāyet | pūrvokta pīṭhedevaṃ śaktisahitamāvāhya pūjayet | vāmāyai <1> jyeṣṭāyai <2> kalpai <3> raudryai <4> kalavikalinyai <5> valavikalinyai <6> vavapramathinyai <7> sarvabhūtadamanyai <8> manonmanyai <9> nama iti daleṣu madhye ca pūjayet | pramodāya <1> sumukhāya <2> durmukhāya <3> vighnanāśakāya <4> nama iti dikṣu | āṃ brāhmyai <1> īṃ māheśvaryai <2> ṛṃ kaumāryai <3> ṝṃ vaiṣṇavyai <4> ḷṃ karāhyai <5> aiṃ māheṃdryai <6> aṃ cāmuṃḍāyai <7> aḥ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ iti pūjayet | lokapālāṃśca svadikṣu | japitvā devaṃ visarjayet | puraścaraṇaṃ pūrvoktaṃ || atha virigaṇapatimaṃtraḥ | hrīṃ virivirigaṇapati varavarada sarvalokaṃmevaśamānaya svāhā | asya maṃtrasya gaṇapati ṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ | virivighneśvaro devatā vaśyādi siddhyarthe viniyogaḥ | hrīṃ virivirihṛdayaṃ <1> hrīṃ gaṇapatiśiraḥ <2> hrīṃ varavaradaśikhā <3> hrīṃ sarvalokaṃmenetraṃ <4> hrīṃ vaśamānaya kavacaṃ <5> hrīṃ svāhā astraṃ <6> dhyānaṃ | siṃdūrābhamibhānanaṃtriṇayamaṃ hasteṣu pāśāṃkuśau vibhrāṇaṃ madhumatkapālamaniśaṃsārddheṃdu mauliṃbhaje ||
<66a>
puṣpāśliṣṭa tanuṃ dhvajāgrakarayā padmollasaddhastayā tadyonyāhitapāṇimāttavasumatyātrollasatpuṣkaraṃ | uparitana dakṣiṇa vāmahastābhyāṃ pāśāṃkuśau | adhastanābhyāṃ madhusahitakapāla puṣṭiyonidhāne dhyeye || iti dhyātvā tīvrādi sahite pīṭhe devamāvāhya pūjayet | vāmādibhiḥ prathamāvṛttiḥ | āmodādibhirdvitīyā | aṃgaistṛtīyā | mātṛbhiścaturthī | lokapālaiḥ paṃcamī | vavādibhiḥ ṣaṣṭhī | caturlakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | trimadhurāktairaṣṭadravyairdaśāṃśohomaḥ || atha suṃdarī vallabhamaṃtraḥ || oṃ hrīṃ gūṃ virivirivināyakavaravarada sarvaloka hṛdayaṃ mevaśaṃ kurukuru svāhā | ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvavat | oṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> hrīṃ śiraḥ <2> gūṃ śikhā <3> virivirivināyaka kavacaṃ <4> varavarada sarvaloka hṛdayaṃ netraṃ <5> mevaśaṃ kurukuru svāhā astraṃ <6> dhyānādikaṃ pūrvavat || atha trailokya mohanamaṃtraḥ || catustriṃśadakṣarātmakaḥ | oṃ namo bhagavate ekadaṃṣṭrāyahastimukha laṃvodarāya ucchiṣa mahātmane āṃ kroṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ gaṃ svāhā | ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvavat | aṃtyavījaiḥ ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | dhyānapūjādikaṃ pūrvoktaṃ || anyastrailokya mohanamaṃtraḥ |
<66b>
trayastriṃśadakṣarātmakaḥ | vakratuṃḍaika daṃṣṭrāya klīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ gaṃgaṇapati varavarada sarvajanaṃ mevaśamānaya svāhā | ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvoktaṃ | vakratuṃḍaika daṃṣṭrāya klīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ gaṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> gaṇapati varavaradaśikhā <2> sarvajanaṃ kavacaṃ <3> mevaśamānaya netrābhyāṃ <4> svāhā astraṃ <5> | dhyānaṃ | paṃcavaktro daśabhujaḥ | śaktisahito mahāgaṇapati maṃtroktāyudhasahitaḥ | anyatsarvaṃ pūrvoktaṃ || atha śaktigaṇapati maṃtrāṃtaraṃ | ekādaśākṣaraṃ || oṃ hrīṃ gaṃ hrīṃ vaśamānaya svāhā | ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvoktaṃ | oṃ hṛdayaṃ <1> hrīṃ gaṃ hrīṃ śiraḥ <2> vaśaṃ śikhā <3> ānaya kavacaṃ <4> svāhā netratrayaṃ <5> samastenāstraṃ || dhyānaṃ | hastairvibhratamiṃdukhaṃḍavaradau pāśāṃkuśau puṣkara spṛṣṭasva pramadāvarāṃgamanayāspṛṣṭaṃ dhvajāgra spṛśā | śyāmāṃgyā vidhṛtābjayā trinayanaṃ caṃdrārdhacūḍaṃ japāraktaṃ hastimukhaṃ smarāmi satataṃ bhogātilolaṃ vibhuṃ || adhasthita dakṣiṇa vāmahastābhyāmikṣuvarau | uparitanābhyāṃ pāśāṃkuśau | lakṣmīṃ ca dakṣiṇenākṣamālāṃ vāmena talligaṃdhārayaṃtī | pūjādikaṃ pūrvoktaṃ | lakṣatrayaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | ājyāktairapūyairdaśāṃśohomaḥ ||
<67a>
hutvā pūpaistrimadhvaktairvaśayedbhuvi pārthivān | caturthyāṃ nālikereṇa mahatīṃ śriyamāpnuyāt ||
loṇairmadhurasaṃyuktairvaśayedvanitājanaṃ || atha paṃcapaṃcāśadakṣaromālāmaṃtraḥ | hrīṃ krauṃ oṃ gaṃ namaḥ sarvavighnādhipāya sarvārthasiddhidāya sarvaduḥkha praśamanāya ehyehi bhagavan sarvahṛdayaṃ staṃbhayastaṃ bhayahrīṃgaṃgīṃ namaḥ svāhā kroṃ hrīṃ | ṛṣyādikaṃ mahāgaṇapati maṃtroktaṃ || atha mahāgaṇapati maṃtraḥ || aṣṭāviṃśatyakṣaraḥ | oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ glauṃ gaṃgaṇapataye varavarada sarvajanaṃmevaśamānaya svāhā | asya mahāgaṇapati ṛṣistrivṛdgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ mahāgaṇapatirdevatāgaṃvījaṃ svāhā śaktiḥ glauṃ kīlakaṃ mahālakṣmī prāptaye viniyogaḥ | oṃ gaṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> śrīṃ gīṃ śirase svāhā <2> hrīṃ gūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> klīṃ glauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ <4> glauṃ glaiṃ kavacāya huṃ <5> gaṃgaḥ astrāya phaṭ <6> | dhyānaṃ | ikṣurasāṃvudhau navaratnadvīpe pārijāta vṛkṣādhaḥ sthitaratnapīṭhe mātṛkāṃvuja karṇikāyāṃ ṣaṭkoṇa madhyasthaṃ dhyāyet | vījāpūragadekṣu kārmukarujā cakrābjapāśāṃkuśa vrīhvagrasva viṣāṇaratnakalaśaṃ prodyatkarāṃbhoruhaḥ | dhyeyo vallabhayā ca padmakarayāśliṣṭo jvaladbhūṣayā viśvotpattivināśasaṃsthiti
<67b>
karo vighno viśiṣṭārthadaḥ || dakṣiṇādhaḥ karamārabhya vījapūragadekṣu kārmukaparaśucakrāṇi dhyeyāni | vāmo paritana karamārabhya abjapāśāṃkuśakalaśāgrasvaviṣāṇāni dhyeyāni || karapuṣkaradhṛtakalaśasrutamaṇimuktā suvarṇenāviratadhāraṃ varṣan paritaḥ sādhakaṃ samagra saṃpatyai | keṣāṃ cinmate dakṣiṇordhakaramārabhya vījāpūretyādiyuktaḥ prādakṣiṇyena dhyeyaḥ | śāradā tilake tu rujāsthāne triśūlaṃ aṃkuśasthāne cotpalaṃ || tathā ca dhyānaṃ | hastīṃdrānanamiṃdu cūḍamaruṇacchāyaṃ trinetraṃrasādāśliṣṭaṃ priyayā sa padmakarayāsvāṃkasthayā saṃtataṃ | vījāpūragadādhanustriṣayukrakrābjapāśotpalavrīhyagraḥ sa viṣāṇa ratnakalaśān hastairvahaṃtaṃbhaje || karāgra dhṛtamāṇikya kuṃbhavaktraviniḥsṛtaiḥ | ratnacaṣakaiḥ prīṇayaṃtaṃ sādhakaṃ madavihvalaṃ dhyāyet || iti dhyātvā mānasairupacārairabhyarcya pūrvokta gaṇapati pīṭhe kamalakarṇikāyāṃ ṣaṭkoṇa madhye tathāvidhaṃ mahāgaṇapatiṃ pādyādibhirupacāraiḥ pūjayet | tato'grastha vilvavṛkṣādhaḥ sthitāṃ lakṣmīṃ padmasaṃsthāṃ cakraśaṃkhahastaṃ ca vāsudevaṃ dhyāyet | evaṃ dhyātvā lakṣmī vāsudevābhyāṃ namaḥ iti pūjayet || dakṣiṇe vaṭavṛkṣādhaḥ pāśāṃkuśadharāṃ gaurīṃ ṭaṃkaśūladharaṃ haraṃ dhyātvā gaurī gaurīpatibhyāṃ namaḥ iti pūjayet | paścime pippalādhaḥ utpaladharāṃratiṃkodaṃḍavāṇadharaṃ
<68a>
ratipatiṃ dhyātvā ratiratibhyāṃ namaḥ iti pūjayet || uttare priyaṃgu vṛkṣādhaḥ suvrīhi vallīdharāṃ bhūmiṃ gadācakradharaṃ varāhaṃ dhyātvā bhūmi varāhābhyāṃ na namaḥ iti pūjayet || atha pūrvādi ṣaṭkoṇeṣu gaṃ sidhyāmodābhyāṃ namaḥ <1> gaṃ samṛddhi pramodābhyāṃ namaḥ <2> gaṃ kāṃti sumukhābhyāṃ <3> gaṃ madanāvatī durmukhābhyāṃ <4> gaṃ madadravāvighnābhyāṃ <5> gaṃ madadrāviṇī vighnakartṛbhyāṃ <6> namaḥ iti pūjayet | atha ṣaṭkoṇa pārśvayoḥ | śaṃvasudhārāśaṃkhanidhibhyāṃ namaḥ | yaṃvasumatī padmanidhibhyāṃ namaḥ iti pūjayet | prapaṃcasāre pūrvāgre tadabhitaśca paścātkoṇa tadabhitaśca siddhāmodyāśca pūjyāḥ | abhitaśca śaṃkhapadmanidhī pūjyau | tatoṃga pūjā | aṃgāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ ityādi pūrvoktānyaṃgāni pūjayet | tato brāhmyādyāḥ | kuṃbhodarāya namaḥ ityagre | tato lokapālāḥ | tadastrāṇi ca | aṣṭottaraṃ japitvā visarjayet || atha tarpaṇavidhiḥ || prātaḥkāle mahāgaṇapatiṃ saṃpūjya jale amṛtavījaṃ vakāraṃ vinyasya tajjalaṃ spṛśannekādaśavāraṃ vaṃvījaṃ japet | tajjalaṃ sudhāmayaṃ saṃcitya devatāmastake mahāgaṇapatiṃ tarpayāmīti samuccārya mūlamaṃtreṇavāra catuṣṭayaṃ tarpayet | catvāriṃśaṭvāraṃ vā taduttaraṃ catuḥśatavāraṃ vā |
<68b>
taduttaraṃ catuḥ sahasraṃ vā tarpayet || kramo yathā | mūlamaṃtraṃ samuccārya mahāgaṇapatiṃ tarpayāmīti uccāryavāt | tuṣṭayaṃ tarpayet | tataḥ śrīvījena viṣṇusahitāṃgaurīṃ tarpayet | tato hrīṃ vījena viṣṇusahitāṃ | śriyaṃ tarpayāmītivāra catuṣṭayaṃ tarpayet | punaḥ gajapati vījena mahāgaṇapatiṃ tarpayāmītivāra catuṣṭayaṃ tarpayet | tato hrīṃ vījena śivasahitāṃ gaurī tarpayet | punargaṇapativījena mahāgaṇapatiṃ | kāmavījena manobhavasahitāṃratiṃ | punargaṇapati vījena mahāgaṇapatiṃ | glauṃ bhūvījena varāha sahitāṃ bhuvaṃ | punaḥ gaṃvījena gaṇapatiṃ | gaṃ vījena śaktisahitaṃ vighnaṃ | punargaṇapatiṃ | gaṃ vījena śaktisahitaṃ vighnakartāraṃ | punargaṇapatiṃ || evaṃ prakāreṇa gaṃ siddhisahitaṃ āmodaṃ <1> gaṃ samṛddhisahitaṃ pramodaṃ <2> gaṃ kāṃti sahisumukhaṃ <3> gaṃ madanāvatī sahitaṃ durmukhaṃ <4> gaṃ madadravāsahitaṃ vighnaṃ <5> gaṃ madadrāviṇī sahitaṃ vighnakartāraṃ <6> gaṃ vasudhārāsahitaṃ śaṃkhanidhiṃ | gaṃ vasumatī sahitaṃ padmanidhiṃ tarpayāmīti mahāgaṇapati pratyaṃtaritaṃ pratyekaṃ vāracatuṣṭayaṃ tarpayet | iti tarpaṇavidhiḥ || āmodādi tarpaṇe śaktirahitān kevalāṁstarpayeditikeṣāṃcinmataṃ | evaṃ tarpayan yadabhilaṣitaṃ tattatsādhayati | aṣṭacatvāriṃśat sahasrādhika caturlakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ |
<69a>
pūrvoktamodakādyairaṣṭadravyairdaśāṃśohomaḥ ||
tarpayechalilaiḥ śuddhairdinaśogaṇanāyakaṃ | catuścatvāriṃśadāvāṃ catuḥ śatamataṃdritaḥ ||
āpnuyānmaṃḍalādarvāgabhīṣṭamadhikaṃ naraḥ | icchaṃjapādibhiḥ siddhaḥ prayogāt sumanīṣitāṃ ||
sādhayedaṣṭabhirdravyairanyairvākalpanoditaiḥ | padmahomena bhūpālāṁstatpatnīnutpalaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
maṃtriṇaḥ kumudaiḥ phullairviprān pippalasaṃbhavaiḥ | samidvarairnarapatīnuduṃvara samudbhavaiḥ ||
plakṣairvaiśyānvaṭodbhūtaiḥ śūdrānmaṃtrīvaśaṃ nayet | madhunā svarṇalābhaḥ syādgodugdhena labhetagāḥ ||
ājyahomena mahatīṃ śriyamāpnoti mānavaḥ | dadhnā sarvasamṛddhiḥ syādannairannapatirbhavet ||
vṛṣṭikāmastu juhuyādvetasānāṃ samidvaraiḥ | vakulaiḥ kusumairhutvā vāsāṃsi labhate'cirāt ||
atha vakratuṃḍa gaṇapatimaṃtraḥ || vakratuṃḍāyahuṃ | asya bhārgavaṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ vighneśvaro devatā vaṃ vījaṃ yaṃ śaktiḥ raṃ kīlakaṃ iṣṭārthe viniyogaḥ | oṃ vaṃ namaḥ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ <1> oṃ kraṃ namaḥ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ <2> oṃ tuṃ namaḥ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ <3> oṃ drāṃ namaḥ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ <4> oṃ yaṃ namaḥ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ <5> oṃ huṃ namaḥ karatala karapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ <6> iti karanyāsaḥ || evamakṣarairhṛdayādi ṣaḍaṃgaṃ vinyaset | oṃ vaṃ namaḥ bhrūmadhye evaṃ kaṃṭhahṛdayanābhi liṃgādhāreṣu akṣarāṇi nyaset |
<69b>
samastena vyāpakaṃ | dhyānaṃ | pāśāṃkuṃśābhayakaraṃ varadaṃ dadhānamudbhinnaśoṇamaṇi sannibhacārukāṃtiṃ | aṃbhoja saṃpuṭagataṃ gaṇanāthamatra dhyāyet prasannamaruṇāṃ varamiṃdirāyai | dakṣiṇopari karamārabhyapāśādīnidhyeyāni | mānasika pūjānaṃtaraṃ pūrvoktaṃ gaṇapati pīṭhedevamāvāhya pādyādibhirupacāraiḥ pūjayet | aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ | vidyāyai <1> vidhātryai <2> bhogadāyai <3> vighnaghātinyai <4> nidhipradīpāyai <5> pāpaghnyai <6> puṇyāyai <7> śaśiprabhāyai <8> nama iti pūjayet || daleṣu vakratuṃḍāya <1> ekadaṃṣṭrāya <2> mahodarāya <3> gajānanāya <4> laṃvodarāya <5> vikaṭāya <6> vighnarājāya <7> dhūmrakāya <8> nama iti pūjayet | tato lokapālāṁsca pūjayet | prasannapuṣpāṃjali naivedyādikaṃ datvā svahṛdi devamudvāsayet | tarpaṇādikaṃ pūrvoktaṃ | akṣaralakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | aṣṭadravyairdaśāṃśohomaḥ | brahmacaryādi yukto dvādaśa sahasraṃ japet | pakṣadvayepi caturthīparyaṃtaṃ krameṇa daśasahasraṃ japitvā aṣṭottaraśataṃ juhuyāt | ṣaṇmāsena dāridryaṃ naśyati | ājyāktenānnena pratimāsaṃ
<70a>
triṃśatkrameṇa homena mahatī dhanavṛddhiḥ | pṛthukanālikeramaricairnityaṃ sahasra homakrameṇa māsamātreṇa mahādhana samṛddhiḥ | maricajīrakasaiṃdhavayuktairaṣṭadravyaiḥ pratidinaṃ sahasrahoma krameṇa pakṣamātreṇa vahvartha siddhiḥ | ityādayo vahavaḥ prayogāḥ saṃtite graṃthagauravānnalikhitāḥ || atha maṃtrāṃtaraṃ || rāyasyoṣasyadayitā nidhihoratnadhātumān | rakṣogaṇo valagahano maṃtrarājaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ | ṛṣyādikaṃ vakratuṃḍavat || athāparaḥ | rāyasyoṣasyadayitā nidhidoḥ yannagomataḥ | rakṣogaṇo valagahano vakratuṃḍāya huṃ | asyāpi ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvavat || tatpuruṣāya vidmahe vakratuṃḍāya dhīmahi | tannodaṃtī pracodayāt || iti gāyatrī || athāparaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ || megholkāya svāhā | ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvavat || athocchiṣṭa gaṇapati maṃtraḥ || hastipiśācilikhe svāhā | asya kaṃkolanāmā ṛṣirvirāṭ chaṃdaḥ ucchiṣṭa gaṇapatirdevatā abhilaṣitasiddhaye viniyogaḥ | hasti hṛdayaṃ <1> piśāci śiraḥ <2> likheśikhā <3> svāhā kavacaṃ <4> samaste nāstraṃ <5> dhyāna pūjādikaṃ pūrvavat | ucchiṣṭa samaye viniyoga japādikaṃ kurvan yadyasya rocate tat tasya kurute || [iti śrīmadāśādityatripāṭhisaṃgṛhīte maṃtrakoṣe gaṇapatimaṃtrakathanaṃ nāma dvādaśaḥ paricchedaḥ] || <70b>
atha śaivamaṃtrāḥ ||
tatrādau prāsādaḥ | hauṃ | prāsādamaṃtrasya vāmadeva ṛṣiḥ paṃktiḥ chaṃdaḥ sadāśivo devatāhaṃ vījaṃ oṃ śaktiḥ iṣṭārthe viniyogaḥ | hāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> hīṃ śirase svāhā <2> hūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <2> haiṃ kavacāya huṃ <4> hauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ <5> haḥ astrāya phaṭ <6> oṃ hauṃ īśānāya namaḥ <1> oṃ haiṃ tatpuruṣāya namaḥ <2> oṃ hūṃ aghorāya namaḥ <3> hīṃ vāmadevāya namaḥ <4> haṃ sadyojātāya namaḥ <5> iti paṃcamaṃtrān aṃguṣṭhādikaṃ niṣṭhāṃtāsu aṃgulīṣu vinyasya tābhirevāṃgulībhirmūrdhāna na hṛdaya guhyapādeṣu vinyaset | punarevatān paṃcamaṃtrān ardhaṃ pūrvadakṣiṇottara paścimamukheṣu vinyaset | tato dhyānaṃ | śūlāhīṭaṃkaghaṃṭā'siśṛṇakuliśapāśāgnyabhītīrdadhānaṃ dorbhiḥ śītāṃśukhaṃḍapratighaṭita jaṭābhāramauliṃ trinetraṃ | nānākatyābhirāmāpaghanamabhimatārthapradaṃ suprasannaṃ padmasthaṃ paṃcavaktraṃ sphaṭikamaṇinibhaṃ pārvatīśaṃ namāmi || dakṣādhaḥ karamārabhya prādakṣiṇyena śūlādyā yudhāni vāmādhaḥ karaparyaṃtaṃ krameṇa dhyeyāni | dakṣiṇavāmo parikarayoḥ śūlāhī tadadhaḥ ṭaṃkaghaṃṭe tadadhaḥ asyaṃkuśau | tadadhaḥ kuliśapāśau | tadadhognyabhaye iti kaścit | iti dhyātvā mānasikapūjānaṃtaraṃ vāhyapūjāṃ kuryāt | pūrvavidhinā'rgha sthāpanaṃvidhāya devāmatapātre |
<71a>
oṃ hāṃ kālāgni rudrāya ādhāraśaktyai <1> mūlaprakṛtyai <2> kūrmāya <3> mahāvarāhāya <4> anaṃtāya <5> bhūmyai <6> kailāsrāya <7> kalpavṛkṣāya <8> ratnamaṃḍapāya <9> ratnasiṃhāsanāya <10> skaṃdādisahita kamalāsanāya namaḥ <11> ityuparyupari pūjayet | tadupari caturasraṃ pīṭhaṃ parikalpa dharmāya <1> jñānāya <2> vairāgyāya <3> aiśvaryāya <4> namaḥ iti pīṭhakoṇeṣu pūjayet | adharmāya <1> ajñānāya <2> avairāgyāya <3> anaiśvaryāya <4> namaḥ iti pīṭhagātreṣu pūjayet | madhye taṃ tamase <1> raṃ rajase <2> saṃ satvāya <3> māṃ māyāyai <4> viṃ vidyāyai <5> ātmane <6> aṃtarātmane <7> paramātmane <8> jñānātmane <9> vahnimaṃḍalāya <10> sūryamaṃḍalāya <11> somamaṃḍalāya <12> namaṃ iti pūjayet | taduparyaṣṭadalaṃ kamalaṃ parikalpa pūrvādipatreṣu vāmāyai <1> jyeṣṭhāyai <2> raudryai <3> kālyai <4> kalavikalinyai <5> valapramathinyai <6> sarvabhūtamadanyai <8> nama iti pūjayet | tataḥ manonmatyai namaḥ iti madhye || oṃ namo bhagavate sakalaguṇātmaśaktiyuktāyānaṃtāya yogapīṭhātmane namaḥ iti puṣpāṃjalinā āsanaṃ pūjyaḥ tatra hṛdayāddevamāvāhyapādyādibhirupacāraiḥ pūjayet | tatra paścimebhāge mṛgākṣamālā abhayavarakaraṃ kuṃdagauraṃ caturmukhaṃ dhyātvā oṃ haṃsadyojātāya namaḥ iti sadyojātaṃ pūjayet || <1> || vāmabāge kuṃkumābhaṃ abhayavaraparaśvadhākṣamālādhārayaṃtaṃ dhyātvā oṃ hiṃ vāmadevāya nama iti vāmadevaṃ pūjayet || <2> ||
<71b>
