dakṣiṇabhāge kajjalābhaṃ caturmukhaṃ akṣasragveda pāśāṃkuśa ḍamaruka khaṭvāṃga śūlakapālāni dakṣiṇa vāmakarābhyāṃ krameṇa dadhānaṃ dhyātvā oṃ huṃ aghorāya namaḥ iti pūjayet || <3> || sarvabhāge hemavarṇaṃ caturmukhaṃ vedākṣābhayavaraṃ kuṭhāraṃ dadhānaṃ dhyātvā oṃ heṃ tatpuruṣāya namaḥ iti tatpuruṣaṃ pūjayet || <4> || madhye mauktikābhaṃ paṃcavaktraṃ suprasannaṃ akṣasragveda pāśāṃkuśaṃ ḍamarukakhaṭvāṃga śūlakapālāni vibhrāṇaṃ dhyātvā oṃ hauṃ īśānāya namaḥ iti īśānaṃ pūjayet || <5> || āgneyādi koṇeṣu nivṛttyai <1> pratiṣṭhāyai <2> vidyāyai <3> śāṃtyai <4> madhye śāṃtyatītāyai namaḥ iti pūjayet || iti prathamā vṛttiḥ || aṃgairdvitīyā | anaṃtāya <1> sūkṣmāya <2> śaivottamāya <3> ekanetrāya <4> ekarudrāya <5> trimūrtaye <6> śrīkhaṃḍāya <7> śikhaṃḍine namaḥ iti pūjayet || ete anaṃtādayaḥ śūlāśani (**)(?) yollasitakarāḥ pāṭalipītasitāruṇasitaraktasita dhūmravarṇāḥ padmasthā dhyeyāḥ | uttaradalamārabhyaḥ umāyai <1> caṃḍeśvarāya <2> naṃdine <3> mahākālāya <4>
<72a>
gaṇeśvarāya <5> vṛṣāya <6> bhṛṃgiriṭaye <7> skaṃdāya namaḥ <8> iti pūjayet | umādyāḥ kanakavidura vidrumamarakatemuktāsitāccharaktābhādhyeyā || iṃdrādīṁśca svadikṣu | tadastrāṇi ca pūjayet | iti pūjayitvā japaṃ samarpya devasya tano parivārān vilapya svahṛdaye devamudvāsya ṣaḍaṃgaṃ vinyasya caṃḍeśvarāya nama ityadho devasya pūjayet | iti pūjā saṃkṣepaḥ || kecittu hṛllekhāpuṭitaṃ vījaṃ japāṃdauvarṇayaṃti | ekādaśalakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | trimadhurāktaiḥ karavīra kusumairdaśāṃśohomaḥ | paṃcabrahmanyāso gauravānnalikhitaṃ |
evaṃ pratidinaṃ devaṃ pūjayet sādhakottamaḥ | putramitrādisahitāṃśriyaṃ prāpyaṃ pramodate ||
atha paṃcākṣaraḥ ||
oṃ namaḥ śivāya | asya vāmadevaṛṣiḥ paṃktiḥ chaṃdaḥ śivodevatā iṣṭārthemaṃvījaṃ āyaśaktiḥ naṃ kīlakaṃ jñānārthe viniyogaḥ || oṃ iti vījaṃ namaḥ iti śaktiḥ iti japakāle kecit | praṇavaprāsādapūrvakaṃ japedityapyasti | na kārādīnāṃ paṃcākṣarāṇāṃ gotamātri viśvāmitrāṃgirobharadvājā ṛṣayaḥ gāyatryanuṣṭup triṣṭup vṛhatī virāṭ chaṃdāṃsi iṃdrarudraharibrahmaskaṃdā devatāḥ pītakṛṣṇadhūmraśvetavarṇāḥ |
<72b>
mūlamaṃtreṇaṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ karaśuddhiṃ ca vidhāya | oṃ hṛdayaṃ <1> naṃ śiraḥ <2> maṃ śikhā <3> śiṃ kavacaṃ <4> vāṃ netratrayaṃ <5> yaṃ astraṃ <6> || athavā oṃ sarvajñadhāmne hṛdayaṃ <1> naṃ tridhāmne śiraḥ <2> maṃ anādivodhadhāmne śikhā <3> śiṃ svataṃtradhāmne kavacaṃ <4> vāṃ jyotirdhāmne netratrayaṃ <5> yaṃ anaṃtaśaktidhāmne namaḥ astraṃ <6> | nyāsaṃ ca | naṃ tatpuruṣāya namaḥ <1> maṃ aghorāya <2> śiṃ sadyojātāya <3> vāṃ vāmadevāya <4> yaṃ īśānāya namaḥ iti tarjanī madhyamānāmikā kaniṣṭhāṃguṣṭheṣu nyaset || vaktrahṛdguhyamāśyamūrddhasu ca vinyaset | prāgyāmyapaścimodīvyorddhavaktreṣu ca vinyaset || tato dhyānaṃ | vibhraddorbhiḥ kuṭhāraṃ mṛgamabhayavarau su prasanno maheśaḥ sarvālaṃkāradīptaḥ sarasijanilayo vyāghracarmāṃtavāsāḥ | dhyeyo muktāyarāgāmṛtarasakalitādriprabhaḥ paṃcavaktrastryakṣaḥ koṭīrakoṭī ghaṭita tu hinarociṣkalottuṃgamauliḥ || dakṣiṇa vāmakarābhyāṃ paraśumṛgau tadadho'bhayavarauvibhrat | iti dhyātvā vāhyapūjāṃ kuryāt | pūrvokte śaive pīṭhe devamāvāhya pādyādibhirupacāraiḥ pūjayet | īśānādibhiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ | aṃgaurdvatīyaṃ | anaṃtādyaistritīyaṃ | umādyaiścaturthaṃ | iṃdrādibhiḥ paṃcamaṃ | tadāyudhaiḥ ṣaṣṭhaṃ | evaṃ saṃpūjya japānaṃtaramudvāsayet | varṇalakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | śuddhaistilairdaśāṃśohomaṃ | dugdhānnairdugdhasamidbhirvāhomaḥ ||
<73a>
athāṣṭākṣaraḥ || śaktipaṃcākṣarovā | oṃ hrīṃ namaḥ śivāya hrīṃ | asya ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvavat | hrīṃ oṃ hrāṃ hṛdayaṃ <1> hrīṃ naṃ hrīṃ śiraḥ <2> hrīṃ maṃ hrūṃ śikhā <3> hrīṃ śiṃ hraiṃ kavacaṃ <4> hrīṃ vāṃ hrauṃ netraṃ <5> hrīṃ yaṃ hraḥ astrāya phaṭ <6> | dhyānaṃ | vaṃde haraṃ varadaśūlakapālahastaṃ sāmīti madrisuta yojvalanehakāṃtiṃ | vāmorupīṭhagatayānija vāmahasta nyastoruṇotpalayujāpariṇaddhadehaṃ | dakṣiṇādhaḥ karamārabhya varadaśūlakapālābhayāni dhyeyāni | iti dhyātvā mānasīṃ pūjāṃ vidhāya prāsāda maṃtroktapīṭhe devamāvāhya pādyādibhirupacārairabhyarcayet | tato'ṃgāvaraṇaṃ | madhyaprāgdakṣiṇāṃ paścimodīcyeṣu | hṛllekhādibhirdvitīyaṃ | brāhmyādibhiścaturthāṃ lokapālaiḥ paṃcamaṃ | japānaṃtaraṃ visarjayet | daśalakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | madhurāktai rājavṛkṣasamidbhiścaturdaśāṃśohomaḥ || athāṣṭākṣarordhanārīśvaraḥ || oṃ hrīṃ hauṃ namaḥ śivāya | vāmadeva ṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ umāmaheśvaro devatā praṇavovījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ naṃ kīlakaṃ iṣṭārthe | pūrvavat ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | dhyānaṃ ca | vāmāṃganyasta vāme tarakarakamalāyāstathā vāmavāhunyastaraktotpalāyāstanavivṛtalasadvāmavāhuḥ priyāyāḥ | sarvākalpābhirāmodhṛta paraśumṛgeṣṭakaraiḥ kāṃcanābho dhyeyaḥ padmāsanasthaḥ smaralalitatanuḥ saṃpadepārvatīśaḥ | adho vāmahastena stanadvayaṃ | dakṣiṇena varadaṃ | uparitanābhyāṃ paraśumṛgaunibhrāṇaṃ | aṣṭalakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | tāvatsahasreṇasājyena homaḥ | paṃcākṣarīmaṃtravatpūjādi || atha mṛtyuṃjayaḥ | oṃ juṃsaḥ ||
<73b>
asya kaholaka ṛṣirdaivīgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ mṛtyuṃjaya rudrodevatājuṃvījaṃ saḥ śaktiḥ iṣṭārthe | sāṃ hṛdayaṃ <1> sīṃ (***)(?) <2> sūṃ śikhā <3> sauṃ netratrayaṃ <4> saḥ astraṃ <5> | dhyānaṃ | puṭita nalina saṃsthaṃ maulivaddheṃdu rekhā galadamṛtajalārdraṃ caṃdravahnyarka(****)(?) kalita mudrā pāśavedākṣamālaṃ sphaṭika rajatamuktāgauramīśaṃ namāmi ||| dakṣiṇa vāmakarābhyāṃ jñānamudrāpāśau (*)(?) dadhokṣa mālā vedau dhyeyau iti | mānasikapūjānaṃtaraṃ prāsādamaṃtroktapīṭhe devamāvāhya pādyādibhirupacāraiḥ pūjayet | athaiḥ athamāvṛttiḥ | anaṃtādibhirdvitīyā | umādibhistṛtīyā | iṃdrādibhiścaturthī | japāṃte visarjayet | lakṣatrayaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ (***)(?) ktairguḍūcīkhaṃḍairdaśāṃśohomaḥ || ekādaśāhutīrnityaṃ dūrvābhirjuhuyānnaraḥ | apamṛtyujideṣasyādāyurārogyavardhanā trisahasraṃ sudhāvallī kāśmarī vakulodbhavaiḥ | samidvaraiḥ kṛto homaḥ sarvamṛtyugadāpahaḥ | siddhārthairvihito homo maha(****)(?) vināśanaḥ | apāmārgakṛto homaḥ sarvāmayaniṣūdanaḥ || atha nīlakaṃṭhaḥ | proṃ trīṃṭhaḥ | asya ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvavat | harahara svāhā hṛdayaṃ <1>
<74a>
kapardine svāhā śiraḥ <2> nīlakaṃṭhāya svāhā <3> kālakūṭa viṣabhakṣaṇaya huṃ phaṭ kavacaṃ <4> nīlakaṃṭhine svāhā astraṃ <5> dhyānaṃ | vālārkāyuta teja saṃvṛta jaṭājūṭeṃdu khaṃḍo jvalaṃ nāgeṃdraiḥ kṛtabhūṣaṇaṃ japavaṭīṃśūlaṃ kapālaṃ karaiḥ | khaṭvāṃgaṃ dadhataṃ trinetra vilasat paṃcānanaṃ suṃdaraṃ vyāghratvak paridhānamakṣavalayaṃ śrīnīlakaṃṭhaṃ bhaje || dakṣiṇādhaḥ karopari karābhyāṃ japavaṭī triśūle | itarābhyāṃ kapālakhaṭvāṃge dadhānaṃ | iti dhyātvā mānasikapūjāṃ kṛtvā prāsādoktapīṭhe devamāvāhya pūrvoktavidhinā pūjayet | lakṣatrayaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | sa sarpiṣā haviṣā daśāṃśo homaḥ | evaṃ pūjādibhiḥ siddhe manau maṃtrī viṣadvayaṃ | nāśayedacirādevanīlakaṃṭha idhāparaḥ | manunānena saṃjaptaiḥ kuṃbhasthaiḥ salilaiḥ śubhaiḥ | abhiṣiṃcedviṣākrāṃtaṃ viṣānmucyeta sadrutaṃ | spṛṣṭvā japedviṣākrāṃtaṃ takṣaṇānnirviṣo bhavet || atha caṃḍeśvaraḥ | rū gha jha gha phaṭ | asya trika ṛṣiranuṣṭhup chaṃdaḥ | caṃḍeśvaro devata iṣṭārthe | dīpta phaṭ hṛdayaṃ <1> jvala phaṭ śiraḥ <2> jvālini phaṭ śikhā <3> kaṭaphaṭ kavacaṃ <4> hanaphaṭ netratrayaṃ <5> sarvaṃ jvālini phaṭ astraṃ <6> |
<74b>
dhyānaṃ | avyātkapardakaliteṃḍukalāṃkarāṃta śūlākṣasūtrakakamaṃḍaluṭaṃka īśaḥ | raktābhavarṇavasano'ruṇa paṃkajastho netratrayollasitavaktra saroruhovaḥ | dakṣiṇoparyadhaḥ karābhyāṃ śūlamakṣasūtraṃ | vāmādhastano parikarābhyāṃ kamaḍaluṃṭaṃkaṃ ca jñeyaṃ || caṃḍacaṃḍāya vidmahe mahādevāya dhīmahi | taṃ naścaṃḍaḥ pracodayāt | iti caṃḍagāyatrī śivasaṃnidhikāriṇī | śaivepīṭhe devamāvāhya pūjayet | aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ | dvitīyaṃ mātṛbhiḥ | lokapālaistṛtīyaṃ | caṃḍeśvarāya namaḥ iti pūjāmaṃtraḥ | lakṣatrayaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | madhuratrayāktaistilaiḥ sa taṃḍulairdaśāṃśohomaḥ || atha ciṃtāmaṇi maṃtraḥ || kṣmyrauṃ | asya kaśyapaṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ ciṃtāmaṇirīśvaro devatāraṃvījaṃ ṣaṃ śakti maṃ kīilakaṃ sakalavidyaiśvaryā vāptaye viniyogaḥ | raṃ hṛdayaṃ <1> kaṃ śiraḥ <2> ṣaṃ śikhā <3> maṃ kavacaṃ <4> raṃ netratrayaṃ <5> yaṃ astraṃ <6> | dhyānaṃ | ahiśaśadharagaṃgāvaddhatuṃgātmamaulistridaśagaṇanatāṃdhristrīkṣaṇaḥ strīvilāsaḥ | bhujagaparaśuśūlān khaḍgavahnīkapālaṃ śaramapi dhanurīśovibhradavyācciraṃvaḥ | uparitana dakṣiṇa vāmakarābhyāṃ sarpaparaśū tadadhastanābhyāṃ śūlakhaḍgau | tadadhaṃ stanābhyāṃ vahnikapāle | tadadhastanābhyāṃ śaradhanuṣīvibhrāṇaṃ | hāvabhāvalalitārdhanārikaṃbhīṣaṇārdhamatha vā maheśvaraṃ | pāśasotpala kapālaśūlinaṃ pūjayejjapavidhau vibhūtaye ||
<75a>
atha vā | ṣoḍaśaśūlavyagrabhujā trinayanā hi ṣaṭvāṃgī | aruṇāṃśukānulepana varṇābharaṇā ca bhagavatī dhyeyā || prāsādokta pīṭhe devamāvāhya pādyādibhirupacāraiḥ pūjayet | aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ | pūrvokta vṛṣādibhirdvitīyaṃ | vṛṃ vṛṣāya <1> kṣaṃ kṣetrapālāya <2> caṃḍeśvarāya <3> duṃ durgāyai <4> guṃ guhāyai <5> naṃ naṃdine <6> | gaṃ gaṇeśvarāya <7> saiṃ sainyapālāya <8> namaḥ iti pūrvādi patreṣu pūjayet | mātṛbhistṛtīyaṃ | lokapālaiścaturthaṃ || lakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | trimadhurāktaistila taṃḍulairdaśāṃśohomaḥ ||
evamabhyarcayeddevamardhanārīśvaraṃparaṃ | tejaḥ kāṃtiṃ yaśolakṣmīṃ vācāṃ bhavati vallabhaḥ ||
kṣveḍeviṣejvaredāhemoheśīrṣagrahebhrame | vījametattathā dhyānaṃ tattatkleśān vyayohati ||
atha tuṃ vuruvījaṃ || kṣmrūṃ | ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvavat | kṣmrāṃ | kṣmrīṃ ityādi ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | dhyānaṃ | ramamiṃduśakalābharaṇaṃ triṇetraṃ khaṭvāṃgapāśaśṛṇi śūlakapālavedān | vedānanaṃ cipiḍanāśamanarghyabhūṣāṃ raktāṃ vahnimaruṇāṃśukamīśamīḍe || uparitana vāmadakṣiṇa karābhyāṃ pāśaparaśū | tadadhastanābhyāṃ śūlakhaḍgau | tadadhastanābhyāṃ vahnikapāle | tadadhastanābhyāṃśaradhanuṣī dhyeye | iti kecit | dakṣiṇādhaḥ karamārabhya khaṭvāṃgādīnyāyudhāni vā kaścit |
dakṣiṇādhaḥ karamārabhya khaṭvāṃga pāśāṃkuśān |
<75b>
vāmepi tathā triśūla kapāla vedān dadhānaṃ ||
pūrvoktapīṭhe devamāvāhya pūjayet | aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ | japādibhirdvitīyaṃ | durgāyai <1> subhagāyai <2> karālyai <3> mohinyai <4> nama iti pūjayet īśānādi koṇeṣu | lokapālāṁśca svadikṣu | tadastrāṇi ca | japitvā devaṃ visarjat | lakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | sarpipāyasenāyutaṃ homaḥ || atha tryaṃvakamaṃtraḥ | tryaṃvakaṃ yajāmahe sugaṃdhiṃ puṣṭivardhanaṃ | urvārukamivavaṃdhanānmṛtyormukṣīyamāmṛtān | tryaṃvakamaṃtrasya vaśiṣṭha ṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ tryaṃvaka rudro devatā mṛtyuṃjayādi siddhaye viniyogaḥ | tryaṃvakaṃ hṛdayaṃ <1> yajāmahe śiraḥ <2> sugaṃdhiṃ puṣṭivardhanaṃ śikhā <3> urvārukamiva vaṃdhanān kavacaṃ <4> mṛtyormukṣīya netratrayaṃ <5> mātṛtāt astraṃ <6> pādadvayasaṃdhyaṃseṣu daśavarṇān vinyaset | guhyādhārodara hṛdayakaṃdhareṣu paṃcavarṇān | vāhudvayasaṃdhyaṃseṣudaśa | ghrāṇayordvayaṃ | āsye ekaṃ | nayanayorekaṃ | karṇayorekaṃ | śirasyekaṃ ityakṣaranyāsaḥ | tryaṃvakaṃ śirasi <1> yajāmahe bhruvoḥ <2> sugaṃdhiṃ nayanayoḥ <3> puṣṭiṃvardhanaṃ mukhe <4> urvārukaṃ kaṃṭhe <5> iva hṛdaye <6> vaṃdhanāt udare <7> mṛtyorguhya <8> mukṣīya (*)(?)rvoḥ <9> mājānvoḥ <10> amṛtāt pādadvaye <11> nyaset | iti padanyāsaḥ |
<76a>
acchasvacchāraviṃdasthita ubhayakarāṃtasthitaṃ pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ dvābhyāṃ vedākṣamāle nijakarakamalābhyāṃ ghaṭau nityapūrṇau | dvābhyāṃtau ca sravaṃtau śirasi śaśikalāvaṃdhureplāvayaṃtau dehaṃ devodadhānaḥ pradiśa tu viśadā kalpajālaḥ priyaṃvaḥ | uparitana vāmadakṣiṇa karadhṛta kuṃbhadvayāmṛtenātmaśiraḥ siṃcaṃtaṃ | tadadhastanābhyāmamṛta pūrṇakuṃbhadvayaṃ dhārayaṃtaṃ | tadadhastanābhyāṃ vedākṣamāle dhyāyet | śāradāyāṃ vedasthāne mṛga uktaḥ | iti mānasika pūjāṃte pūrvoktepīṭhe devamāvāhya pādyādibhirupacāraiḥ pūjayet || aṃgaiḥ prathamāvṛttiḥ | arkāya <1> iṃdave <2> dharaṇyai <3> toyāya <4> analāya <5> vāyave <6> ākāśāya <7> ātmane <8> nama iti pūrvādi patreṣu pūjayet | ramāyai <1> raktāyai <2> prabhāyai <3> jyotsnāyai <4> pūrṇāyai <5> uṣāyai <6> pūraṇyai <7> svadhāyai <8> namaḥ iti pūjayet | viśvāyai <1> vidyāyai <2> sitāyai <3> pracchyai <4> sārāyai <5> saṃdhyāyai <6> śivāyai <7> ārdrāyai <8> prajñāyai <9> prabhāyai <10> medhāyai <11> kāṃtyai <12> śāṃtyai <13> dhṛtyai <14> matyai <15> namaḥ iti pūjayet || dharāyai <1> umāyai <2> pāvanyai <3> padmāyai <4> śāṃtāyai <5> amoghāyai <6> jayāyai <7> amalāyai <8> namaḥ iti pūjayet || lokapālāṁśca svadikṣu | tadastrāṇi ca | evaṃ saṃpūjya japitvā devaṃ visarjayet || lakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | vilvapalāśavaṭapippala siddhārthapāyasakṣīradūrvābhiḥ pratyekaṃ daśāṃśohomaḥ ||
<76b>
atha dakṣiṇāmūrti maṃtraḥ | ṣaḍviṃśadakṣarātmakaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtaye tubhyaṃ vaṭamūlanivāsine dhyānaikaniratāṃgāya namo rudrāya śaṃbhave oṃ hrīṃ | asya śukaṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ dakṣiṇāmūrti rudrodevatā oṃ vījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiriṣṭārthe viniyogaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtaye hrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> oṃ hrīṃ tubhyaṃ hrīṃ śirase svāhā <2> oṃ hrīṃ vaṭamūlanivāsine hruṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> oṃ hrīṃ dhyānaikaniratāṃgāya hraiṃ kavacāya huṃ <4> oṃ hrīṃ namo rudrāya hrauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ <5> oṃ hrīṃ śaṃbhave hraḥ astrāya phaṭ <6> || athākṣaranyāsaḥ | śirasyekaṃ lalāṭe ekaṃ karṇayordvayaṃ gaṃḍayorekaṃ nāsayordvayaṃ mukhe ekaṃ doḥ saṃdhiṣvaṣṭau kaṃṭhe ekaṃ stanayordvayaṃ hṛnnābhyorekaikaṃ kaṭibhāga dvayedvayaṃ guhye ekaṃ pādasaṃdhiṣṭaṣṭau dvābhyāṃ vyāpakanyāsaḥ || śāraṣṭayāṃ nayanānaṃtaraṃ karṇanyāsaḥ | prapaṃce tu pūrvaṃ karṇanyāsaḥ | atha dhyānaṃ | mudrāṃ bhadrārthadātrīṃsa paraśuhariṇī vāhubhirvāhumekaṃ jānvā saktaṃ dadhāno bhujagavarasamāvaddhakakṣojaṭādhaḥ | āsīnaścaṃdrakhaṃḍa pratighaṭitajaṭaḥ kṣīragaurastrinetro dadyādāṣṭauḥ śukādyairmunibhirabhivṛto bhāvaśuddhiṃ bhavovaḥ | mudrāṃ paraśuṃcādhastanopari dakṣiṇakarābhyāṃ vāmena hariṇaṃ tadadhastanaṃ jānvāsaktaṃ dhyāyet | iti dhyātvā mānasikapūjānaṃtaraṃ prāsādoktapīṭhe devamāvāhya pādyādibhirupacāraiḥ pūjayet |
<77a>
aṃgaiḥ prathamāvṛttḥ | dvitīyāmūrti śaktibhiḥ | tṛtīyā vṛṣādibhiḥ | lokapālaiścaturthī | tadastraiḥ paṃcamī | dvātriṃśallakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | dugdhāplutaistilaiḥ sājyena haviṣā vā daśāṃśohomaḥ ||
nityaśo dakṣiṇāmūrtiṃ dhyāyansādhakasattamaḥ | sostravyākhyāna sāmarthyaṃ labhate vatsarāṃtare ||
brāhmīṃ saiṃdhavasiddhārtha vacāt uṣṭakarṇotpalaiḥ | sugaṃdhi saṃyutaiḥ kalkaiḥ śṛtaṃ brāhmīrasairghṛtaṃ ||
manunā tena saṃjaptamayutaṃ sādhusādhitaṃ | nipītaṃ kavinākāṃti rakṣāyuḥ śrīdhṛtipradaṃ ||
atha caturviṃśatya kṣarātmakomaṃtraḥ | oṃ namo bhagavate dakṣiṇāmūrtaye mahyaṃ siddhiṃ medhāṃ prayaccha svāhā | śāradā tilake tu siddhimityakṣaraṃ vinādvāviṃśākṣaraḥ || maṃtramuktāvalyāṃ ca medhāṃte prajñāmiti | tena caturviṃśatyakṣaraḥ | medhāmitiśaṣṭātpūrvaṃ prajñāṃ vinā siddhamitikaścit | prajñāmiti kīlaṃ tatra vāgbhavaṃ vījaṃ datvā japet | asya brahmāṛṣirdaivī gāyatrī chaṃdaḥ dakṣiṇāmūrtirdevata sakalapuruṣārtha siddhyarthe viniyogaḥ | oṃ vījaṃ svāhā śaktiḥ | ā hrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> īṃ hrīṃ śirase svāhā <2> oṃ hrūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> aiṃ hraiṃ kavacāya huṃ <4> aṃ hrauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ <5> aḥ hraḥ astrāya phaṭ <6> | tato'kṣaranyāsaḥ |
mūrdhnipaścāllalāṭe ca cakṣuṣī śravaṇadvaye | nāsāpuṭadvaye paścāddaṃtayorgaṃḍayordvayoḥ ||
jihvāgre nāsikāgre catuṣṭayoryugalegale |
<77b>
vāhvośca hṛdaye caiva nābhau kukṣau gude tathā ||
ūrvojānvośca jaṃghāyāṃ pārśve pādayuge tathā | sarvāṃge saṃdhiṣu tathā nyasenmaṃtrākṣarāṇi hi ||
iti caturviṃśatpakṣarāṇi vinyasya dhyānaṃ kuryāt | sphaṭika rajatavarṇaṃ muktikī makṣamālāmamṛtakalaśavidyājñānamudrākarāgraiḥ | dadhatamuragakacchaṃ caṃdracūḍaṃ trinetraṃ vidhṛtavividhabhūṣaṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtimīḍe | dakṣiṇa vāmakarābhyāṃ mauktikamālāṃ amṛtakalaśaṃ | tadadhaḥ jñānamudrāṃ vidyāṃ ca dadhataṃ | iti dhyātvā śaivepīṭhe devamāvāhya pūjayet | aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ | svaradvaṃdvāṣṭakairdvitīyaṃ | a ka ca ṭa ta pa ya śa la kṣa ityaṣṭabhirvargaistṛtīyaṃ | anaṃtādibhiścaturthaṃ | sarasvatī brahmāsanakasanaṃdana sanātana sanatkumāra śukavedavyāsaiḥ paṃcamaṃ || pārvatī subhagā bhadrā krīḍāśaktistathaiva ca | raudrī kālī vijṛṃbheti dakṣiṇāmūrti śaktayaḥ || akṣasrak pustakāḥ svacchāḥ proktāḥ syurvarṇabhūṣaṇāḥ | etābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ ṣaṣṭaṃ | saptamamidrādibhiḥ | tadāyudhairaṣṭamaḥ | evaṃ saṃpūjya yathāśakti japitvā devaṃ visarjayet | evaṃ paścimadvāraśivālaye maṃtraṃ japet | lakṣa catuṣṭayaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | pāyasena daśāṃśo homaḥ || atha viniyogaḥ | jalamannaṃ vā
<78a>
paṃcaviṃśati paṃcaviṃśati maṃtrajāṃpenābhimaṃtritaṃ pivet tadā vāksiddhirbhavati sarvarogaśamanaṃ ca bhavet ||
trayodaśyāṃ pradoṣeṇa sopahāraḥ śivālaye | maunī bhūtvārcayeddevaṃ vidyāvuddhivivardhanaṃ ||
sājyena pāyasenānna kāmo juhuyāt | śrīkāmaḥ padmairvilvairvāśataṃ juhuyāt | sājyakṣīrākta dūrvābhirāyuḥ kāmo juhuyāt | gurave gāṃ mahīṃ dadyāttasya mṛtyubhayaṃ kutaḥ | putraṃ ca viṃdati |
ādityābhimukho bhūtvā dvādaśāṃjali secanaṃ | sarvaiśvaryaṃ ca tejaśca sa doṣairna pravādhyate ||
prātaḥsāyaṃ ca saptaiva madhyāhne caika viṃśatiḥ | dugdhavudhyājalairdevaṃ tarpayitvā sukhī bhavet ||
palāśapuṣpairayuta homādvidyādhiko bhavet | pratyakṣaṃ maṃḍalādarvāk kavīnāmagraṇīrbhavet ||
gauryā pārśvasthayāsārdhaṃ śrīkāmaściṃtayedvibhuṃ | ayutaṃ juhuyānmaṃtrī bhūyasī śriyamāpnuyāt ||
bhuṃjānaḥ prayato maṃtrī gomūtraiḥ pakvamodanaṃ | bhikṣānnamatha vā maṃtrī yatiryāvakabhuktathā ||
aśrutvā vedaśāstrāṇāṃ kovido jāyate dhruvaṃ ||
atha yaṃtra mucyate ||
daśadalapadmaṃ viracayet |
sādhyanāma yuktaṃ prāṇavaṃ vilikhya dalamūleṣu maṃtravarṇadvayaṃ aṃtyadale avaśiṣṭaṃ varṇaṃ tadvahirmātrikābhirveṣṭayet |
<78b>
etadyaṃtra japādibhiḥ sādhitaṃ pānīyādipītaṃ mahāsārasvataṃ syāt || atha maṃtrāṃtaraṃ || oṃ namo bhagavate dakṣiṇāmūrtaye mahyaṃ medhāṃ prayaccha svāhā | asya brahmā ṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ dakṣiṇāmūrtirdevatā sārasvatārthe viniyogaḥ | aṃgamaṃtrairaṃguṣṭhādinyāsaḥ | oṃ namo bhagavate hṛdayaṃ <1> dakṣiṇāmūrtaye śiraḥ <2> | mahyaṃ śikhā <3> medhāṃ kavacaṃ <4> prayaccha netratrayaṃ <5> svāhā astraṃ <6> || athākṣaranyāsaḥ |
mūrdhnipaścāllalāṭe ca cakṣuṣoḥ śravaṇadvaye | nāsāpuṭadvaye paścādgaṃḍayordaṃtayordvayoḥ ||
jihvāgre nāsikāgre ca ūṣṭayoryugalegale | vāhvośca hṛdaye caiva nābhau guhye gude tathā ||
ūrvoścajānvorjaṃghāyāṃ pārṣṇipāde tathaiva ca | sarvāṃgasaṃdhiṣu paraṃ nyasedvānataṃtritaḥ ||
dhyānaṃ |
dhyātvā devaṃ jagannāthaṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtimavyayaṃ | kuṃdeṃdu śaṃkhadhavalaṃ vyāghra carmāṃta vā sasaṃ ||
vyākhyā pīṭhe samāsīnamākrāṃtāpa smṛtiṃ sadā | vāmapāṇitaledyotajjātaveda sa pustakaṃ ||
vyākhyā mudrākṣamālābhyāṃ virājita karadvayaṃ | munibhiḥ sevitaṃ devamaśeṣārtha phalapradaṃ ||
<79a>
athavā | kapardinaṃ camḍrakalāvataṃ saṃtrinetramiṃdu pratimaṃ smṛto jvalāṃ | caturbhujaṃ jñānadamakṣasūtraṃ pustāni hastaṃ hṛdi bhāvayāmi | iti dhyātvā pūrvokte śaivepīṭhe devamāvāhya pādyādibhirupacāraiḥ pūjayet | aṃgaiḥ prathamāṃvaraṇaṃ | brāhmaṇāya <1> śakrāya <2> sanaṃdāya <3> sanatkumārāya <4> śukāya <5> vyāsāya <6> gaṇeśāya <7> siddhāya <8> gaṃdharvāya <9> yogīṃdrāya <10> vidyādharāya <11> nama iti pūjayet || ete pustaka sarasvatī vācayato dhyeyāḥ | lokapālāṁśca svadikṣu | tadāyudhāni ca | lakṣaṃmekaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | savūtaiḥ padmairdaśāṃśohomaḥ || ecchaṃ japādibhiḥ siddhe maṃtresminsādhakottamaḥ | maṃtreṇānenaṃsaṃjaptairviśuddhaiḥ salilaiḥ sudhīḥ | abhiṣiṃcet svaśirasiśriyamārogyamāpnuyāt | kaṃṭhamātrodake sthitvā japanmaṃtra sahasrakaṃ | pratyahaṃ maṃḍalādarvāk kavīnāmagraṇīrbhavet || athaikapaṃcāśadakṣarātmako aghora maṃtraḥ | hrīṃ sphurasphura prasphuraprasphura ghoraghorataratanurūpa vama caṭacaṭa pracaṭapracaṭa kahakaha vamavama vaṃdhavaṃdha ghātayaghātaya huṃ phaṭ | asya maṃtrasya aghora ṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ aghorarūpa rudrodevatā sakalaśatrukṣayapūrvaka sakalasamṛddhikāmanārthe viniyogaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ sphurasphura hṛdayāya namaḥ <1>
<79b>
prasphura <2> śirase svahā <2> ghoraghorataratanurūpaśikhā <3> caṭa <2> pracaṭa <2> kavacaṃ <4> kaha <2> vama <2> netratrayāya vauṣaṭ <5> vaṃdha <2> ghātaya <2> kavacāya huṃ <6> huṃ phaṭ astrāya phaṭ <7> | iti ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | hrīṃ sphura <2> mūrdhni <1> prasphura <2> netrayoḥ <2> ghora āsye <3> ghorataratanurūpakaṃṭhe <4> caṭacaṭa hṛdi <5> pracaṭa <2> nābhau <6> kaha <2> guhye <7> vama <2> ṛrvoḥ <8> vaṃdha <2> jānvoḥ <9> ghātaya <2> jaṃghayoḥ <10> huṃ phaṭ pādayoḥ <11> | tato dhyānaṃ | sajalaghanasamānaṃ bhīmadaṃṣṭraṃ triṇetraṃ bhujagadharamaghoraṃ raktavastrāṃgarāgaṃ | paraśuḍamarukhaḍgānkheṭakaṃ vāṇa ca | (*##?) bhavet prabhuḥ | vaśye kuṃkumasaṃkāśo muktau caṃdra sa(***##?) | tadadho vāṇakārmukau | tadadhaḥ śūlakapāle vidhatāṃ | iti dhyātvā pūrvokte śaive pīṭhe devamāvāhya pādyādibhirupacāraiḥ pūjayet | yathā vidhi | aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ | paraśave <1> ḍamarukāya <2> khaḍgāya <3> kheṭāya <4> vāṇāya <5> kārmukāya <6> śūlāya <7> kapālāya <8> nama iti kamalapatreṣu pūjayet | tato brāhmyādīn | dikyāśāṁśca | iti pūjāṃte japaṃ nivedya visarjayet | lakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | ghṛtāktaistilairdaśāṃśohomaḥ || kramāt sarpirayāmārgatilasarṣa(*)(?) pāyasaiḥ |
<80a>
sājyaiḥ sahasraṃ pratyekaṃ yāminyāṃ juhuyāt sudhīḥ | homoyannāśayet sarvān bhūtakṛtyādyupadravān || atha pāśupatamaṃtraḥ || oṃ ślīṃ paśu huṃ phaṭ | asya ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvavat | devatā paśupatiḥ | oṃ hṛdayaṃ <1> ślīṃ śiraḥ <2> ya śikhā <3> śukavacaṃ <4> huṃ netratrayaṃ <5> phaṭ astraṃ <6> | aṃganyāseṣu huṃ phaṭ aṃtāni maṃtrākṣarāṇīti kaścit || tato dhyānaṃ | madhyāhnārka samaprabhaṃ śaśidharaṃ śrīmāṭṭahāsojvalaṃ saṃsatpannagabhūṣaṇaṃ śiśiśikhāramaśrusphuranmūrdhvajaṃ | hastābjai striśikhaṃ samudgaramasiṃśaktiṃ dadhānaṃ vibhuṃ daṃṣṭrā bhīmacaturmukhaṃ paśupatiṃ divyāstrarūpaṃ smaret | uparitanadakṣa vāmakarābhyāṃ triśūlamudgarau | tadadho hastābhyāmasi śaktīdadhānaṃ | etadviparītamiti kaścit || iti dhyātvā śaive pīṭhe devamāvāhya pūjayet | aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ | brahmādibhirdvitīyaṃ | lokapālaistṛtīyaṃ | tadāyudhaisturīyaṃ | ṣaṭlakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | gavyena pāyasena daśāṃśo homaḥ || anena maṃtritaṃ toyaṃ grastasya vadane kṣipet | sadyastaṃ muṃcatikraṃda grahomaṃtra prabhāvataḥ | amunāmaṃtritān vāṇān vikiredyudhi bhūpatiḥ | japet kṣaṇena nikhilān śatrūn pārtha ivāparaḥ || atha kṣetrapālamaṃtraḥ | oṃ kṣauṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ | kṣāṃ kṣīṃ kṣūṃ kṣaiṃ kṣauṃ kṣaḥ iti ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | dhyānaṃ | nīlāṃjanādrinibhamūrdhvapiśaṃgakeśaṃ
<80b>
vṛttogra locanamupāttajaṭākalāpaṃ | āśāṃvaraṃ bhujagabhūṣaṇamugradaṃṣṭraṃ kṣetreśamadbhutatanuṃ praṇamāmidevaṃ | iti dhyātvā śaivepīṭhe devamāvāhya pūjayet | aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ | pūrvādi patreṣu analāya <1> ardhvakeśāya <2> karālāya <3> ghaṃṭāravāya <4> mahākopāya <5> piśitāśanāya <6> piṃgalākṣāya <7> ardhakeśāya namaḥ <8> iti pūjayet | lokapālāṁśca svadikṣu | tadastrāṇi ca pūjayet | lakṣamekaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | ghṛtāktena caruṇā daśāṃśohomaḥ || ehi ehi viduṣi purupurubhuṃjaya <2> nartaya <2> vighna <2> mahābhairavabhairava kṣetrapālavaliṃ gṛhṇa <2> svāhā | eṣa valimaṃtraḥ | anena kṣetrapālāya valiṃ dadyāt || validānena saṃtuṣṭaḥ kṣetrapālaḥ prayacchati || kāṃtimedhāvalārogyaṃ tejaḥ puṣṭiṃ yaśaḥ śriyaṃ || athaikaviṃśatyakṣarātmako vaṭukamaṃtraḥ | hrīṃ vaṭukāya āpaduddharaṇāya kuru kuru vaṭukāya hrīṃ | hrāṃ vāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> hrīṃ vīṃ śirase svāhā <2> hrūṃ vūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> hraiṃ vaiṃ kavacāya huṃ <4> hrauṃ vauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ <5> hraḥ vaḥ astrāya phaṭ <6> | tasya dhyānaṃ tridhā proktaṃ sātvikādi vidhānataḥ || vaṃdevālaṃ sphaṭika sadṛśaṃ kuṃtalolāsivaktraṃ divyākalpairnavamaṇimayaiḥ kiṃkiṇī nūpurādyaiḥ | dīptākāraṃ viśadavasanaṃ suprasannaṃ dvinetraṃ hastābhyāṃtaṃ vaṭukamaniśaṃ śūladaṃḍau dadhānaṃ ||
<81a>
udyadbhāskarasannibhaṃ triṇayanaṃ raktāṃgarāgastrajaṃ smerāsyaṃ varadaṃ kapālamabhayaṃśūlaṃ dadhānaṃkaraiḥ || nīlagrīvamudārabhūṣaṇaśataṃśītāṃśu cūḍojvalaṃ vaṃdhūkāruṇavāsasaṃ bhayaharaṃ devaṃ sadā bhāvaye || uparitana dakṣavāmakarābhyāṃ triśūlakapāle | tadadhastanābhyāṃ varābhaye dadhānaṃ || dhyāyennīlādrikāṃtaṃ śaśiśakaladharaṃ muṃḍamālaṃ maheśaṃ digvastraṃ piṃgakeśaṃ ḍamarumathaśṛṇiṃ khaḍgaśūlābhayāni | nāgaṃ ghaṃṭāṃ kapālaṃ karasarasiruhairvibhrataṃ bhīmadaṃṣṭraṃ sarpākalpaṃ trinetraṃ maṇimayadvilasatkikiṇīnūpurādyaṃ || dakṣiṇādhaḥ karamārabhya ḍamaruka śṛṇiṃ khaḍgaśūlābhayanāga ghaṃṭākapālāni pradakṣiṇato dhyeyāni ||
sātvikaṃ dhyānamākhyātamayamṛtyunivāraṇaṃ | āyurārogyajananaṃ sarvaiśvaryaṃ sukhapradaṃ ||
rājasaṃdhyānamākhyātaṃ dharmakāmārthasiddhidaṃ | tāmasaṃ śatruśamanaṃ kṛtyā bhūtagadāyahaṃ ||
iti dhyātvā yathā ruciṃ śaive pīṭhe ṣaṭkoṇāṃtarāle kamale devamāvāhya pūrvavidhinā pūjayet | ṣaṭkoṇāṃtarāle aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ | asitāṃgāya <1> rurave <2> caṃḍāya <3> krodhāya <4> unmattabhairavāya <5> kapālātmane <6> bhīṣaṇāsyāya <7> saṃhārā nama <8> iti daleṣu pūjayet |
<81b>
tadvahiḥ ḍākinī putrakāya <1> rākinī putrakāya <2> lākinī putrakāya <3> kākinī putrakāya <4> śākinī putrakāya <5> hākinī putrakāya <6> mālinī putrakāya <7> devīputrakāya <8> namaḥ iti pūjayet | daśadikṣuḥ umāputrakāya <1> rudra putrakāya <2> mātṛputrakāya <3> nama iti dakṣiṇataḥ ūrdhvamukhī putrakāya ityūrdhve | adhomukhī putrakāya namaḥ ityadhaḥ | tadvahiḥ padmapatreṣu brāhmī putrāya pūrve | māheśvarī putrāya īśāne | vaiṣṇavī putrāya saumye | kaumārī putrāya vāyavye | iṃdrāṇī putrākāya paścime | mahālakṣmī putrakāya nairṛtye | vārāhī putrakāya dakṣiṇe | cāmuṃḍā putrakāya ityāgneye || punarvahiḥ patreṣu | dhenukāya <1> tripurāṃtakāya <2> vetālāya <3> vahnivījākhyāya <4> kālāṃtakāya <5> karālāya <6> ekapādāya <7> bhīmarūpāya <8> acalāya <9> hāṭakeśvarāya <10> namaḥ iti daśadikṣu pūjayet | tataḥ śrīkaṃṭhādīn pūjayet | iti japitvā visarjayet | akṣaraṃ lakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | trimadhurāktaistilairdaśāṃśohomaḥ || tvaṃ saṃpūjayeddevaṃ vaṭukaṃ proktavartmanā | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ patirbhavati mānavaḥ | vighnaṃ durgāṃ samārādhya valiṃdatvā vidhānataḥ | kāmyān saṃsādhayenmaṃtrī yathoktāṃ śriyamāpnuyāt |
<82a>
śālpannaṃ palalaṃ sarpirlājacūrṇāni śarkarāṃ | guḍabhikṣu rasāpūpairmadhvaktaiḥ parimiśritaiḥ ||
kṛtvā kavalamārādhyadevaṃ prāgukta vartmanā | raktacaṃdana puṣpādyairniśitasmaivaliṃ haret ||
tatra sidhyaṃti kāryāṇi validānena maṃtriṇaḥ | juhuyāt sarpiṣāmaṃtrī yathoktāṃ siddhimāpnuyāt ||
vaśyāya juhuyāddikṣu śavalairvaśayejjanān | juhuyāt putralābhāya praphullaiḥ kairavaiḥ sudhīḥ ||
dhanadhānyāptaye caiva juhuyāt tilataṃḍulaiḥ | vilvaprasṛtairjuhuyānmahatīṃviṃdati śriyaṃ ||
loṇairmadhurasaṃmiśrairvaśayedvanitājanān | vṛṣṭikāmena hotavyaṃ vetasasyasamidvaraiḥ ||
vyāghrājinesamāsīno juhuyādayutaṃ tilaiḥ | bhūtādayaḥ palāyaṃte nekṣaṃtetāṃdiśvaṃbhayāt ||
vacācūrṇapalaṃ japtaṃ gavyenājyena lolitaṃ | vibhajya bhakṣayedvaṃdhyāmaṃḍalaṃ putrakāṃkṣiṇī ||
vinītaṃ putramāpnoti medhārogyavalānvitaṃ | brāhmaṇo niyataḥ śuddhaḥ sātvikaṃ valimāharet ||
sādhayenmanunānena bhasmasarvārthasiddhidaṃ | uśīraṃ caṃdanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ ghanasāraṃ sa kuṃkumaṃ ||
śvetārkamūlaṃ vārāhīṃ lakṣmīṃ kṣīramahī ruhāt |
<82b>
tvavoṃ sūlvatarormūlaṃ śoṣayitvā sucūrṇayet | cūrṇaṃ vyomni gṛhītena gomayena vimiśritaṃ ||
kṛtvā piṃḍāni saṃśoṣya saṃskṛte havyavāhane | mūlena dagdhvā tadbhasma śuddhepātre niveśayet ||
ketakī mālatī puṣpairvāsayedbhasmaśodhitaṃ | ayutaṃ prajapenmaṃtraṃ spṛṣṭvā bhasma supūjitaṃ ||
etadādāyadinaśaḥ prātaḥ puṃḍraṃ karotiyaḥ | tasya rogāḥ praṇaśyaṃti kṛtyā drohā mahāgrahāḥ ||
ripucora mṛgādibhyo bhavanasya na jāyate | vardhaṃte saṃpadaḥ sarvāḥ pūjyate sakalairjanaiḥ ||
rājā vaśyo bhavettasyaḥ sāmātyaḥ sa paricchadaḥ | ghanasāraḥ karpūraḥ | vyomni gṛhītena gomayena yathā bhūmau na patati tathā pratīcchet || atha khaḍgarāvaṇamaṃtraḥ | saptatyadhikaśatākṣaraḥ | oṃ namaḥ paśupataye oṃ namo bhūtādhipataye oṃ namo rudrāya lalat khaḍgarāvaṇa vihara <2> sara <2> nṛtya <2> śmasāna bhasmārcita śarīrāya ghaṃṭākapāla mālādharāya vyāghracarmaparīdhānāya śaśāṃkakṛtaśeṣa(*)(?) kṛṣṇasarpayajñopavītine vala <2> valā <2> anivartakapāline hana <2> bhūtāṁstrāyatrāya maṃḍalamadhye kaṭṭakaṭṭa rudrāṃkuśena śamaya viśaya <2> āveśaya <2> caṃḍāsidhārādhipati rudro jñāpayati svāhā | ṛṣicchaṃdasīnastaḥ |
<83a>
khāṃ khīṃ khūṃ khaiṃ khauṃ khaḥ ṣaḍaṃgāni | dhyānaṃ | ghaṃṭā kapāla śṛṇimuṃḍapāla kheṭakhaṭvāṃgaśūlaḍamarū na bhayaṃ dadhānaṃ | raktāṃgamiṃduśakalābharaṇaṃ trinetraṃ paṃcānanābjamaruṇāṃśukamīśamīḍe | dakṣiṇādhaḥ karamārabhya vāmādhaḥ karaparyaṃtaṃ ghaṃṭādi daśāyudhāni dhyāyet | kaścittu dakṣiṇavāmādhaḥ karayorghaṃṭā kapāle | taduparyaṃkuśamuṃḍamāle | tadupari khaṭvāṃgaśūle | tadupari ḍamarukābhaye | iti dhyātvā mānasikapūjāṃvidhāya prāsādoktapīṭhe devamāvāhya pādyādibhirupacāraiḥ pūjayet | pūjāmaṃtrastu | oṃ bhūtādhipataye svāhā | aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ | tataḥ patreṣu | culukaṃḍāyai <1> praskhalinyai <2> kṛṣṇapiṃgalāyai <3> phalgunyai <4> ṭiriṭilyai <5> mattamālikāyai <6> khiṃkhilyai <7> cadrāṃkita jaṭāyai <8> namaḥ iti pūjayet | aiṃ hyai <1> kaumārikāyai <2> brāhmyai <3> vārāhyai <4> vaiṣṇavyai <5> vināyakāya <6> cāmuṃḍāyai <7> māheśyai <8> nama iti dikṣu | raudrapiṃgalābhyāṃ namaḥ <1> śmaśānaniṣaṇābhyāṃ <2> dṛḍhakarṇabhṛṃgariṭibhyāṃ <3> āmardaka mahākālābhyāṃ <4> kauṇapālābhyāṃ <5> kuṃbhakarṇaśokābhyāṃ <6> bhallaṭahorābhyāṃ <7> namaḥ iti pūrvādi dikṣu pūjayet | iṃdrādi lokapālān samajyotiṣābhinnadaityaḥ |
<83b>
jvālāmālāparītaṃ raviśaśidahanatrīkṣaṇaṃ dīptajihvaṃ daṃṣṭrograṃ dhūtakeśaṃ vadanamapi vahan pātuvo nārasiṃhaḥ | dhyānakāle kopaśāṃtaye dakṣiṇa vāhuṃ saṃspṛśya śivaṃ stauti | vāmavāhuṃ brahmāṇaṃ iti saumya dhyānaṃ | evaṃ dhyātvā nārāyaṇa maṃtroktapīṭhedevamāvāhya pādyādibhirupacāraiḥ pūjayet | tatoṃgāvaraṇaṃ | pakṣīṃdrāyanamaḥ <1> śaṃkarāya <2> śeṣarāya <3> brahmaṇe nama <4> iti pūrvādi dikpatreṣu pūjayet | śriyai <1> hriyai <2> dhṛtyai <3> puṣṭyai <4> namaḥ iti koṇapatreṣu pūjayet | lokapālāṁśca svadikṣu | tadastrāṇi ca tadvahiḥ | evaṃ pūjayitvā yathā śakti japitvā devaṃ visarjayet | ayaṃ maṃtraḥ praṇavabhuvaneśvarī puṭito japyaḥ dvātriṃśadayutaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | dvātriṃśallakṣa japātsiddho bhavati | ājyāktaiḥ kamalaistāvat sahasraṃ homaḥ || icchaṃ japādibhiḥ siddhemanau kāmyāni sādhayet || tatra dhyānamevaṃ | udyatkoṭi raviprabhaṃ narahariṃ koṭīrahārojvalaṃ daṃṣṭrābhīmamukhelasannakhamukhairdīrghairanekairbhujaiḥ | nirbhinnāsuranāgamagniśaśabhṛtsūryātma netratrayaṃ vidyutpuṃja jaṭākalāpabhayadaṃ vahniṃ vamaṃtaṃ bhaje | iti krūradhyānaṃ || saumyaṃ saumye smaretkārye krūrekrūramimaṃ bhajet | śrīpuṣpairjuhuyānmaṃtrī vilvakāṣṭhaidhitenale |
<123a>
sahasraṃ śriyamāpnoti patrairvā vilvasaṃbhavaiḥ | prasūnairvā phalaistadvat dūrvā homādarogitā ||
maṃtrajaptāṃ vacāṃ śvetāṃ bhakṣayet prātaranvahaṃ | vāksiddhiṃ labhate maṃtrī vācaspatiri vā paraḥ ||
duḥsvapne niśi saṃjāte snātvā maṃtramamuṃjapet | anidro maṃtravinyāsātsusvapna upajāyate ||
vyāghracora mṛgādibhyo mahāraṇye bhayāvahe | rakṣenmanurayaṃ japto bhayeṣṭhānyeṣu maṃtriṇā ||
anena maṃtritaṃ bhasmaviṣagraha mahābhayān | nāśayeda cirānmaṃtrī maṃtrasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ||
siṃharūpaṃ mahābhīmaṃ nakhadaṃṣṭrādi bhīṣaṇaṃ | smṛtvātmānaṃ ripuṃ paścāddhyāyenmṛgaśiśuṃ punaḥ ||
gṛhītvā daladeśaṃtaṃ punardikṣu kṣipet drutaṃ | putramitra kalatrādyairuccāṭo jāyate ripoḥ ||
pūrvamṛtyupadesādhyaṃ nāma kṛtvā svayaṃ hariḥ | niśitairnakhadaṃṣṭrāgraiḥ khādyamānaṃ ripuṃ smaran ||
nityamaṣṭottaraśataṃ japenmaṃtramataṃdritaḥ | jāyate maṃḍalā darvāk śatrurvaivasvatapriyaḥ ||
atha nṛsiṃhavījaṃ | kṣauṃ | asyāpi ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvavat || atha saptaṣaṣṭyakṣarojvālāmālāmaṃtraḥ || oṃ kṣauṃ namo bhagavate narasiṃhāya jvālāmāli medīpta daṃṣṭrāya agninetrāya sarvarakṣoghnāya sarvabhūtavināśanāya sarvajvaravināśanāya daha <2> paca <2> rakṣa <2> huṃ phaṭ svāhā | asyāpi ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvavat | oṃ kṣauṃ namo bhagavate narasiṃhāya hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> jvālāmāline dīptadaṃṣṭrāya
<123b>
śirase svāhā <2> agninetrāya sarvarakṣoghnāya śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> sarvabhūtavināśanāya sarvajvaravināśanāya kavacāya huṃ <4> daha <2> paca <2> rakṣa <2> netrābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ <5> huṃ phaṭ svāhā astrāya phaṭ <6> iti ṣaḍaṃgaṃ vidhāya | dhyānaṃ kuryāt | ujvalatprayāna lābhama yugmanetramanārataṃ | bhāsuraṃ śikhinaḥ śikhābhirudagra daṃṣṭramukhāṃvujaṃ rakṣasāṃbhayadaṃ vikīrṇa saṭākalāpavibhīṣaṇaṃ śaṃkhacakrakṛpāṇakheṭadhāriṇaṃ nṛhariṃbhaje | iti dhyātvā pūrvokte pīṭhe devamāvāhya pādyādibhirupacāraiḥ pūjayet | āvaraṇādikaṃ pūrvoktadevatāḥ pūjayet | evaṃ pūjānaṃtaraṃ yathāśakti japitvā devaṃ visarjayet | lakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | kapilājyena daśāṃśohomaḥ | prayogādikaṃ maṃtrarājoktaṃ | viśeṣāt kṣudrabhūtādināśanīyaṃ || atha ṣaḍakṣaromaṃtraḥ || āṃ hrīṃ kṣrauṃ kroṃ huṃ phaṭ | asya brahmāṛṣiḥ paṃktiśchaṃdaḥ narasiṃha hariharirdevatā iṣṭārthe | kṣrāṃ kṣrīṃ kṣrūṃ kṣreṃ kṣrauṃ kṣraḥ astrāya phaṭ | dhyānaṃ | kopādālolanetraṃ vivṛtanijamukhaṃ somasūryāgninetraṃ pādādānābhirakta prabhamuparisitaṃ bhinnadaityeṃdragātraṃ | cakraṃ śaṃkhaṃ sa pāśāṃkuśakuliśagadādāraṇānyudvahaṃtaṃ bhīmaṃ tīkṣṇogradaṃṣṭraṃ maṇimaya vividhākalparmaḍinṛsiṃhaṃ ||
<124a>
evaṃ dhyātvā | pūrvoktapīṭhe devaṃ pūjayet | tatoṃgāvaraṇaṃ | cakrāya <1> śaṃkhāya <2> pāśāya <3> aṃkuśāya <4> cakrāya <5> kaumodakyai <6> khaḍgāya <7> kheṭāya <8> namaḥ iti pūrvādi dikpatreṣu pūjayet | lokapālāṁśca svadikṣu | tadastrāṇi ca pūjayet | tato devaṃ visarjayet | ṣaṭlakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | ghṛtena ṣaṭsahasraṃ homaḥ ||
payoktairamṛtā khaṃḍaistri sahasraṃ caturdināt | anena vidhinā homograhajvaravināśanaḥ ||
ityādyaneke prayogāḥ |
vahunā kimihoktena maṃtrairetairudīritaiḥ | samonāsti manuḥ kaścit chāyānugrahakārakaḥ ||
atha lakṣmī nṛsiṃhaḥ || kṣauṃ lakṣmī nṛsiṃhāya namaḥ | asya prajāpatirṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ lakṣmī nṛsiṃhodevatā iṣṭārthe viniyogaḥ | ī haṃ ugraṃ vīraṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ ānaṃdātmane hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> īhaṃ jvalaṃtaṃ sarvatomukhaṃ priyātmane śirase svāhā <2> īhaṃ nṛsiṃhabhīṣaṇaṃ jyotirātmane śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> īhaṃ mṛtyumṛtyuṃ namāmyahaṃ māyātmane kavacāya huṃ <4> īhaṃ samastena ajñānātmane astrāya phaṭ <5> krodha kṣamādiśāṃtaye dakṣiṇavāhuṃ saṃspṛśan śalabhamaṃtraṃ japet | maṃtrastu | oṃ hauṃ namaḥ śivāya mahāśalabhāya svāhā
<124b>
svarakṣārthaṃ cānekāni vījāni maṃtrākṣara saṃpuṭitānisaṃtitāni graṃthagauravānnalikhitāni || mahābhaye prastute maṃtrāte evaṃ bhīṣaṇāṁśthiṃdhibhiṃ vibhīṣaṇaṃbhī iti japet || atha vā maṃtrāṃtemāṃrakṣarakṣeti paṭhet || maṃtranyāsādau rakṣā yathā |
keśavaḥ pātu me pādau jaṃghe nārāyaṇo mama | mādhavomekaṭiṃ pātu goviṃdo guhyameva ca ||
nābhiṃ viṣṇustu mepātu jaṭharaṃ madhusūdanaḥ | urastri vikramaḥ pātu hṛdayaṃ pātu vāmanaḥ ||
śrīdharaḥ pātumekaṃṭhaṃ hṛṣīkeśomukhaṃ mama | padmanābhastu nayane śirodāmodaro mama ||
evamaṃgeṣu vinyasya japakāle sulocane | chāyāmapi na laṃghaṃti bhūtavetāla rākṣasāḥ ||
tasmāt sarvaṃ prayatnena dhyānaṃdevi samācaret | purastāt keśavaḥ pātu cakrījāṃvūnadaprabhaḥ ||
paścānnārāyaṇaḥ śaṃkhī nīlajīmūtasaṃnibhaḥ | iṃdīvaradalaśyāmo mādhavorddhvaṃ gadādharaḥ ||
goviṃdo dakṣiṇepārśve dhanvīcaṃdra prabhomahān | uttare halabhṛgviṣṇu padmakiṃjalkasaṃnibhāḥ ||
āgneyyāma raviṃdābhomuśalī madhusūdanaḥ | trivikramaḥ khaḍgapāṇirnairṛtyāṃ jvalanaprabhaḥ ||
vāyavyāṃ mādhavo yajñītaruṇādityadīptimān | aiśānyāṃ puṃḍarīkākṣaḥ śrīdharaḥ paṭṭiśāyudhaḥ ||
viṣṇuprabho hṛṣīkeśohya vācyāṃdiśimudgaraṃ |
<125a>
hṛnnyaset padmanābhome sahasrāṃśu samaprabhaḥ ||
sarvāyudhaḥ sarvaśaktiḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ | iṃdragopakasaṃkāśaḥ pāśahasto'parājitaḥ ||
sa vāhyābhyaṃtaraṃ dehaṃ vyāpya dāmodaraḥ sthitaḥ | evaṃ sarvatraniḥchitraṃnāma dvādaśapaṃjaraṃ ||
praviṣṭohaṃ name kiṃcidbhayamasti kadācana |
iti nyāsaṃ kuryāt | iti rakṣāṃvidhāya pūrvoktapīṭhe devamāvāhya āvāhanādikāḥ ṣaṇmudrāḥ pradarśayan jitaṃte puṃḍarīkākṣa namaste viśvabhāvana | namastestu hṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣapūrvaja | namaḥ | śāvaraṃ | dhyānaṃ | kṣīrode'bjamukhairvṛtaḥ savaradaṃ cakraṃ pinākābhayevibhraccaṃdra rucirmahārivaraṇāmi svālasadbhūṣaṇaḥ | āśliṣṭo ramayorageṃdra phaṇasāhasrā tapatrāsvidṛkanīlagrīva idaṃ punātu nṛhariryoyogapadmāsanaḥ | evaṃ dhyānaṃ pūjāṃte ugraṃ namāmyahamityādinā vyūhapūjānavabhiḥ padaiḥ | oṃ bhīmāya <1> ugrāya <2> nayanāya <3> nīlāya <4> caṃdrāya <5> bhayaṃkarāya <6> viśveśāya <7> kamalāya <8> namaḥ iti prāgādi daleṣu | śraddhāyai <1> ṛddhyai <2> samṛddhyai <3> maharddhyai <4> kāmāyai <5> bhīmāyai <6> mahānanāyai <7> ajñānāyai <8> dīptyai namaḥ iti teṣveva pūjayet | ityādyanekāvaraṇāni saṃtitāninātra prapecitāni |
<125b>
evaṃ pūjayitvā yathāśakti japitvā guhyāti guhyagoptṛtvaṃ gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japaṃ | siddhirbhavatu medevatvatprasādāddhṛdisthitā iti japaṃ nivedayet | stutvā natvā visarjayet | asyāneke prakārāḥ saṃti || atha vidāraṇa nṛsiṃhaḥ || kṣauṃ jayajayanṛsiṃha | asya maṃtrasya prajāpatirṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ vidāraṇa nṛsiṃho devatājaṃvījaṃ haṃ śaktiḥ iṣṭārthe viniyogaḥ | kṣrāṃ kṣrīṃ ityādi ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | dhyānaṃ | avyānnirvyājaraudrākṛti rati vikṛtā syollasatīkṣṇaṃ daṃṣṭraścakraṃ śaṃkhaṃ sa pāśāṃkuśakuliśa gadādāraṇākhyaṃ dadhānaḥ | raktākāraścanābheradha uparisito divyabhūṣā viśeṣo devo'rkāgnīṃdu netro nikhilasuravaro nārasiṃhaściraṃvaḥ | pūjādikaṃ ṣaḍakṣaravat || atha divyanṛsiṃhaḥ |
taptahāṭakakeśāṃta jvalatyāvakalocana | vajrādhikanakhasparśadivyasiṃha namostute ||
asya brahmāṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ divyanṛsiṃhodevatārakārovījaṃ ekāraḥ śaktiḥ iṣṭārthe | caturbhiḥ pādaiḥ samastena ca paṃcāṃgaṃ | dhyāna pūjādikaṃ pūrvavat ||
<126a>
atha dvādaśākṣara nṛsiṃhaḥ | oṃ kṣrauṃ mahānṛsiṃhāya namaḥ kṣrauṃ oṃ | asya vāmadeva ṛṣirvirāṭ chaṃdaḥ śrīnṛsiṃhodevatākṣakāro vījaṃ oṃ śaktiḥ raṃkṣaḥ kīlakaṃ iṣṭārthe viniyogaḥ | ṣaḍaṃga dhyānādikaṃ pūrvavat || atha trayodaśākṣara maṃtrāṃtaraṃ | sahasrāra jvālamṛtyunāśana svāhā | āditya somasaptārcirityādi dhyānaṃ | pūrvavat sarvā || atha vīranṛsiṃhaḥ | oṃ namo bhagavate vīranṛsiṃhāya jvālāmālāpi nadvāṃgāya agninetrāya sarvabhūta vināśanāya sarvaśatruvināśanāya hana <2> daha <2> paca <2> rakṣa <2> hrāṃ hrīṃ phaṭ svāhā | asyāpi vidāraṇavatsarvaṃ || atha vīranṛsiṃhamaṃtrāṃtaraṃ | oṃ namo bhgavate vīranṛsiṃhāya jvālāmāline dīptadaṃṣṭrāyāgni netrāya sarvarakṣoghnāya sarvabhūtavināśanāya sarvavyādhi vināśanāya sarvadoṣa vināśanāya sarvajvaravināśanāya hana <2> daha <2> paca <2> vaṃdha <2> rakṣa <2> māṃ huṃ phaṭ svāhā | asyāpi sarvaṃ pūrvavat || punarapi vīranṛsiṃhāṃtaraṃ | oṃ namo bhagavate vīranṛsiṃhāya jvālāmāline dīptadaṃṣṭrāyāgninetrāya sarvarakṣoghnāya sarvabhūtavināśanāya sarvavyādhivināśanāya sarvavighnavināśanāya
<126b>
sarvadoṣavināśanāya hana <2> daha <2> paca <2> vaṃdha <2> rakṣa <2> māṃ māṃ māṃ huṃ huṃ huṃ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā | asyāpi sarvaṃ pūrvavat || athāparājita nṛsiṃhaḥ || catuḥśatī | oṃ namo bhagavate anaṃtāya sahasraśīrṣāya kṣīrodārṇavaśāyine śeṣabhogaparyaṃkaśāyine namo garuḍavāhanāya vāsudevaya namaḥ | pītavāsase vāsudeva saṃkarṣaṇa pradyumnā niruddhahaya śirovarāha nṛsiṃhavāmana rāma rāma kṛṣṇavaraprada namostute asuradaityayakṣarākṣasabhūtapretapiśāca siddhayoginī ḍākinīśākinī brahmarākṣasaṃ vināyakaṃ pūtanāgrahaskaṃdapurogagrahānūkṣatragrahān bhūtagrahān pretagrahān vetāla grahān jaṃbhakagrahān vetālāṁśca hana <2> daha <2> paca <2> maṃtha <2> mada <2> gṛhna <2> vidhvaṃsaya <2> vitrāsaya <2> cakreṇagadayāvajreṇa bhasmī kuru sahasra vāho sahasra praharaṇāyudhajaya <2> vijayā parājitā pratihata sahasranetra jvala <2> prajvala <2> viśvarūpa madhusūdana mahāpuruṣa nārasiṃhanārāyaṇa padmanābhadāmodara hṛṣīkeśa sarvabhūtavaśaṃkaraśaṃkhacakragadādharaṃ sarvanāgapramardana sarvaviṣanāśana sarvasurāhlādana sarvadeva
<127a>
maheśvara sarvamaṃtra prabhedena sarvabhayavināśana sarvajvaravināśana sarvaduḥkhapraśamana sarvarogāpakarṣaṇa janārdana devadevavarapradanamostute || asya vāmadeva ṛṣirvirāṭ chaṃdaḥ aparājita nṛsiṃho devatā iṣṭārthe | kṣrāṃ kṣrīṃ ityādi ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | dhyānādikaṃ ṣaḍakṣaravat || athāparājita nārāyaṇa nṛsiṃhaḥ || oṃ namo bhagavate anaṃtāya sahasraśīrṣāya kṣīrodārṇa vaśāpine śeṣabhogaparyaṃkāya garuḍavāhanāya vāsudevāya namaḥ pītavāsase vāsudeva pradyumnāni ruddhahayaśirovarāha nṛsiṃhavāmanatrivikramamatsyakūrma kṛṣṇakalkirāmavarapradajanārdana devadeva namostute asuradaityadānavayakṣarākṣasabhūtapretapiśācāpasmārakūṣmāṃḍa siddhayoginīḍākinīśākinī brahmarākṣasapūtanāvetālaṃ grahān maraṇagrahān pretagrahān piśācagrahān vātagrahān jvaragrahān nakṣatragrahān etānanyāṁśca mahāgrahān hana <2> daha <2> matha <2> paca <2> muṃca <2> mṛhna <2> āveśaya <2> vidhvaṃsaya <2> vitrāsaya <2> sarvāyudha cakreṇa gadayāśaṃkhenaśārṅgeṇa vajreṇa sakalena bhasmī kuru <2> sahasravāho sahasra praharaṇāyudhāya (*)(?)
<127b>
jaya <2> vijayāyānaṃtāyā parājitāyā pratisahasranetra jvala <2> prajvalita viśvarūpa madhusūdana hṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣa vaikuṃṭha nārāyaṇa goviṃda padmanābhadāmodara sarvabhūtavaśaṃkaraśaṃkhacakragadādhara sarvabhūta namaskṛta sarvabhūtaprabhaṃjana sarvā (*****)(?) deva maheśvara sarvagrahanivāraṇāyudhamaṃtra prabhaṃjana sarvayaṃtraprabhaṃjana sarvavyādhināśana sarvamudrā prabhedana sarvajvaravināśana sarvabhūtāyakarṣaṇa sarvavaṃdhavimokṣaṇa sarvaduḥkhavināśana sarvāriṣṭa praśamanaṃ sarvaśatruvināśana sarvaviṣavinā (*****##?) aṣṭākṣaravatsarvaṃ || athāṣṭākṣaro nṛsiṃhā (***)(?) namo narasiṃhāya | asya paṃcākṣaravatsarvaṃ || atha ṣaḍakṣaraḥ | oṃ kṣrauṃ namaḥ svāhā | asya brahmāṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ | kṣrāṃ kṣrīṃmityādi ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | pūjā ca pūrvavat || atha lakṣmī nṛsiṃhaḥ | kṣrauṃ lakṣmī nṛsiṃhāya | ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvavat || atha kopananṛsiṃhaḥ | oṃ kṣrauṃ kopananṛsiṃhāya svāhā | ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvavat | śrīmatpadmāsanastheti śāṃtaṃ dhyānaṃ | (***)(?) dhyānamidaṃ | udyadbhāsvat sahasraprabhamaśaninibhaṃtrīkṣaṇaṃ vīkṣanaṃtaṃ vihnīvahnāya vidyuttativitatiṃ
<128a>
sadā mīṣaṣairbhūṣaṇaiścādivyairādīptadehaṃ niśitanakhala saṭvāhudaṃḍairanekaiḥ saṃbhinnaṃ bhinnadaityaiḥ sthita tanumatanuṃ nārasiṃhaṃ namāmi | anyat pūrvavat | atha tejo nṛsiṃhaḥ | oṃ kṣrauṃ namo bhagavate nṛsiṃhāya namastejastejase āvirāvirbhavavajranakhavajradaṃṣṭrakarmāśayāvuddhapararaṃdhrāya namogrāya oṃ svāhā | gāyatrī chaṃdaḥ | dhyānaṃ |
dvibhujaṃ cakraśaṃkhadharaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaṃ | koṭisūrya samaprabhadīptaṃ daṃṣṭrājvālaṃ dhyāyet ||
atha lakṣmī nṛsiṃha maṃtrāṃtaraṃ | oṃ īṃ haṃ kṣrauṃ haṃ īṃ oṃ | asya brahmāṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ svasthaḥ padmāsana iti dhyānaṃ || atha pucchanṛsiṃhaḥ | haraye viṣatrāte kṣrauṃ namo bhagavate mahāpucchāya narasiṃhāya | asya brahmāṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ | ṣaḍakṣaravaddhyānaṃ || atha svastha narasiṃhaḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīnarasiṃhāya pratiguṇakeśarasaṭāyakhaḍgāṃtāyudha karāladaṃṣṭrā locanagadra <2> marda <2> jāti <2> jālitaṃ <2> devaṃ <2> tvaṃ svasvāveśaṃ kuru <2> svāhā | asya ṛṣyādikaṃ dhyānaṃ ca pūrvavat | anekagrahabhūtādīn staṃbhayeti | lakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | ekabhaktāvaṣṭāyana brahmacārīyatī syāt | tataḥ siddhiḥ || atha maṃtrāṃtaraṃ | oṃ kṣrauṃ namo bhagavate narasiṃhāya | ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvavat |
<128b>
atha vila narasiṃhaḥ || oṃ namo bhagavate narasiṃhāya daityadānavavṛjitāya pradīpta sahasrakoṭi samastatejase vajranakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhāyaṃ sphaṭikavikaṭakīrṇakesarasaṭāya kṣubhita mahārṇavāṃbhodhiduṃdubhinirghoṣāya sarvayaṃtrāṃtarhṛdayāya ehyehi bhagavannārasiṃha puruṣacarācara brahmāsatyena sphuravijṛṃbhadaradāraya sarvapātālānbhragarjasurasiṃhanādavidrāvayāveśaya sarvayaṃtrarūpāṇi | sarvajātīśca hana <2> chṃdasaṃkṣipadaradāraya sphoṭaya jvālāmālāsaṃdhānāveśaya sarvato'naṃtajvālā vajrāśanicakreṇa sarvapātālānutsādaya sarvato'naṃta jvālā vajraśarajālena sarvapātālāngrathaya sarvato'naṃta jvālāśarapaṃjareṇa sarvapātālān parivārayasuralokanivāsinīnāṃ hṛdayānyākarṣayadhunaśīghraṃ daha <2> paca <2> śoṣaya <2> nikṛttayatāvadyāvadvikalanyāya samāpannāḥ pātālebhyaḥ phaṭ yaṃtrarūpebhyaḥ phaṭ yaṃtrajātibhyaḥ phaṭ sasahāyaṃmāṃ rakṣabhagavannārasiṃharūpaviṣṇo sarvapāpebhyaḥ sarvāyudhebhyaḥ sarvabhayopadravebhyaḥ oṃ hrīṃ kṣrīṃ phaṭ iṃkāstute huṃ phaṭ svāhā | asya siddhamaṃtratvā dṛṣyādikaṃ nāsti | daśasahasraṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | ayameva paridhāchedanaḥ || atha ṣaḍakṣaraḥ |
<129a>
āṃ hrīṃ kṣrauṃ kroṃ huṃ phaṭ | asya maṃtrasya vāmadeva ṛṣiḥ paṃktiśchaṃdaḥ nṛsiṃho devatā iṣṭārthe | kṣrauṃ vījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ | oṃ āṃ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ <1> oṃ īṃ hrīṃ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ <2> oṃ ūṃ kṣrauṃ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ <3> oṃ ūṃ ṝṃ krauṃ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ <4> oṃ aiṃ huṃ kaniṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ <5> oṃ aṃ phaṭ karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ <6> etānyakṣarāṇi hṛdayādiṣu nyaset | avyānnirvyājeti dhyānaṃ | pūjāyaṃtraṃ ca pūrvoktameva | kiṃtu ṣaṭkoṇa madhye bhuvaneśvarī pūjanīyeti śeṣaḥ | tato vaiṣṇave pīṭhe devamāvāhya pūjayet | aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ | cakraśaṃkhapāśāṃkuśaṃkuliśagadākṛpāṇakheṭānidaleṣu pūjayet | lokapālāṁstadāyudhāni ca pūjayet | akṣaralakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | tatsahasraṃ ghṛtaplutābhirapāmārgasamidbhirjuhuyāt || atha sudarśana nṛsiṃhaḥ || sahasrārajvālāvartin kṣrauṃ hanahana huṃ phaṭ svāhā | asya maṃtrasyajayaṃta ṛṣirjagatī chaṃdaḥ sudarśana nṛsiṃho devatā iṣṭārthe | kṣrauṃ vījaṃ huṃ śaktiḥ | cakrarājāya svāhā hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> jvālā cakrāya svāhā śiraḥ <2> mahaccakrāya svāhā śikhā <3> gajeccakrāya svāhā kavacaṃ <4> asurāṃtaka cakrāya svāhā astraṃ <5> | dhyānaṃ |
cakrākṣakarṇikāsīnaṃ kālāgnisadṛśaprabhaṃ |
<129b>
danujaṃ ca vivṛttāsyaṃ catuścakradharaṃ hariṃ ||
yogavahaniṣiddhāṃgaṃ trinetraṃ cogravigrahāṃ | dhyāyet samastabhūtaghnamaśokadrumamūlagaṃ ||
evaṃ dhyātvā vaiśṇave pīṭhe devamāvāhya pūjayet ||
atha sahasrākṣaro narasiṃhamaṃtraḥ || oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ kṣrauṃ krodhamūrte nṛsiṃha mahāpuruṣapradhānadharmādharmanigaḍanirmocana kālapuruṣakālākta viśveśvaraviṣāṃtaniviṣṭa caitanyacitsadābhāsakakālādhvatīta nityoditoyāstamayomnibhamahākāruṇika hṛdayābja caturdalaniviṣṭa caitainyaikātman caturātman dvādaśātman caturviṃśātman paṃcaviṃśātman śatasahasramūrta ehyehi bhagavan nṛsiṃhapuruṣakrodheśvararamā sahasravaṃdita pādakalyāṃtāgni sahasrakodyāṃbha mahādevavināyaka daśaśatajñānavalajñeyāmalāmale piṃgalekṣaṇasaṭollasaddaṃṣṭrāyudha nakhāyudhadānaveṃdrāṃtakāraṇaśoṇitasaṃsiktavigrahabhūtāyasmārayātu(##-) vyomacakreśvaraprabhāvāvacyarūpeṇottiṣṭha <2> avidyānicayaṃ daha <2> jñānaiśvaryaṃ prakāśaya <2> oṃ sarvajñā śeṣajṛṃbhājṛṃbhita oṃ satpuruṣasadanādhyanidhiṣṭa nama duḥsvapnabhayaṃ nigaḍabhayaṃkāṃtārabhayaṃ
<130a>
viṣajvaraḍākinī kṛtyādhvaravedinībhayamaśanibhayaṃ durbhikṣabhayaṃ bhāribhayaṃmārī ca bhayaṃ chāyāskaṃdāya smārabhayaṃ corabhayaṃ jalaśvabhrāgnibhayaṃ gajasiṃhabhujaṃgabhayaṃ janmajarāmaraṇādi sarvabhayaṃ nirmocaya <2> praśamaya <2> jñeyarūpadhārin nṛsiṃhavṛhatsāmapuruṣa sarvabhayanivāraṇāṣṭāṣṭakaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiceṭikāmayavidyāvṛttatrayastriṃśaddevatā koṭi narapādapaṃkajanvita sahasravadana sahasrodara sahasrekṣaṇa sahasrapādasahasrabhujajihvāsahasra lalāṭa sahasrāyudhadharatamaḥ prakāśakāṃtamadhumatha na sarvamaṃtramaṃtrarājeśvaravaihāya sagatipradapātālayaṃtramardanaghorāṭṭahāsaśitaviṣāvāsa vāsudevā krūrahayamukhaparamahaṃsa viśveśaviśvaviḍaṃvananiviṣṭaprādurbhāvakāraka hṛṣīkeśa svacchaṃda pradaniḥ śeṣajīvagrāsakamahāpisitāsṛglaṃ paṭakhecarī siddhapradāyaka ajeyāvyayāvyakta brahmāṃḍodara brahmāṃḍakoṭisragmuṃḍamālāmaṃḍitamuṃḍamatsyakūrmavarāha nṛsiṃha vāmanatrailokyā kramaṇapādaśālikarāmatrayayutavuddha viṣṇurūpadhara ekatatvatrayapraṇavādhāratacchikhāniviṣṭa svāhā svadhā vaṣaṭ vauṣaṭ huṃ prāṇādhāra
<130b>
ādideva prāṇāpāna niviṣṭa pāṃcarātrikaditijanidhanakara mahākāya asodhadaityeṃdra darpadalana tejo rāśin oṃ klāṃ tejo varapuruṣa phaṭ oṃ saṃsaṃtyapuruṣa phaṭ oṃ dhāṃ acyuta phaṭ hūṃ viśvarūpin phaṭ oṃ hrauṃ haṃsa phaṭ oṃ hrauṃ paramahaṃsa phaṭ oṃ hraḥ hiraṇyagarbharūpadhārin phaṭ oṃ hrauṃ anaupamyarūpadhārin phaṭ oṃ vāṃ vāsudeva phaṭ oṃ hrīṃ mūrte phaṭ oṃ klīṃ amūrte phaṭ oṃ kṣrāṃ viśvamūrte phaṭ hrāṃ viśvātman phaṭ oṃ sauṃ caturātman phaṭ oṃ kṣrauṃ nṛsiṃharūpadhārin phaṭ oṃ klāṃ klaḥ aṣṭāṃga vinyāsa vinyastamūrtarūpadhārin phaṭ oṃ hrauṃ nisargasiddhaikarūpadhārin phaṭ oṃ huṃ huṃ huṃ ṣṭaṃ kaṃ khaṃ amukamamukaṃ khāhi <2> khādaya <2> klaṃ klīṃ sādhyamānayānaya mahātman samādarśaya <2> kṣrāṃ kṣrīṃ kṣrūṃ kṣraiṃ kṣrauṃ kṣreṃ kṣra japitakalmaṣottārayottāraya drāṃ drīṃ klīṃ klūṃ saṃnṛsiṃha jvālātmane svāhā nṛsiṃha jvālātmane svāhā nṛsiṃhajvālātmane svāhā | oṃ kṣrauṃ klīṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ oṃ || asya nṛsiṃhasahasrākṣara maṃtrasya kapilamaharṣi ṛṣirati jagatī chaṃdaḥ śrīnṛsiṃhodevatā kṣrauṃvījaṃ svāhā śaktiḥ śvetovarṇaḥ udāttaḥ svaraḥ paramātmā nṛsiṃha prītaye viniyogaḥ | oṃ kṣraḥ sahasra vāhave sahasrāyudhadharāya nṛsiṃhāya svāhā astrāya phaṭ |
<131a> <9873258547> <8004496992>
iti karaśuddhiṃ vidhāyāṃgulīṣu hṛdayādiṣu ca | oṃ kṣrāṃ sahasrākṣaravijṛṃbhita nṛsiṃhāya svāhā hṛdayaṃ <1> oṃ kṣrīṃ mahāprabhāvikaṭa nṛsiṃhāya svāhā śiraḥ <2> oṃ kṣrūṃ taptahāṭakakeśāṃtetyādi mahādhvanidhvastajagadbhayāya nṛsiṃhāya svāhā 'sikhā <3> oṃ kṣraiṃ suvarṇamadamatta vijvalita nṛsiṃhāya svāhā kavacaṃ <4> oṃ kṣrauṃ sahasrākṣa viśvarūpiṇe dhāriṇe svāhā netraṃ <5> oṃ kṣraḥ sahasra vāhave sahasrāyudhāya nṛsiṃhāya svāhā astraṃ <6> iti vinyasya ṣaḍaṃgaṃ vyāpakaṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ ca kṛtvā hṛdaye nṛsiṃhaṃ dhyāyet | udyadbhāsvaditi dhyātvā japet | anye ca maṃtrāḥ saṃtite graṃthagauravānnalikhitāḥ ||
[iti śrīmadāśādityatripāṭhīsaṃgṛhīte maṃtrakoṣe nṛsiṃhamaṃtrakathanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśaparicchedaḥ] || paṃcāyatanamaṃtrakathanānaṃtaraṃ nānāmaṃtrā ucyaṃte ||
tatrādau gāyatrīvidhānaṃ likhyate |
praṇavasya brahmāṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ paramātmā devatā vyāhṛtīnāṃtisṛṇāṃsāmastena prajāpatirṛṣiḥ ekaikaśogautamabharadvājaviśvāmitrāṛṣayaḥ gāyatryuṣṇiganuṣṭupchaṃdāṃsi agnirvāyurādityo devatāḥ || gāyatryā viśvāmitraṛṣirdaivīgāyatrīchaṃdaḥ
<131b>
savitādevatāvareṇyamityatraramitiśaktiḥ vamiti vījaṃ ṇakāraḥ | sādhāraṇa śaktiḥ | ṇakāro valamiti śruteḥ || atha padanyāsaḥ | oṃ tat pādātmane namaḥ <1> oṃ saviturjānvātmane namaḥ <2> oṃ vareṇyaṃ guhyātmane namaḥ <3> oṃ bhargojaṭharātmane <4> oṃ devasya hṛdayātmane <5> oṃ dhīmahi varṇātmane <6> oṃ dhiyaḥ pūrvamukhāyai <7> oṃ yo paścimamukhāyai <8> oṃ naḥ mūrdhātmane <9> oṃ pracodayāt astrāya phaṭ <10> || punaḥ | oṃ tat mūrdhātmane <1> oṃ saviturbhrūmadhyātmane <2> oṃ vareṇyaṃ ca kṣurātmane <3> oṃ bhargovaktrātmane <4> oṃ devasya karṇātmane <5> oṃ dhīmahi hṛdayātmane <6> oṃ dhiyaḥ nābhyātmane <7> oṃ yaḥ guhyātmane <8> oṃ naḥ jānvātmane <9> oṃ pracodayāt pādātmane <10> || punaḥ | oṃ tat guhyātmane <1> oṃ savituḥ cakṣurātmane <2> oṃ vareṇyaṃ vāgātmane <3> oṃ bhargo karṇātmane <4> oṃ devasya hṛdayātmane <5> oṃ dhīmahijānvātmane <6> oṃ dhiyaḥ aṃdryātmane <7> oṃ yaḥ lalāṭātmane <8> oṃ naḥ ghrāṇātmane <9> oṃ pracodayāt mūrdhne namaḥ <10> || punaḥ oṃ bhūstatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhūragnaye pṛthivyai brahmaṇelokatrayātmane namaḥ <1> oṃ bhuvaḥ bhargodevasyadhīmahi bhuvo'ṃtarikṣāya vāyave viṣṇave vedatrayātmane namaḥ <2>
<132a>
oṃ svaḥ dhiyoyonaḥ pracodayāt svarādityāyadive maheśvarāya prāṇatrayātmane namaḥ <3> pādahṛdaśiraḥ supādanyāsaḥ || atha saśaktikākṣaranyāsaḥ || oṃ tatprahlādinyai caṃpakanibhāyai namaḥ <1> oṃ saprabhāyaiśvetavarṇāyai <2> oṃ vinityāyai piṃgalavarṇāyai <3> oṃ tuḥ viśvaprabhāyai iṃdranīlanibhāyai <4> oṃ rva vilāsinyai vahnidīptāyai <5> oṃ re prabhāvatyai vahnirūpāyai <6> oṃ ṇi jayāyai vidyutprabhāyai <7> oṃ yaṃ śāṃtāyai raktavarṇāyai <8> oṃ bha kāṃtāyai jaladavarṇāyai <9> oṃ rgo durgāyai raktavarṇa nibhāyai <10> oṃ de sarasvatyai marakatanibhāyai <11> oṃ va viśvarūpāyai śuklarūpāyai <12> oṃ sya viśālāyai suvarṇaprabhāyai <13> oṃ dhī īśāyai kuṃdaprabhāyai <14> oṃ mavyāpinyai padmarāganibhāyai <15> oṃ hi vimalāyai śaṃkhanibhāyai <16> oṃ dhi tamopahāriṇyai pāṃḍuraprabhāyai <17> oṃ yo sūkṣmāyai iṃdragopanibhāyai <18> oṃ yo viśvayonyai kuṃkumanibhāyai <19> oṃ naḥ jayāvahāyai sūryodayanibhāyai <20> oṃ pralayāyai nīlotpalanibhāyai <21> oṃ coparāyai gorocananibhāyai <22> oṃ da śobhāyai kuṃdeṃduśaṃkhadhavalāyai <23> oṃ yāt bhadrarūpiṇyai sphaṭikanibhāyai namaḥ <24> || oṃ tadagnaye caṃpakanibhāya padmāsana rūḍhāya
<132b>
brahmaviṣṇu śivātmane namaḥ <1> oṃ sa prajāpataye śyāmavarṇāya padmāsana rūḍhāya brahmaviṣṇuśivātmane namaḥ <2> oṃ visomāya piṃgalanibhāya padmāsanarūḍhāyetyādi <3> oṃ tuḥ īśānāya iṃdranīlanibhāya pa<0> <4> oṃ rvaḥ ādityāya vahnidīptāya pa<0> <5> oṃ re vṛhaspataye vahnirūpāya <6> oṃ ṇi iṃdrāya vidyutprabhāya <7> oṃ yaṃ bhagadevāya raktavarṇāya <8> oṃ bha aryamne jaladavarṇāya <9> oṃ rgo savitreraktagauranibhāya <10> oṃ detvaṣṭremarakatanibhāya <11> oṃ va pūṣṇe śuklavarṇāya <12> oṃ sya iṃdrāgnibhyāṃ suvarṇaprabhāyāṃ padmāsanarūḍhābhyāṃ brahmaviṣṇu śivātmabhyāṃ namaḥ <13> oṃ dhī vāyave kuṃdaprabhāya <14> oṃ ma vāmadevāya padmarāganibhāya <15> oṃ hi mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ śaṃkhanibhābhyāṃ <16> oṃ dhi bhrātṛvya devāya pāṃḍura prabhāya <12> oṃ yo viśvedevebhya iṃdragopanibhebhya padmāsana rūḍhebhyo brahmaviṣṇu śivātmabhyo namaḥ <18> oṃ yo viṣṇave kuṃkumanibhāya <19> oṃ naḥ vasubhyaḥ sūryodayanibhebhyaḥ pa<0> <20> oṃ prapitṛbhyo nīlotpala nibhebhyaḥ pa<0> <21> oṃ co kuverāya gorocananibhāya <22> oṃ da aśvibhyāṃ kuṃdeṃdu śaṃkhanibhābhyāṃ <23> oṃ yāt brahmaṇe sphaṭikanibhāya padmāsanarūḍhāya brahmaviṣṇuśivātmane namaḥ <24> ||
<133a>
oṃ tadagnaye pṛthivyātmane namaḥ <1> oṃ sa prajāpataye a vātmane <2> oṃ vi somāya vahnyātmane <3> oṃ tuḥ īśānāya vāṃ dyātmane <4> oṃ rva ādityāya ākāśātmane <5> oṃ re vṛhaspataye gaṃdhatanmātrātmane <6> oṃ ṇi iṃdrāya rasatanmātrātmane <7> oṃ yaṃ bhagadevāya rūpatanmātrātmane <8> oṃ bha aryamne sparśatanmātrātmane <9> oṃ rgo savitreśaṣṭatanmātrātmane <10> oṃ detvaṣṭre rūpasthātmane <11> oṃ va pūṣṇe pādyātmane <12> oṃ sya iṃdrāgnibhyāṃ pādātmabhyāṃ namaḥ <13> oṃ dhī vāyave pāṇyātmane <14> oṃ ma vāmadevāya vāgātmane <15> oṃ hi mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃghrāṇātmabhyāṃ <16> oṃ dhi bhrātṛvyadevāya jihvātmane namaḥ <12> oṃ yo viśvebhyo devebhyaścakṣurātmabhyo namaḥ <18> oṃ yoṃ viṣṇavetvagātmane <19> oṃ naḥ vasubhyaḥ śrotrātmabhyo namaḥ <20> oṃ pra pitṛbhyomana ātmabhyaḥ <21> oṃ co kuverāya vuddhyātmane <22> oṃ da aśvibhyāṃ ahaṃkārātmabhyāṃ <23> oṃ yādbrahmaṇe avyaktātmane namaḥ <24> || oṃ tat hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> oṃ sa vituḥ śirase svāhā <2> oṃ vareṇyaṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> oṃ bhargoḥ kavacāya huṃ <4> oṃ devasya astrāya phaṭ <5> oṃ dhīmahi netratrayāya
<133b>
vauṣaṭ <6> oṃ dhiyoyonaḥ pārśvābhyāṃ namaḥ <7> oṃ pracodayāt hastābhyāṃ namaḥ <8> || punaḥ | tatsaviturbrahmaṇe hṛdayāya namaḥ | oṃ vareṇyaṃ viṣṇave śirase svāhā <2> oṃ bhargodevasya rudrāya śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> oṃ dhiyaḥ īśvarāya kavacāya huṃ <4> oṃ yonaḥ sadāśivātmane netratrayāya vauṣaṭ <5> oṃ pracodayāt astrāya phaṭ <6> || tato'kṣaraśaktinyāsaḥ || oṃ tattadhyāyai <1> oṃ sa samagrāyai <2> oṃ vi vimalāyai <3>oṃ tu tuṣṭyai <4> oṃ rva vaṃdyāyai <5> oṃ re revatyai <6> oṃ ṇi niravadyāyai <7> oṃ yaṃ yajñavidyāyai <8> oṃ bha bhargāyai <9> oṃ rgo godāyai <10> oṃ de devinyai <11> oṃ va varadāyai <12> oṃ spa spaṃdanāyai <13> oṃ dhī dhīrāyai <14> oṃ ma madhurāyai <15> oṃ hi himavatsutāyai <16> oṃ dhi dhisnyai <17> oṃ yo yoginyai <18> oṃ yo yogadāyai <19> oṃ naḥ narmadāyai <20> oṃ pra pramathapriyāyai <21> oṃ co coriṇyai <22> oṃ da dayitāyai <23> yāt yājñyai namaḥ <24> || sthānāni | pādasaṃdhi catuḥkāṃḍanābhihṛdgalodordvayoḥ | saṃdhyāsyanāsāgaṃḍākṣikarṇabhrūmastakeṣvapi | vāruṇeṃdavayāmye pragūrdhvageṣu mukheṣu ca | krameṇa varṇān vinyasya gāyatryāviṃtravittamaḥ | iti nyāsānaṃtaraṃ dhyānaṃ saṃdhyātrayekāryaṃ | pūrvāhne brahmadaivatyāṃ raktavarṇāṃ raktavastrāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāṃ caturbhujāṃ kamaṃḍalvakṣamālāvaradābhayadhāriṇīṃ caturmukhāṃ haṃsārūḍhāṃ gāyatrīṃ dhyāyet |
<134a>
aparāhne viṣṇudaivatyāṃ kṛṣṇavarṇāṃ pītāṃvarāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāṃ caturbhujāṃ śaṃkhacakragadābhayadhāriṇīṃ garuḍārūḍhāṃ sāvitrīṃ dhyāyet | madhyāhne rudradaivatyāṃ śvetavarṇāṃ śvetavastrāṃ caturbhujāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāṃ śūlakapālavaradābhayakarāṃ vṛṣārūḍhāṃ sarasvatīṃ dhyāyet | anyadātvevaṃ muktāvindumahemanīlavalacchāyai mukhaistīkṣṇa (*)(?)rsauryuktāmiṃdunivadvaratnamukuṭāṃ tatvātmavarṇātmikāṃ | sāvitrīṃ varadābhyāṃkuśakarāṃpāśaṃ kapālaṃ guṇaṃ śaṃkhaṃcakramathāraviṃdayugalaṃ hastairvahaṃtīṃ bhaje | evaṃ dhyātvā tīvrādi śaktisahite saurepīṭhe trikoṇa madhye devīmāvāhyahā mudrāḥ pradarśayet || tadyathā | saṃmukhaṃ <1> saṃpuṭaṃ <2> vivṛtaṃ <3> ekamukhaṃ <4> dvimukhaṃ <5> trimukhaṃ <6> caturmukhaṃ <7> paṃcamukhaṃ <8> ṣaṇmukhaṃ <9> dviliṃginaṃ <10> śaṃkaṭaṃ <11> prāgagryaṃ <12> yamāsyaṃ <13> grathitaṃ <14> vimukhaṃ <15> adhomukhaṃ <16> pralaṃvamuṣṭiṃ <17> mīnākrāṃtaṃ <18> kūrmākrāṃtaṃ <19> varāhākrāṃtaṃ <20> siṃhākrāṃtaṃ <21> mahākrāṃtaṃ <22> pralaṃvaṃ <23> mudgaraṃ <24> etāmudrāścaturviṃśāgāyatrīṣu prasādhikāḥ |
vṛthā maṃtrājapāścaiva snānaṃ bhojanameva ca | tathā vai tīrthayātrā vai mudrāhīne vṛthā hi sā ||
yajñaśca viphalasteṣāṃ homodevārcanaṃ tathā | tasmānmudrāḥ sadā jñeyā vidvadbhiryatnamāsthitaiḥ ||
evaṃ mudrāḥ pradarśya pādyādibhirupacārairgāyatrīṃ pūjayet | gāyatryai <1> sāvitryai <2> sarasvatyai <3> nama iti trikoṇeṣu |
<134b>
brahmaṇe <1> viṣṇave <2> maheśvarāya <3> iti tadvahiḥ || ukhāyai <1> prajñāyai <2> prabhāyai <3> saṃdhyāyai <4> namaḥ iti caturdikṣu | tatoṃgāvaraṇaṃ | prahlādinyai <1> prabhāyai <2> nityāyai <3> viśvaṃbharāyai <4> vilāsinyai <5> prabhāvatyai <6> jayāyai <7> śāṃtāyai <8> durgāyai <9> sarasvatyai <10> durgārūpāyai <11> viśālāyai <12> īśānāyai <13> vimalāyai <14> tamopahāriṇyai <15> sūkṣmāyai <16> viśvayonyai <17> jayāvahāyai <18> padmāyai <19> parāyai <20> śobhanāyai <21> bhadrarūpāyai <22> namaḥ iti āvaraṇatrayaṃ kamalapatrāṣṭakeṣu pūjayet | tato brāhmyādayaḥ tato navagrahāḥ | āditya parṣadbhyo namaḥ iti | tato lokapālāḥ pūjyāḥ | aṣṭottaraśatamaṣṭāviṃśatiṃ vā japitvā uttare śikhare iti visarjayet | caturviṃśati lakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | caturviṃśati sahasraṃ śuddhaistilairhomaḥ | pāyasaṃghṛtaṃ tilādūrvākṣīradrumasamidhaḥ pṛthak pṛthak sahasraṃ juhuyāt | tato gāyatrī siddhā bhavati |
tatvasaṃkhyā sahasrāṇi maṃtravijjuhuyāttilaiḥ | sarvapāpa vinirmukto dīrghamāyuḥ sa viṃdati ||
āyuṣesājyahaviṣā kevalenātha sarpiṣā | dūrvātrikaistilairmaṃtrī juhuyāttrisahasrakaṃ ||
aruṇābjaistrimadhvaktairjuhuyādayutaṃnaraḥ | mahālakṣmīrbhavettasya ṣaṇmāsānnātrasaṃśayaḥ ||
trimadhughṛtaśarkarāmadhunītyarthaḥ | brahmaśriye prajuhuyāt prasūnairbrahmavṛkṣajaiḥ ||
<135a>
atha sādhanaprakāraḥ || kṛtvādinādau śuciśuddhadeholakṣāṇi japtvā triguṇī kṛtāni | satārakāvyāhṛtikottamāṃgāṃ sa daivatāṃ chaṃdaṛṣi prayuktāṃ | snāyācca samyak (*)(?) savanatrikeṣumitāsanaḥ saṃyatamānasākṣaḥ || haviṣyabhugdyomaparaśca vahnau tadottaraṃ karmasamārabhet | payo vrato dvādaśavāsareṣu dine dine gavyaghṛtāhutīnāṃ | hutvā sahasraṃ khadireṃdhanāgnau sahasraṃ niṣkaṃ sa labheta hemnāṃ | kṛtābhiṣekaḥ savanatrikeṣu japan trisaṃdhyaṃ tu sahasrasaṃkhyaṃ | māsena mucyeta mahai na sopi ṣaḍbhistu māsairapamṛtyu cakrāt | jalaṃjalāṃtargata sūryaviṃveśataṃ sahasraṃ kanakasya lābho yadi ceṃduviṣe | patrāṇi lakṣaṃ yadi maṃjulasya madhyājyaliptāni hutāni vahnau | meghastadāvarṣati sarvabhūmaunivārayedaṃbhasibhasmahomaḥ || samānavatsā kapilā ghṛtena japtvā sahasraṃ dhavalogra gaṃdhaṃ | upoṣya caṃdragrahaṇenipīyamedhāmavāpnoti jaḍopi sadyaḥ | tataḥ sa paścāt sa tatopayogājjīvet sahasraṃ parivatsarāṇāṃ | nādena kāvyodhiṣaṇaścavuddhyā dṛṣṭyāgarutmāniva sarvavedī | palāśahomāllabhate nidhānaṃ ghṛtena tejovalapuṣṭikāmaṃ | dūrvābhirāyuḥ payasāttathāgāṃ grāmaṃ tilairbhāsura taṃḍulaiśca |
<135b>
vaśyo madhukṣīraghṛtāhutīnāṃ bhavedavaśyaṃ nṛpatiḥ sabhṛtyaḥ | akāraṇādvāyadikāraṇādvākurvaṃti pīḍāṃ yadi śatrusaṃghāḥ | teṣāmidaṃ karmanarāsurāṇāṃ vidveṣaṇoccāṭanamāraṇāni | niśāṃtarekākakulāyakāṣṭhamādāya mātaṃgagṛhīta bhagnāṃ | cāṃḍālahastoddhṛtadīpite'gnau catuḥpathe prasphurita prakopaḥ | naivaṃ dalaṃ vā samidhaścanaiṃvīḥ sarājikātailavimiśritāṃgīḥ | vilomapādena sa huṃkṛtena vidarbhya śatrorabhidhānavarṇān | aṣṭau sahasrāṇi juhoti yasya sa durbhagaḥ sarvajanasyaneṣṭaḥ | avārapārātsarito mṛdaśca kṛtvā tu puṃsaḥ pratimāmarāteḥ | nāmākṣarairaṃkita hṛtpradeśāṃsarājikātailavilepitāṃgīṃ | vyastāṃghriṇā tailavimiśritena pratyakṣa vacchatrutanuṃ praviśya | tīkṣṇānalairmādana kaṃṭakaiśca catuḥpathe vai nikhaneda dṛṣṭaḥ | pādena viddhaḥ sa bhavettukhaṃjonābhi praveśe yadi kukṣiśūlaṃ | galagrahaścāpigalapradeśekarṇāṃtaredāruṇakarṇaśūlaṃ | lalāṭadeśepi hi muṃḍaśūlaṃ netrekṣi rogaṃ hṛdaye vināśaḥ || gāyatryā anekeprayogāḥ saṃtite graṃthagauravānnalikhitāḥ ||
<136a>
atha vadikāḥ kecana ucyaṃte || atha jātavedo durgāmaṃtraḥ || jātavedasesu na vāma somamarātī yato nidahāni vedaḥ | sanaḥ parṣadati durgāṇi viśvānāveva siṃdhuṃduritānyagniḥ || asya maṃtrasya marīciputrakaśyapaṛṣistriṣṭup chaṃdaḥ jātarūpiṇī durgādevatāduṃvījaṃ agniḥśaktiḥraṃkīlakaṃ śatrunigrahādau viniyogaḥ | jātavedasesuna vāmahṛdayāya namaḥ <1> somamarātīyataḥ śirase svāhā <2> nidahāni vedaśikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> sanaḥ parṣadati kavacāya huṃ <4> durgāṇi viśvānāvaiva netratrayāya vauṣaṭ <5> siṃdhuduritānyagniḥ astrāya phaṭ <6> | aṃghrigulpha jaṃghājānūru kaṭiguhyanābhi hṛdayasta na pārśvadvaya pṛṣṭhadvaya skaṃdhamadhya vāhumūlopadhāṃhukaurparaprakoṣṭha maṇivaṃdha talamukhanāsākṣikarṇamastakamastiṣ.kamūrdhasudakṣa vāmakrameṇākṣaranyāsaḥ | śiro lalāṭa dṛkkarṇayugoṣṭharasanākaṃṭhavāhu hṛtkukṣikaṭiguhyorujānujaṃghācaraṇeṣu padanyāsaḥ | atha dhyānaṃ | vidyuddāma samaprabhāṃ mṛgapatiskaṃdhasthitāṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ | kanyābhiḥ karavāla kheṭavilasaddhastābhirāsevitāṃ | hastaiścakra gadāsikheda viśikhaścāpaṃ varaṃ tarjanīṃ vibhrāṇāmaruṇātmikāṃ śaśidharāṃ durgāṃ trinetrāṃ smare | dakṣavāmo parikarayoścakragade |
<136b>
tadadhaḥ asikheṭau tadadho vāṇacāpau | tadadho varatarjanyau | iti dhyātvā daurge pīṭhe aṣṭadalakamalakarṇikāyāṃ jayādi sahitāṃ jayā vijayā bhadrā bhadrakālī sumukhī vyāghramukhī etājayādyaḥ | tatra ṣaṭkoṇe devī māvāhya pūjayet | aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ | agnaye jātavedase namaḥ <1> agnaye saptajihvāya <2> agnaye havyavāhanāya <3> agnaye aśvodarāya <4> agnaye kaumāra tejase <5> agnaye viśvamukhāya <6> agnaye devamukhāya <7> nama iti daleṣu pūjayet | pṛthivyātmane namaḥ <1> salilātmane <2> agnyātmane <3> vāśvātmane <4> namaḥ iti dikṣu | nivṛtyai <1> pratiṣṭāyai <2> vidyāyai <3> śāṃtyai <4> namaḥ iti koṇeṣu pūjayet | anyāḥ śaktayo gauravānnoktāḥ | evaṃ pūjayitvā visarjayet | catuścatvāriṃśat sahasraṃ pūraścaraṇaṃ | kṣīravṛkṣa tilarājīhavimirhaśāṃśo homaḥ | prayogā astra prakaraṇe lekhyāḥ || tryaṃvaka maṃtrasya pūrva eva likhitaḥ || atha śatākṣīmaṃtraḥ || oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ gāyatrī jātavedaḥ tryaṃvakaṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaroṃ | iti śatākṣarī | sūryavahni somātmikā ṛṣyādayaḥ pūrvoktā eva | tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargodevasyadhīmahi hṛdayaṃ <1> dhiyoyonaḥ pracodayāt śiraḥ <2> jātavedasesu na vāmasomamarātī
<137a>
yato nidahāti vedaśikhā <3> sanaḥ parṣadati durgāṇi viśvānāvaivedasiṃdhuṃduritābhyagniḥ kavacaṃ <4> tryaṃvakaṃ yajāmahe sugaṃdhiṃ puṣṭivardhanaṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ <5> urvāruvasiva vaṃdhanānmṛtyormukṣīyamāmṛtāt bhūrbhuvaḥ svaroṃ astrāya phaṭ <6> dhyānaṃ pūrvoktaṃ | athavā gāyatrī varṇaparipūrṇa tanuścabhānustriṣṭup viśiṣṭamahimāmahitaḥ kṛśānuḥ | ānaṣṭubhākṣara samagra ruciḥ śaśāṃkodadyuḥ samudyatamamīparivāṃchitaṃ vaḥ || atha vā smartavyākhila lokavārtasatataṃ yajuṃgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ vyāptaṃ yena ca yatprapaṃcarahitaṃ mukteśca yatsiddhidaṃ | yadvāsyāt praṇava tribhedagahanaṃ śrutvā ca yadgīyate tadvaḥkāṃchita siddhaye'stu paramaṃ sajyoti rucchaṃ mahaḥ || iti dhyātvā śaurepīṭhe devamāvāhya pūjayet | aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇam | gāyatrī yuktābhiḥ prahlāditābhiḥ aṣṭakaṃ trayasaṃkhyābhirdvitīya tṛtīyacaturthikā āvṛtayaḥ | jātavedoktābhirjāgavādibhiḥ paṃcamī | tryaṃvaka maṃtroktābhiraṣṭaśoṣṭhaśaścatuṣṭayaṃ | lokapālairdaśamī evaṃ pūjayato japataśca vāṃchita siddhirbhavati | viśeṣājjapataśca muktirbhavati lakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ tilairdaśāṃśohomaḥ || uktaṃ ca | praṇava vyāhṛtyādyāvyāhṛtitārāṃtikāmaṃtrivaraiḥ |
<137b>
japyā śatākṣarī syādiha paralokaprasiddhaye dinaśaḥ | manumatha śāṃtyai tatpadādyaṃ prajapyādgaṇarahitāyāpyāyuṣenubhādyaṃ | vimalamatiraniyaṃsanetriṣṭubhādyaṃdinamanudinacakre vatsaraṃ saṃyatātmā || śatākṣaramanorayaṃkame udāhṛtaḥ gaṃthahadbhajedamumataṃdritodinaśa eva maṃtrīrahaḥ | abhīṣṭaphalasiddhaye ca yaśase sudīrghāyuṣepya śeṣajanaraṃjanāya ciramiṃdirāvāptaye || atha yajurvedadurgā || tāmagnivarṇāṃ tapasā jvalaṃtīṃ vai rocanīṃ karmaphaleṣu puṣṭāṃ | durgādevīṃ śaraṇamahaṃ prapadyemuttarasitarase namaḥ || asya ṛṣyādikaṃ nāsti | oṃ tāmagni varṇāṃ namo hṛdayaṃ <1> oṃ tapasājvalaṃtīṃ namaḥ śiraḥ <2> oṃ vai rocanīṃ karmaphaleṣu puṣṭāṃ namaḥ śikhā <3> oṃ durgā devīṃ namaḥ kavacaṃ <4> oṃ śaraṇamahaṃ prapadye namaḥ netratrayaṃ <5> oṃ sutasitarase namaḥ astraṃ <6> dhyānaṃ | udyaddinakara sahasrabhāsurāṃ śaṃkhakheṭakacāpavāṇakalāpamuśalamuṃḍasrak dadhrīṃ trinetrāṃ dhyātvā daurgepīṭhe devīmāvāhya pūjayet | aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ | prahlādinyādibhiśca | puraścaraṇādikaṃ pūrvoktaṃ || ṛgvedoktaḥ sauraḥ | udyannudyanmitramaha ārohannuttarāṃdivaṃ | hṛdrogaṃ mamasūryaharimāṇaṃ ca nāśaya || asya praskaṇva ṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ sūryodevatā iṣṭārthe |
<138a>
pūjādikaṃ pūrvaṃ ghṛṇivat || taittirīyake | yosāvādityetyādi paṃcabhānavaḥ prasiddhāḥ | asya pūjādikaṃ pūrvavat kuryāt || atha ṛgvedasyāgamokto vāruṇa maṃtraḥ | dhruvāsitvā su kṣitiṣukṣipaṃtovya smatyāśaṃ varuṇonumocata | avocan vāṇā adite rūpasthājyūyaṃ pātaḥ svastibhiḥ sa dānaḥ | asyā vāruṇyā vaśiṣṭha ṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ varuṇo devatā mahaiśvaryā vāptyarthe viniyogaḥ || dhruvāsitvāmukṣitiṣu hṛdayaṃ <1> kṣipaṃtovya smatpāśaṃ śiraḥ <2> varuṇonumocata śikhā <3> avocanvānā aditeḥ kavacaṃ <4> upasthājyūyaṃ pātaḥ netrābhyāṃ <5> svastibhiḥ sa dānaḥ astrāya phaṭ <6> || athākṣaranyāsaḥ | pādadvayasaṃdhyagreṣudaśa | pāyuguhyādhārakukṣipṛṣṭhahṛtsusapta | stanayordvayaṃ | ekaṃ karṇe | doḥ saṃdhyagreṣu daśa | vakṣasyekaṃ | gaṃḍaghrāṇalocanaśravaṇayugaleṣvaṣṭau | bhrūmadhye ekaṃ | mastaka ekaṃ | sarvāṃgeṣvekamiti | dhyānaṃ | akṣāṃśukābharaṇamālyavilepanāḍyaḥ pāśāṃkuśā bhayavarodyatadoḥ sarojaḥ | svacchāraviṃdavasatiḥ prasannobhūyādvibhūti vidhayevaruṇaściraṃ vaḥ || iti dhyātvā dharmādiyukte pīṭhe varuṇamāvāhya pūjayet | aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ | vāsukaye namaḥ <1> takṣakāya <2> karkoṭakāya <3> dhanaṃjayāya <4>
<138b>
padmāya <5> mahāpadmāya <6> śaṃkhāya <7> kulikāya <8> namaḥ iti pūrvādi patreṣu pūjayet | iṃdrādīṁśca | iti saṃpūjya yathāśakti japitvā visarjayet | lakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | pāyasenāyutaṃ homaḥ ||
ṛṇamuktyai japenmaṃtraṃ pratyahaṃ sāṣṭakaṃ śataṃ | japenānena labhate mahatīṃ śriyamavyayāṃ ||
sitekṣu śakalairmaṃtrī juhuyāt ghṛtasaṃplutaiḥ | caturdinaṃ daśaśataṃ ṛṇamuktau mahāpriyaḥ ||
samidbhirvetasocchābhiḥ kṣīroktābhirdinatrayaṃ | juhuyādvṛṣṭi saṃsiddhyai maṃtraviddhi jiteṃdriyaḥ ||
anena vidhināmaṃtrī śataṃ śatabhiṣāgataḥ | catuḥśataghṛtayutaṃ pāyasaṃ juhuyādvaśī ||
ṛṇanāśāya saṃpatyai vaśyā rogyāya siddhaye | maṃtrī pratyaṅmukho bhūtvā tarpayet dviguṇairjalaiḥ |
sarvopadravanāśāya samastābhyudaye nṛṇāṃ ||
atha paṃcabrahmavidhānaṃ || īśānaḥ sarvavidyānāmīśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ brahmādhipatirbrahmaṇodhipatirbrahmāśivome astu sadāśivoṃ || <1> || tatpuruṣāya vidmahe mahādevāya dhīmahi | tanno rudraḥ pracodayāt || <2> || adhorebhyotha ghorebhyo ghoraghoratarebhyaḥ sarvataḥ sarvebhyo namastestu rudrarūpebhyaḥ || <3> || vāmadevāya namo jyeṣṭhāya namo rudrāya namaḥ kalavikaraṇāya namo valapramathanāya namaḥ sarvabhūta damanāya namo manonmanāya namaḥ || <4> || sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmi sadyojātāya vai namaḥ | bhavebhavenāti bhavebhajasvamāṃbhavodbhavāya namaḥ || <5> || iti paṃcamaṃtrāḥ | īśāna maṃtrasya īśāna ṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ īśāno devatā || <1> ||
<139a>
tatpuruṣasya tatpuruṣa ṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ bhago devatā sarveṣāṃ halo vījāni svarāḥ śaktayaḥ sakala vā pakṣayapūrvaka caturvidha puruṣārthe viniyogaḥ || prāsādamaṃtreṇa karaśuddhiṃ vidhāya | aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ phreṃ hyauṃ sarvajñāta hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ sphreṃ hyauṃ amṛta tejogālini tṛptāya brahmaśirase svāhā <2> aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ṣphreṃ hyauṃ jvalita śikhiśikhe anādi vodhāya śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ṣphreṃ hyauṃ vajriṇe vajradharāya kavacāya huṃ <4> aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ṣphreṃ hyauṃ sauṃ roṃ hūṃ aluptaśaktaye netratrayāya vauṣaṭ <5> aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ṣphreṃ hyauṃ śrīpaśu huṃ phaḍaṃta śaktaye astrāya phaṭ <6> || tato īśānādayo maṃtrāḥ paṃcadhānyastavyāḥ | tadyathā | īśānaṃ maṃtraḥ paṃcadhā vibhajya kalābhiḥ sahaprāgyāmya vāruṇottarorddha vaktreṣu krameṇa nyaset | īśānaḥ sarvavidyānāṃ śaśinyai namaḥ <1> īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ aṃgadāyai namaḥ <2> brahmādhipatirbrahmaṇodhipatirbrahmā iṣṭāyai namaḥ <3> śivo me astu marīcyai namaḥ <4> sadāśivoṃ jvālinyai namaḥ <5> iti vinyasya tatpuruṣamaṃtraṃ paṃcadhā vibhajya prāgdakṣiṇordha vakreṣu krameṇa nyaset | oṃ tatpuruṣāya vidmahe nivṛtyai namaḥ <1> oṃ mahādevāya dhīmahi pratiṣṭhāyai namaḥ <2> tanno rudraḥ vidyāyai namaḥ <3> pracodayāt śāṃtyai namaḥ <4> || tato'ghoramaṣṭadhā vibhajya hṛdaya grīvāṃ sadvayanābhyudaravakṣaḥ su ca saṃnyaset | oṃ aghorebhyastaṃdryai namaḥ <1> atha ghorebhyo mohinyai <2> ghorakṣamāyai <3> ghoratarebhyo mṛtyurūpiṇyai <4> sarvataḥ
<139b>
sarvamāyāyai <5> sarvebhyo nidrāyai <6> namaste astu bhayāyai <7> rudrarūpebhyo jayāyai namaḥ | tato vāmadeva maṃtraṃ trayodaśadhā vibhajya āghoravījakośorudvayajānudvaya jaṃghādvaṃyasphicchūṭī pārśvadvaiyeṣu nyaset | oṃ vāmadevāyai namaḥ <1> oṃ karālikāyai namaḥ <2> jyeṣṭhāyai <3> ratnāyai <4> rudrāya <5> ratyai <6> kālāya <7> kālinyai <8> kalakāṃtāyai <9> karaṇāya <10> saṃyaminyai <11> valāya <12> īśānāyai <13> valavṛddhyai <14> vikaraṇāya <15> sthirāyai <16> valapramathanāya <17> rātryai <18> sarvabhūtadamanāya <19> grāminyai <20> namo namo mohinyai <21> unmanāya <22> jarāyai namaḥ <23> iti vinyasya | punaḥ sadyojātamaṣṭadhā vibhajya | pādahasta talaghrāṇa mastaka vāhuṣu nyaset | sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmi namaḥ siddhyai <1> bhave namo dyutaye <2> abhaye namo lakṣmyai <3> anādi bhave namo medhāyai <4> bhajasvamāṃ namaḥ kāṃtyai <5> bhava namaḥ svadhāyai <6> udbhavāya namaḥ | sthirāyai <1> evaṃ vinyāsaṃ kurvato mahādeva pūjā vaiśiṣṭyaṃ | yathā | vinyāsaḥ pratimā kṛtau tu nitarāṃsānidhya kṛtsyādayaṃ dehe cāpi śarīriṇāṃ nigaditāḥ sāmarthyakārīti ca | āste yatra tathā munai ca dinaśauvinyastadehaḥ pumān kṣetraṃ śaivamamuṃcayojanamitaṃ śaivāgamajñā viduḥ | evaṃ vinyasya śaive pīṭhe devamāvāhya abhyarcya paṃcaprarṇamaṃtraiḥ krameṇa madhya prāgyāmya paścimadikṣu īśāna tatpuruṣāghora vāmadeva sadyojātān vidikṣu kalāṁśca pūjayet | aṃgaurdvitīyāvṛttiḥ | anaṃtasūkṣmyādibhistṛtīyā ||
<140a>
umādyaiścaturthī | lokapālaiḥ paṃcamī | tadāyudhaiḥ ṣaṣṭī | śeṣaṃ pūrvavat || atha saṃvādasūktaṃ ||
saṃsamādyuvame vṛṣennalagneti viśvānyarya ā | iḍasyadesamidhyasesanāvasūnyābhara || <1> ||
saṃgacchadhvaṃ saṃvadadhvaṃ saṃvomanāṃsijāyatāṃ | devābhāgaṃ yathā pūrve saṃjānānā upāsate || <2> ||
samāno maṃtraḥ samitiḥ samānī samānaṃ manaḥ sahacittameṣāṃ | samānamaṃtramabhimaṃtrayāvaḥ samāne navo haviṣājuhomi || <3> ||
samānīrava ākūtiḥ samānī hṛdayāni vaḥ | samānamastu vo mano yathā vaḥ su sahāsati || <4> ||
iti saṃvāda sūktaṃ || asya saṃvanana ṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ saṃvādāgnirdevatā iṣṭārthe viniyogaḥ | brahmaṇe hṛdayaṃ <1> viṣṇave śiraḥ <2> rudrāya śikhā <3> īśvarāya kavacaṃ <4> sadāśivāya netraṃ <5> sarvātmane astraṃ <6> | dhyānaṃ | dhavalamalinarājaccaṃdra madhye niṣaṇaṃ karavilasitacāpaṃ sāṃkuśaṃ cābhayaṃ ca | saṃvaramamalaviṃdukṣīragauraṃ trinetraṃ praṇamatavaracakraṃ maṃjusaṃvādayaṃtaṃ || agnipīṭhe devamāvāhya pūjayet | aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ | agnyaṣṭamūrtibhirdvitīyaṃ | lokapālaistṛtīyaṃ | evaṃ japapūjāvataḥ śīghraṃ dhanaprāptirbhavati || <2> || atha samṛddhyāgni maṃtraḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ svāhā | asya bhṛguṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ agnirdevatā vahutaradhanaprāptyarthe viniyogaḥ sahasrārciṣe hṛdayaṃ <1> svasti pūrṇāya śiraḥ <2> uttiṣṭhapuruṣāya śikhā <3> dhūma vyāpine kavacaṃ <4> saptajihvāyanetraṃ <5> dhanurdharaśca astraṃ <6> |
<140b>
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ || bhūḥ vaḥ svaḥ iti varṇaiva ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | tata śaktiparyaṃtaṃ saurapīṭhavatpīṭhaṃ tatra pītāyai <1> śvetāyai <2> aruṇāyai <3> kṛṣṇāyai <4> dhūmrāyai <5> tīvrāyai <6> sphuliṃginyai <7> rucirāyai <8> jvālinyai namaḥ <9> sarvaśakti kamalāsanāya namaḥ <10> dhyānaṃ | śaktisvastika pāśāṃkuśa varadābhayān dadhat trimukhaḥ | mukulādi vividhabhūṣo'vatācciraṃ pāvakaḥ prasannovaḥ | uparitana dakṣiṇa vāmahastābhyāṃ śakti svastikau | tataḥ pāśāṃkuśau | tadadho varadābhaye iti dhyātvā devaṃ pūjayet | aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ | dvitīyaṃ jātavesenna śaktibhiḥ | lokapālaiśca | ṣallakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | ghṛtāktena pāyasena daśāṃśohomaḥ || athāparo maṃtraḥ paṃcaviṃśākṣaraḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaragnirjātaveda ihāvaha sarvakarmāṇi sādhaya svāhā | ṛṣyādikaṃ dhyānaṃ ca pūrvavat || athavā śakti svastika darbhākṣavalayasrugabhayavaraṃdāni (**)(?)mitā kalpovovasuravatāt kanakamālikā kalitaḥ | dakṣiṇādhaḥ karamārabhya śaktyādi dhyeyaṃ | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ hṛdayaṃ oṃ agnirjātavedaḥ śiraḥ <2> ihāvahaśikhā <3> sarvakarmāṇi kavacaṃ <4> sā(**)(?) netraṃ <5> svāhā astraṃ <6> || atha turagāṇi maṃtraḥ | uttiṣṭha puruṣa haripiṃgalalohitākṣadehime dāpaya svāhā |
<141a>
ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvavat | uttiṣṭha puruṣa hṛdayaṃ <1> haripiṃgalaśiraḥ <2> lohitākṣa śikhā <3> dehime kavacaṃ <4> dāpayanetraṃ <5> svāhā astraṃ <6> | oṃ vījaṃ svāhā śaktiḥ | dhyānaṃ | hemāśvaccha suradrumodarabhuvo niryāṃtamaśvā kṛttiṃ varṣaṃtaṃ dhanadhānyaratnanicayān raṃdhraiḥ svakaiḥ saṃtataṃ | jvālā pallavittasvaromavivaraṃ bhaktārtisaṃbhedinaṃ vaṃde dharmasukhārtha mokṣaphaladaṃ divyākṛtiṃ pāvakaṃ | aṃgairjāta vedādibhirlokapālaiścāvaraṇaṃ | lakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | ghṛtena pāyasena daśāṃśo homaḥ | ete'gni maṃtrādhanārthibhirjapyāḥ || atha somamaṃtraḥ | soṃ somāya namaḥ | bhṛguḥ paṃktiriti vā | asyātriṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ somodevatā soṃvījaṃ yaṃ śaktiḥ lakṣmī prāptaye viniyogaḥ | sāṃ sīṃ sūṃ saiṃ sauṃ saḥ ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | dhyānaṃ | amalakamalasaṃsthaḥ suprasannānaneṃ durvaradakumudahastaḥ śubhrahārādibhūṣaḥ | sphaṭikarajatavarṇo vāṃchita prāptayevo bhavatu bhavadabhīṣṭaṃ jyotitāṃgaḥ śaśāṃkaḥ || evaṃ dhyātvā dharmādi pīṭhaṃ somamaṃḍalāṃtaṃ saṃpūjya tatra somamāvāhya pūjayet | kesarasthāḥ | tārāpataye <1> rohiṇyai <2> kṛttikāyai <3> revatyai <4> bharaṇyai <5> rātryai <6> ārdrāyai <7> jyotsāyai <8> kalāyai namaḥ <9> iti prāgādi dikṣu pūjayet | imāḥ kṛtāṃjalayo dhyeyāḥ |
<141b>
āditya <1> maṃgala <2> vudha <3> vṛhaspati <4> rāhu <5> śukra <6> ketūn <8> | dikpālāṁśca pūjayet | ṣaṭlakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | pāyasena daśāṃśo homaḥ || evaṃ siddhe manau maṃtrī saṃpadāṃ vasatirbhavet | hṛtpuṃḍarīka madhyasthaṃ tārahāra vibhūṣitaṃ | tārāpati manuṃmaṃtrī trisahasraṃ manurjapet | rājyaiśvaryaṃ daridropi prāpnuyādvatsarāṃtare | pūrvoktasaṃkhyaṃ prajapet śaśinaṃ mūrdhani smaran | rogāya mṛtyu duḥkhānijivā varṣaśataṃ vrajet || atha kuveramaṃtrāḥ | vaiśravaṇāṃya svāhā <1> pakvāśāya svāhā <2> piṃgalāya svāhā <3> vividhāya svāhā <4> kuverāya svāhā <5> bhūḥ svāhā <6> bhuvaḥ svāhā <7> svaḥ svāhā <8> bhūrbhuvaḥ svāhā hrīṃ etemaṃtrāḥ dhanapradāḥ | hemapīṭhe kanakavarṇaṃ kanakapuṭakaraṃḍavilasita karadvayaṃ vṛhadudaraṃ ratnamaṃḍitaṃ śaṃkhapadmanidhidyotitaṃ kuveraṃ dhyātvā vaiśvadevāvasāne agnāvevādāhyataḥ mukhe ājyāktāḥ anyonya saṃdaṣṭādaśavaṭakasamidhaḥ daśabhiretairmaṃtrairjuhuyāt | vahutara dhanalābhaḥ syāt | ghṛtāktapāyasairvā | ghṛtāktavilvasamidho vā | juhuyāt | dhanalābhaḥ syāt || athānna pūrṇāmaṃtraḥ || oṃ namo bhagavati māheśvari annapūrṇe svāhā | śāradātilake bhuvaneśvarī vījādi bhavaṃ |
<142a>
asya brahmāṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ annapūrṇā devatā hrīṃ vījaṃ svāhā śaktiḥ | hrāṃ hrīmityādi ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | dhyānaṃ ca | rudratāṃḍavavilokanalolāṃ bhadravaktranayanāṃ bhavakāṃtāṃ | annadānaniratāṃ jananīṃtāṃ ciṃtayan japaṃ tu citradukūlāṃ || evaṃ dhyātvā abhyarcya ṣoḍaśa sahasraṃ japet | sājyenānnena daśāṃśo homaḥ | anena japtena maṃtreṇa vahvanna samṛddhirbhavati || athānnādhipatimaṃtraḥ || annaṃ mahyamannaṃmedehyannādhipatayemamānnaṃ pradāpaya svāhā | asyānnādhipati maṃtrasya brahmāṛṣiravikṛti chaṃdaḥ bhūmiśriyodevate vahvanna prāptaye bhūvījaṃ śrīvīje vījaśaktīgnau śrīmityādi ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | annaṃ mahyaṃ hṛdayaṃ <1> annaṃ medehi śiraḥ <2> annādhipataye śikhā <3> mamānnaṃ pradāpaya kavacaṃ <4> svāhā astraṃ <5> | dhyānaṃ | dugdhākṣauraupyava prāvṛta kanakamayeṃ dvīpavargesurādyekalpadrūdyānamālemaṇimayalasite vittayasyāgrabhāge | āsīnebhūśriyau vāṃchita vasuni ca yānmaṃtriṇe saṃsṛjaṃtyau maṃtrīsaṃciṃtayāno japatu dinamukhe saṃpade'nnasya maṃtraṃ | kṣīrasamudre rajataprākāraveṣṭita svarṇadvīpe devagaṇa saṃyukte kalpavṛkṣaṃ vanasyādhaḥ | tanmaṇimayabhūbhāge kuverasyāgrato bhūmiṃ śriyaṃ ca vāṃchitārthapradāyinyau dhyātvā saṃpūjayet |
<142b>
mahatī dhanadhānya saṃpattirbhavati | paṃcaviṃśati sahasraṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | sa sarpiṣāpāyasena daśāṃśohomaḥ || atha vṛhaspati maṃtraḥ | vṛṃ vṛhaspataye namaḥ | asya brahmāṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ bṛhaspatirdevatā vṛṃ vījaṃmaḥ śaktiḥ | vrāmityādiṣaḍaṃgaṃ | dhyānaṃ | ratnasvarṇāṃśukādīnnijakarakamalāddakṣiṇādākiraṃtaṃ vāsorāśau nidhāyā paramamaraguruṃ pītavastrādibhūṣaṃ | dhyāyannāsīnamapyāyatabhuviśatasaṃkhyaistu kāṃcanāktairbhītā puṣpairghṛtāktaistridinamathadganetsvarṇavastrādi siddhyai | evaṃ bṛhaspatimaṃtrajapedhanalābho bhavati || atha śukramaṃtraḥ || vastraṃmedehi śukrāya svāhā | parāya vedikāmāsīnaṃ śubhrakusumānulepanaṃ vāmakareṇavāso ratnahiraṇyāni sādhakāya prayacchaṃtaṃ vyākhyā mudrāṃkita dakṣiṇakaraṃ śukraṃ dhyātvā arcayet | ayutaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | sarpiṣā sahasraṃ homaḥ | agnau śukramuktarūpaṃ dhyātvā tanmukhe śuklapuṣpāṇi triṣaṣṭhivāraṃ saptacatvāriṃśadadhika śatavāraṃ juhuyāt vā sodhanaratnalābha vāhulyaṃ syāt || uktaṃ ca prapaṃce | śukrāsye śukla puṣpairhutabhuvigaṇaśaḥ saptasauhyekaviṃśadvāraṃ hotavyameṣopyatisita kusumālepano vāmadoṣṇā | vāso ratnādikāntā suramapi satataṃ
<143a>
sādhakāya prayacchan dhyāto vyākhyāna mudrākalita paramakalastvāpanāliṃdasaṃdhyaḥ || atha vyāsamaṃtraḥ | oṃ vyāṃvedavyāsāya namaḥ | dhyānaṃ | munivrātāvītaṃ muditadhiyamaṃbhodaruciraṃ rucivyākhyā mudrākalitavilasaddakṣiṇakaraṃ | paraṃ jānau kṛtvā dṛḍhakalitakakṣaikavivaraṃ samāsīnaṃ vyāsaṃ smaratanirataṃ puṇya nicayaṃ | (**)(?) smaratāṃ nirupama kavitā prajñā vyākhyā mahālakṣmī śuddhasarasvatīpradā bhavati || uktaṃ ca prapaṃcasāre | prakṛti sahasraṃ japaḥ syāddaśāṃśakṛtapāyasājyavidhiḥ | nirupama kavitā prajñā vyākhyā śrīsaṃpadāya ho maṃtraḥ || atha vāradevīmaṃtrau vaidikaḥ | yadvāgvadaṃtyavicetanāni rāṣṭrīdevānāṃ niṣasādamaṃdrā | catasra jha juṃ huṃ duheṣayāṃsikasvidasyā paramaṃjagāma | asya bhārgavanemiṛṣistriṣṭup chaṃdaḥ vāgdevī devatā vāk siddhaye viniyogaḥ | vaṃ vījaṃ taṃ śaktiḥ draṃ kīlakaṃ | daśabhiḥ paṃcabhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ paṃcabhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ daśabhiḥ ṣaḍaṃgaṃ || asya jape sarasvatī siddhirbhavati || atha gaurīmaṃtraḥ śrīgaurirudradayite yogeśvari huṃ phaṭ svāhā | asya ajaṛṣistrivṛt chaṃdaḥ gaurīdevatāvaśyādi siddhaye viniyogaḥ | dhyānaṃ |
<143b>
asakalaśaśirājan maulirāvaddha pāśāṃkuśa rucirakarābjāṃ vaṃdhujīvāruṇāṃgī | amaranikaravaṃdyātrī kṣaṇāśoṇalepāṃśukaṃ kusumayutā syāt saṃpade pārvatī vaḥ | evaṃ dhyātvā śaktipīṭhe devīmāvāhya pādyādibhiḥ pūjayet | mātṛbhirekaṃ | lokapālairdvitīyaṃ | lakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | pāyasenāyutaṃ homaḥ | saubhāgyādi siddhaye strī japet | vaśyārthe saṃpadarthe ca puruṣo japet | niśāyāṃ strīnāmasvavāmoraulikhitvā vāmapāṇi nāpidhāya japetsāvaśyā bhavatyā gācchati ca || athāparo gaurīmaṃtraḥ ekaṣaṣṭi varṇātmakaḥ | hrīṃ namo brahma śrīrātiterājite jayevijayegaurigaṃdhāri tribhuvana ca śaṃkari sarvalokavaśaṃkari sarvastrī puruṣavaśaṃkari su su du du ghe ghe vā vāhnaṃ | svāhā | ṛṣyādikaṃ gaurīmaṃtravat | caturdaśabhirdaśabhiścāṣṭabhistato daśabhirekādaśabhirmaṃtrākṣaraiḥ kramāducyate ṣaḍaṃgavidhiḥ | ayutaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | mṛtāktaiḥ pāyasairdaśāṃśohomaḥ | vāśaṣṭā darvāk sādhyanāmayo japitvā maṃtraṃ japet aśeṣa vaśyakaraṃ || atha gāṃdhārī maṃtraḥ | kāṃchita strīvaśaṃkari su su du du ghe ghe vā vā strīṃ svāhā | asya sarvaṃ pūrvavat | hoi pakṣarādupari vā ityakṣarādarvāk striyo vā puruṣasya vā nāmasaṃyojya maṃtraṃ japet |
<144a>
śīghraṃ vaśīkṣapeti || atha rājamukhī maṃtraḥ | rājamukhi rājābhimukhi vaśyamukhi hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ devi devi mahādevi devādevi sarvajanasya mukhaṃ mamavaśaṃ kuru kuru svāhā || rājamukhi rājābhimukhi hṛdayaṃ <1> vaśyamukhi hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ śiraḥ <2> divi devi śikhā <3> mahādevi kavacaṃ <4> devādevi netratrayaṃ <5> śeṣeṇāstraṃ <6> | anyat sarvaṃ gāṃdhārī maṃtravat | sarvajanasya sthāne sādhyanāma prakṣipet sabhādau japet rājāna mavaśyamanyaṃ vā vaśīkaroti || atha bhūvijayamaṃtraḥ | bhage bhage kṣobhaye mohayecchedaye kledayeklinna svaśarīre huṃ phaṭ svāhā | eṣamaṃtravaraḥ śrīmān triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ | nāmnā bhūvijaya iti svayaṃ devenabhāṣitaḥ | durbhāgyānāṃ ca kopānāṃ nirdravyāṇāṃ varānane | śuddhi tejo vihīnānāṃ vidyāguṇa vivarjināṃ | sarvametajjapenaivaśīvramāpnoti mānavaḥ | yadyadvihīno japati tattatprāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ || atha ratnadhārāmaṃtraḥ | ratnaratna mahāratnadhārāya svāhā | asya prajāpati ṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdo ratnadhārākhyo maṃtrodevatā ratnādi lābhe viniyogaḥ | maṃtravibhāgairaṃgaṃ | sādhakāya ratnadhārāṃ varṣaṃtaṃ hastābhyāṃ hāramukuṭādi bhūṣaṇabhūṣitaṃ dhyāyan japet | mahatīṃ samṛddhirbhavati || atha śāstṛmaṃtraḥ ||
<144b>
oṃ śāstāraṃ mṛgayā śrāṃtamaśvārūḍhaṃ gaṇāṃvṛtaṃ | pānīyārthaṃ vanādebhyaḥ śastretaraimvate namaḥ ||
asyaraiṃvatakaṛṣiḥ paṃktiśchaṃdaḥ mahāśāstā devatā sarvavaśyārthe viniyogaḥ | maṃtrapadaiḥ ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | pāśavadhyaṃ śādhyaṃ sādhakasya pādayoḥ pātayaṃtaṃ daṃḍadharaṃ dhyāyan japet | tadgaṇa pūjā yathā | goptre <1> piṃgalākṣāya <2> vīrasenāya <3> śrībhavāya <4> trinetrāya <5> śūline <6> kṣāya <7> bhīmarūpāya <8> namaḥ iti pūjayet | evaṃ madhyāhne'smaisaktūn datvā aṃjalinājalaṃ dadyāt | tadgaṇebhyaśca |
viśrāṃtāya namastasmai svakāryāṇi nivedayet | prītacetāstathetyuktkāsa tu jāta iti smaret ||
maṃtrastu | ṣaihaṃtāya śāstre goptre praśāstre | gāyatrī bhūtādhipāya vidmahe mahādevāya vīmahi | tannaḥ śāstā pracodayāt || atha kāmamaṃtrāḥ | klīṃ | saṃmohana ṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ kāmo devatā sakalapuruṣa vaśyārthe viniyogaḥ | klāṃ klī mityādi ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | netradvayaṃ tu | dhyānaṃ | aruṇamaruṇa vāso mālyadāmāṃgarāgaṃ svakarakalitapāśaṃsāṃkuśāstreṣu cāpaṃ | maṇimayamukuṭādyairdīptamākalpajālairaruṇanalinasaṃsthaṃ ciṃtayedātmayoniṃ | evaṃ dhyātvā mohinyai <1> krodhinyai <2> trāsinyai <3> staṃbhinyai <4> ākarṣiṇyai <5> drāvinyai <6> āhlādinyai <7> klinnāyai <8> kledinyai <9> namaḥ iti navaśakti yuktāyāṃ aṣṭadala kamalakarṇikāyāṃ devamāvāhya pūjayet | drāṃ śoṣaṇavāṇāya <1> drīṃ mohanavāṇāya <2> klīṃ saṃdīpanavāṇāya <3> saṃ unmādanavāṇāya <4> iti prādakṣiṇyena vāṇān pūjayet |
<145a>
