anaṃtaraṃ | anaṃgarūpāyai <1> anaṃgamadanāyai <2> anaṃgamanmathāyai <3> anaṃgakusumāyai <4> anaṃgakusumāturāyai <5> anaṃgaśeṣarāyai <6> anaṃgamekhalāyai <7> anaṃgadīpikāyai <8> namaḥ iti dikpatreṣu pūjayet | lokapālāṁśca | lakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | trimadhurasiktaiḥ kiṃśukakusumairdaśāṃśohomaḥ | sakalalokavaśyārthe japet | atha kāmagāyatrī | kāmadevāya vidmahe puṣpacāpāya dhīmahi | tanno'naṃgaḥ pracodayāt || oṃ klīṃ namaḥ kāmadevāya sarvajanapriyāya sarvajana saṃmohanāya jvala <2> prajvala <2> sarvajanaṃ me vaśaṃ kuru <2> svāhā | asyāpi ṛṣi dhyānādikaṃ pūrvavat || atha prakārāṃtaraṃ | amṛtodbhavāyamakaraketanāya saṃkalpajāyākṣararūpāyekṣu dhanurdharāya puṣpaśarāya namaḥ | ebhiḥ padaiḥ ṣaḍaṃgaṃ vidhāya dhyāyet | drāṃ drī mityādi paṃcavījāni lalāṭamukhakaṃṭha hṛdayaguhyeṣu nyaset | aruṇavarānamālyānulepanābharaṇabhikṣucāpa puṣpavāṇadharaṃ dhyātvābhyarcya vāhyapūjāṃ kuryāt | paṃcopacārairabhyarcyadevaṃ | aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ | tato vāṇaiḥ | hrīṃ yuvatyai <1> hrīṃ vipralaṃbhāyai <2> hrīṃ jyotsnāyai <3> hrīṃ subhruve <4> hrīṃ madadravāyai <5> hrīṃ suratāyai <6> hrīṃ varuṇāyai <7> hrīṃ lolāyai <8> hrīṃ kāṃtyai <9> hrīṃ saudāminyai <10> hrīṃ kāmachatrāyai <11> hrīṃ caṃdrarekhāyai <12> hrīṃ śuktyai <13> hrīṃ madanāyai <14>
<145b>
hrīṃ māyāvatyai <15> namaḥ iti prādakṣiṇyena pūjayet hrīṃ śokāya <1> hrīṃ mohāya <2> hrīṃ vilāsāya <3> hriṃ vibhramāya <4> hrīṃ madanāturāya <5> hrīṃ patrapāya <6> hrīṃ yūne <7> hrīṃ kāmine <8> hrīṃ cūtapuṣpāya <9> hrīṃ ratipriyāya <10> hrīṃ grīṣmāya <11> hrīṃ tāpāya <12> hrīṃ urjāya <13> hrīṃ hemaṃtāya <14> hrīṃ śiśirāya <15> hrīṃ vasaṃtāya <16> hrīṃ madanāya <8> namaḥ iti kāmaparivārān prāgādiṣu pūjayet | lakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | palāśakusumairdaśāṃśohomaḥ | evaṃ japataḥ pūjayataśca mahālakṣmīprāptirbhavati || atha śatrunigrahaṇamaṃtra (*)(?) na viṃśatyakṣaraḥ | oṃ aṃ kaṃ caṃ ṭaṃ taṃ paṃ yaṃ saṃ haloṃ hrīṃ huṃsaḥ huṃ phaṭ svāhā | asya brahmāṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ mahāparvata mahāsamudra mahāvahni mahāpavana pṛthivīgaṇāni devatāḥ huṃ vījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ iṣṭārthe viniyogaḥ hṛllekhādyaiḥ ṣaḍaṃgāni kuryāt | dhyānaṃ nānyaṃ paśyāmaḥ | pūjādikaṃ mūlamaṃtreṇa kuryāt | ṣaṭsahasrāṇyadhikamayutaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | tilasarṣapataṃḍula vrīhi havirājyaiḥ yathā vibhāgaṃ daśāṃśohomaḥ | śatrunigrahārthamupayuktaḥ prathamamaṃtrākṣaraṃ parvatarūpaṃ śatruṃgrasyamānaṃ ciṃtayet | dvitīyaṃ samudrarūpaṃ tatra nimagnaṃ śatruṃ | tṛtīyamagnirūpaṃ tena dahyamānaṃ | caturthaṃ pavanarūpaṃ tena saṃśoṣyamānaṃ | halomiti varṇadvayena śatrorniḥśvāsaṃ ruṃdhaṃtaṃ ciṃtayet | hrīṃ huṃ saḥ ityakṣara trayeṇa śatrornetrakarṇamukhāniruṃdhaṃtaṃ ciṃtayet | phaṭkāreṇa śatrorādhārāducchitāgninā dahyamānaṃ dhyāyet |
<146a>
evaṃ dhyāyanmaṃtraṃ japanmaṃḍalādarvāk śatruṃ mārayati || atha ṛkpaṃcātmako lavaṇamaṃtraḥ || lavaṇāṃbhasi tīkṣṇosyugrosi hṛdayaṃ tava | lavaṇasya pṛthivī mātālavaṇasya varuṇaḥ pitā <1> | lavaṇaṃ pacati pācayati lavaṇaṃ chiṃdatibhiṃdati | lavaṇed trayamāne tu kuto nidrā kutoratiḥ <2> | amuṣya dahagātrāṇi dahamāṃsaṃ dahatvacaṃ | daṃtatvagasthi lomāni asthibhyo majjikāṃdahoyārātriḥ śalyaviddhasya śūlāgrāropi tasya ca | yā te rātrirmahārātriḥ sā te rātrirmahāniśā <4> | oṃ āṃ hrīṃ kroṃ ciṭiciṭi cāṃḍāli mahācāṃḍāli amukaṃ vaśamānaya svāhā <5> | maṃtrāṃtare idamadhikaṃ paṭhaṃti | lohaprākāre nagare kṛṣṇasarpāṣṭatāṃ tarjule caṃḍisvānayameśīghramagnerlāvaṇatejasā | ityanye ca paṭhaṃti | asyāṃgirā ṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ agnirātri bhadravālyā devatāvaśyādi siddhyarthe viniyogaḥ | ṛgbhiḥ paṃcabhiḥ krameṇa paṃcāṃgaṃ kuryāt | athavā oṃ ciṭiciṭi hṛdayaṃ <1> cāṃḍāli śiraḥ <2> mahācāṃḍāli śikhā <3> amukaṃ me kavacaṃ <4> vaśamānaya netravedhaṃ <5> svāhā astraṃ <6> | dhyānaṃ | aruṇoruṇa paṃkajasaṃnihitaḥ śruvaśaktivasabhayayuktakaraḥ | amitārcirajāṃtagatirvikasannayanatritayo'vatuvodahanaḥ | nīlatarāṃśukakeśakapālānīlatarurnijasvanahārā | sāṃkuśapāṃśakapālāyapābhavatī bhavato'vatu nityaṃ | karakamalavirājaccakraśaṃkhāsiśūlāparilasitakirīṭāpātitānekadaityā trinayana lalitāṃgīpātukātyāyanīvaḥ ||
<146b>
suraudrasitadaṃṣṭrikā trinayanordhakeśolvaṇākapālasaśūlasaḍamarukatriśūlā kulāghanāccanatibhāraṇadrudhirakiṃkinīmālikā bhavadvibhavasiddhaye bhavatu bhadrakālī ciraṃvaḥ | evaṃ dhyātvā paṃcopacāraiḥ pūjayet | ayutaṃ trisahasraṃ vā puraścaraṇaṃ | ghṛtasaṃyuktena haviṣā daśāṃśohomaḥ ||
evaṃ kṛtapuraścaryaḥ prayoge kuśalo bhavet | agniṃ yāmavatiṃ dhyāyedvaśyākarṣaṇakarmaṇo ||
smaret durgāṃ bhadrakālīṃ maṃtrīmāraṇakarmaṇi | jānu pramāṇe salile sthitvā niśijapanmanuṃ ||
anena vāṃchitaḥ sādhyaḥ kiṃkaro jāyate kṣaṇāt | nābhimātre (********)(?) ciraṃ sudhīḥ ||
aṣṭottara sahasraṃ yastasya sādhyo bhavecca saḥ | ṛkyaṃ cakaṃ japenmaṃtrī kaṃṭhamātrāṃbhasi sthitaḥ ||
saptabhirdivasairbhūyovaśayedvidhinā punaḥ | likhitvā tāpapatretāṃ sādhyanāmavidarbhitāṃ ||
nikṣipya kṣīrasaṃmiśrajalena kvathayenniśi | vaśyo bhavati sādhyo syānātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
pācayet khādire vahnau māsaṃ vaśyo bhavennaraḥ ||
atha brahmamaṃtraḥ | oṃ namo bhagavate brahmaṇe aṣṭau me putrājāyaṃtāṃ akṣīṇa tejase svāhā | asya maṃtrasya saurabhi ṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ brahmādevatā oṃ vījaṃ svāhā śaktiḥ aṣṭaputra vahuttara dhanadhānyādi prāptaye viniyogaḥ |
<147a>
oṃ namo bhagavate hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> brahmaṇe śirase svāhā <2> vedhase śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> aṣṭau putrājāyaṃtāṃ kavacāya huṃ <4> akṣīṇa tejase netratrayāya vauṣaṭ <5> svāhā astrāya phaṭ <6> | dhyānaṃ | aruṇakamalasaṃstho raktavarṇo viriṃcirvividharucirabhūpālaṃ kṛto viśvayoniḥ | abhayavarakamaṃḍalvakṣasūtraiḥ svavāhurvitara tu vividhānvo viśvabhogān ca putrān | evaṃ dhyātvā mānasai rūpacārairabhyarcya vidhivadarghaṃ saṃsthāpya ādhārādi pīṭhaṃ parikalpya tadupari aṣṭadalaṃ kamalaṃ kṛtvā pūrvādi krameṇa | aṇimādyai <1> mahimāyai <2> laghimāyai <3> garimāyai <4> prāptyai <5> parikāmyai <6> vaśimāyai <7> kāmānaśāyitāye <8> namaḥ iti daleṣu pūjayet | sarvaiśvaryai namaḥ iti madhye | oṃ namo bhagavate kamalasthāya namaḥ iti pīṭhaṃ pūjayitvā tatkarṇikāyāṃ devamāvāhya pūjayet pādyādibhiḥ | aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ | ūrdhvāya namaḥ <1> pralaṃvāya <2> ūrdhvakeśāya <3> vimohanāya <4> gaṃdhapataye <5> kāmāya <6> kaliṃgāya <7> kapaye namaḥ <8> iti pūrvadalamārabhya pūjayet | lokapālāṃśca svadikṣu | tato yathāśakti japitvā svahṛdidevaṃ vilāpayet | lakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | pāyasena daśāṃśo homaḥ || prātaḥsnāyī vimalakaraṇaḥ śuddhavastrānulepogaṃgāyāṃ vā sariti yadi vānyatratīrye suṣuṇyai |
<147b>
śaive vā mahati madhurāhārabhūtaḥ pavitrācāraiḥ puṇyairanudinamavāpnākhilārthomanasvī | anudinamiti maṃtraṃ saṃjapate | yo maṃtramenaṃ satataṃ dhanasvī vidyābhikāṃkṣī vahuputrakāmī | kiṃvānyakāmī prasabhaṃ labheta aṣṭau dvijān saṃkramayeccaturbhyaḥ | anudinamudaye ca yastrisaṃdhyaṃ śatamathavārddhaśataṃ japecca nityaṃ | salilamapi pivecca maṃtrapūtaṃ sa tu labhate tu dhanaṃ tadiṣṭaputrān | ya imāṃ vṛddhimanvicchan pratipālayate manuṃ | narakottaraṇaṃ tasya pitṛvargasya jāyate || atha subrahmamaṃtraḥ || vacarbhuve namaḥ | eṣa ṣaḍakṣaraḥ sārasvataḥ || varadāya duḥsahinyai vāhule yavacadbhuve | skaṃda skaṃda su subrahmaṇya namaḥ | svāmin guhāśaya | oṃ duṃ namaḥ parāyagoptre ityekaḥ | evamasyepi || atha śāstṛmaṃtraḥ | bhāṃ bhūtādhipataye namaḥ | ayaṃ valijapādau japyatā || athāparaḥ revate namaḥ paṃcākṣaraḥ | adhāsthitaṃ kalpataroḥ śāstāraṃ vasudāyinaṃ | dhyātvā lakṣaṃ japenmaṃtraṃ malaṃ cāmīkarāptaye || atha skaṃdamaṃtraḥ | svāmin vidhi svāhā |
lagnaḥ skaṃdhoni jāṃgasthaḥ kiṃkinī koṭimān viduḥ | kaṃpayan kāmadaṃ vṛkṣaṃ tatphalaiḥ patitairbhuvi ||
hemaratnādibhiḥ pūrṇamātmānaṃ bhāvayenmanuṃ | japettasyāśuvardhaṃte dhanadhānyādi saṃpadaḥ ||
pūrvokta pīṭhedevaṃ pūjayet |
<148a>
devasenā <1> vidyā <2> medhā <3> prajñā <4> śakti <5> kukkuṭa <6> mayūra <7> dvipān <8> pūjayet | evaṃ guhaḥ śrīsarasvatī jayaputra vīryāṇi dadati || atha śāstā |
śāstāraṃ mṛgayāśrāṃtamaśvārūḍhaṃ gaṇāvṛtaṃ | pānīyārthaṃ dhanādeta dhyātvā mṛgarūpiṇaṃ ||
madhyāhne śaktūn datvā asmaipunaraṃ jalinājalaṃ | vinipītamebhirmaṃtraistadgaṇānapi tarpayet ||
viśrāṃtāya namastasmai svakāryāṇi nivedayet | bhūtādhipāya vidmahe bhavaputrāyadhīmahi ||
tannaḥ śāstā pracodayāt | śāstṛparyadbhyo namaḥ | śāstāraṃ pūjayet | valīn rātrau dadyāt | mahāśāstre namaḥ | bhūtādhipataye namaḥ | rudrasūtāya | paṃcakeśvarāya | sādhave | haraye ityādi || atha kṣetrapālamaṃtraḥ | kṣaṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ | ūrdhvapiṃgalākṣaṃ kapālinaṃ khaṭvāṃgapāṇinaṃ sarvabhūṣaṇaṃ dhyāyet | valimaṃtraḥ | ehyehi guṣu <2> muṣu <2> hana <2> vighna <2> mahābhairava kṣetrapāla valiṃ gṛhṇa <2> ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ | analāya ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ agnikeśāya | kālāya | mahākrodhāya | piśitāśanāya | piṃgalākṣāya ūrdhvakeśāya ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ | ebhyo valiṃ dadyāt | vālādi rakṣā sarvaṃ bhavati || atha mālāmaṃtraḥ | athāṣṭaka vargaḥ | a ka ca ṭa ta pa halauṃ | ityaṣṭaka vargajāpenāṣṭa kulaparvatānāṃ nicaya paripaṃthināṃ uparinidhāyaṃ hamityākāśamākṛṣya tadupari nidhāyalamiti pārthivamaṃḍalaṃ taduparisthāpayitvā gadayāvaṣṭabhya niścalī kṛtya ātmano yoganidrāmohanī siṃhoparitiṣṭhaṃtī dhyātvā vanadurgāṃ japan gacchet |
<148b>
sarvabhaya nivṛttirbhavati || atha vāk staṃbhana maṃtraḥ |
caturmukhaṃ yajāmahe mṛtyormukṣīyavardhanaḥ | sarvaṃ ṛtamayāsiṃca sarvaṃ vaṃdhaya vaṃdhaya ||
oṃ hrīṃ valāmukhī āsthāna mukhastaṃbhini mukhaṃ khilaya <2> jihvāṃ khilaya <2> ṭhāṃ ṭhāṃ svāhā || ayaṃ maṃtro rājasabhāyī vāgvādādau japyaḥ || atha paṃcāmṛta maṃtrāḥ || oṃ acyutāya roganāśāya haraye amṛtāya namaḥ oṃ saḥ anaṃtāya roganāśāya haraye amṛtāya namaḥ oṃ vaṃ amṛtāya roganāśāya haraye amṛtāya namaḥ | oṃ aiṃ goviṃdāya roganāśāya haraye amṛtāya namaḥ | oṃ ṭhaṃ viṣṇave roganāśāya haraye amṛtāya namaḥ | oṃ aṃ acyutāya namaḥ | anaṃtāya namaḥ | goviṃdāya namaḥ | viṣṇave namaḥ | ityevaṃ pūjayet | asya maṃtrasya roganāśana ṛṣiranitagāyatrī chaṃdaḥ acyutānaṃtāmṛtagoviṃda viṣṇavo devatā asmaccharīra sakalaroganāśane viniyogaḥ | atha ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | oṃ acyutāya hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> oṃ saṃ anaṃtāya śirase svāhā <2> oṃ vaṃ amṛtāya śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> oṃ aiṃ goviṃdāya kavacāya huṃ <4> oṃ ṭhaṃ viṣṇave astrāya phaṭ <5> | tato dhyānaṃ | kṣīrodasya pradeśe śucimaṇi vilasatsaikatemauktikānāṃ mālāgucchāsanasthaḥ sphaṭikamaṇinibhomauktikairmaṃḍitāṃgaḥ |
<149a>
śubhrairabhrairadabhrairupariparicitairmuktapīyūṣavarṣairānaṃdaṃvaḥ punīyādarinalinagadāśaṃkhapāṇirmukuṃṭaḥ || ayaṃ maṃtro jvarādyutpattau japyaḥ || etanmaṃtrābhimaṃtritamauṣadhādikaṃ bhakṣayet | rogādirnāśaṃ gacchati || atha dhanvaṃtarimaṃtraḥ || oṃ namo bhagavate dhanvaṃtaraye amṛtasahasrāya sarvāmayanāśāya trailokyanāthāya viṣṇave svāhā | asya maṃtrasya brahmā ṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ dhanvaṃtarirdevatā ārogyārthe viniyogaḥ | karpūravarṇamauṣadhasthagikāṃvahaṃtamamṛtena roginaṃ sicaṃcaṃtaṃ dhyāyet | anenauṣadhādikaṃ spṛṣṭvā japannabhi maṃtrayet tadbhakṣaṇe rogopaśāṃtirbhavati || atha gārūḍa maṃtraḥ | kṣipa oṃ svāhā | asyānaṃto ṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ garuḍo devatā sarpādi viṣanāśane viniyogaḥ | jvalajvala mahāgati svāhā hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> garuḍa cūḍāmaṇi svāhā śirase svāhā <2> garuḍa śikhe svāhā śikhāyai ṣaṭ <3> garuḍa prabhaṃjana prabhaṃjana prabhedena prabhedena vitrāsaya <2> vimardaya <2> svāhā kavacāya huṃ <4> aprativalāpratiśāsana huṃ phaṭ svāhā astrāya phaṭ <5> | ugrarūpadhāraka sarpabhayaṃkara bhīṣaya <2> daha <2> bhasmīkurū svāhā netrābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ <6> | tato dhyānaṃ |
ājānunaḥ suvarṇābhamānābhestu hi na prabhaṃ | kuṃkumāruṇamākarṇamākarṇāṃtaṃ śitetaraṃ ||
brahmāṃḍa vyāpinaṃ tākṣyaṃ riktāṃgaṃ nāgabhūṣaṇaṃ |
<149b>
nīlavāsa samātmānaṃ mahāpakṣaṃ smaredvudhaḥ ||
smaran gāruḍamātmānaṃ maṃtrametaṃ japennaraḥ | viṣamālokane naivahanyānnāgakulodbhavaṃ ||
atha citraguptamaṃtraḥ ||
oṃ namo vicitrāya dharmalekhakāya yāmavahikādhikāriṇe jamalavararipuṃjanmasaṃpatpralayaṃ kathaya kathaya svāhā | dhyānāṃ | bhāsvadratnagaṇo jvalaṃ ca mukuṭaṃ bhāsvat prabhāmaṃḍalaṃ vaktraṃ caṃdrasamopamaṃ sukaciraṃ hāraṃ ca tārāgaṇaṃ | karmaṇyatra adharmadharmagaṇanā saṃlekhakāyāniśaṃvaṃde nūpuradhāriṇaṃ ca ruciraṃ rājadvicitraṃ padaṃ | evaṃ japataścitraguptaḥ prasanno bhūtvā dharmamevagaṇaṃ yati na pāpaṃ || atha karṇapiśācikāmaṃtraḥ | oṃ rūṃ hrūṃ devīmamakarmājñānāya kanakavaiḍūryamuktālaṃkṛtaśarīri ehyehi āgacchāgaccha mamakarṇaṃ priviśyaṃ praviśyabhūta bhaviṣyavartamānakālajñānasadarśanaṃ vrūhi vrūhi agniṃ staṃbhajalaṃ staṃbhavākstaṃbhaṃ kuru <2> śatrukārya vighnakārī mamakārya siddhikarīdhātrūṇā mudogahānikarī mamodyogaphalaṃkarī śrīvīracāmuṃḍī huṃ phaṭ svāhā mama śatravaḥ pādāgratalepataṃ tu mama (****##?) raktāṃ varadharāṃ devīṃ raktamālyānulepanāṃ | sādhakaṃ sarvakāmaiśca pūrayaṃtīṃ smaret sadā || sahasraṃ japaḥ | madhuratrayāktaiḥ palāśapuṣpairdaśāṃśohomaḥ || evaṃ kṛtapuraścaraṇasyakarṇe
<150a>
āgatyāgatya devī atīṃdriyajñānaṃ sarvaṃ kathayati lokāṁśca sarvān śatrūṁśca sarvān vaśīkaroti sarvasiddhiṃ ca kurute || atha vāktarparīmaṃtraḥ | sarpariramariṃ vādhamānāvṛhanmimābjamadagnidattā āsūryasya duhitā tanmanaḥ śravo devodeveghamṛtayurya apasarparīrasarpagesmānupasuṣṭuretu |
nābhirbrahmāhariryasyā hṛtpradeśe sthitaḥ śivaḥ | pādāśca vedāścatvāroravicaṃdrāvubhau dṛśaḥ ||
aṃgāni vedasthānāni pucchaṃ romāṇi devatāḥ | oṃ nakulīṃ raktavarṇāṃtāṃ naumi vyāptāṃ sarasvatīṃ ||
asya viśvāmitra ṛṣistriṣṭup chaṃdaḥ vāktarparī devatā vāksiddhaye viniyogaḥ | imaṃ maṃtraṃ japato'vyāhataprasarāvāgbhavati || atha nakulī maṃtraḥ | oṃṣṭhāpidhānāṃ nakulīdatta parimitaḥ paviḥ jihvemavihvalevācaṃ cānumāvehavādaya | asya viśvāmitra ṛṣirgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ nakulī sarasvatī devatā vāksiddhyarthe viniyogaḥ | anyat pūrvavat || atha mahārātri maṃtraḥ || oṃ namo rātrigaṇebhyaḥ sarvavaśya karebhyaḥ parigṛhṇaṃ tu sarvavaśyāya sarvaśāṃtaye valiṃ tasmai svāhā | asya brahmāṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ mahārātrirdevatāvaśyādi siddhyarthe viniyogaḥ | homādāvayameva valimaṃtraḥ || kṣrauṃ ityanena valiṃ dadyāt || atha viśvāvasugaṃdharvamaṃtraḥ | oṃ gaṃdharvarājaviśvāvasomamābhilaṣita kanyāṃ prayaccha svāhā |
<150b>
imaṃ maṃtraṃ prārthitakanyārthī paścimābhimukho bhūtvā japet tāṃ prāpnoti || athāparaḥ | viśvāvasunāmagaṃdharvaḥ kanyānāmadhipatiryathā | sakośāṃ labhate kanyāṃ tasmai viśvāvasave namaḥ | ayamapi pūrvavat || atha rāvaṇamaṃtraḥ || oṃ namo bhagavate rāvaṇāya daśakaṃdharāya rāmaprayuddhakaṃdharāya rāmaprayuddhakarāya śivabhaktāya caturveda viduṣe namo namo namaḥ || ayaṃ rākṣasādibhītaujapyaḥ || atha pratyaṃgirāmaṃtraḥ | oṃ yāṃ kalpayatinorayaḥ krūrāṃ kṛtyāṃvabhūviva | tāṃ brahmābhibhūtyai pratyak kartāramicchatu | asya brahmāṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ pratyaṃgirā devatā oṃ vījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ iṣṭārthe viniyogaḥ | praṇavaṃ oṃ hrīṃ ādau hrīṁ oṃ aṃte iti kecit hṛllekhāpuṭito japyaḥ | karaśuddhiṃ vidhāya | oṃ yāṃ kalpayati norayaḥ hrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> krūrāṃ kṛtyāṃ hrīṃ śiraḥ <2> vabhūvivahrūṃ śikhā <3> tāṃ brahma hraiṃ kavacaṃ <4> abhibhūtyai hrauṃ netratrayaṃ <5> pratyakkartāramicchatuhnaḥ astraṃ <6> | dhyānaṃ | khaḍgacarmadharāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ muktakeśīṃ śivāracanāṃ | daṃṣṭrākarālavadanāṃbhīṣaṇāṃ sarvabhūṣaṇāṃ | grasaṃtīṃ vairiṇaṃ dhyāyet preritāṃ śivatejasā | lakṣyaṃ japyaḥ | apāmārga samidbhirdaśāṃśo homaḥ || athāparaḥ pratyaṃgirāmaṃtraḥ | oṃ hrīṃ namaḥ kṛṣṇavāsasese tu sahasrasiṃhavāhini sahasranetravadane mahāvale aparājite nijavala rakṣiṇi paravalavidhvaṃsini paramaṃtrotsādini
<151a>
sarvabhūtadamani sarvadevān vaṃdhavaṃdha sarvavidyāṃcchiṃvicchiṃdhi kṣobhaya <2> paraṃ yaṃtrāṇi sphoṭaya <2> sarvaśṛṃkhalāṃ troṭaya <2> jvalajvālā jihvā karālavadane pratyaṃgire hrīṃ namaḥ | asya siddhimaṃtratvāt ṛṣyādikaṃ nāsti || dhyānaṃ |
siṃhārūḍhāṃ kṛṣṇavastrāṃ bhīṣaṇāṃ nīlavigrahāṃ | jvālāmukhīṃ śūlakarāṃgrasaṃtīṃ ripumaṃjasā ||
anyat sarvaṃ pūrvavat ||
atha sahasrākṣarī pratyaṃgirā | oṃ namaścāmuṃḍenarakapālāṃkamālādhare gṛdhrolūkakāraṃḍakaparivāre śmaśānapriye narakapālahuṃkāra jṛṃbhīnīye asimukhalapavitomarakṣurikā vigrahe sahasravāhudhāriṇau karahṛdaya viṣṇubhāvaśarīre sarvaduṣṭānnāśayāgniṃ vidhāraya <2> naraśarīraṃ rakṣa <2> narāṇāṃ nirviṣaṃ kuru <2> ripūn nāśaya <2> duṣṭān prothaya <2> vṛkṣāṃ na cūrṇaya <2> astramastraṃ kurusenāṃ troṭaya <2> gonasānāṃsārikāṇāṃmaśakānāṃ tuṃḍavaṃdhaṃ kuru <2> drāṃ drīṃ drūṃ draiṃ drauṃ draḥ ekaviṃśati japādagniṃ vidhāralalaṃvakeśe pralaṃvakeśenīlāṃvaresitaśārdūla priye mahāvartakārān bhairavarūpeṇa hara <2> svaratarūpeṇā hara <2> gaccha <2> rudrarūpeṇa yatkāla dṛṣṭaṃ tatsarvamucchāpayocchāpaya kālakūṭaviṣaṃ nirviṣī kuru <2> jvaraṃ nāśayaikāhikaṃ dvyāhikaṃ tryāhikaṃ cāturthikaṃ dṛṣṭi jvaraṃ sānnipātikaṃ satatajvaraṃ lākṣiṇikaṃ vā guggulu dhūpenāṣṭābhi
<151b>
maṃtritena jvaraṃ nāśaya <2> gauraśarṣapānabhimaṃtryasusārikā piṃḍaṃ vadhnāmi ākarṣayākarṣayakṣatriyāvaiśyāviṭ sūdrāraṃgiṇī mohinī cāṃḍālyaṣṭādaśa prakṛtīnāṃ vikṛta daṃṣṭrā karālinīnāṃ parvatanitaṃvavāsinīnāṃ ujjayinī nivāsinīnāṃ bhasmojvaritaśarīre namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ hrāṃ yeṃ kṣoṃ kroṃ namaḥ svāhā | asya ṛṣyādikaṃ nāsti |
eṣā tu paramavidyā trisahasreṇa siddhyati | jāpyena taddaśāṃśena juhuyāttilarājikāḥ ||
dhyānaṃ |
vyāghra carmāṃvaradharāsita śārdūlavāhinī | vikarālamukhītigmadaṃṣṭrā kṛṣṇātibhīṣaṇā ||
dadhatī kṣurikā vajraśūlatomarakaṃkaraiḥ | bhasmoddhūlita sarvāṃgī nīlakucitamūrdhvajā ||
bhayakārita duṣṭānāṃ bhaktānāma bhayapradā | ciṃtanīyā sadānānyaṃ cetasā parameśvarī ||
etanmaṃtraṃḍākinī bhutaśatrunigrahādau japyaṃ ||
atha jvaranāśanamaṃtraḥ |
kuveraṃtamukhaṃ raudraṃ naṃdīmānaṃdamāvaha | jvaraṃ mṛtyuṃ bhayaṃghoraṃ jvaraṃ nāśayamejvara ||
sarvadiśaṃvaṃdha paścimadiśaṃvaṃdha uttaradiśaṃ vaṃdha ekāhikaṃ dvyāhikaṃ tryāhikaṃ divājvaraṃ rātrijvaraṃ saṃdhyājvaramākasmikajvaraṃ sarveṣāṃ chedaya <2> kledaya <2> bhiṃdhi <2> chiṃdhi <2> muśalena hana <2> viṣṇucakreṇa chedaya <2> mahāsumukhi svāhā || ayaṃ maṃtraḥ sarvajvarejapyaḥ | tālapatrādau likhitvā yasmin vaṃdhayet sadyastaṃ muṃcati jvaraḥ || atha kārtavīryojvaramaṃtraḥ |
<152a>
kārtavīryārjuno nāmarājā vāhusahasrabhṛt | tasya saṃsmaraṇā devahṛtaṃ naṣṭaṃ ca labhyate svāhā || asya dattātreya ṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ kārtavīryārjuno devatā naṣṭadravyacaurādibhayanāśārthe viniyogaḥ | hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ hraiṃ hrauṃ hraḥ kārtavīrya hariṃ ṛṣiriti ṣaḍaṃgaṃ | dhyānaṃ | sahasravāhuṃ śaraṇaṃ mupāśaṃ raktāṃvaraṃ raktakirīṭaṃ kuṃḍalaṃ | caurādi duṣṭabhayanāśanamiṣṭadattaṃ vaṃde mahāvala vijṛṃbhitakārtavīryaṃ || athāparomaṃtraḥ | oṃ namo bhagavate kārtavīryārjunāya sahasravāhave vahuvalavīryeṇa sarvacaurānstaṃbhaya <2> mohaya <2> māraya <2> huṃ phaṭ svāhā | asya dattātreya ṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ śrīkārtavīryārjuno mahāviṣṇurdevatā caurādibhaya vyāvṛttyarthe viniyogaḥ ṣaḍaṃgaṃ pūrvavat | dhyānaṃ | dordaṃḍaikasahasrasaṃmitatanuḥ svetasrajaḥ prollasatkodaṃḍaiścaśarairudagraviśikhairudyadvivasvatprabhaḥ | brahmāḍaiḥ paripūrayaṁstadakhilaṃ gaṃḍadvayollālitaṃdyo tatkuṃḍalamaṃḍito vijayate śrīkārtavīryoviduḥ || athāparomaṃtraḥ | kṛtavīryasuto rājāsahasrabhujamaṃḍalaḥ avatāro hareḥ sākṣātpālayet sakulaṃ mama || asya dattātreya ṛṣiramitā gāyatrī chaṃdaḥ | dattātreya priyāya hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> māhiṣmatīnāthāya śirase svāhā <2> revājalakrīḍā tuṣṭāya śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> haihayādhipatayekavadhāraṇa
<152b>
parvatotpāṭana kumārabrahmacārin gaṃbhīraśaṣṭa sarvavigrahavināśana sarvajvarotsādanaḍākinī vidhvaṃsa na hrīṃ hrīṃ hrāṃ hyaiṃ ehi sarvaviṣaṃ harahara <4> ravalaṃ kṣobhayoṃ huṃ phaṭ svāhā || hanū tanū maṃtrasyeśvara ṛṣistriṣṭup chaṃdaḥ hanūmān devatā sakalakopadrava śāṃtyarthe viniyogaḥ | aṃjanā sutāya hṛdayaṃ <1> rudramūrtaye śiraḥ <2> vāyusutāya śikhā <3> agnigarbhāya kavacaṃ <4> madūtāyanetraṃ <5> brahmāstra nivāraṇāyāstraṃ <6> | ekavīratvātpari(**)(?)dikaṃ nāsti | etena sarveṇa sarvaṃ sādhaye | ityādayeneke prayogāmaṃtrāśca jāyaṃtete graṃthagauravānnalikhitāḥ || atha prāṇapratiṣṭhāmaṃtraḥ || prāṇapratiṣṭhāmaṃtraṃ vinārvemaṃtrāvyarthāḥ | tathā coktaṃ | prāṇapratiṣṭhāna manorvidhānaṃ pravakṣyate saṃprati sarvasiddhyai | yasmādṛte'mīkathitāḥ prayogāvyarthī bhaveyurgattajīvakalpāḥ | maṃtrastu | āṃ hrīṃ kroṃ ya ra la va śa ṣa sa hauṃ haṃsaḥ mama prāṇā iha prāṇāḥ mamajīvahasthitaḥ | mama sarveṃdriyāṇi vāṅmanaścakṣuḥ śrotra jihvā ghrāṇā prāṇā ihaivāgatyāgatyasukhaṃciraṃ tiṣṭhaṃ tu svāhā haṃsaṃ || prāṇapratiṣṭhā maṃtrasya brahmaviṣṇurudrāṛṣayaḥ ṛgyajuḥ sāmātharvāṇi chaṃdāṃsi sakala jagatsṛṣṭikāriṇaṃ prāṇaśaktirdevatā āṃvījaṃ kroṃ śaktiḥ vaśyākarṣaṇavidveṣasāstaṃbhanoccāṭana māraṇārthe viniyogaḥ | oṃ pṛthivyācāya huṃ <4> sahasravāhave astrāya phaṭ <5> ||
<153a>
athāparaḥ || oṃ proṃ namo bhagavate kārtaṃ vīryārjunāya hai hayakārtavīryārjuna sahasrakarasahasradṛśasahasraduṣṭāṃtaka sarvaśiṣṭeṣṭa pada udadhe rāgaṃ tu kāmasmadvasuluṃpakān caurasamūhān svakarasahasrairnivāraya <2> raṃdha <2> svapāśahastairvaṃdha <2> svāṃkuśa sahasrairākhaṃḍayākhaṃḍayasvadhāyodgatairvāṇa sahasrairmardaya <2> svaśaṃkhodgatanādasahasrairbhīṣaya <2> svahastodgata vajra sahasrairnikṛṃtaya <2> parakṛtaṃ trāsaya <2> garjayāgarjaya ākarṣaya <2> bhrāsaya <2> mohaya <2> mādaya <2> unmādaya <2> tāpaya <2> dīpaya <2> śoṣaya <2> vidāraya <2> staṃbhaya <2> jṛṃbhaya <2> vijṛṃbhaya <2> māraya <2> vaśīkuru <2> uccāṭaya <2> vināśaya <2> dattātreya śrīpāda priyatama śrīkārtavīryārjuna sarvaṃta udadheṃ rāgatān vasuluṃpakān corasamūhān samyagunmūla <2> huṃ phaṭ svāhā | asya ṛṣyādikaṃ ṣaḍaṃgaṃ dhyānaṃ ca pūrvavat || oṃ bhrāṃ paritomebhramyannavyāddvidyut samaprabhaḥ sarvatomebhramyannavyāddhanvīvāṇī raviprabhaḥ | ityādayo'nekemaṃtrāḥ saṃti tān graṃtha gauravānnalikhāmaḥ || atha hanūmanmaṃtraḥ | oṃ namo bhagavate hanūmate prakaṭaparākramāya ākrāṃtadiṅmaṃḍalāya yaśovilāsadhavalīkṛtadiṅmaṃḍalāya vajradeha rudrāvatāralaṃkāpurīdahana udadhi vaṃdhana daśagrīva kṛtāṃtasītāśvāsanāyuta nāgavalāṃjanā garbhasaṃbhūta rāmalakṣmaṇānaṃdakakapisainyaprākārasugrīvasā
<153b>
tejovādvākāśātmanenabhaḥ aṃ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ṅaṃ āṃ jñānātmane hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> oṃ śaṣṭasparśarūparasagaṃdhātmane namaḥ iṃ caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ ñaṃ īṃ śaktyai śirase svāhā <2> oṃ śrotratvak cakṣurghrāṇātmane namaḥ oṃ ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ huṃ valāyai śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> oṃ vākyāṇi pāyupāda upasthātmane namaḥ eṃ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ aiṃ aiśvaryāya kavacāya huṃ <4> oṃ vacanādāna gamana visargānaṃ dātmane namaḥ oṃ paṃ phaṃ vaṃ bhaṃ maṃ āṃ tejase netratrayāya vauṣaṭ <5> oṃ namo vuddhyahaṃkāracittajñānātmane namaḥ aṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ laṃ kṣaṃ aḥ vīryāyāstrāya phaṭ <6> || ānābhimārabhya hṛdayaparyaṃtaṃ nyaset <1> hrīṃ hṛdayamārabhya nābhiparyaṃtaṃ nyaset <2> kroṃ mūrdhāna mārabhya hṛdayāṃtaṃ nyaset <3> samastena vyāpakaṃ <4> || dhyānaṃ | raktāghripottāruṇa padmasaṃsthāṃ pāśāṃkuśā vikṣuśarāsanajyān | śūlaṃ kapālaṃ dadhatīṃ karābjai raktāṃ trinetrāṃ praṇamāmidevīṃ | evaṃ dhyātvā trikoṇasthe śaktipīṭhe devīmāvāhya pūjayet | brahmaṇe <1> viṣṇave <2> īśvarāya <3> namaḥ iti koṇatraye | sarasvatyai <1> lakṣmyai <2> umāyai <3> nama iti koṇatraye | tato ṣaḍaṃgaṃ pūjayet | tadvahiraṣṭa daleṣu brāhmyādayaḥ | tadvahirlokapālāḥ | yathāśakti japitvā visarjayet |
<154a>
lakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | ghṛtaptutaiścaturbhirdaśāṃśo homaḥ ||
evaṃ saṃsādhito maṃtraḥ ṣaṭkarma phalado bhavet | sthāpayenmanunānena prāṇān sarvatra deśikaḥ ||
vījāṃtemavaśaṣṭānāmādaudūtyaḥ prayojayet | mṛtā vai vasvatā bhūyo jīvahā prāṇahā tataḥ ||
ākṛṣṭāgraranā eṣā pramadāvisphuliṃginī | kṣetra pratigṛhītvetāḥ prāṇadūtyo navasmṛtāḥ ||
pāśenavaddha ceṣṭasya śaktyā svīkṛta cetasaḥ | aṃkuśenāhṛtasyābhiḥ sādhyasyāsūnsamāharet ||
dvādaśāṃgulamānena kṛtvā sādhyasya puttalīṃ | tasyāṃ prāṇātmikaṃ maṃtraṃ sa kīṭaṃ hṛdivinyaset ||
niśītha samaye sādhye supte tasya hṛdaṃvuje | daleṣu vāyuvahnīṃdravaruṇānāmataḥ paraṃ ||
īśarākṣasaśītāṃśuyamānāṃ karṇikāṃtare | yādon haṃsasamāyuktān bhṛṃgākārānanusmaret ||
śiroviṃdusamudbhūtaṃ taṃtu saṃvaddha vigrahān | evaṃ sādhyahṛdaṃbhoje bhṛṃgī rūpāṃdhiyā smaret ||
ātmahṛtpadmagān bhṛṃgān prasthāpyaśvātasavartmanā | ekaikaṃ sādhyahṛtpadmebhṛṃgamekaikamānayet ||
puttalyāṃ sthāpayenmaṃtrī svacitte vā vidhānavat | taṃtucchedaṃ prakurvīta vahnivījena saṃyataḥ ||
ākṛṣṭā sādhyabhṛdbhṛṃgāṁstatastaṃstaṃbhayedbhuvā | evamekādaṃśāvṛttiṃ kuryāt sarveṣu karmasu ||
<154b>
asyārthaḥ |
pūrvaviṃdūcchaṃtaṃtuṃ vardhānyādīn bhṛṃgīrūpeṇa prasthāpya sādhyahṛdisthitān prāṇānākṛṣya svahṛdayeputtalpādausthāpayet lamiti vījenetyuktaṃ sthāpanānaṃtaraṃ vahnivījenarephetatuṃchayediti | evamekādaśavāraṃ pratiprayogaṃ sādhyahṛtprāṇānākṛṣya svahṛdayeputtalpādauvāstaṃbhayediti rahasyaṃ ||
vaśyākarṣaṇayoryādīnaruṇān staṃbhayetsudhīḥ | mohadveṣaṇayordhūmrān kṛṣṇān māraṇakarmaṇi ||
pītānsaṃstaṃbhane dhyāyet prāṇākarṣaṇakarmaṇi ||
ākṛṣṭānsādhya hṛtprāṇān sthāpayedātmano hṛdi | krūrakarmasu puttalyāṃ teṣāṃ sthāpanabhīritaṃ ||
prāṇān sādhyasyamaṃḍūkānātmanastu bhujaṃgakān | saṃsmarettatra nipuṇaḥ sadā krūreṣu karmasu ||
vādvagniśakravaruṇeśvara rākṣaseṃdupreteśa patralikhitairathayādivarṇaiḥ | viṃdvaṃtikaiḥ kṣagamahaṃ sasametasādhyaṃ prāṇātma yaṃtramatha varṇābhṛtaṃdharāsthaṃ | evaṃ prayogakuśalomanunānena maṃtravit | vaśayet sakalān devān kiṃ punaḥ pārthivān janān || prakārastvayaṃ | devadatta prāṇā iha | prāṇā ityuktvā puttalyāṃ prāṇānākarṣayet | yaṃ bhūtātmanetva ca mākarṣayāmi <1> raṃ vaivasvatātmane raktamākarṣayāmi <2> | laṃ jīvahātmātmane māṃsamākarṣayāmi <3> | vaṃ prāṇahātmanemedamākarṣayāmi <4> | śaṃ prāvṛṣyātmane snāyumākarṣayāmi <5> |
<155a>
ṣaṃ gūthikātmane asthīnyākarṣayāmi <6> | saṃ pramodātmane aṃgalomānyākarṣayāmi <7> | haṃ visphuliṃgātmane medamākarṣayāmi <8> | kṣaṃ kṣaṃ triprahāriṇsatmane sarvadhātūnākarṣayāmi <9> | evaṃ vaśyādau voddhavyaṃ | vaśayāmi vidveṣayāmi mohayāmi mārayāmi ityādyūhyaṃ || atha sarveṣāṃ devānāmeka daivapūjākramaḥ kathyate | gurūpadeśaḥ prāptaḥ || oṃ aiṃ īṃ aṃ ūṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya viṣṇuryoniṃ kalpayatu tvaṣṭā rūpāṇiyāṃ | śa tu āsiṃca tu prajāpatirddhātāgarbhaṃ dadhātute śrīṃ aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ | oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ tatsaviturvareṇiyaṃ bhargodevasyadhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt hrīṃ hlaiṃ hlīṃ hlauṃ | oṃ tryaṃvakaṃ yajāmahe sugaṃdhiṃ puṣṭivardhanaṃ | urvārukamiva vaṃdhanānmṛtyormukṣīyamāmṛtāt klīṃ sahasakalaraiṃ hklāṃ hsrauḥ | kṛṣṇāya goviṃdāya gopījanavallabhāya svāhā pratadviṣṇustavate vīryeṇa mṛgona bhīmaḥ kucarogiriṣṭhāḥ | yasyoruṣu triṣu vikramaṇeṣvadhikṣiyaṃti bhuvanāni viśvāḥ | glauṃha sakalaraḍaiṃhasakalaraṃḍīhasakalaraṃḍau syonā pṛthivīnobhavānṛccharāṇiveśanī yacchānaḥ śarmaśaprathāḥ | oṃ namo bhagavate varāharūpāya bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ yataye bhūpatitvaṃme dehi dāpaya svāhā | haṃsaḥ śuciṣaṭvasuraṃtarikṣasaddhotā vediṣasaditiduronasat nṛṣadvarasadṛtasadvyoma sadajjāgojāṛtajā adrijāritaṃ vṛhat |
<155b>
gaṃkapaṭala hrīṃ sahakala hrīṃ gaṇānāṃtvā gaṇapatiṃ hava | mahekavīkavīnāmupastavastavaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ rājaṃ brahmaṇāṃ brahmaṇasyata | ānaḥ śṛnbhūtibhiḥ sīdaspadanaṃ oṃ bhūḥ oṃ bhuvaḥ oṃ svaḥ oṃ mahaḥ oṃ janaḥ oṃ tapaḥ oṃ satyaṃ tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargodevasyadhīmahyoṃ | jātavedasesuna vāma somamarāhī yato nidahāṃ vedaroṃ hrīṃ duṃ durgāyai namaḥ | jvalajvalaśūlini duṣṭagraha huṃ phaṭ svāhottiṣṭha puruṣi kiṃ svapiṣiṃbhayaṃme samupasthitaṃ yadiśakyamaśakyaṃ huṃ duṃ durge bhagavati śamaya svāhā | parṣadati durgāṇi viśvānāveva siṃdhuṃ duritātyagniroṃdhiyolaḥ pracodayādoṃmāyojyoti rasomṛtaṃ brahmabhūrbhuvaḥ svaroṃ | paropajasisyavadoṃvyoṃ ravyoṃhamuttiṣṭhaharipiṃgalalohitākṣa yakṣāya su kuverāya vaiśravaṇāya dhanadhānyadhipataye dhanadhānyasamṛddhiṃmedehidāpaya svāhā | gagalaṃrīgrīṃ namo mahāgaṇapataye gaṇapatyai varevaradekṣmyaiṃ | oṃ namaḥ śivāya namo nārāyaṇāya tryaṃvakaṃ yajāmahe sugaṃdhiṃ puṣṭivardhanaṃ | urvārukamivavaṃdhanānmṛtyormukṣīyamāmṛtāt sarvajanaṃmeva śamānayakṣipraprasādanāya namaḥ oṃ namo nārāyaṇa svāhā ||
<156a>
ayaṃ mahāmaṃtraḥ sarvadeva sādhāraṇaḥ | āgamavaidikamayāḥ | asya ṛṣyādikaṃ nāsti || atha brahmaviṣṇurudrātmako maṃtraḥ ||
haṃsātmakoyamayāmagnestejasādīpyamānaḥ | sano bhṛtyostrāyatāṃ namo brahmaṇe viśvanābhi ||
rugraṃvaraṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ jvalaṃtaṃ viśvatomukhaṃ | nṛsiṃhabhīṣaṇaṃ bhadraṃ mṛtyumṛtyuṃ namāmyahaṃ ||
tryaṃvakaṃ yajāmahe sugaṃdhiṃ puṣṭivardhanaṃ | urvārukamivavaṃdhanānmṛtyormukṣīyamāmṛtāt ||
asya maṃtrasya vaśiṣṭa ṛṣayaḥ anuṣṭubhau chaṃdasī brahmaviṣṇurudrādevatā iṣṭārthe viniyogaḥ | haṃsātmakoyamugraṃ vīraṃ tryaṃvakaṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> apāmagne mahāviṣṇuṃ yajāmahe śirase svāhā <2> tejasādīpyamānaṃ jvalaṃtaṃ sarvatomukhaṃ sugaṃdhaṃ puṣṭiṃvardhanaṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> sanomṛtyostrāyatāṃ nṛsiṃhabhīṣaṇaṃbhadraṃ urvārukamiva vaṃdhanāt kavacāya huṃ <4> namo brahmaṇe mṛtyumṛtyuṃ mṛtyormukṣīya netratrayāya vauṣaṭ <5> viśvanābhirnamāmyahaṃ māmṛtāt astrāya phaṭ <6> |
ityasmāt pratilomena svaramaṃtraṃ havirbhujaḥ | uddharet prayato bhūtvāviyatpūrvaṃ saviṃdukaṃ ||
sva evamapratiṣṭaśca śriyāgaṃdhayahaṃ vadet | vāyuṃ ca viṃdumapyuktātaṃ vai mānadayā punaḥ ||
sajñānā mṛtayā prāṇā urcārānnabha udbhavaḥ |
<156b>
pūrvarṇāyā viśvagaṃ vidyācchaśinaṃ vyomagaṃ punaḥ ||
pratiṣṭhāṃtamathoddhṛtya tayā sahakhale vadet | anayā prāṇamuddhṛtya yathā vaditi maṃtravit ||
kṛtyāstrametattenaivaripoḥ prāṇān dhiyā haret | ādhārāducchitāyāstu suṣumnāṃtaragāḥ punaḥ ||
kuṃḍalī vyomagā bhūtvā jvalaṃtī sarṣasaṃnibhā | sāvaktrāṃtaragā bhūtvā śatruṃ pratinivartyasā ||
svāgāre praviśet sadyaḥ paṃcāgni samavāyake | saptāhāt mrīyate'rātirnātrakāryā vicāraṇā ||
sarṣayaṃkuṭuvaṃjaptaṃ tattailena ca lolitaṃ | citāgnau juhuyādūktairarddharātre ripuḥ punaḥ ||
mrīyate sārdhamāsena kṛtyāstra jvālayāhataḥ | citāgni sakalānaṣṭau vraṇa tailayutāni ca ||
ardharātre caturdaśyāṃ juhuyāt saptavārataḥ | mrīyaterirna saṃdehaḥ kṛtyāstra jvālayāhataḥ ||
tuṣāsthibhyāṃ pratikṛtiṃ kṛtvārdhaśikhivairiṇaḥ ||
samīraṇaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya vraṇatailena lohitaṃ | chitvā chitvājaraktena saptāhaṃ juhuyādriṣuḥ ||
mrīyate nātrasaṃdehaḥ kṛtyāstra jvālayāhataḥ | vālukaṃ sākṣataṃ gṛhya japedayuta maṃtravit ||
sādhitamapsuvikiredaṇavāyathepsitaṃ | tajjalaṃ dahati kṣipramāgneyāstrābhimaṃtritaṃ ||
āsaptalokaṃ lokāṁśca sadahenmaṃtravittamaḥ | sadehaṃ yaktato dhyātvā vāṃchitaṃta tryahādripuṃ ||
<157a>
nakṣatra vṛkṣa prakṛtiṃ kṛtvānyaistaṃ samīraṇaṃ | tīkṣṇatailokṣitāṃ japtāṃ kṛtyāstreṇa vardakeniśi ||
chitvāgataścitā vahnau hunet saptāhato mṛtaḥ | nakṣatravṛkṣaḥ asya sādhyasyayannakṣatraṃ tadvṛkṣaḥ ||
kāraskarośayadhātrīsyāduduṃvara taruḥ punaḥ | jaṃvuḥkhadira kṛṣṇākhyau vaṃśapippalasaṃjñakau ||
nādārohitanāmānaupalā (*)(?) śaplakṣa saṃjñakau | aṃvaṣṭa vilvārjunākhyavikaṃkitamahīruhāḥ ||
vakulaḥ sāvaraḥ sarjovaṃjulaḥ panasārkakau | śamīkadaṃdhāṃmraniṃvamadhūkāṛkṣaśākhinaḥ ||
caturdaśyāmathāṃgāre madhyarātre citodbhavaṃ | bhasmasaṃgṛhya yatnena mahiṣyājyena bhāvitaṃ ||
catvāriṃśa catuḥ pūrvaṃ guṭikāstatra kārayet | tāścājaraktasaṃsiktāḥ pratiṣṭita samīraṇāḥ ||
citākāṣṭaudhite cāgne juhuyānmrīyate ripuḥ | caturdaśyāṃ prayogoyaṃ munibhiḥ kathitaḥ purā ||
māhiṣe paṃcagavye tu rājibhasmacitodbhavaṃ | nikṣipya kvāthayedhyānakālāgni sadṛśānanaṃ ||
japenmanuṃ surākṣaṃ ca śoṣitaṃ varjayettadā | citikāṣṭena cityagnau durgāgāyaṃ hutaṃ hunet ||
samūlatūlamādāya lāṃgalīṃ raktavārake | ajāgaṃdhī yathāvaccakarakrośanikāmapi ||
markaṭīmapita ucca yathāvadayutaṃ japet | caturdaśyāmathāṃgāre madhyarātre gṛhāṃtare ||
<157b>
