<158a>
gabhiṣyati ripuḥ kṣipraṃ yamakṣayama saṃśayaṃ ||
avagāhya suvāṇajñastādṛśaṃ viṃvagaṃ ripuṃ | savituḥ prayato dhyāyejjapanmaṃtraṃ ca śaktitaḥ ||
śataṃ vātha śatārdhaṃ vā saptāhānmrīyate ripuḥ | yatra yatrasthito maṃtrī śucinyastamanustathā ||
sūryodayaṃ samārabhyayāvadastaṃ gato raviḥ | tāvatkālaṃ manuṃjapyādvidvān saptāhamādarāt ||
sannipāta jvarākrāṃto ripuḥ prāṇān vimuṃcati | durgāgāre manuṃ siddho varjitānna strirātrataḥ ||
japedavirataṃ dhyāyan dināstrāgnihataṃ ripuṃ | tadayaṃ mṛtyumāyāti śatrurjvaravimohitaḥ ||
bhāvaṃ yan dinavātena ripuḥ janmarkṣa saṃbhavaṃ | ākṛtiṃ sthāpitaṃ prānnikṣipyollodake japet ||
ayutaṃ ca tryahādarvāk mṛtiṃ gacchati mohitaḥ | durgāyāḥ purato maṃtrī kuṃḍaṃ kṛtvā trikoṇakaṃ ||
tadagrāgni vidhānena prajapitvā samāhitaḥ | māhiṣaṃ gomayaṃ gṛhya ajaraktāktamastravit ||
tena pratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā pratiṣṭhita samīraṇāṃ | riporjaptādināstreṇa dhyāyan vai caṃḍikāṃ punaḥ ||
mahiṣorasthalasthāṃ ca śūlapiṃḍittamastakāṃ | nṛtyaṃtī tadurāraṃgaḥ ṣoḍaśārdhakarairyutāṃ ||
hāhākārairasadriśca huṃkāreṇa hutāsuraiḥ | hṛtāṃ trailokya saṃhārāṃ jvālānalavirājitāṃ ||
ghūrṇitā netrayugmāṃtāṃsaṃ daṣṭādharapallavāṃ | khaḍgakheṭaka saṃyuktāṃ kanyakābhiḥ samāvṛtāṃ ||
chitvā citvā niśāmadhye kṣatajena hunet punaḥ |
<158b>
tryahācca gacchati paraḥ paralokaṃ sa putrakaḥ ||
atha brahmaṇe'nuṣṭup ||
haṃsātmako yamayāmagnestejasā dīpyamānaḥ | sanāmṛtyostrāyatāṃ namo brahmaṇe viśvanābhiḥ ||
asya prajāpati ṛṣiranuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ brahmā devatādhana putrādi siddhyarthe viniyogaḥ | haṃsātmako yaṃ hṛdayaṃ <1> apāmagneḥ śiraḥ <2> tejasādīpyamānaḥ śikhā <3> sanomṛtyostrāyatāṃ kavacaṃ <4> namo brahmaṇe netraṃ <5> viśvanābhiḥ astraṃ <6> dhyānaṃ |
arkaughāyutasaṃkāśaṃ raktavastraṃ mahātanuṃ | sruk srucau cākṣamālāṃ kamaṃḍaluṃ kairdhṛtāṃ ||
caturmukha mudārāṃgamālolāyatalocanaṃ | jaṭādharaṃ jagadyoniṃkuṃḍalābhyāṃ virājitaṃ ||
hārakeyūra valayagnaiveyormibhirāvṛtaṃ | sarvartu kusumaiḥ śubhraiḥ sarvavarṇiralaṃkṛtaṃ ||
ādyairdevarṣi siṃhaiśca sevyamānaṃ samaṃ tataḥ | udgiraṃtaṃ śrutīrdikṣuśākhābhedena dik kramān ||
evaṃ dhyātvā japenmaṃtraṃ maṣṭottaraśataṃ punaḥ |
atha pūjā |
mānasika pūjānaṃtaraṃ vāhyapūjāṃ ca kuryāt |
ādhārādi pīṭhaṃ saṃpūjya tadupari aṣṭadalaṃ kamalaṃ parikalpya pūrvādi dikṣu nityāyai <1> śraddhāyai <2> dhārāyai <3> pāvanyai <4> yogāyai <5> śikhāyai <6> dhāyinyai <7> namaḥ iti pūjayet | tatkarṇikāyāṃ devamāvāhya mudrāḥ pradarśya gāyatryā arghaṃ dadyāt <1> hastābhyāmiti pādyaṃ dadyāt <2>
<159a>
hiraṇyamaṃtreṇā camanaṃ <3> mūlamaṃtreṇa madhuparkaṃ <4> dhruvāsutveti snānaṃ <5> yuvastrāṇīti vastraṃ <6> haṃsa dṛṣaditi yajñopavītaṃ <7> vyāhṛtyā bhūṣaṇāni <8> gaṃdhadvāreṇeti gaṃdhaṃ puṣpāṇi ca <9> pauruṣeṇa srutiṃ kuryāt <10> || daleṣu godāya <1> pramodāya <2> haṃsāya <3> sāmagāya <4> satyalakṣaṇāya <5> hiraṇyagarbhāya <6> viśvanābhaye <7> namaḥ iti pūjayet | teṣveva daleṣu śraddhāyai <1> lakṣmyai <2> dhṛtyai <3> tuṣṭyai <4> puṣṭyai <5> medhāyai <6> sarasvatyai <7> kriyāyai <8> namaḥ iti pūjayet | punasteṣveva | bhṛgave <1> pulastyāya <2> pulahāya <3> kratave <4> aṃgirase <5> marīcaye <6> dakṣāya <7> atraye <8> namaḥ iti || vaśiṣṭhāya namaḥ ityagre | evaṃ kuṃbhākṣaśrakapustakābhītiravacchinnādhanaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ yāvadbhavati || iti gṛhasthānāṃ dharmārthaṃ kāmābhilāṣavataṃ | kecana maṃtrā atravyaktīkṛtāḥ | ebhyopyanyān jānīmaḥ tānarucaunalikhāmaḥ || ito mumukṣoḥ praṇavasva rūpaṃ nirūpyate | tadyathā | talpāducchāyodakamupaspṛśya prātaḥ prasannavadanaṃ svaguruṃ murdhni ciṃtayet | jñānamudrālasaṭvāhuṃ jñānadaṃ śivamādarāt | praṇavaṃ sthitvānābhyādi sthitaṃ brahmaviṣṇurudreśvarā dvādaśādgaladamṛtamayairupahārairabhyarcya
<159b>
praṇaveccāraṇāyaikī kṛtyaparaṃ cinmayaṃ vibhāvya |
svātaṃ tryānaṃda saṃpūrṇaṃ saccidānaṃdasuṃdaraṃ | advayaṃ paramaṃ tejo nityasasminniraṃjanaṃ ||
iti japitvā oṃ itaḥ pūrvaṃ dehadharmādhikārato jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyavasthāsu japan karma sarvasva rūpamanusaṃdhāya aṃgāni vinyasya | ata divasa pūjāṃ samāpayet | punarvahirnirgatya āvaśyakaṃ vidhāyasnātvā savitṛmaṃḍalādvaiṣṇavatīrthaṃ āvāhayāmitvāṃ gaṃgesnānārthamihasuṃdari | ehigaṃge namastubhyaṃ sarvatīrtha samanvite namaḥ iti japan āvāhyaśuddhavasanādyalaṃkṛtāṃ dvibhujāṃjale saṃpūjya cidrūpayātayā saṃpūrṇajalaṃ smṛtvā nimajya sakaladuritaṃ saṃharasaṃhareti japan mūlaṃ yathāśakti japitvā ucchāya śaṃkhamudrā jalenātmānamabhiṣicya tīramāgatya vāsaḥ paridhāyācamya praṇavena prāṇāyāma ṣaṭkaṃ vidhāya vāgādikaṃ nyasitvā praṇavābhimaṃtrita jalenātmānamabhyukṣya praṇaveṇārghaṃ datvā saṃtarpya aṣṭottaraśataṃ japitvā tadabhimaṃtritaṃ jalaṃ triḥpītvā tīrthaṃ visṛjyaṃ japasthānaṃ yāyāt | pādaprakṣālanaṃ vidhāyāṃtaḥ praviśya akārādyakṣaratrayeṇa śoṣaṇādikaṃ vidhāya śuddhasthale paṃkajaṃ praṇayaṃtropetaṃ viciṃtya svāsanaṃ sasakalayorapi tathaiva praṇavayaṃtrānvitaṃ lipi padmaṃ saṃcitya dakṣiṇenodakamādāya vāmenapidhāya praṇava
<160a>
maṣṭavāraṃ japitvā saṃprokṣya sohamityupaviśya gurvādīn praṇamat | tathāhi paramaśivādyaśeṣavāraṃparyakrameṇa svagurupādāṃvujaṃ yāvattāvat praṇamāmīti śirasi natvā oṃ gurubhyo namaḥ | oṃ gaṇapataye | oṃ durgāyai | oṃ kṣaṃ kṣetrapālāya | oṃ sarasvatyai | oṃ paramātmane namaḥ iti vāmadakṣānsa vāmadakṣau tu purato hṛdyabhimaṃtrya | praṇavasyāṃtaryāmī ṛṣirvāparamātmā devatā ākārovījaṃ oṃkāraḥ śaktiḥ makāraḥ kṣetraṃ praṇavo vācakaḥ brahmavācyaṃ mokṣārthe viniyogaḥ | praṇavo brahmaputrolātavyagotraḥ <1> akārasyāṃtaryāmī ṛṣirbrahmā ṛṣirvā gāyatrī chaṃdaḥ <2> brahmādevatāḥ <3> pṛthivī tatvaṃ <4> ṛgvedasvarūpaṃ <5> bhūrloko <6> gārhapatyaṃ kṣetraṃ <7> udāttaḥ svaraḥ <8> nābhiḥ sthānaṃ <9> rajoguṇaḥ <10> prātaḥ savanaṃ <11> bhūrvyāhṛtiḥ <12> prāṇovṛttiḥ <13> iḍānāḍī <14> jāgradavasthāṃ <15> viśvaḥ puruṣaḥ <16> pītavarṇā <17> sṛṣṭikriyā <18> sṛṣṭyarthe viniyogaḥ || oṃkārasyaṃ brahmā atrirvāyurviṣṇurvā ṛṣi <1> striṣṭup chaṃdaḥ <2> viṣṇurdevatā <3> rudro'dhidaivataṃ <4> aṃtarikṣaṃ tatvaṃ yajurveda svarūpaṃ <5> bhuvolokaḥ <6> anvāhārya pavanaṃ kṣetra <7> anudāttaḥ svaraḥ <8> hṛdayaṃ sthānaṃ <9> satvaṃ guṇaḥ <10> mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ <11> bhuvovyā hṛtiḥ <12> aṣāṃvṛttiḥ <13> piṃgalānāḍī <14> svapnāvasthā <15> taijasaḥ puruṣaḥ <16> vidvidvarṇaḥ <17> sthitikriyā <18> sthityarthe viniyogaḥ || makārasya vāmadevo rudraḥ sūryo vā ṛṣiḥ <1> jagatīcchaṃdaḥ <2> īśvaro devatā <3> rudro'dhidaivataṃ <4> dyaustatvaṃ <5> sāmavedasvarūpaṃ <6> svarlokaḥ <7> āhavanīyaṃ kṣetraṃ <8> svaritaḥ svaraḥ <9> bhrūmadhyaṃ sthānaṃ <10> tamoguṇaḥ <11> tṛtīyaṃ savanaṃ <12> kharvyāhṛtiḥ <13> vyānovṛttiḥ <14> suṣumnā nāḍī <15> suṣuptyavallā <16>
<160b>
prājñaḥ puruṣaḥ <17> śuklovarṇaḥ <18> saṃhārakriyā <19> layārthe viniyogaḥ || ardhamātrasya saṃvartakāgni ṛṣirvirāṭ chaṃdaḥ puruṣoṁdhidevatā maruto'dhidaivataṃ somalokastatvaṃ atharvavedasvarūpaṃ sarvovarṇasturīyāvasthā jīvasya prāṇeśvarārthe viniyogaḥ | iti smṛtvā tato'ṃguli śodhanamantreṇa aṃguṣṭhādikāniṣṭhikātaṃ copadeśa krameṇa yugapadubhayakarāṃguliṣu vinyasya korparādyāṃgulyagrāṃtaṃ ca kṛtvā digvaṃdhanaṃ ca kurvan dikṣu lokapālāṁstadāśrayaṃ prākāratrayaṃ kuryāt | tathāhi oṃ aṃ oṃ namaḥ <1> uṃ ūṃ ūṃ namaḥ <2> oṃ maṃ oṃ namaḥ <3> evaṃ pādādi mastakāṃtaṃ vyāpya sthūlasūkṣma suṣuptyātmakaṃ virāṭ hiraṇyagarbha jñānātmakaṃ samagnau vilīnaṃ dyātvā tadabhimāninyātmani cidrūpa saṃharaṇa praṇavaṃ japet | japenaiva jñānāvāptirbhavati | yadi vāhyapūjāṃkattumicchati tadā evaṃ kuryāt || praṇavasya prajāpati ṛṣirdaivī gāyatrī chaṃdaḥ paramātmā devatā jñānaprāptyarthe viniyogaḥ | aṃ oṃ āṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> iṃ ṛṃ iṃ śiraḥ <2> uṃ ūṃ ṛṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> eṃ oṃ aiṃ kavacāya huṃ uṃ ūṃ aṃ netrābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ <5> a uṃ aḥ astrāya phaṭ oṃ bhūḥ ityādi ṣaḍbhirvyāhṛtibhirvā | dhyānaṃ | viṣṇuṃ bhāsvatkirīṭāṃgadavalayagadā kalpahārodarāṃhni śreṇībhūṣaṃ sa vakṣomaṇimakara mahākuṃḍalā maṃḍitāgraṃ | hastodyaccakraśaṃkhāṃvujā damabhalaṃpītakauśeyabhāsāvidyo tadbhāsamudyaddina karasadṛśaṃ padmasaṃsthaṃ namāmi ||
<161a>
evaṃ dhyātvā vimalādi śaktiyukte pīṭhe devamātmānaṃ māvāhya vījātmaikavudhyā pūjayet | pṛthivyādyātmakagaṃdhāmādikamupasaṃhāravuddhyātasmin samarpayet | aṃgaiḥ prathamāvaraṇaṃ | vāsudevāya <1> saṃkarṣaṇāya <2> pradyumnāya <3> aniruddhaya <4> namaḥ iti dikṣu | sphaṭika suvarṇa pūrṇeṃdu nīlaprabhāścaturbhujāḥ śaṃkhacakragadāpaṃkajadhāriṇaḥ kirīṭakeyūradhāriṇāḥ pītāṃvarāśca dhyeyāḥ | śāṃtyai <1> śriyai <2> sarasvatyai <3> ratyai <2> namaḥ iti koṇeṣu | tato lokapālāḥ pūjyāḥ | ete sarvepi tata utpannāstatraiva praviṣṭā iti smaret | smṛtvā svātmani saṃharet | ityeka vuddhyā pūjākāryā | lakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ | ghṛtāktaiḥ pāyasairdaśāṃśohomaḥ | evamātmarūpaṃ viṣṇuṃ saṃciṃtya pūjayet | jñānamupadiśati yena paramānaṃdāvāptirbhavati ||
[iti śrīmadāśādityatripāṭhīsaṃgṛhīte maṃtrakoṣe nānāmaṃtrakathanaṃ nāma saptadaśaḥ paricchedaḥ] || athāgneyāstraṃ likhāmaḥ |
ragnistyatāridudhuṃ siṃdhavenāsvāvinirgāduniṣadaripaṇaḥ sadaverihādanito yadatī rāmamaṃsomavāsusedavetajāraṃ || āgneyāstrasyamārī ca ṛṣisveṣṭup chaṃdaḥ jātavedognirdevatā śatruvimardanārthe viniyogaḥ | ṣaḍaṃgaṃ ragnistanādiridhuṃ sidhane jñānātmana hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> nāśvāvinirgādu śaktyai śirase svāhā <2> niṣadaripanaḥ valāyai śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> sadavetihādani tejase netratrayāya vauṣaṭ <4> toyatī rāmamasoma aiśvaryāya kavacāya huṃ <5> navāvasusedavetajāraṃ vīryāstrāya phaṭ aṃguṣṭhāṃgulya jaṃghā sujānuno rūrū yugmake |
<161b>
kadyaṃdhunābhiṣu hṛdi stanayoḥ pārśvayordvayoḥ | pṛṣṭhataḥ skaṃdhayormadhye vāhumūloya vāhuṣu ||
prakoppare prakoṣṭeṣu maṇivaṃdhakareṣu ca | mukhanāsākṣi karṇeṣumastaṃ mastikamūrdhasu ||
krameṇa vinyasedvarṇān vidvānastra samudbhavān ||
śikhālalāṭanayanakarṇauṣṭharasanā tathā | sakaṃṭha vāhu hṛtkukṣikaṭi guhyorujānuṣu ||
jaṃghayoḥ pādayornyasyetpadānyasya manoḥ sudhīḥ | dhyānamasya prayogena prayoge sphuṭī bhaviṣyati ||
pūrvavajjapaktṛpti syāt juhuyāt pūrvasaṃkhyayā | paṃcamavyastu pakvenaṃ caruṇātasya siddhaye ||
japasaṃkhyā sahasrāṇi homo tasya daśāṃśakaḥ | arcanaṃ pūrvavat kuryāt śaktīstu pratilomataḥ ||
sarvatra deśikaḥ kuryādgāyatryā dviguṇaṃ japaḥ | krūrakarmaṇi kurvīta pratiloma vidhānataḥ ||
śāṃtikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ karmakartavyamanulomataḥ | prayogakāle prajapedaṣṭaupādān vilomataḥ ||
sādhito jāyate paścānmaṃtroyaṃ vidhināmunā | gnpādayaḥ paṃcākṣaraḥ pādo jñeyo jñāneṃdriyātmakaḥ ||
dhvādyonyaḥ paṃcavarṇaśca smṛtaḥ karmeṃdriyātmakaḥ | svādyastṛtīyaḥ paṃcārṇaḥ paṃcabhūtamayātmakaḥ ||
tyādyaḥ saptākṣaraḥ paścādadūraturakṣaraḥ | daḥ pūrvaḥ paṃcamaḥ pādaḥ urmirūpaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
<162a>
to varṇādiḥ ṣaḍvarṇaḥ ṣaṭkeśika udīritaḥ | so pūrvaḥ paṃcamovarṇaḥ śaṣṭādimaya īritaḥ ||
sovarṇādyo'ṣṭamovarṇapaṃcārṇovacanātmakaḥ | evaṃ tatvasamāyogātpādallaptirudāhṛtā ||
tattatpādākṣarotpannāstāvaṃto vahnidevatāḥ | pradhānamūrti pratimāḥ svasvavarṇodi prabhāḥ ||
prajvalat keśavadanā bhīmadaṃṣṭrā bhayānakāḥ | devatā iṃdriyotpannāḥ urdhvadṛṣṭāya īritāḥ ||
devatā bhūtapākṣaḥ stīryagvaktrāḥ samīritāḥ | dhātuḥ pādādarodbhūtā ubhayāna na śobhitāḥ ||
urmijāstūrdhvavadanāḥ keśocchāstiyaṃgānanāḥ | etāḥ sarvāḥ smṛtāḥ klīvāḥ iti pāthodbhavāḥ striyaḥ ||
adhastiryaṅmukhopetārdharitā varṇadevatāḥ | ābhimukhyaḥ smṛtaḥ saumye parāṅmukhā'nyakarmaṇi ||
ābhimukhyāḥ samutpannā devatā jvalitānanāḥ | yābhirmaṃtre dahecchatro rāṣṭraṃ sa girikānanaṃ ||
astraṃ manuṣyanakṣatre dhārabheta vicakṣaraḥ | āsureṣu prayuṃjīta devatārāsu saṃharet ||
pūrvottara trayaṃ paścādbharaṇyārdrātha rohiṇī | imāni mānuṣāṇyāhurnakṣatrāṇi manīṣiṇaḥ ||
jyeṣṭhā śatabhiṣaṅmūladhaniṣṭhā śleṣakṛttikāḥ | citrāmathāviśāyāḥ syustārākṣaradevatāḥ ||
aśvinī revatī puṣpa svātihasta punarvasū | anurādhā mṛgaśiraḥ śravaṇā devatārakāḥ ||
upakrameta naṃdāsuriktāsvastraṃ visarjayet | bhadrā svāharaṇaṃ kuryājjayāsvatyaṃtamuttamaṃ ||
upakramo bhaumavāreśa nivāre visarjayet | pratisaṃharaṇaṃ vāre guroḥ śukrasya vā bhavet ||
<162b>
sthire ghurāśidhāraṃbhaśvareṣu ca visarjanaṃ | astrasaṃharaṇaṃ kuryāddu bhayeṣu vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
kṛṣṇapakṣanalenāstraṃ visṛjet śaśinā punaḥ | śuklapakṣe kramādastraṃ punarātmani saṃharet ||
bhānunāmokṣa saṃhārau kuryāt pakṣadvayaṃ śudhīḥ ||
paścimābhimukho bhūtvā karma sarvatra kārayet | nakṣatra vṛkṣe sakalānsādhyākṣān karmasaṃyutān ||
tatra maṃtrākṣaropetānmaṃtrīmaṃtrārṇa saṃkhyā | juhuyāddīpite vahnau mārayedriyumātmanaḥ ||
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīṃ samārabhya yāvat kṛṣṇacaturdaśī | dhattūra viṣavṛkṣākṣabhūruhoccha samīraṇān ||
rājītailena saṃliptān pṛthaka patra sahasrakaṃ | juhuyāt saṃyato bhūtvāri puryamapuraṃ vrajet ||
viṣavṛkṣaḥ kāraskaraḥ | akṣavṛkṣaḥ vibhītakaḥ | rājīrāī iti |
saptarātraṃ prajuhuyāt siddhārtha snehalohitaiḥ | arddavastreviṣṭikālemarīcairmanunāmunā ||
nigṛhyate jvareṇāriḥ pralayāddhisamenasaḥ | siddhārthāḥ sarṣayāṃ vṛṣṭikāle bhadrākāle ||
tālapatre samālikhya śatrunāma yathāvidhi | āgneyāstreṇa saṃveṣṭya kuṃḍamadhyeniṣaṇya tat ||
juhuyānmaricaiḥ kruddho jvarākrāṃtaḥ sa jāyate |
āgneyāstreṇa veṣṭitaṃ śatrunāma tālapatre likhitvā kuṃḍamadhye khātvā tadupari samādhāya juhuyādityarthaḥ | tadādāyakṣipettoyeśītale sa vaśobhavet |
<163a>
piṣṭvā yāmārgavījāni marīca madhusaṃyute | atyullelavaṇetoye nikṣipya kvāthayettataḥ ||
lavaṇa miśritaye ṛkṣa vṛkṣa pratikṛtaiḥ | hṛdaye vadane nāśikāyāṃ kiṃcit saṃkṣipet ||
darvyākāskarotpalayā | ṛkṣavṛkṣaḥ śatrunāma nakṣatra vṛkṣaḥ | tallavaṇatoyaṃ kvāthitamāgneyāstramuccaran maṃtraṃ socirājvarito bhavati | puttalī hṛdayādau āgneyamaṃtramuccaran kiṃcit kiṃcittoyaṃ kṣipet |
kvathite'ṃbhasitaṃ kṣiptvāhanyācchatrumayatnataḥ | aṃbhasilavaṇāṃbhasi | saṃtapta tīkṣṇatailena saṃjaptaṃ śatroḥ pratikṛtiṃ niśi |
tāpayededhite vahnau pratiloma manuṃ japan | jvareṇa vādhyate sadyastryahādasyamṛtirbhavet ||
tīkṣṇatailena sarṣapa tailena |
sāmudre lavaṇe hiṃguviṣajīrakaloḍite | kvathite puttalī sādhyanakṣatra tanu nirmitā ||
adhovaktrāṃvu nikṣipya yaṣṭyāviṣatarūcchayā | tacchirastāḍanaṃ kurvan japedastraṃ vilomataḥ ||
saptāhānmaraṇaṃ yāti śatrurjvaravimohitaḥ | sāmudre salile samudralavaṇaṃ miśritapānīye ||
ādityaratha nāgeṃdragrastāgni tadviṣā hataṃ | vraṇatailena liptāṃ gaṃdagdhaṃ bhānumarīcibhiḥ ||
adhomukhaṃ nija ripuṃ dhyātvā kathitavāriṇā | tarpayedbhānumālokya śatrurmṛtyupriyo bhavet ||
vibhratīmuśalaṃ śūlaṃ dhyātvā durgāṃ bhayaṃkarīṃ | mahiṣī ghṛtasaṃtaptaiḥ pallavairviṣavṛkṣajaiḥ ||
hutvā ripoḥ kṣaṇātsenāmuccāṭayati maṃtravit |
<163b>
kāraskaraṃ vṛkṣajairdhyātvā devīṃ purā proktāṃ caturbhirmaricānvitaiḥ |
ajārudhira saṃsiktairjuhuyāddivasatrayaṃ | ripo ruccāṭanaṃ kuryātsenāyāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
agniśūlakikāṃdevīṃ jvalaṃtīṃ pralayāgnivat | dhyātvā śarṣapatailāktairvījairddhattūra saṃbhavaiḥ ||
hutvā vimohayecchatrūn marīcairvā sa sarṣapaiḥ | kālāṃjananibhāṃ durgāṃ śūlakhaḍgadharāṃ smaret ||
nakṣatra vṛkṣasaṃbhūtairvījairddhattūra saṃbhavaiḥ | hutvā dhiyo hayecchatrūnmarīcairvā sa sarṣapaiḥ ||
kālāṃjananibhāṃ durgāṃ śūlakhaḍganibhāṃ smaret | nakṣatravṛkṣa saṃbhūtairvraṇakṛttaila saṃbhavaiḥ ||
samidvaraiḥ prajuhuyāddhanyānmāsena vairiṇāṃ |
vraṇa kṛttailaṃ bhallātaka tailaṃ |
siṃhādhirūḍhāṃ dhāvaṃtīṃ dhāvamānāṃ ripuṃ pratiṃ | śarān kārmukanirmuktān vahnijvālāmukhākulān ||
muṃcaṃtīṃ saṃsmaran durgāṃ śūlakhaḍgadharāṃ smaret |
tarpayedullavāriṇā |
ati durgāmayomuṣṭi gadāhastāṃ viciṃtayet |
mahiṣī ghṛtasaṃplutaiḥ |
pulākairjuhuyānnityaṃ vibhītaka samidvaraiḥ | kodravairatha vā śatroḥ senāyā uccāṭanaṃ bhavet ||
āturaiḥ sādhya vṛkṣakāṣṭhedhitenale |
juhuyānniśi saptāhaṃ maṃtravidvaśayennṛpān | pāśāṃkuśadharāṃ raktāṃ viśvāṃ durgāṃ viciṃtayet ||
phalinī kusumaiḥ phullaiścaṃdanāṃbhaḥ samukṣitaiḥ | juhuyānniśiyo maṃtrī tasya viśvaṃ vaśaṃ bhavet ||
phalinī priyaṃguḥ ||
<164a>
śaraccaṃdranibhāṃdevīṃ vigalat paramāmṛtāṃ | pāśāṃkuśadharāṃ jñātvā siṃdhudurgāṃ samidvaraiḥ ||
tasairmadhurā siktairjuhuyāt vṛṣṭi siddhaye | kapālaṃ triśikhaṃ pāśamaṃkuśaṃ vibhratīṃ karaiḥ ||
japākusumasaṃkāśāmagni durgāṃ viciṃtayet | hutvā lavaṇapunnalpā madhuratraya yuktayā ||
ākarṣitadvākṣitān sarvyāmaṃtravinnātrasaṃśayaḥ | madhuratrayaṃ ghṛtaśarkarā madhūni | atidurgeyamatpādyāḥ | ṣaḍaṃgāṁ striṣu vīriṇāṃtādurvāṇāṃ tāpyagādyāṃgāni durgā prakīrtitā |
viśvādyānyakṣarāṃtāsā viśvadurgā prakīrtitā | siṃdhvyādyāsātakārāṃtā siṃdhu durgā prakīrtitā ||
tyannāmāgnyādikāmenāmagni durgā prakīrtitā | aṃgaṇesthaṃḍilaṃ kṛtvā sugaṃdhi kusumādibhiḥ ||
devīmabhyarcayennityaṃ prāgukte naiva vartmanā | atiṣaditi akṣarātmakamati durgāstraṃ nāma ||
agnitya iti agnidurgāstraṃ |
āharedrāvitriṣuvaliṃ caturṇāṃ sarvasiddhidaṃ | kṛtvā rogagrahādrohaṃ bhītāsannāpayedayaṃ ||
yathāvadagnimārādhyagaṃdhaiḥ puṣpairmanoharaiḥ | sthitvā tasyāgrato maṃtrī japenmaṃtramananpadhīḥ ||
japoyaṃ sarvasiddhiḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā | lavaṇairmadhurāsiktairjuhuyāt paścimāmukhaḥ ||
maṃtrārṇa saṃkhyayā maṃtrī ripūnātmavaśaṃ nayet | śālīḥ prakṣālya saṃśodhya śuddhān kurvīta taṃḍulān ||
japitvā paṃcagavyeṣu saṃskṛte havyavāhane | caruṃ pecejjapanmaṃtraṃ mavatī ye punaḥ sudhīḥ ||
<164b>
arcayitvā viśadadhīḥ devīmagnau yathā purā | juhuyācca ruṇānena sājyenāṣṭa sahasrakaṃ ||
pātre saṃpātanaṃ kurvansādhyaṃ tatprāśayet punaḥ | śiṣṭānnaṃ nikhanet dvāri saṃpātaṃ prāṃgaṇāṃtare ||
kṛtyārogāvinśyaṃti sahabhūtādyupadravaiḥ | parairutpāditā kṛtyāyuḥ snānena ca bhakṣayet ||
vrīhibhirhaviṣākṣīraiḥ payovṛkṣa samidvaraiḥ | ājyairmadhuratrayopetairetairdaśaśataṃ pṛthak ||
juhuyāt saṃpadāṃ bhūmiḥ sādhako bhavati dhruvaṃ | bhāskare meṣarāśisthe maṃtrajñānuguṇedine ||
nadyāṃ sāgaragāminyāṃ satataṃ puṣkarāṃbhasi | uddhṛtpādau ca sikatāḥ saṃśodhya pariśoṣayet ||
nyasyatāḥ paṃcagavyeṣu saṃskṛte havyavāhane | bharjjayenmanunā siddhyaidarvyā brahmatarūcchayā ||
siṃhameṣa dhanusthe'rke kṛṣṇapakṣe'ṣṭamītithau | viśākhā kṛttikāmūla hastottaramaghāstathā ||
rohiṇyāṃ śravaṇe vārau maṃdavākyati daivatau | vihāyānyeṣu kurvīta sikatāsthāpanaṃ sudhīḥ ||
gṛhagrāmādi rāṣṭrāṇāṃ rakṣārthaṃ śikatāḥ śubhāḥ | prasthāḍhake ghaṭonmānāṃ madhyādiṣvavaṭeṣvimāḥ ||
nava su prakṣipejjaptvā teṣu saṃpūjayet kramāt | madhyādi devīmastrāṇi kapālāṃtāni deśikaḥ ||
cakraṃśaṃkhamasiṃkheṭaṃvāṇaṃcāpaṃtriśūlakaṃ | astra maṃtreṇa saṃpūjya pūjāṃte ca valiṃ haret ||
nakṣatra graharāśīnāṃ lokeśānāṃ valiṃ haret | vihitya yatra rakṣertha vardhate tatra saṃpadaḥ ||
<165a>
kṣudragraha mahāroga caurabhūta sarīsṛpāḥ | amunāvilayaṃ yāṃti vidhinā nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
ityādi vahuprakārāseti || atha dināstraṃ ||
ramati durgāṇi viśvānāveva siṃdhuṃduritātyagniḥ jātavedase sṛnakāmasomamarātī yato nidahāti vedasanaḥ parṣataraṃ || ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvoktaṃ | agnistyatāriṃdudhuṃśirāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ <1> vicenāśvānirgādurīṃ śirase svāhā <2> tiṣaripaṇaḥ sarūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ <3> daveti hādaniraiṃ kavacāya huṃ <4> toyatī rāmamasorauṃ netratrayāya voṣaṭ <5> mamā āsunase vṛvetajāraḥ astrāya phaṭ <6> || dhyānamagre prayogakāle vaktavyaṃ bhavati ||
bhānu viṃvagataṃ śatruṃ madhovaktraṃ viṣāpahaṃ | mūlāducchitayāgrastaṃ kuṃḍalyā bhāvayansudhīḥ ||
mūlādhāre kṣipatsadyaḥ prasphuratkāla pāvake | dināyājvājkrāṃto ripuḥ prāṇān vimuṃcati ||
kālapāvaka mūlādhārāducchitāgnau dināstrena pravṛddhāṃgasvādhiṣṭhānagataṃ ripuṃ |
paṃcavāyu susiddhena vahninādagdhavigrahaṃ | dhyāyanmanuṃ japet sadyaḥ sa bhavet jvaravallabhaḥ ||
svādhiṣṭhānaṃ mūlādu paribhāgaḥ | paṃcavāyuḥ prāṇāpānādi | vahninā mūlādhārāducchitāgninā |
maṇipūragataṃ śatruṃ vahninā dagdha vigrahaṃ | dhyāyan dināstraṃ prajapet sa mṛtyuvaśatāṃ vrajet ||
maṇipūragataṃ svādhiṣṭhānāduparibhāgaṃ |
vahninā pūrvoktena |
anāhita gataḥ śatrurnirdagdho maṃtravairiṇā |
<165b>
pāśena vadhvā śīghrena nīyate yama kiṃkaraiḥ ||
anāhato nāmanābherūrddhabhāge vāyusthānaṃ ||
viśuddhisthānago vairādinadīpitaḥ |
adhomukhaḥ smṛtastūrṇaṃ parāsuḥ syāddinatrayāt | viśuddhisthānaṃ pūrvokta vāyusthānādu paribhāgaḥ ||
nābhimātrodake sthitvā dhyāyan viṃvaṃ dineśituḥ | vairiṇaṃ dagdhasarvāṃgaṃ maṃtramaṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ ||
japet saptadinā darvāk yamalokaṃ sa gacchati | āravāraṃ samārabhya saptāraṃ prajapenmanuṃ ||
sūryodayaṃ samārabhya yāvadastamayo bhavet | sannipāta jvarākrāṃto yamagrasto bhavedariḥ ||
āravāraṃ bhaumavāraṃ |
ājñāyāṃ nihitaṃ śatruṃ dahedastrāgninādhiyā | putramitra kalatrādīn hitvā mṛtyumupāśrayet ||
ājñāyāmiti viśuddhisthānādu paribhāgaḥ | sthitvā durgālaye maṃtrī trirātraṃ varjitāśanaḥ ||
dinavāreṇa viddhāṃgaṃ vairiṇaṃ praticiṃtayan | japenmaṃtramimaṃ śatrurjvarito maraṇaṃ vrajet ||
spṛṣṭvā durgāṃ japanmaṃtraṃ manasthaṃ tridinaṃ smaran | śūlaprotaṃ nijaṃ ripuṃ dināstreṇa pradīpitaṃ ||
jvareṇa mahatāviṣṭo jāyate sauyamātithiḥ | ravimaṃḍalagaṃ śatruṃ daṣṭaṃ tadravyapannagaiḥ ||
viṣāgni dagdhasarvāṃgaṃ dhyāyannuṣṇena cāriṇā | tarpayeddina vātenasyādevīyama vallabhaḥ ||
<166a>
raviviṃvādā gatayā jvālayāgrasta vigrahaṃ | ripuṃ dhyātvā japenmaṃtraṃ sa krīḍati yamāṃtike ||
grahayuktārkaviṃvasthaṃ viddhaṃ maṃtramayaiḥ śaraiḥ | pratipadya nijaṃ śatruṃ japedayutamastravit ||
ripuṃ na yati śīghreṇa yamadūto yamālayaṃ |
grahayukte rāhugrastaṃ ||
pralayānalasaṃkāśāṃ kālarātrimivāparaṃ | śūlapāśadharāṃdevīṃ siṃhaskaṃdhaniṣeḍuṣīṃ ||
sa viturmaṃḍalādhasthāṃ raktanetratrayodgataiḥ | visphuliṃgairnirdahaṃtīṃ ripumākulavigrahaṃ ||
spaṣṭa daṃṣṭrādharāṃ nṛtyadbhṛkuṭī bhīṣaṇānanāṃ | darśayaṃtīṃ nijaṃ śatruṃ tarjanyā bhīmarūpayā ||
daṃṣṭrāma yūṣajālena dyotayaṃtīṃ digaṃtaraṃ | śūlena vairiṇo vakṣo dārayaṃtīṃ bhayaṃkarīṃ ||
japeddina trayaṃ maṃtramārayed ripu mātmanaḥ | astramaṃtrakṛta nyāsaḥ pralayāgni samaprabhāṃ ||
raktavastradharāṃ kruddhāṃ raktanetra trayānvitāṃ | siṃhādhirūḍhāṃ dhāvaṃtīṃ dhāvamānāṃ ripuṃ prati ||
khaḍgena tacchiraśchitvā kṣaṇādvyomasthalaṃgatāṃ | dhyātvā durgāṃ japanmaṃtrī tridinaṃ varjitāśanaḥ ||
anenaiva vidhānena ripurmṛtyu priyo bhavet | karmāṇyetāni kurvīta divasena tu rātriṣu ||
paścimāmukhaliṃgasya sa vījaṃ mahiṣaṃ puraḥ | nikhanettasya śirasi kuṃḍaṃ kṛtvā trikoṇakaṃ ||
<166b>
tasmin samedhite vahnau yathāvaddeśikottamaḥ | sādhakonāma maṃtrāṇāṃ sādhyanāma samanvitaṃ ||
ajāraktena saṃsiktān kāraskarasamidvarān | sahasraṃ juhuyāddevīṃ dhyātvā savitrimaṃḍale ||
pralayāgni samāṃghorāṃ dvātriṃśaḍbhujaśobhitāṃ | udyadāyudha saṃyuktāṃ nṛtyaṃtīṃ siṃhamastake ||
mahādaṃṣṭrāṃ mahābhīmāṃ jvalatkeśīṃ tadunmukhīṃ | raktānna māṃsavadanāṃ ghūrṇitāgra vilocanāṃ ||
anena vidhinā śatrurmahājvaranipīḍitaḥ | vimuṃcati nijaṃ dehaṃ putramitra kalatrakaiḥ ||
ūrdhvamuktāṃbhaso maṃtrī laṃvayitvā bhujaṃgamaṃ | bhānuviṃvagatāṃ durgāṃ sahasrādityasannibhāṃ ||
sahasrapāṇi caraṇāṃ sahasrākṣi śiromukhīṃ | sahasranāgavaddhāṃgīṃ trāsayaṃtīṃ jagattrayīṃ ||
dhyāyannanena sarpāspetarpayedullavāriṇā | saṃyataḥ kālapāśena vairī mucyeta jīvitaṃ ||
madhyāhnārkāyutaprakhyāṃ na daṃtīṃ narasiṃhavat | ghorasiṃha samāsīnāṃ mahābhīṣaṇa darśanāṃ ||
śūlaprotā hitāṃ dhyāyan japenmaṃtramananyadhīḥ | tarpayedullatoyena sarpavaktre dinatrayaṃ ||
yamasya bhuvanaṃ gaccheda rātirnātra saṃśayaḥ | ṛkṣavṛkṣa pratikṛtiṃ pratiṣṭhita samīraṇāṃ ||
ullodake vinikṣipya viṣāde vidhinā tataḥ | arkeṃdvana na saṃkāśāṃ khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇīṃ ||
<167a>
nayana trayasaṃgacchadvisphuliṃgaśatākulāṃ | siṃhasthāṃ sarpabhūṣāḍhyāṃ trailokya bhayadāyinīṃ ||
khaḍgaktattāhitaṃ dhyāyan prajapeda yutaṃ manuṃ | vidhānenāmunā śatrurgrasto bhavati mṛtyunā ||
prakalpya durgāyatane trikoṇaṃ kuṃḍamuttamaṃ | tatra saṃjvalite vahnau mahiṣīśaṃskṛtā kṛtāṃ ||
puttalīmajaraktāktāṃ pratiṣṭhita samīraṇāṃ | chitvā chitvā prajuhuyādajaraktānvitāṃ niśi ||
dhyātvā durgāṃ pranṛtyaṃtīṃ mahiṣorasthalāṃtare | śūlena mahiṣasyāṃgaṃbhiṃdaṃtīṃ ghoradarśanāṃ ||
aṭṭahāsai rajasrocchairbhīṣitāṃ surasevitāṃ | pralayānalasaṃkāśāṃ bhramannetratrayānvitāṃ ||
saṃdaṣṭādharasaṃbhinnāṃ daṃṣṭrā bhīmamukhāṃvujāṃ | khaḍgakheṭakayuktāṃktiḥ kanyakābhiḥ samāvṛtāṃ ||
anena vidhinā śatruḥ prayāti yamasaṃnidhiṃ | dināstrametatkathitaṃ śatrunigrahakāraṇaṃ ||
atha kṛtyāstraṃ |
raṃdaṣadaripanaḥ sadavetihādaniyato yatoyatī rāmamasedhavāna sudavedravetajāgnista nāridudhuṃsiṃdavenākhā vinirgādu araṃ | etat krameṇa ṣaḍaṃgāni || atha prayogaḥ |
kṛtāstra coditān kuryāt prayogān maṃtravittamaḥ | ādhārāducchitāṃ devīṃ kuṃḍalī sarparūpiṇīṃ ||
<167b>
suṣumṇā raṃdhramārgeṇa jātaṃ vyomasthalaṃ tataḥ | mukhena śatrumādāya nivṛttāṃ svagṛhaṃ prati ||
jvalaṃ jvālānalādīptāṃ viciṃtya prajapenmanuṃ | saptabhirvāsaraiḥ śatrurmṛtyumāpnoti mohitaḥ ||
aṃgāravāre cityagnau sarṣapa snehalohitaṃ | siddhārthaṃ kuḍavaṃ japtaṃ juhuyāt pakṣamātrataḥ ||
kṛtyāstra jvālayā dagdho ripuryamapuraṃ vrajet | caturdaśyā mardharātre citāsthīnyaṣṭa sādhakaḥ ||
vraṇataila viliptāni citāgnau juhuyāttataḥ | anena vidhinā śatrurmṛtyumāpnoti kātaraḥ ||
tuṣāsthi nirmitāṃ śatrorvraṇatailapariplutāṃ | pratimāṃ sthāpita prāṇāṃ juhuyānniśikārakaḥ ||
chitvā chitvā jaraktena saptāhān mrīyate ripuḥ | śmaśāna vālukāṃ spṛṣṭvā sākṣānniśiṣutāṃ japet ||
vikirettāstaḍāgādau kṛtyāstra kvathitaṃ jalaṃ | tadāyaṃ pītamacirānnihaṃti sakalān janān ||
kṛṣṇāṃgāra caturdaśyāṃ prajaptaiḥ pretabhasmabhiḥ | mahiṣājyena lulitāstanmaṃtrākṣara saṃkhyayā ||
nirmitāṃ gulikā etāḥ samyak japtasamīraṇā | nitākāṣṭodhite vahnau juhuyāt dṛḍhamānasaḥ ||
caturdaśī trayā darvāk śatrurmṛtyu priyo bhavet | śmaśāna bhasma siddhārthaṃ paṃcagavye vinikṣipet ||
<168a>
mahiṣe saṃsmaran devīṃ kālāgni sadṛśa prabhāṃ | bharjayet praṃjapan maṃtraṃ citākāṣṭedhitegnale ||
durgāgāre prajuhuyādane nāyuta mastravit | punarādāya tadbhasma senāyāṃ vairiṇaḥ kṣipet ||
sā senā vahudhā bhinnā jvararoga vimohitā | āyudhāni parityajya yuddhakāle palāyate ||
viṣakāṣṭāṃkāraskarakāṣṭāṃ ||
gehe dāmādikaṃ kṣiptaṃ kuryāduccāṭanaṃ kṣaṇāt | saptavāreṣu gulikā durgā veśmasuṃśarkarāḥ ||
japtamāheṃdra digvajra gṛhītvā prajapanmanuṃ | caturdaśyāṃ riporgehe nikhanet prajapanmanuṃ ||
siddhaṃ putrakalatrādyaiḥ |
mahiṣī paṃcagavyeṣu bharjayettāṃ yathā purā | bhūyo japitvā vikire gehagrāmapureṣvimāḥ ||
sa deśo naśyati kṣipraṃ dagdhomaṃtra bhavāgninā | brahmadaṃḍī markaṭikā krayakrāśanikātrayaṃ ||
bhaumavāresu kulike gṛhītvā prajapanmanuṃ | caturdaśyāṃ riporgehe nikhanet prajapanmanuṃ ||
sārdhaṃ putrakalatrādyai runmādo jāyate ripoḥ |
brahmadaṃḍī markaṭi kākavacchu |
ekaikaṃ vā japenmaṃtraṃ maṃḍalāt saphalaṃ bhavet | ṣaḍviṃdu ṣaṭkaṃ puttalyāṃ nikhanedodanānvitāṃ ||
spṛṣṭvā tāṃ prajapedastraṃ kṛṣṇāṣṭāmyāṃ niśārdhataḥ | śatrornāma samāyuktāṃ śmaśāne nikhanedimaṃ ||
praṇaśpetā ripuḥ śīghraṃ sa kuṭuṃvaḥ sa vāṃdhavaḥ |
<168b>
ṣaḍviṃdu ṣaṭkaṃ ṣaḍviṃduḥ kīṭaka viśeṣaḥ ||
kapāla sakalānmaṃtrī kṛtyāṃstrākṣara saṃkhyakān | saṃspṛśya prajapedastraṃ prāṇasthāpana pūrvakaṃ ||
kṛṣṇavāre caturdaśyāṃ śmaśāne viṣavṛkṣake | juhuyāda jaraktāktān kṛtyāstra jvālayāhataḥ ||
ripuryamapuraṃ gacchen mahājvaravimohitaḥ |
kapāla sakalān prāṇi śiraḥ khaṃḍān |
ajaraktena saṃpūrṇe kalaśe nikṣipe dahiṃ | kapālenapidhāyainaṃ chādayedrakta vāsasā ||
pūjayed rakta puṣpādyaiḥ spṛṣṭvā tama yutaṃ japet | bhaumavāre niśāmadhye kāraskara samanvite ||
śmaśānaṃ vahnau juhuyād gacched yamapuraṃ ripuḥ | sādhyanakṣatra vṛkṣeṇa kṛtvā kuṃbhaṃ prapūrayet ||
māhiṣaiḥ paṃcagavyaistaṃ viḍālaṃ tatra nikṣipet | japapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ samācaret ||
kāraskara bhave vahnau kṛtyāstreṇa samedhite | ayutaṃ vraṇatailena hutvānnaitaṃ ghaṭaṃ punaḥ ||
āmastakaṃ samuddhṛtya japenmaṃtra mananyadhīḥ | juhuyādvinipātena tridinānmrīyate ripuḥ ||
viḍālo mārjāraḥ |
vraṇatailaṃ bhallātakatailaṃ |
suṃdaraṃ mahiṣī vatsamekarātramupoṣitaṃ | pāyagnenmahiṣīsarpiḥ prasthaṃ maṃtreṇa maṃtravit ||
kuśairāvaddha sarvāṃgaṃ sthāpita prāṇamaṃjasā | kāraskaredhite vahnau vraṇatailena maṃtravit ||
homaṃ kṛtvā yutaṃ vatsa juhuyādvatamānasaḥ | ekena divase nārirgacchedyamapuraṃ sukhī ||
trikoṇa kuṃḍa nihite vahnau maṃtre dīpite |
<169a>
arcite gaṃdhpuṣpādyaira yutaṃ juhuyāt kramāt ||
rājī bhallātaka tilatilaiḥ saptadinaṃ tataḥ | prasūtisamayaprāptāṃ mahiṣīṃ sthāpitaṃ punaḥ ||
pūjitāṃ gaṃdhapuṣpādyaiḥ spṛśan kūrcenatāṃ japan | mastakādyoniparyaṃtaṃ vidhau vatsamanusmaran ||
ākṛṣ (*)(?) hastapatitaṃ juhuyādedhite'nale | evaṃ kṛte samutpannā kṛtyā dīptāṃdutāśanāt ||
bhakṣayeda cirācchatrumīśvareṇāpi rakṣitaṃ | punaragnau viśatyeṣākartāramapikāṃkṣati ||
evaṃ vidhāni karmāṇayaḥ kuryānmaṃtravittamaḥ | sa japedātma rakṣārthe maṃtraṃ mṛtyuṃjayādikaṃ ||
[iti śrīmadāśādityatripāṭhisaṃgṛhīte maṃtrakoṣe astrādimaṃtrakathanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśaḥ paricchedaḥ] || atha yaṃtre vaktavye pūrvaṃ homīyadravyaparibhāṣā likhyate ||
atha tu homadravyāṇāṃ paribhāṣā vidhīyate | karṣamātraṃ ghṛtaṃ home śuktimātraṃ payaḥ smṛtaṃ ||
uktāni paṃcagavyāni tatsamāni manīṣibhiḥ | tatsamaṃ madhudugdhānnamakṣimātramudāhṛtaṃ ||
dadhiprasṛtimātraṃ syāllājāḥ syurmuṣṭi saṃmitāḥ | pṛthukāstatpramāṇāḥ syuḥ saktavastu tathoditāḥ ||
guḍaṃ palārdhamānaṃ syādikṣuḥ parvāvadhiḥ smṛtaḥ | ekaikaṃ patrapuṣpāṇi tathā pūṣāni kalpayet ||
kadalīphalanāraṃgaphalānye kaikaśo viduḥ | mātuluṃgaṃ catuḥkhaṃḍaṃ panasaṃ daśadhā smṛtaṃ ||
aṣṭadhā nāri kerāṇi khaṃḍitāni vidurvudhāḥ | tridhā kṛtaṃ phalaṃ vilvaṃ kapicchaṃ khaṃḍitaṃ (*)(?)dhā ||
<169b>
urvāruka phalaṃ hyeme khaṃḍitaṃ coditaṃ tridhā | phalānyanyāni khaṃḍāni samidhaḥ syurdaśāṃgulaiḥ ||
dṛrvātrayaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ guḍūcī caturaṃgulā | vrīhayo muṣṭimātrāḥ syurmudga (***)(?) vā api ||
taṃḍulāḥ syustadardhāṃśāḥ kodravyamuṣṭimaṃmitāḥ | tilāśculukamātrāḥ syuḥ sarṣapāstat pramāṇataḥ ||
śukti pramāṇaṃ pravaṇaṃ marīcānyapi viṃśatiḥ | puraṃ vadaramānaṃ syādrāmaṭhaṃ tatsamaṃ smṛtaṃ ||
caṃdanā gurukarpūrakastūrī kuṃkumāni ca | tittilī vījamānāni samuddiṣṭāni deśikaiḥ ||
iti homīya dravyāṇi ||
athāgni viśeṣāḥ |
vaiśvānaraṃ sthitaṃ dhyāye samiddhomeṣu sarvadā | śayānamājya homeṣu niṣaṇaṃ śeṣavastuṣu ||
āsyāṃtarjuhuyādagnervipaścit sarvakarmasu | karṇahome bhavedvyādhirnetre'ṃdhatvamudīritaṃ ||
nāśikāyāṃ manaḥ pīḍāmastake dhanasaṃkṣayaḥ | svarṇasiṃdūravālārkakuṃkumakṣodasannibhaḥ ||
suvarṇa tejasovarṇaḥ śobhanaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | bherīvāridahastīṃdradhvanirvahneḥ śubhāvahaḥ ||
nāgacaṃpaka punnāgapāṭalā yūthikānibhaḥ | padmeṃdīvarakahlārasāryarguggulasannibhaḥ ||
yāvakasya śubhogaṃdhaḥ ityuktastaṃtravedibhiḥ | pradakṣiṇāstyaktakaṃpāḥ chatrābhāḥ śikhinaḥ śikhāḥ ||
<170a>
śubhadā japamānasya rāṣṭrasyāpi viśeṣataḥ | kuṃdeṃdu dhavalo dhūmo vahneḥ proktaḥ śubhāvahaḥ ||
kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇagate varṇo japamānaṃ vināśayet | svato rājyaṃ nihaṃtyāśu vāyasasya tu sannibhaḥ ||
kharasvarasamo vahnerdhvaniḥ sarvavināśakṛt | pūtigaṃdho hutabhujo hoturduḥkhaprado bhavet ||
chinnāvṛttā śikhā kuryānmṛtyurdhana parikṣayaṃ | śukapakṣa nibho dhūmaḥ pītavāsa samaprabhaḥ ||
hāniṃ tu ragajātīnāṃgavāṃ ca kurute'cirāt | evaṃvidheṣu doṣeṣu prāyaścittāya deśikaḥ ||
mūlenājyena juhuyāt prāyaścittāya deśikaḥ |
evaṃ agniṣo homo jñātavya iti || atha yaṃtrāṇi | tatra mātṛkā yaṃtraṃ || tārttīyojvalakarṇikaṃ svarayugairāvirbhavat kesaraṃ sargollāsivasuchadaṃ vasumatī gehena saṃveṣṭitaṃ | tārādhīśvara vārivarṇa vilasaddikoṇa saṃśobhivāyaṃtraṃ varṇamanoḥ padaṃ nigaditaṃ sarvāmayaghnaṃ paraṃ tārttīyaṃ tripurāmaṃtravījaṃ sauḥ iti tṛtīyaṃ vījaṃ | anyat sugamaṃ tārādhīśaścaṃdrastadvījaṃ ṭamiti |
<170b>
vārivījaṃ vamiti koṇe || trilohinī mudrā yathā ||
somasūryāgni rūpāḥ syurvarṇa lohatrayaṃ matāḥ | raupyamiṃduḥ smṛto hemasūryastāmaṃ hutāśanaḥ ||
lohabhāgāḥ samuddiṣṭāḥ svarādyakṣara saṃkhyayā | tairlohaiḥ kārayenmudrāṃ asaṃkalita saṃgatāṃ ||
sāgraṃ sahasraṃ saṃjapya spṛṣṭvā tāṃ juhuyānnaraḥ | tasyāṃ saṃpātayenmaṃtrī sarpiṣā pūrvasaṃkhyayā ||
niḥkṣipya kuṃbhe tāṃ mudrāṃ abhiṣekokta vartmanā | āvāhya pūjayeddevīmupacāraiḥ samāhitaḥ ||
abhiṣicya vinītāya dadyāttāṃ mudrikāṃ guruḥ | iyaṃ raktā kṣudrarogaviṣajvaravināśinī ||
vyālacoramṛgādibhyo rakṣāṃ kuryādviśeṣataḥ | yuddhe vijayamāpnoti dhārayan manujeśvaraḥ ||
svarādyakṣara saṃkṣarasaṃkṣayet ṣoḍaśa paṃcaviṃśati bhāgaṃ agnyātmakaṃ tāmraṃ daśabhāgaṃ somātmakaṃ raupyaṃ ṣoḍaśabhāgaṃ saṃkhyayeti | etadvāritamudrā uktaphaladā || atha mahālakṣmī yaṃtraṃ || vedādisthitasādhyanāmayugaśaḥ śrīśaktimārānvitaṃ kiṃjalkeṣu dineśapatra vilasatmatrākṣaraṃ tadvahiḥ | padmaṃ vyaṃjana keśaraṃ suralasatpadmāṣṭayugmaṃdharāviṃvābhyāṃ vaṣaḍaṃtayā tvaritayā yaṃtraṃ likhedveṣṭitaṃ |
(***) (?)sarvakoṇeṣu hakṣau lekhyau punaḥ punaḥ | mahālakṣmī yaṃtramidaṃ sarvaiśvarya phalapradaṃ ||
<171a>
sarvaduḥkhapraśamanaṃ sarvāyadvi nivāraṇaṃ | vahunā kimihoktena paramasmānna vidyate ||
asyārthaḥ |
dvādaśapatraṃ padmaṃ kṛtvā tatkarṇikāyāṃ oṃ iti vilikhya tanmadhye sādhyanāma śrīvījaṃ hrīṃ vījaṃ klīṃ vījaṃ iti vījatraya saṃhitaṃ likhet | kiṃjalkeṣu ca vījatrayaṃ guṇamaṃtreṇa veṣṭayet | dvādaśapatreṣu maṃtrākṣara dvādaśakaṃ tadvahiḥ ṣoḍaśapatraṃ | tatkeśareṣu yugaśo vyaṃjanāni | patreṣu ṣoḍaśa svarā iti | tadvahirbhūviṃva dvayaṃ vaṣaḍaṃtaṃga tvarita maṃtreṇa veṣṭayet | tatkoṇeṣu hakṣaumiti likhet | iti mahālakṣmī yaṃtraṃ || atha bhuvaneśvaryā striguṇitaṃ | śaktyānnasthiti sādhyakarma bhavanaṃ vahnervṛtaṃ śaktibhirapyāvītami (**)(?) rtha(*)daṃ yaṃtraṃ | bhūpuramadhyagaṃ triguṇitaṃ saubhāgyasaṃpatkaraṃ | asyārthaḥ |
<171b>
ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vilikhya tanmadhye hrīṃ vījaṃ tanmadhye sādhyanāmasahitaṃ karmakathaṃ devadattaṃ rakṣa rakṣa ityādi | koṇatraye īṃ likhet | tadvahiḥ hrīṃ anyonyaṃ vadhnī (**)(?) kathaṃ eṣāṃ vījānāmekaikaṃ repha īkārābhyāṃ pradakṣiṇī kṛtya parasparaṃ vadhnīyāt | tataḥ (**) (*)(?) kapolayoḥ iri hara iti likhet | athavā hariśaṣṭena ikāra repha īkārāḥ sūcyaṃte hari(***)(?) ikārarephāviti | tena hrīṃ hraṃ iti | ayaṃ makṣaḥ sāṃpradāyikaḥ | tato hari īṃ hara īṃ iti likhet athavā hrīṃ īṃ hraṃ īṃ iti likhedvā | tadvahiḥ paṃcadaśākṣarairvā veṣṭayet | punarbhūgṛhena veṣṭayet | etat triguṇita yaṃtra muktaphaladaṃ tathā likhet | iti triguṇita yaṃtraṃ || atha ṣaṭguṇitaṃ yaṃtraṃ bhuvaneśvaryāḥ || vījāṃtasthita sādhyanāma sarasaṃ mamaumaṭayā ramāmanmathairvītaṃ vahni (*****)(?) puṭeśvākhyādya vīja trayaṃ | ātmānātmakamīśikhaṃ hariharairāvaddhagaṃḍaṃ vahiḥ ṣaṭ(****)(?) suvaddha siṃcilipibhirvītaṃ gṛhābhyāṃ bhuvaḥ | ciṃtāmaṇi nṛsiṃhābhyāṃla satkoṇamidaṃ (****) (*)(?) maṃtra ṣaḍguṇitaṃ divyaṃ vahitāṃ sarvasiddhidaṃ |
<172a>
asyārthaḥ | ṣaṭkoṇe hrīṃ vījaṃ sa sādhyaṃ likhet | kathaṃ vījasya repha bhāge sādhyanāma | īkārabhāge sādhakanāma | ubhayormadhye ubhayormadhyekatamāḥ śarasauvāra paṃcakaṃ madhyavījaṃ hrīṃ vījena śrīṃ vījena klīṃ vahnivījena ca veṣṭayet | tadvahiḥ ṣaṭkoṇa madhye sātmakāni sānusvārāṇi likhet | dakṣiṇakoṇatrayetānyeva sādhyāni anusvāra sahitāni īśiṣaṃ ṣaṭkoṇa madhye sānusvāramīkāraṃ gaṃḍayoḥ i harihara iti | ṣaṭkoṇādvahiḥ pūrvavat ṣaṭkoṇa vījāni saṃvaddhānilipibhiḥ | bhūkoṇa dvayena pūrvādiṣu nṛsiṃhavījaṃ koṇeṣu ciṃtāmaṇiriti | iti ṣaḍguṇitaṃ yaṃtraṃ || atha tvaritā yaṃtraṃ || madhye saroje daśapatrayukte māyāṃ likhedvāṃchita sādhyagarbhāṃ | tārādi varṇāṃ daśapatra saṃsthān ṣaṭkoṇavījaṃ vasudhā purasthaṃ | athaḥ syaṣṭa eva | kṛtyā drohādi śamanaṃ vyālacorabhayāpahaṃ | vidhṛtaṃ tvaritā yaṃtraṃ viśeṣādvijayapradaṃ || iti tvaritā yaṃtraṃ || atha yaṃtrāṃtaraṃ tvaritāyāṃ eva || tāre huṃ vilikhet saroja kuhare sādhyābhidhānānvitaṃ maṃtrārṇān vasu saṃkhyakān vasudaleṣvā likhyatadvāhyataḥ |
<172b>
śaktyātriḥ pariveṣṭitaṃ ghaṭavṛtaṃ padmastha mabjānanaṃ yaṃtraṃ vaśykaraṃ grahādi bhayahṛllakṣmīpradaṃ kīrtidaṃ | ityaparaṃ tvaritā yaṃtraṃ || padmaṃ bhānudalānvitaṃ pravilikhettatkarṇikāyāṃ punastāraṃ śaktigasādhyanāmasahitaṃ tatkesareṣu kramāt | mardinyāmanu saṃbhavān yugalasovarṇakān punaḥ patragān maṃtrārṇān guṇaśovidhāya vilikhedatyaṃ tadatte dale |
mātṛkā varṇasaṃvītaṃ bhūpuradvayamadhyagaṃ | yaṃtraṃ viṃdhyanivāsinyāḥ proktaṃ sarvasamṛddhidaṃ ||
rakṣākaraṃ viśeṣeṇa kṣudra kṛtyādi nāśanaṃ | rājyadaṃ bhraṣṭārājyānāṃ vaśyadaṃvaśyamicchatāṃ ||
sutārthinīnāṃ sutadaṃ rogiṇāṃ rogaśāṃtidaṃ | vahunā kimihoktena yaṃtraṃ tatkāmadomaṇiḥ ||
asyārthaḥ |
mahiṣārdinyā maṃtryakṣarāṇi | aṣṭapatreṣu maṃtrārṇān yugalaśaḥ tadupari ṣoḍaśa daleṣu vanavāsinyāstrīṇitrīṇi akṣarāṇi likhet | iti vanavāsinī yaṃtraṃ || atha tripurabhairavī yaṃtraṃ || madhyādyaṃ navayoniṣu pravilikhedvīmānivarṇāṃ striśo gāyatryāṣu narabjapatra vivareṣvā likhyalipyāvṛtaṃ |
<173a>
bhūrvivadvitayena manmathayujākoṇeṣu saṃveṣṭitaṃ yaṃtraṃtrepuramīritaṃ tribhuvana prakṣobhakaṃ śrīpradaṃ |
asmin yaṃtre samāvāhya samyak saṃpūjayettataḥ | japena kṛtasaṃpātaṃ lākṣālohatrayāvṛtaṃ ||
vibhṛtaṃ vāhunā yaṃtraṃ yuddheṣu vijayāvahaṃ | vā devāgvijayaṃ kuryāt kavitvaṃ puṣkalaṃ bhavet ||
āyurā rogyamitrāṇi putrapautrān vivardhayet |
asyārthaḥ |
navayoni cakraṃ kṛtvā uparitana īśānakoṇamārabhya yoniṣu maṃtrīvījāni trīṇi <2> yathā kramaṃ punaḥ <2> likhet | taduparyaṣṭadalaṃ kamalaṃ kṛtvā pratyekaṃ triśaḥ <2> gāyatrī varṇān | tadupari vṛttaṃ kṛtvā tanmadhye mātṛkāvarṇān | tadupari nūpuradvayaṃ tatkoṇeṣu manmathavījaṃ likhet | etadyaṃtraṃ proktaphaladaṃ | iti tripurabhairavī yaṃtraṃ || atha mahāgaṇapati yaṃtraṃ || vījaṃ ṣaṭkoṇa madhye sphuradanalapuraṃtāragaṃdikṣu lakṣmī māyākaṃdarpa bhūmīstadanu rasapuṭeṣṭāṃ likhed vījaṣaṭkaṃ |
<173b>
tatsaṃviṣṭāṃga maṃtrān vasudala kamale mūlamaṃtrasya varṇān śiṣṭān patreṣu vidvān vilikhatu guṇaśaścāṃtyamaṃtyepalāśe || āvītaṃ lipibhiḥ kramoktamavaśān pāśāṃkuśābhyāmapi kṣmā geha dvitayena veṣṭitamidaṃ yaṃtraṃ gaṇādhīśituḥ | lākṣākuṃkuma rocanā mṛgamadairbhūrjevare hemnivāsaṃ likhyābhi vahellabheta sakalaiḥ saṃprārthanīyāṃ śriyaṃ || asyārthaḥ ||
trikoṇaṃ vilikhya tanmadhye praṇavaṃ sa sādhyaṃ gaṇeśa vījasahitaṃ | tadvahiḥ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ trikoṇādvahiścaturdikṣu hrīṃ klīṃ glauṃ iti likhet | koṇa ṣaṭkeṣu praṇavādi ṣaṭvījāni likhet | koṇasaṃdhiṣṭhāṃgamaṃtrān | taduparyaṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ patreṣu trayaḥ <2> maṃtravarṇān avaśiṣṭān aṃtyapatre tadvahiranuloma pratilomaḥ lipibhirveṣṭayet | iti mahāgaṇapati yaṃtraṃ ||
<174a>
atha rāma yaṃtraṃ || tāraṃ likhet koṇagaṃḍeṣu paścāt kiṃjakteṣu svaragaṇamatho patra madhyeṣu mālā |
maṃtrohyarṇā guṇamukhasitānaṣṭame maṃtravarṇān | daśākṣareṇa saṃveṣṭyakādi varṇaiśca bhūpure ||
digvidikṣu likhedvījaṃ nārasiṃha varāhayoḥ | japādisādhitaṃ yaṃtraṃ svarṇapaṭṭādi nirmitaṃ ||
vāhunā vidhṛtaṃ dadyādvijayaśrī parākramān | gaditaṃ vai rāmayaṃtra vidhānaṃ munipūjitaṃ ||
(***)(?) ṣaṭkoṇa madhye praṇavaṃ tanmadhye sādhyaṃ ṣaṭsu koṇeṣu maṃtravarṇān | tatra saṃdhiṣṭhāṃga maṃtravarṇān tataḥ pratyekaṃ hṛllekhā vījaṃ kāmavījaṃ ca likhet || taduparyaṣṭadalaṃ kamalaṃ tatkesareṣu pratyekaṃ mālāmaṃtrasya ṣaṭ ṣaṭvarṇān aṣṭame dale paṃcavarṇān | tadupari daśākṣareṇa maṃtreṇa veṣṭayitvā taduparikādivarṇaiḥ paścādbhūpureṇa veṣṭayet | dikṣu varāhavījaṃ koṇeṣu narasiṃhavījaṃ || iti rāmayaṃtraṃ || atha varāhayaṃtraṃ || madhye vījaṃ sa tāraṃ dahanapurayuge cakravarṇān ṣaḍāśreṣṭhābhikhyaṃgāni saṃdhiṣṭhathakaraṇadale kesarastha svarāhye | maṃtrārṇān vedasaṃkhyān
<174b>
dalamanulikhedaṃtamaṃtye'tha vāhye kiṃjalke kādivarṇā vikasita kamale ṣoḍaśāre yathāvat | maṃtrārṇān yugaśastūccaramadanagataṃ śliṣṭavarṇaṃ likhitvā kṣmākoṇa vījaistadanu parivṛtaṃ sādhyanāmārṇamadhyaiḥ | darvibhiḥ sādhyanāmārṇairmaṃtravarṇairvṛtaṃ vahiḥ |
bhūviṃvenāsyakoṇeṣu bhūvījaṃ sādhyasaṃyutaṃ | aṣṭaśūleṣu vārāhaṃ bhūvījasahitaṃ likhet ||
sārvīśavimḍugaganaṃ vījadhārāmamīritaṃ | rocanā gurukarpūralākṣā kuṃkumacaṃdanaiḥ ||
gomayāṃbhasi saṃpiṣṭairlikhedyaṃtraṃ śubhe dine | lekhinya hi mamapyatha maṃtrī kāma prasiddhaye ||
svarṇapaṭṭe likhedyaṃtraṃ rājyaśrī samavāptaye | bhūrjapatre nijeṣṭāptyai kṣaume bhūsiddhaye likhet ||
japapūjādibhiḥ siddhaṃ yaṃtraṃ kuryānnijepsitaṃ | rāmapattana rāṣṭreṣu yaṃtrame tatsusādhitaṃ ||
nikhanecchu bhavārādausāṃgaṃ dikṣu samarcayet | kṣudrāpa mṛtyurogādi bhūtavyālamahābhayaiḥ ||
na śakyate padaṃ iṣṭuṃtaṃ deśaṃ devatā valāt |
asyārthaḥ |
sādhya ṣaṭkoṇādvahiścaturdalaṃ | koṇeṣu cakrākṣarāṇi saṃdhiṣu ṣaḍaṃgāni ||
catuḥ patreṣu nārāyaṇāṣṭākṣara dvayaṃ | patreṣu vārāhamaṃtrasya caturaścaturaḥ | tadvāhye ṣoḍaśadalaṃ tatkeśareṣukādiśāṃtādvaṃdvaśaḥ |
<175a>
patreṣu maṃtravarṇadvayaṃ | tadupari śravaṇa ca bhūvarāhavījaiḥ sādhyagarbhaiḥ | tato maṃtrārṇaiḥ | bhūviṃvena sa sādhyena kṣmāvījakoṇena veṣṭitaṃ aṣṭaśūlaṃ sa bhūvījaṃ likhet || iti vārāha yaṃtraṃ || atha cakraṃ yaṃtraṃ || tāraṃ likhedvāṃtagataṃ sa sādhyaṃ teṣveva śiṣṭaṃ manuvarṇaṣaṭkaṃ | aṃgāni saṃdhiṣvatha ṣoḍaśāraṃ sa ṣoḍaśārṇaṃ vasudhāpurasthaṃ | ṣaṭkoṇa madhye vilikhet sa sādhyaṃ tāraṃ ṣaḍasriṣvathaśiṣṭavarṇān | aṃgāni tatsaṃdhiṣu tatra madhye nyaseta hauṃ kṣāṃ vidhivat prajaptāṃ |
japitvā kṛta saṃpātaṃ garbhiṇīnāṃ hitapradaṃ | abhicāra grahonmādān yaṃtrametadvināśayet ||
tāramityasyārthaḥ | ṣaṭkoṇamadhye praṇavaṃ sa sādhyaṃ likhitvā garbheṭhakāraṃ koṇeṣu maṃtravarṇa ṣaṭkaṃ saṃdhiṣvaṃga maṃtrān | upariṣoḍaśapatraṃ kamalaṃ bhūpuradvayenāvṛtaṃ |
<175b>
ṣoḍaśa daleṣu ṣoḍaśākṣara varṇāniti || athābhiṣekamāha |
palāśakṣīra vṛkṣāṇāṃ tvacomalayajaṃpuraṃ | kuṃkumaṃ yāminīkoṣṭhaṃ vilvāpāmārga sarṣapān ||
tiladūrvājavān devī tulasī yugalaṃkuśaṃ | lakṣmīṃ gorocanāṃ padmaṃ va cāṃgomayasaṃyutāṃ ||
viṣṇukrāṃtā markayuktāṃ japanmaṃtraṃ vinikṣipet | paṃcagavyena saṃpūrṇe pātre tatsaṃkṛte'nale ||
saṃsthāpya kvāthayet samyagyāvadbhasma bhaviṣyati | tadādāya japedbhūyaḥ prayutaṃ devatā dhiyā ||
liṃpet sarvāṃgametena kiṃcicchirasini kṣipet | kṛtyā drohagrahonmādavyādhi duḥkhanivāraṇaḥ ||
sarvaśatru praśamanaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ paraṃ | śubhadaṃ vaśyadaṃ puṃsāṃ samastāpannivāraṇaṃ ||
garbhiṇī valarugnānāṃ viśeṣeṇa praśasyate | asmāt paratarā rakṣānāsti lokeṣu kīrtitā ||
malayajaṃ caṃdanaṃ | puruṃ gugguluṃ | yāminī haridrā | devī sahadevī | lakṣmī vilvaṃ | etatsarvaṃ paṃcagavye pūrṇakuṃbhe kṣipet | prayutaṃ daśalakṣaṃ lakṣadvayaṃ vā || paṃcagavya ghṛtaprakāramāha | mustāmaṭīniśā vahnirelāyaṣṭi vacāvṛṣā |
pāṭhāviḍaṃgaṃ maṃjiṣṭhā drākṣā dārvī sa rohiṇī | phalatrayaṃ cataiḥ kalkaiḥ paṃcagavyeṣu sarpiṣā ||
prasthaṃ pivedyathā nyāyaṃ maṃtreṇānena sādhitaṃ | śāṃtidaṃ sutadaṃ strīṇāṃ bhūtapreta bhayāpahaṃ ||
garbharakṣākaraṃ śuddhaṃ paramasmānna vidyate | mustāmopyaṃ niśā haridrā vahniścitrakamūlaṃ ||
<176a>
yaṣṭiḥ madhu yaṣṭiḥ | rohiṇī kaṭukī | phalatrayaṃ harītakyādi | prasthaparimitaṃ ghṛtaṃ samyak pācayet | maṃtrasādhita muktaphaladaṃ || atha puruṣottama yaṃtraṃ || kāmollāsita sādhya maṃgavilasat ṣaṭkoṇametadvahiḥ gāyatrī guṇavaddha varṇa su dalaṃ mālāmanorakṣaraiḥ | ṣaṭsaṃkhyaiḥ sahitāṣṭa patrasahitaṃ kṣoṇī pureṇā vṛtaṃ koṇanyasta mano bhavena sahitaṃ yaṃtraṃ jaganmohanaṃ | asyārthaḥ | ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vilikhya tanmadhye kāmavījaṃ ṣaṭkoṇopari aṣṭadalaṃ kamalaṃ pratimaṃtraṃ kāmagāyatryā akṣaratrayaṃ <2> | punastaduparyaṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ tasya prati patraṃ mālāmaṃtrākṣara ṣaṭkaṃ <2> | tataḥ bhūpuraṃ sā kāmavījaṃ vaśyārthaṃ dhārayet | iti puruṣottama yaṃtraṃ || śūlāṃkite vahni gṛhasya yugme dhūmāvatī maṃtralikhet krameṇa | madhyādi koṇeṣu marudgṛhasthaṃ yaṃtraṃ hutāśā nila vahnivījaṃ | dāṃtośārvīśaviṃdvaṃtau vīje dhūmāvaṃtīṃ manuḥ proktaḥ śatru nigrahakārakaḥ viṣeṇa kanakāṃbhobhiḥ pretakarpaṭakalpitaṃ |
<176b>
śmaśāne nikhanedetacchatrumutsādayeddhruvaṃ | asyārthaḥ | ṣaṭkoṇa dhūmāvatī maṃtraṃ ekaikaṃ likhet | tadvahirvāyu gṛhena veṣṭayet | tato repheṇa | tadvahiryakāreṇa | pretavastre dhattūrakarasena kākapakṣa lekhanyā likhitvā śmaśāne nikhanet | śatrūccāṭanaṃ bhavet || māmālikhyamakārakoṣṭhayugale koṇeṣu tasyā likhenmaṃtrajñoṅaṇanāñjakārasahitān dhūmāvatīṃ patragāṃ | vītaṃ gharmaṭikādināparamidaṃ vāyutrigehāvṛtaṃ yaṃtraṃ prāṃtapareta bhūmi nihitaṃ vidveṣaṇaṃ syāt dviṣaḥ | asyārthaḥ | aṣṭadalakamalaṃ kṛtvā tanmadhyemāṃkāraṃ tatkoṣṭhadvaye sādhyaṃ makāreṇa catuṣṭayenaṅaṇanārṇān patreṣu dhūmāvatīṃ | vahirghumuṭikādinā veṣṭayet | etat pretavastreṇa dhattūra karasena kākapakṣa lekhanyā likhet | śmaśāne nihitaṃ dveṣakaraṇaṃ |
<177a>
ekāśīti padeṣu madhya dahane sādhyaṃ likheddhuṃ punaḥ kṣtrūṃ śrūṃ vrūṃñjitidiggatā su vilikhedvījān paṃktiyvatha | śiṣṭoṣvīśa niśācarādi vilikhetkālī manupaṃktiśastadvāhye yamavītamagni yavanāvītaṃ ca yaṃtraṃ likhet | likhedaṣṭaviṣāṃgāraniṃvaniryāsakajjalaiḥ |
nigrahākṣamidaṃ cakraṃ kākapakṣeṇa karpaṭe | vibhīta vṛkṣe valmīke śmaśāne vā catuḥ pathe ||
dakṣiṇasthenilemaṃtrī nikhanedartharārdhake | sarvathā śatruretena saptāhānmrīyate ripuḥ ||
nigrahīta mahārogaiḥ patite vā bhavedasau | śilāyāmi (****)(?) cakrame tatprakīrtitaṃ ||
markaṭī viṣadaṃḍībhiḥ samālikhya madhomukhaṃ | yatra rātrauravānaṃ tatra bhūyāśubhaṃ bhavet ||
ākhyātuṃ puramadhyataḥ smaragatāmālikhya jaṃbhābhidhāṃ vidyāṃ diggatapatrakeṣvatha likheddevī daleṣu smaraṃ | koṇastheṣu samānakaṃ ca hi rataḥ pāśāṃkuśābhyāṃ vṛtaṃ yaṃtraṃ vaśyakaraṃ grahādi bhayahṛt kṣudrābhicārāpahaṃ |
<177b>
asyārthaḥ | aṣṭadalakamala madhye tuṃ vuruvījaṃ tanmadhye kāmavījaṃ tataḥ sā(*)(?) dikpatreṣu | jaṃbhejaṃbhini mohemohini aṃdheaṃdhini ruṃdheruṃdhi svāhā sarvatra || atha mṛtyuṃjayaṃ yaṃtraṃ || puṭī kṛte bhūmipurasya yugme māyāṃ likhenmanmatha sādhyasaṃjñāṃ | cakāra koṇena mahīpureṇa saṃveṣṭitaṃ kasyakaraṃ taduccaiḥ | madhye sārṇavidarbhitaṃ prapuṭitaṃ mṛtyuṃjayaṃ tryakṣaraiḥkṣāṃtasthaṃ nijasādhyanāma vilikhet kiṃjalkasaṃsthānsurān | patreṣvaṣṭāsu nāmamaṃtrapuṭitaṃ vargeṣvatho yaṃtraṃ padmapuṭīkṛtaṃ nigaditaṃ mṛtyuṃjayākhyaṃ paraṃ | viṣajvara śiroroganāśanaṃ śrījayapradaṃ | kāṃtipuṣṭipradaṃ vaśyaṃ sarvakamārthasādhakaṃ | asyārthaḥ | aṣṭadalakamalaṃ kṛtvā daleṣu svarakesaraṃ kṛtvā kamalakarṇikāyāṃ kṣakāraṃ tanmadhye mārṇavidarbhitaṃ sādhyanāma mṛtyuṃjaya tryakṣarapuṭitaṃ kṛtvā patreṣtaṣṭayuk tryakṣarapuṭitaṃ nāmalikhet | patrāṃgeṣvaṣṭavargān | aṣṭa upari padmadvayena puṭitaṃ yaṃtramuktaphaladaṃ || iti mṛtyuṃjaya yaṃtraṃ || oṃkāramāyādiṣu mekhalegni vadhūrmanuṃ vahni gṛhasya yugme | madhyādi koṇeṣu vilikhya bhūrje yaṃtraṃ vidadhyādripunāgahāniṃ || asyārthaḥ | vahnigehayugaṃ likhitvā |
<178a>
madhye oṃkāraṃ koṇeṣu hrīṃ mekhale svāheti likhet ||
vihāya vījaṃ nṛkāraṃ glakāraṃ tatra saṃlikhet | kṣakāre nāvṛtaṃ vāhye pāśāṃkuśa vṛtaṃ punaḥ ||
ṭakāreṇāvṛtaṃ bhūyobhūmimaṃḍalamadhyagaṃ | lakārairviṃdu saṃyuktairveṣṭitaṃ tadvahiḥ kramāt ||
sargāṃta mātṛkā vīja sarvaṃ vṛttena ceṣṭitaṃ | kaukṣaiṃya karpāṭe kḷptamiṣṭadvayaṃ ca madhyagaṃ ||
senāgre nikhanede tatstaṃbhanaṃ kurute dhruvaṃ ||
madhye śrīnarasiṃha vījamatha tadvāhya svarān kesarevārīdveṃduyameṃdrakeṣu vilikhen madhye manuṃ gāruḍaṃ | aṃtasthānmarudagni nairṛti śiveṣvālikhya vargāvṛtaṃ yaṃtraṃ mājibhiraṣṭibhiḥ parivṛtaṃ saṃvartakairgāruḍaṃ || asyārthaḥ | aṣṭadalakamala madhye nṛsiṃhavījaṃ svarāḥ kesareṣu | paścimottara yāmya patreṣu madhye gāruḍamaṃtraṃ | vāyuvahni nirṛti śikhi patreṣu yaralavāḥ | vahirvarāhena tadvahiraṣṭabhiḥ kṣakārairveṣṭayet | etadyaṃtraṃ dhārayataḥ paśyataśca sarvaviṣaṃ naśyati ||
<178b>
atha kāmayaṃtraṃ || sādhyaḥ saṃpuṭitaiḥ smarairapi vṛtaṃ kāmaṃ likhenmadhyataḥ paścāttārapikārapakṣaparānnāśārpi jhaṃṭīśapān | śūlāṣṭāṣṭa daleṣu sādhavilikhet tāṃvūlapatrodareyaṃtraṃ tanniśikhādayet kṛtajapaṃ vaśobhavettatrasaḥ | asyārthaḥ aṣṭapatra padmaṃ tāṃvūlodarelikhitvā tanmadhye kāmavījaṃ sa sādhyanāmākṣarapuṭitaiḥ kāmavījaistadveṣṭayet | paścādaṣṭa patreṣu pratyekaṃ vakṣyamāna vījāni vilikhet | kathaṃ tāraḥ oṃkāraḥ | oṃkāraḥ | khaṃ ṛṃ uṃ eṃ yaṃ aṣṭadaleṣu likhecchūlāni dalāgreṣu | etadyaṃtraṃ vaśyakaraṃ || atha goviṃdayaṃtraṃ || prāk pratyagdakṣiṇodagvividhadabhilikhet sāṣṭarekhā catuṣkaṃ koṇodyacchūla yuktaṃ valayugayutaṃ madhyakoṣṭhe tadaṃaḥ | ślokasyārṇān parastādvasudalavivare'ṣṭavarṇaṃ likhitvā tadvāhye dvādaśārṇestadanuparivṛtaṃ devakīputrayaṃtraṃ | likhitaṃ bhūrjapatrādau yaṃtrame tadyathā vidhividhṛtaṃ vāhunā nityaṃ sarvakāma phalapradaṃ | palāśavṛkṣaphalake likhitaṃ sādhusādhitaṃ | gosthāne nikhanede tadgavāṃ vṛddhiḥ prajāyate ||
<179a>
atha lekhyadravyāṇi ||
kāśmīrarocanā lākṣā mṛgebhamadacaṃdanaiḥ | vilikheddhemalekhanyā yaṃtrāṇyetāni deśikaḥ ||
bhūmisṛṣṭaṃ vaśaspṛṣṭaṃ dagdhaṃ nirmālyasaṃgataṃ | vistīrṇaṃ laṃghitaṃ maṃtrī yaṃtraṃ jātu na dhārayet ||
atha yaṃtrarūpāṇi dīkṣādyupayuktāni sarvatobhadranavanābhapaṃcābjāni maṃḍalāni likhyaṃte || sarvatobhadraṃ yathā ||
caturasraṃ catuḥkoṣṭhe karṇasūtrasamanvite | caturṣvapi ca koṇeṣu dadyāt sūtracatuṣṭayaṃ ||
tataḥ koṣṭheṣu matsyāḥ syusteṣu sūtreṣu pātayet | ṣaṭtriṃśattānityadairmadhye likhet padmaṃ salakṣaṇaṃ ||
vahiḥ paṃktyā bhavet pītaṃ paṃktiyugmena vīthikāḥ | dvāraśobhopaśobhāśca śiṣṭābhyāṃ parikalpayet ||
śāstroktavidhinā maṃtrī tataḥ padmaṃ samālikhet | padmakṣetrasya saṃtyajya dvādaśāṃśaṃ vahiḥ sudhīḥ ||
tanmadhyaṃ vibhaje mṛttaistribhiḥ samavibhāgaśaḥ | ādyaṃ syāt karṇikāsthānaṃ keśarāṇāṃ dvitīyakaṃ ||
tṛtīyaṃ tatra patrāṇāṃ uktāṃśena dalāgrakaṃ | vāhyavṛṃtāṃtarālasya mānaṃ yad vidhinā sudhīḥ ||
nidhāya keśarāgreṣu paritorddhaniśākarān | likhitvā saṃdhisaṃsthāne tataḥ mūtrāṇi pātayet ||
dalāgrāṇāṃ ca yanmāna tanmānaṃ vṛṃtamālikhet | tadaṃtarāle tanmadhye sūtrasyobhayataḥ sudhīḥ ||
<179b>
prālikhed vāhyahastena dalāgrāṇi samaṃ tataḥ | dalamūlena yugaśaḥ kesarāṇi prakalpayet ||
etat sādhāraṇaṃ proktaṃ paṃkajaṃ taṃtravedibhiḥ | padāni trīṇi pādārthaṃ pīṭhakoṇeṣu mārjayet ||
avaśiṣṭaiḥ padairvidvān pīṭhagātrāṇi kalpayet | padāni vīthisaṃsthāni mārjayet paṃktyabhedataḥ ||
dikṣu dvārāṇi yajet dvicatuḥkoṣṭhakaistataḥ | padaistribhirathaikena bhāgāḥ syurdvārapārśvataḥ ||
upaśobhāḥ syurekaina tribhiḥ koṣṭhairanaṃtaraṃ | avaśiṣṭaiḥ padaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ koṇānāṃ syāccatuṣṭayaṃ ||
raṃjayet paṃcabhirvarṇairmaṃḍalaṃ tanmanoharaṃ | pītaṃ haridrācūrṇaṃ syācchvetaṃ taṃḍulasaṃbhavaṃ ||
kusuṃbhacūrṇamaruṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dagdhapulākajaṃ | vilvādi dīpakaṃ śyāmamityuktaṃ varṇapaṃcakaṃ ||
aṃgulotsedhavistārā śrīmā rekhāḥ sitāḥ śubhāḥ | karṇikā pītavarṇena kesarāṇyaruṇena ca ||
śubhravarṇena paṃtrāṇi tatsaṃdhīḥ śyāmalena ca |
<180a>
rajasāsaṃ japenmaṃtrī yadvā pītaiva varṇikā ||
kesarāḥ pītaraktāḥ syuraruṇāni padānyapi | saṃdhayaḥ pītavarṇāḥ syuḥ pītenāpyasitena vā ||
raṃjayet pīṭhagarbhāṇi pādāḥ syuraruṇāḥ śubhāḥ | gātrāṇi tasya śuklāni vīthīṣu ca catasṛṣu ||
ālikhet kalpalatikā dalapuṣpaphalānvitāḥ | varṇārnānāvidhaiścitrāḥ sarvadṛṣṭi manoharāḥ ||
dvārāṇi śvetavarṇāni śobhā raktāḥ samīritāḥ | upaśobhāḥ pīitavarṇāḥ koṇānyasitabhāṃsi ca ||
tisrorekhā vahiḥ kāryāsitaraktā sitāḥ kramāt | maṃḍalaṃ sarvato bhadrame tatsādhāraṇaṃ smṛtaṃ ||
asyārthaḥ ||
uktaprakāreṇa pūrvapaścimāyatā uttaradakṣiṇāyatāśca saptadaśarekhā samāḥ koṣṭhāḥ kāryāḥ | madhyastha ṣaḍbhiḥ koṣṭhaiḥ padmaṃ likhet | padmamadhye pītavarṇāni kesarāṇi aruṇāni patrāṇi śubhrāṇi patrasaṃdhayaḥ | asitā varṇāḥ | padmoparipaṃktyaikena pīṭhaṃ kāryaṃ | tribhistribhiḥ koṣṭhaiḥ pītādyāḥ | aruṇāḥ koṣṭha catuṣṭaye kāryāḥ | pīṭhoparipaṃktidvaye nānāvarṇāḥ sarvato vīthīkāḥ kartavyāḥ | uparipaṃktidvayamavaśiṣṭaṃ jātaṃ | tasya koṇeṣu pādacatuṣṭayeṣu haritaṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ koṣṭhaiḥ kāryaṃ | tatsamīpastha koṣṭha trayeṇa tadarddhe naiva ca pītā upaśobhāḥ kāryāḥ |
<180b>
dvārāṇi caturbhiḥ koṣṭhaiḥ | dvābhyāṃ ca śvetavarṇāni evaṃ ca dikṣu voddhavyāḥ | tato maṃḍalādvahistisrorekhāḥ śvetāruṇa kṛṣṇavarṇāḥ kāryāḥ | evaṃ sarvato bhadramaṃḍalaṃ manoharaṃ saṃpadyate || atha navanābhamaṃḍalaṃ kathyate ||
caturasre catuḥ ṣaṣṭhi padānyā racayet sudhīḥ | pādaiścaturbhiḥ padmaṃ syānmadhye tatparitaḥ punaḥ ||
vīthīścatasraḥ kurvīta maṃḍalāṃtāvasānikāḥ | diggateṣu catuṣkeṣu padmāni ca samālikhet ||
vidiggata catuḥkānibhitvāṃ ṣoḍaśadhā sudhīḥ | mārjayet svastikākāraṃ śvetapītāruṇāsitaiḥ ||
rajobhiḥ pūrayettāni svastikānisitāditaḥ | prāk proktenaiva mārgeṇa śeṣamanyat samāpayet ||
navanābhamidaṃ proktaṃ maṃḍalaṃ sarvasiddhidaṃ ||
asyārthaḥ |
pūrvapaścimāyatānavarekhāḥ samāḥ kāryāḥ | tathottarāyatāśca navarekhāḥ kāryāḥ | evaṃ caturasraṃ samyak catuḥṣaṣṭikoṣṭhātmakaṃ saṃpadyate | tasya koṇasya koṇacatuṣṭayaṃ bhitvā ṣoḍaśadhā kāryāḥ ||
<181a>
ṣoḍaśakoṣṭhamadhye tribhiḥ koṣṭhaiḥ ekena ca liṃgākāraṃ saṃpadyate | tathaiva trayamapi | evaṃ svastikaṃ koṇacatuṣṭaye kāryaṃ dikṣu koṇacatuṣṭayena padmacatuṣṭayaṃ kāryaṃ | madhyastha koṇacatuṣṭaye padmaikaṃ | avaśiṣṭa koṇapaṃktibhirvīthī catuṣṭayasīmāṃtaṃ kāryaṃ | evaṃ navanābhamaṃḍalaṃ bhavati || atha paṃcābjaṃ || paṃcābjaṃ maṃḍalaṃ proktametatsvastikavarjitaṃ | dīkṣāyāṃ devapūjārthaṃ maṃḍalānāṃ trayaṃ śubhaṃ || svastikasthāne koṇacatuṣṭaye varṇikāpūraṇaṃ caturasraṃ kāryaṃ | pūrvavat padmapaṃcakaṃ caturdikṣu madhye ca kāryaṃ | vīthyaścatasrakāryāḥ || [iti śrīmadāsādityatripāṭhīsaṃgṛhīte maṃtrakoṣe yaṃtrakathanaṃ nāma ekonaviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ] || atha devapūjādau upayuktā mudrā likhyaṃte | āvāhanādikā mudrāḥ pradarśyaṃte yathā kramāt ||
yābhirviracitābhistu modaṃte maṃtra devatāḥ | samyak saṃpūritaiḥ puṣpaiḥ karābhyāṃ racito'ṃjaliḥ ||
āvāhanākhyā kathitā mudrā deśikasaptamaiḥ || <1> || adhomukhī kṛtā saiva proktāsthāpana karmaṇi || <2> ||
āśliṣṭa muṣṭi yugalā pronnatāṃguṣṭha yugmikā | sannidhāne samuddiṣṭā mudreyaṃ deśikādibhiḥ || <3> ||
śrīguṣṭagarbhiṇī saiva sannirodhe samīritāḥ || <4> ||
<181b>
devatāṃge ṣaḍaṃgānāṃ nyāsaḥ syāt sakalīkṛtaḥ || <5> ||
savyahastakṛtā muṣṭidīrghādho mukhatarjanī | avaguṃṭhana mudreyaṃ proktā deśikasattamaiḥ || <6> ||
anyonyābhi mukhāśliṣṭakaniṣṭhānāmikā punaḥ | tathā tarjanimadhyeyaṃ dhenumudrā prakīrtitā || <7> ||
amṛtīkaraṇaṃ kuryādyathā deśikasattamaḥ || <8> ||
anyonyagrathitāṃguṣṭhāḥ prasāritakarāṃguliḥ | mahāmudreyamuditā paramīkaraṇe vudhaiḥ ||
prayojayedimā mudrā devatāyāga karmaṇi ||
athākṣamālā |
ādīkṣātānya yogatvā dakṣamāleti kīrtitā | tadvarṇa saṃkhyairmaṇibhirjapamālāṃ prakalpayet ||
rudrabhūmālikāsūre japet svamano rathāt | padmākṣairvihitāmālā śatrūṇāṃ nāśinīmatā ||
kuśagraṃthimayīmālā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī | putraṃ jīvaphalaiḥ proktā kurute putra saṃpadaṃ ||
nirmitā rūpyamaṇibhirjapamālāsthitipradya | hiraṇmayairviracitā mālākāmān prayacchati ||
pravālairvihitāmālā prayacchet puṣkalaṃdhanaṃ | saubhāgyaṃ sphāṭikī mālāmauktikairvihitāśriyaṃ ||
nirmitā śaṃkhamaṇibhiḥ kurute kīrtimakṣayāṃ | sarvairetairviracitāmālā syānmuktayenṛṇāṃ ||
atha vaśyādi proyogopayuktāni ṣaṭkarmāṇi likhyaṃte ||
abhidhāsye hi taṃtre'smin samyak ṣaṭkarmalakṣaṇaṃ | sarvataṃtrānusāreṇa prayogaphalasiddhidaṃ ||
śāṃtivaśyastaṃbhanāni dveṣaṇoccāṭane tataḥ |
<182a>
māraṇāṃtāniśaṃsaṃti ṣaṭkarmāṇi manīṣiṇaḥ ||
rogakṛtyā grahādīnāṃ nirāsaḥ śāṃtirīritā || <1> || vaśyaṃ janānāṃ sarveṣāṃ vidheyatvamudīritaṃ || <2> || pravṛttirodhaḥ sarveṣāṃ staṃbhanaṃ tadudāhṛtaṃ || <3> || snigdhānāṃ dveṣajananaṃmitho vidveṣaṇaṃ mataṃ || <4> || uccāṭanaṃ svadeśāderbhramaṇaṃ parikīrtitaṃ || <5> || prāṇināṃ prāṇaharaṇaṃ māraṇaṃ tadudāhṛtaṃ || <6> ||
svadevatādi kālādīn jñātvā karmāṇi sādhayet | ratirvāṇī ramājyeṣṭhā durgākālī yathā kramāt ||
ṣaṭkarmadevatāḥ proktāḥ karmādautāḥ prayojayet ||
īśacaṃdreṃdra nirṛti vādvagnīnāṃdiśomatāḥ | sūryodayaṃ samārabhya ghaṭikādaśakaṃ kramāt ||
ṛtavaḥ syurvasaṃtādyā ahorātraṃ dine dine | vasaṃtagrīṣmavarṣākhyaśaraddhe maṃtaśaiśirāḥ ||
hemaṃtaḥ śāṃtike prokto vasaṃto vaśyakarmaṇi | śiśiraḥ staṃbhane jñeyo vidveṣo brahma īritaḥ ||
prāvṛduccāṭane jñeyā śaranmāraṇa karmaṇi | padmākhyaṃ svastikaṃ bhūyo vikaṭaṃ kukkuṭaṃ punaḥ ||
vajraprahvākhyamāhurāsanāni manīṣiṇaḥ | ṣaṇmudrāḥ kramato jñeyāḥ padmapāśagadādvayaḥ ||
muśalāsallikhaḍgākhyāḥ śāṃtikādiṣu karmasu | jaleṃ śāṃtividhauśastaṃ vaśye vahnirudīritaḥ ||
staṃbhane pṛthivīśastā vidveṣe vyomakīrtitaṃ | uccāṭane smṛto vāyu bhūyognirmāraṇe mataḥ ||
tattadbhūtodake samyak tattanmaṃḍala saṃyutaṃ | tattatkarmavidhātavyaṃ tṛṇāni niśitātmanā ||
<182b>
sitāṃtyusalilakṣoṇī vyomavāyuhavirbhujaḥ | maṃtrāṃ syurvarṇavījāni ṣaṭkarmasu yathā kramāṃ ||
gaṃthanaṃ ca vidarbhaśca saṃpuṭo ropaṇaṃ tathā | yogaḥ pallava ityete vinyāsāḥ ṣaṭsukarmasu ||
maṃtrārṇāṃtaritān kuryānnāma varṇān yathāvidhi | gaṃthanaṃ taddhi vijñeyaṃ praśastaṃ śāṃtikarmaṇi || <1> ||
maṃtrārṇadvaṃdva madhyasthaṃ sādhyanāmākṣaraṃ likhet | vidarbha eṣa vijñeyo maṃtribhirvaśyakarmaṇi || <2> ||
ādāvaṃte ca maṃtraḥ syānnyastosau saṃpuṭaḥ smṛtaḥ | eṣa saṃstaṃbhane śasta ityukto maṃtravedibhiḥ || <3> ||
nāmna ādyaṃta madhyeṣu maṃtraḥ syādroṣano mataḥ | vidveṣaṇa vidhānena praśastamidamuttamaṃ || <4> ||
maṃtrasyāṃte bhavennāma yogaḥ proccāṭane mataḥ || <5> ||
aṃte nāmno bhavenmaṃtraḥ pallavo māraṇemataḥ || <6> ||
sitaraktapītamiśra kṛṣṇadhūmrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | varṇato maṃtrataḥ proktā devatāḥ ṣaṭsukarmasu ||
yaṃtrāṇāṃ lekhanaṃ dravyaṃ caṃdanaṃ rocanā niśā | gṛhadhūmavitāṃgārā māraṇeṣu viṣāṇi ca ||
śyenāgni loṇapiṃḍāni dhattūrakarasastathā | gṛhadhūmastrikaṭukaṃ viṣāṣṭakamudīritaṃ ||
devatā kālamudrādīn samyak jñātvā vicakṣaṇaḥ | ṣaṭkarmāṇi prayuṃjīta yathokta phalasiddhaye ||
śyenaḥ syenaviṣṭhā | gṛhagodhikāgodhā | agniścitrakaṃ | loṇapiṃḍāni loṇamalaṃ | iti sarvavijānataḥ puruṣasya tattatkarmasiddhyati nānyatheti || jalādi bhūtodayo yathā |
<183a>
ūrdhve vahniradhaścāpastiryak ketu prabhaṃjanaḥ | kṣomadhyapuṭe jñeyā nāmaḥ sarvatra pūritaṃ | iti vaśyādi karmaṇi svarodaya prāraṃbhe apekṣaṇīyaḥ || śāṃtau vaśye ca saumyāstithayaḥ | anyeṣu krūrāḥ | śāṃtivaśyayormṛdu dhruvanakṣatrāṇi | staṃbhane dhruvanakṣatrāṇi | māraṇādau ukta nakṣatrāṇi | śāṃtivaśyayoḥ saumyavārāḥ anyeṣu krūrāḥ | śāṃtivaśyastaṃbhaneṣu sthirāṇi lagnāni anyeṣu krūralagnāni | saumyakarmasu śubhasthānāni krūrakarmasutādṛśasthānāni | ityādayo'neke prakārāstattanmaṃtrajapādau voddhavyāḥ | iti maṃtrasaṃkṣepaḥ | etadvyatiriktānmaṃtrādi viśeṣān graṃthagauravānnalikhāmaḥ || bhosajjanāmamanatiḥ satataṃ bhavatsu kāryaṃ na jātu khalu sarvajanī name tat | vyaktī kṛtā yadihaguptatamāstumaṃtrāḥ saukaryatotra (*******) (?) || <1> ||
yadgopitaṃ maṃtrasamūharatnaṃ sarvāgamajñairvividhāgameṣu | vyaktīkṛtaṃ tanmamamaṃtrakoṣe gṛhnaṃ tu lubdhvā sukhino bhavaṃtu || <2> ||
śiṣṭo bhaṭṭasamāpa (****) (?) guṇa nidhirnaktya ca yovasthito nāmnaḥ premakarasya yo'janisutaḥ prītaḥ śivādityataḥ | [āśādityamatīśvaraḥ sakṛtavān śrīratnamaṃtrāvalīkoṣaṃ koṣavataḥ sato bhavati kiṃdāridryabhītiḥ kṣitau] || <3> || iti [śrīmadāśādityatripāṭhīsaṃgṛhītemaṃtrakoṣemudrādikathanaṃ] (##-)
<184a>
ādarśadoṣānmativibhramādvātvarāviśeṣāllikhanasyavegāt | yadatra vṛttaṃ tadaśuddhavarṇaṃ kṣamaṃ tu saṃtaḥ khalu lekhakasya || <1> ||
bhagnapṛṣṭhakaṭigrīvastaccadṛṣṭiradhomukhaḥ | kaṣṭena likhitāpustī putravat paripālayet || <2> ||
pustakalikhanapariśramavettā vidvajjano nānyaḥ | sārāralaṃghanakhedaṃ hanūmānekaḥ paraṃ veda || <3> ||
etat prayāsaṃ sakalaṃ samīkṣya haraṃti ye pustakamasmadīyaṃ | netrasya nāśaṃtana yasya śokaṃ sarvāṃgakuṣṭhaṃ labhatāṃ sa nityaṃ || <4> ||
śrīśāke <1565> pauṣavadi <13> vudhānurādhāyāṃ likhitaṃ manoharasuta śrīmadanaṃtarārmaṇā || śubhamastu || vidhaḥ sarvacarācarasyadaṃ ca nelabdhā pratiṣṭātvayā sarvaṃ sādhumayaṃ kṛtaṃ viracitaṃ cāturyahīnaṃ dvayaṃ | āmraṃ sādhusudhārasaṃ niramitaṃ sthūlena vījena kiṃ nirvīryauvanitā kucauviracitau ced vettayasyāṣutaṃ ||
